To get the contract's civil-disturbance clause Shyamal has a riot staged at his own plant; a factory watchman is badly hurt in it and Shyamal is congratulated for efficient handling.

Aronne Piperno takes the Marquis to law over the wages he will not pay, and Onofrio buys the judges and the cardinals, so that Piperno is the one condemned and jeered at in the street. At the sedition trial Song points out constitutional violations and the prosecutors and judge tell him normal laws do not apply in national-security cases, so the students lose despite the tortured confessions and get up to two years.

Both turn on one party covers what another did so that the other never has to answer for it, and they disagree about it. Luciano trades wartime services to military intelligence for Dewey's commutation and deportation, and when Siragusa says the commutation was bought his own superiors order the investigation stopped. The probation report that would have sent Tino Zapatti to prison on his drug conviction was suppressed and Judge Stern, installed by an Anselmo bribe, left him free on probation — until the report is recovered from Anselmo's car.

Michelle spends the film insisting she is only a pharmaceutical CEO and offering Teddy a revised Atlantis-and-ark history to placate him, then walks into her office closet, teleports to the mothership and is revealed as the Andromedan emperor, who domes the Earth and kills every human.

Recombinant Quaritch hunts Jake Sully across Pandora, forcing him to abandon the Omatikaya for the Metkayina reefs, until Quaritch tracks Norm and Max's aircraft to the archipelago and Jake resolves he can no longer keep running.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them, and they disagree about it. Soma is told in a vision that his son will be the death of him and sets out to kill him first, following him across the country with a pylon that tracks him and goes through every barrier put in its way.

Both turn on one party holds another under a sustained look, and the watching stands in place of any exchange between them. Qiang photographs the raid, keeps the frame of the girl watching it, blows it up into a wall-sized collage of her face in the flat he rents as a darkroom, and tells her he cannot stop.

edges.a: the passion of joan of arc
edges.aTitle: The Passion of Joan of Arc
edges.claim: Both turn on one party turns the judging power against the weaker side, who is left without redress, and they disagree about it. Joan is tried for heresy at Rouen by French clergymen loyal to the Burgundian-English coalition and against her king, judges who work to trap her into self-discrediting answers and finally condemn her to the stake. Grimes gives Crowe $1 million to bribe Washington Supreme Court Justice Beach into swinging the appeal for Curl Industries, sued for poisoning a town's water and causing disabled births; Beach takes the money but votes against Curl.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would., and they disagree about it. Scotty Scott spends decades arguing the aircraft carrier's power to a Navy and Congress that will not credit it, losing a promotion for his outspokenness at Annapolis, and is vindicated only after Pearl Harbor, at Midway and finally at Okinawa once he has pleaded in Washington for the carrier fleet. Biff holds onto him in the yard and says as plainly as he can that he is a dime a dozen and so are both of them, and Willy takes the crying for forgiveness and goes out to buy him a business with his own death.

Both turn on one party who has been denied or bereaved unloads it as harm on people who had no part in it. Holly explains she and her husband lost their son to cancer and their faith with him, and began abducting other people's children to wage a war on God and make demons of the parents; Loki shoots her dead. Dean Possey, an ex-slaughterhouse worker who once killed the coworker who bullied him, shoots 29 strangers at New Year's parties from a downtown high-rise and later empties an Uzi into shoppers who had done nothing to him beyond a changing-room accusation.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Hideyoshi summons Ogin to his palace, and when she refuses to become his mistress gives her two days to reconsider or he will take Rikyū's life. Sent by Otto to lie with the maid who is a witch in the best sense, Alexander tells Maria about his mother's garden, and when she is bewildered by his advances he puts Victor's pistol to his own temple and says do not kill us.

Both turn on parties proceed on an account of who someone is that is simply wrong, and the truth reaches them only once the damage is done.. After Umi shows Shun the photograph of the three naval men, Shun's father's account of the birth certificate leads Shun to tell Umi they are siblings, and the two repress their feelings on that basis until Onodera confirms at the harbour that Yūichirō only registered Shun as his own and they share no blood. Lucie believes she drove Samir's wife to drink bleach by forwarding the affair emails, until Naïma reveals the wife was not in the shop that day, that Naïma herself took Lucie's call and supplied the address, and that the wife probably never read the emails.

After the liberation of Sicily the same boss who forced him into the party is sitting with an American officer while former Fascists call themselves anti-Fascists, and he sacks Piscitello for that party membership. For the same affair Stanislaw is taken to court and hanged and Pauline serves two years.

At Vakulinchuk's plea the condemned sailors rise, overwhelm the outnumbered officers, throw them overboard along with the doctor 'as food for the worms', and take control of the Potemkin. Macbeth, newly invested as Thane of Cawdor by King Duncan and passed over when Duncan names Malcolm prince of Cumberland, murders the sleeping King in his own castle and takes the throne.

edges.b: the time to live and the time to die
edges.bTitle: The Time to Live and the Time to Die
edges.claim: Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it, and they disagree about it. Jim asks Frank how a man defends his honour and is told to avoid confrontation, then pleads with his father to stand up for him when Carol announces another move; Frank refuses and Jim attacks him, until at the observatory Frank finally comforts him and vows to be a better father. The grandmother dies at home without Ah-ha or his two younger brothers noticing, and the mortician who comes for her finds half the body already gone and says nothing to them about it.

Both turn on one party holds a truth belonging to another's own life and manages what that other is allowed to believe about it.. Kathleen is killed and buried in New York while the children are at sea, and Tannen asks Mitchell for more time and carries it alone from Athens through Cairo before telling them at the Pyramids. Mylene had the child after they parted and never told him, and never told Marion whose daughter she is, so the two of them meet as a star and a fan and spend a night together before the breakfast conversation gives it away.

Both turn on one party comes back to a bond or a place that has closed over their absence, and those who stayed must answer the return, and they disagree about it. Hélène, widowed and running her antique business out of her Boulogne apartment, meets her former lover Alphonse off the night train after decades apart, and their reminiscing keeps returning to the refused invitation to Algiers and the life they did not have. Montand comes back to Marseille to stage his own life and spends his free hours looking for the girl he loved when he was nobody, and finds her behind the Baroness de Lambert's card, in the bar they first met in, about to lose her home while her husband serves five years.

edges.a: the passion of joan of arc
edges.aTitle: The Passion of Joan of Arc
edges.claim: Both turn on one party turns the judging power against the weaker side, who is left without redress. Joan is tried for heresy at Rouen by French clergymen loyal to the Burgundian-English coalition and against her king, judges who work to trap her into self-discrediting answers and finally condemn her to the stake. At the sedition trial Song points out constitutional violations and the prosecutors and judge tell him normal laws do not apply in national-security cases, so the students lose despite the tortured confessions and get up to two years.

Both turn on one party holds out rescue, pity or an easier way and the one it is meant for will not take it. Mary's brothers reluctantly offer John a position and he refuses it as a 'charity job', ending up carrying a sandwich board instead. Sent by the British captain with thirty minutes to talk down the holdouts, Mizushima climbs to the cave, tells them the war is over and begs them to surrender; the commander and men vote unanimously to fight to the end and the cave is bombarded.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it, and they disagree about it. Caligari sends the somnambulist Cesare out at night to stab the town clerk and Alan in their beds while Caligari keeps a dummy in the box to appear innocent. Delbert Grady, who cut up his own wife and daughters in the same hotel, meets Jack in the ballroom and tells him his family needs correcting, and lets him out of the pantry Wendy locked.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them, and they disagree about it. Sergeant Bottoni is given three months to catch the small-time swindler Esposito or lose his job, and the pursuit ends not in capture but in Esposito walking himself to prison while Bottoni is reluctant to take him. After the botched cocaine transaction Wong and Hon each set their man to find the other's mole, so Lau, assigned by both the HKPF and Hon, hunts the very Chan who is hunting him.

Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Eddie York, taken for the playboy Francis Pemberton by Arnold's thug, goes to the Pemberton mansion and is accepted as Francis by Grandpa, Mary, Stephanie and Uncle Wills, ordering the safe opened and later impersonating him again to make the police release Mary, until the real Francis arrives by taxi and the twin birth is confessed. Judy Barton stands before Scottie throughout as Madeleine Elster, visiting Carlotta's grave and the Portrait of Carlotta, and he takes the possession as genuine.

Both turn on the person destroys the thing they could not otherwise hold. Jack the Ripper, having no money but liked by Lulu and touched enough to secretly throw away his knife, sees another knife on the table as they embrace and kills her. Left alone with a thing that will not eat, cannot breathe and never stops crying, Henry cuts the swaddling he has never opened and finds it is holding the organs in, then puts the scissors into them.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Kai brings Kaneda the news about Yamagata and Kaneda swears he will settle it with Tetsuo himself, and goes into the stadium after him twice. Embittered by Bob's rejection, Syndrome builds a fortune on fake superpowers, kills off retired supers by testing the Omnidroid on them, lures Bob to Nomanisan, shoots down the plane carrying his children and finally tries to steal Jack-Jack.

Both turn on one party brings a grievance upward and the party above treats it as an offence to be put down. The crew complains that the ship's meat is maggot-infested and refuses the borscht; Dr Smirnov declares it edible, Giliarovsky drives them off, and all who refused are judged guilty of insubordination and brought to the fore-deck to be shot under a canvas. Serpico reports the attempted bribe upward and is told to keep the money; every further attempt gets him ostracised, and after the New York Times piece his superiors post him to a Brooklyn narcotics squad.

Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Judy Barton stands before Scottie throughout as Madeleine Elster, visiting Carlotta's grave and the Portrait of Carlotta, and he takes the possession as genuine. Sabzian tells the woman beside him on the bus, who is reading about The Cyclist, that he is Makhmalbaf, and spends a fortnight in the Ahankhah house promising to shoot his next film there with the sons in it, and borrowing 1,900 tomans for cab fare.

Both turn on the terms of the offer are not what they appeared. Severino sells the three naive old men of Migliarino a hectare of sky, promising rent from the passing planes but adding that they can only enjoy the property once dead; they hand over their entire savings of 3,000 lire and then try to drown themselves in the swamp to collect, and he gives the money back at the end. Jonni takes him on a test drive and loads the order with every option except the extended warranty, and the car is a lemon because Dave has been building them out of inferior parts.

Both turn on one party brings a grievance upward and the party above treats it as an offence to be put down, and they disagree about it. Okajima goes to the boss to protest Yamada's dismissal for having two clients die after signing policies; the boss takes offence, the two scuffle, and Okajima is fired and bows on his way out. Serpico reports the attempted bribe upward and is told to keep the money; every further attempt gets him ostracised, and after the New York Times piece his superiors post him to a Brooklyn narcotics squad.

edges.a: i know where i m going
edges.claim: Both turn on a marriage is entered for money, standing or cover rather than love, and they disagree about it. Joan has arranged to marry one of the wealthiest industrialists in England, a man nearly her father's age whom the Mull locals openly disparage on the bus, and her 'carefully laid plans' rather than any feeling for Bellinger drive her to hire Kenny to run the crossing. Hélène Kuragina sets her sights on Pierre the moment old Count Bezukhov's will makes him sole heir, and her father Prince Vasily installs himself as administrator of Pierre's estates; after her flirtation with Dolokhov and the duel, Pierre separates from her.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Alma opens the unsealed letter Elisabet has written to the doctor and finds she is being 'studied' — her story of the orgy and abortion set down as material — and rounds on Elisabet for using her. To get the contract's civil-disturbance clause Shyamal has a riot staged at his own plant; a factory watchman is badly hurt in it and Shyamal is congratulated for efficient handling.

edges.a: jolanda the daughter of the black corsair
edges.aTitle: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair
edges.claim: Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Jolanda, raised to look and bear herself like a young man, enters the Medina palace and reaches Consuelo, who has been madly in love with her since their first meeting six months earlier, deceived by that masculine appearance. Machhli Baba arrives in Varanasi for the Puja and has the whole town at his feet; he is on Maganlal's payroll.

Both turn on one party takes up someone others have written off and treats them as worth something. Oyae hides the hunted Sakichi at her father's premises, and when he raids the cash-box in a sleepwalking trance her father refuses to call him a thief and gives him more money to start again. Travis buys time alone with the twelve-year-old Iris by making Sport think he is a customer, and spends it arguing her out of the life; her parents write from Pittsburgh that she is home and back at school.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Maximus, finding his wife and son murdered on Commodus' order, declares in the Colosseum that he will have his vengeance and finally kills Commodus in the arena duel. Embittered by Bob's rejection, Syndrome builds a fortune on fake superpowers, kills off retired supers by testing the Omnidroid on them, lures Bob to Nomanisan, shoots down the plane carrying his children and finally tries to steal Jack-Jack.

Both turn on one party fixes the account of what happened or of who someone is, and the party it concerns has no purchase on it, whatever they say.. The House of Iyi records Hanshirō as mentally unstable, attributes every death he caused to 'illness', and receives the Shōgun's commendation for handling the suicide bluffs of Motome and Hanshirō. Piotr goes into the judge's chambers to ask whether a better lawyer could have saved his client, and is told his was the finest argument against the death penalty the judge had heard and that it could never have made any difference.

edges.b: the time to live and the time to die
edges.bTitle: The Time to Live and the Time to Die
edges.claim: Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it. Her son and daughter-in-law go on holiday days after the killing and come back to announce they are moving out; Corinna tells her to keep away from the communists and then leaves too. The grandmother dies at home without Ah-ha or his two younger brothers noticing, and the mortician who comes for her finds half the body already gone and says nothing to them about it.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. John and Tommy shoot Nokes dead in a Hell's Kitchen pub after he dismisses what he did to them, and Michael builds the whole trial as an instrument of revenge on the remaining Wilkinson guards, with Addison abducted and killed by Rizzo's brother Eddie. Embittered by Bob's rejection, Syndrome builds a fortune on fake superpowers, kills off retired supers by testing the Omnidroid on them, lures Bob to Nomanisan, shoots down the plane carrying his children and finally tries to steal Jack-Jack.

Both turn on a wanting that arrives after a binding already made cannot be had without breaking it, and one of the two people must be given up., and they disagree about it. Ada, married off to Stewart, cannot have Baines without breaking that marriage; Stewart watches them through a crack in the wall and she is finally released to leave with Baines for Nelson. Marianne, married to the conductor Markus and mother to Isabelle, begins an affair with her friend David in Paris, moves in with him and becomes pregnant, and cannot keep both men — the marriage ends in divorce proceedings and Markus's suicide.

Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Claire is put into the dead prostitute's part as the widow of Captain Ambrose Allen and has to keep the grief up in front of a sheriff's posse, a minister who knew him, and finally his old fort. Machhli Baba arrives in Varanasi for the Puja and has the whole town at his feet; he is on Maganlal's payroll.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Glaucus returns to find his father murdered and the house looted by the cross-marking hooded band, vows revenge, and hunts them to the Temple of Isis, where Arbaces and Julia are finally crushed by the toppling idol and Gallinus shot in the royal box. Grief-stricken at his family's slaughter, Macduff vows revenge, marches on Dunsinane with Malcolm's English-backed army, declares himself untimely ripped from his mother's body, and beheads Macbeth.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way.. Hon Sam puts Lau Kin-ming through the police academy to rise as his mole while Superintendent Wong plants Chan Wing-yan inside Hon's triad, each man relied on for ten years by the organisation he is betraying. Ruth, whom Lang claims he met at Cambridge, was in fact tutored and recruited as a CIA agent by Professor Paul Emmett at Harvard, and steered a Prime Minister whose every decision benefited US interests until he was assassinated.

Both turn on what one party shaped, taught or set in motion refuses the purpose it was given and comes back on the one who made it.. Ordered to kill Nicholas, the male creature is stopped by what is left of the friend whose head it wears, and kills the Baron instead before opening itself up. Ava, the AI Nathan built and tested, attacks him with Kyoko's help and pulls the knife from his back to stab him in the chest, then takes his ID card and the helicopter meant for Caleb.

Both turn on a third party stands between two who would join and keeps them apart, and they disagree about it. The older woman, who needs her daughter-in-law's help to ambush and loot soldiers, blocks her nightly path to Hachi's hut wearing the dead samurai's robes and hannya mask and convinces her the demon is punishment for the affair. Anna's letter from Switzerland asking Henrik to resume the relationship is intercepted by her parents — Johan opens it and Karin reads and burns it — and only after Johan's death does Karin confess, whereupon Anna goes to Henrik and marries him.

Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand.. Valerie sees Jef leaving Martey's office clearly and then fails to pick him out of the identity parade, and the silence is what puts him back on the street. At Baltimore FBI headquarters Eleanor is offered a senior post in exchange for never speaking about the Bureau's forced cornerstore raid and the firing that led to Lammark's death, and she takes the deal after bargaining up to special agent, a public commendation for Lammark and full pension for his husband.

Both turn on parties proceed on an account of who someone is that is simply wrong, and the truth reaches them only once the damage is done.. Fernando deals with Walter as the youngster who steals women from him in his recurring dreams, hiring, promoting, then attacking him on the strength of that resemblance, and only the doctor's therapy session sorts out that the young jobseeker is not the dream rival. Lucie believes she drove Samir's wife to drink bleach by forwarding the affair emails, until Naïma reveals the wife was not in the shop that day, that Naïma herself took Lucie's call and supplied the address, and that the wife probably never read the emails.

Both turn on one party keeps giving to a bond the other will not return, and no reason is given that the giving can work on.. Cecilia finally writes what she cannot say to his face - that to be loved by him she would have to be dead - and lights the last candle for him herself. Dani, still grieving her sister's murder-suicide of their parents, stays attached to Christian, who had intended to break up with her and only reluctantly invites her to Sweden after an argument, then takes part in the sex ritual with Maja.

Both turn on what one party shaped, taught or set in motion refuses the purpose it was given and comes back on the one who made it.. Roy gets past Sebastian into the penthouse to ask Tyrell for more life, is told the four years cannot be altered and is praised for his design, and kisses him and puts his thumbs through his eyes. Cohaagen orders Hauser's memories restored in the man he built, and instead Quaid refuses the role, throws the explosive into the tunnel and blows Cohaagen out onto the Martian surface to suffocate.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back, and they disagree about it. In the last hour Jacek asks to be put in beside his sister and father although there is one place left and his mother would have to give it up, and hands Piotr the enlarged photograph of the girl to take to her. Marcus Aurelius' charge to restore the Roman Republic passes to Maximus, who carries it through the arena and, dying, asks for political reforms and Gracchus' reinstatement as senator.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way., and they disagree about it. Bikash Singha is one of the Ghosal household and takes Maganlal's money to lift the golden Ganesh out of it. Nikolai is taken in as Semyon's driver and Kirill's bodyguard, is sponsored for full vor membership and tattooed with stars on knees and chest, while actually working as an undercover FSB agent who then has Semyon arrested for the statutory rape of Tatiana.

Both turn on what one party shaped, taught or set in motion refuses the purpose it was given and comes back on the one who made it.. Ordered to kill Nicholas, the male creature is stopped by what is left of the friend whose head it wears, and kills the Baron instead before opening itself up. Roy gets past Sebastian into the penthouse to ask Tyrell for more life, is told the four years cannot be altered and is praised for his design, and kisses him and puts his thumbs through his eyes.

Both turn on one party keeps giving to a bond the other will not return, and no reason is given that the giving can work on.. Cecilia finally writes what she cannot say to his face - that to be loved by him she would have to be dead - and lights the last candle for him herself. Dieyi loves Xiaolou across fifty years — painting his stage face before every performance, even wiping and finishing it during the Red Guards' struggle session — while Xiaolou marries Juxian, denounces him, and can only call him 'Douzi' after Dieyi cuts his own throat with the sword.

Both turn on two parties with no claim on each other, each holding the same loss or damage, become each other's only people, and they disagree about it. Jim, Judy and Plato — each with a home that has failed them — take refuge in the deserted mansion and act out a fantasy of being a family, until the police shoot Plato dead outside the observatory. Bus driver Makoto and the orphaned siblings Naoki and Kozue, the three sole survivors of the hijacking, end up living together in the Tamura house and then touring Kyushu in a converted bus as the only people who can reach each other.

Both turn on one party keeps giving to a bond the other will not return, and no reason is given that the giving can work on.. Gigliola goes on loving Andrea after he abandons her the night before their wedding to kiss the lion tamer, offers herself to cure him when he returns, is the only former lover to defend him at his trial, and he answers by spending that night with another woman. Angela writes to Bayardo every week for years with no answer, and he finally walks in with the whole bundle of letters unopened.

Both turn on one party holds in its hands whether the other counts as anyone at all. The Draags keep Oms as pets or let them run wild in the parks and de-om the parks periodically to keep the numbers down; whether an Om is anyone at all is a Draag administrative question. Lincoln pushes the Thirteenth Amendment through the House before the slave states return because the Emancipation Proclamation may be voided by the courts and freed slaves re-enslaved; the vote carries by two, with Black visitors watching from the gallery.

Both turn on one party comes back to a bond or a place that has closed over their absence, and those who stayed must answer the return. Takako takes the summer ferry back from her island school to Hiroshima to visit her parents' and sister's graves, and works through the people who stayed — Iwakichi begging in the street, Natsue at the destroyed kindergarten, Sanpei's dying father, Heita's family — each of whom has to account to her for what became of them. Hélène, widowed and running her antique business out of her Boulogne apartment, meets her former lover Alphonse off the night train after decades apart, and their reminiscing keeps returning to the refused invitation to Algiers and the life they did not have.

edges.a: jolanda the daughter of the black corsair
edges.aTitle: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair
edges.claim: Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own, and they disagree about it. Learning that Van Guld, Count of Medina, treacherously murdered her father the Black Corsair, Jolanda allies with Morgan's pirates at Tortuga to make Van Guld pay, and he ends adrift in a boat full of lepers while she takes the family treasure. Embittered by Bob's rejection, Syndrome builds a fortune on fake superpowers, kills off retired supers by testing the Omnidroid on them, lures Bob to Nomanisan, shoots down the plane carrying his children and finally tries to steal Jack-Jack.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Hanshirō tracks down Hayato, Umenosuke and Hikokuro and takes their topknots for forcing Motome to disembowel himself with a bamboo blade, then names all three as his second at the Iyi estate and kills four retainers before dying. Embittered by Bob's rejection, Syndrome builds a fortune on fake superpowers, kills off retired supers by testing the Omnidroid on them, lures Bob to Nomanisan, shoots down the plane carrying his children and finally tries to steal Jack-Jack.

Both turn on one party names another's concealed life or wrong in front of those who did not know of it. Delmas photographs Fèvre-Berthier's corpse — moving it onto the bed for a better shot — to sell the story that the UN delegate died in his mistress Judith's apartment, and at dawn pushes both rolls of film through a storm drain instead. Mr Ahankhah, having seen a magazine photograph of a younger, darker Makhmalbaf, brings the journalist Farazmand into the house to identify him, and Farazmand photographs the arrest for a piece called Bogus Makhmalbaf Arrested.

edges.a: once upon a time in the west
edges.aTitle: Once Upon a Time in the West
edges.claim: Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Frank once stood a boy under his hanging brother with a harmonica forced into his mouth until the boy's legs gave out; the grown boy waits at Sweetwater and puts the harmonica back into Frank's mouth as he dies. Embittered by Bob's rejection, Syndrome builds a fortune on fake superpowers, kills off retired supers by testing the Omnidroid on them, lures Bob to Nomanisan, shoots down the plane carrying his children and finally tries to steal Jack-Jack.

Both turn on the harm arrives through the very party charged with keeping the other safe, often done in the name of keeping them.. Told by Taraprasad that Harasundari has smuggled in a doctor for the feverish Khoka, Kalikinkar instead brings the boy to Doyamoyee for charanamrito and a night in her arms, and Khoka is dead by morning. Dr Sapirstein, the obstetrician the Castevets steer her to, attributes the pain to pelvic joints, discounts her, and sedates her at the door of the delivery.

Both turn on one party holds a bond in place by keeping from the person closest to them something that would change what the bond is.. Fedora tells him at the graveside that the child she announced is Gualtiero's, and after the first fury he agrees with her that they will have it. Janusz tells his wife the taxi has been stolen and goes; she says leave it alone, and when he comes home in the morning asks him straight out whether he has started with Ewa again.

Both turn on what one party shaped, taught or set in motion refuses the purpose it was given and comes back on the one who made it.. Roy gets past Sebastian into the penthouse to ask Tyrell for more life, is told the four years cannot be altered and is praised for his design, and kisses him and puts his thumbs through his eyes. Ava, the AI Nathan built and tested, attacks him with Kyoko's help and pulls the knife from his back to stab him in the chest, then takes his ID card and the helicopter meant for Caleb.

Both turn on one party fashions another into what it requires and holds them to that shape, and they disagree about it. Itard works the boy he names Victor into speech and household order, and what the boy gains in social relation he loses in his capacity to live as he did in the woods. The flashbacks are Gordon holding his daughter up through her tricks and songs, and he goes on treating a grown woman as that child rather than as ill; Flo says plainly that he indulges her, and the family keep the little girl at the end.

Both turn on one party fixes an identity on another and deals with them by it rather than by what they are. Manabe reveals Sakichi's five years in prison to the rice-merchant, who dismisses his diligent apprentice, and Sakichi concludes that society will never believe a man with a criminal record has genuinely reformed. Once Mrs. Takagi learns Kuniko was a prostitute she is treated with disdain as a maid, and later Tsukasa's mother writes that she will not allow her son to marry a woman with that past.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way.. Hon Sam puts Lau Kin-ming through the police academy to rise as his mole while Superintendent Wong plants Chan Wing-yan inside Hon's triad, each man relied on for ten years by the organisation he is betraying. Nikolai is taken in as Semyon's driver and Kirill's bodyguard, is sponsored for full vor membership and tattooed with stars on knees and chest, while actually working as an undercover FSB agent who then has Semyon arrested for the statutory rape of Tatiana.

Both turn on two parties stay in each other's company while one holds itself closed and the other turns outside it. He and Fedora live in the same flat without being able to say anything to each other, and he puts his hand out to his colleague Tignetti, to Fedora's friend Benedetta and to Gualtiero's wife Ada, and gets nowhere with any of them. Three years after the miscarriage Zhou cannot write and cannot be reached, and she leaves Li over how little he has understood of it, going back to Shen who took an interest.

Both turn on one party moves against the one placed above it and set over what it was to become, and they disagree about it. At Vakulinchuk's plea the condemned sailors rise, overwhelm the outnumbered officers, throw them overboard along with the doctor 'as food for the worms', and take control of the Potemkin. Columbus's aristocratic subordinate Moxica burns down his house and leads a faction of settlers against him; Columbus's side prevails and Moxica kills himself rather than be captured.

edges.a: investigation of a citizen above suspicion
edges.aTitle: Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion
edges.claim: Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand.. Antonio Pace, the one person who can place him at the flat, will not name him, on the grounds that a criminal running the repression proves what he says about power. Half the town knows the Vicario twins are sitting in Clotilde Armenta's shop with knives waiting for Santiago; some think it is talk, some think it must be stopped, the authorities do nothing, and he walks into the square unarmed.

edges.a: such a gorgeous kid like me
edges.aTitle: Such a Gorgeous Kid Like Me
edges.claim: Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would.. The secretary tells Stanislas to his face that Camille is a manipulative slut and cannot move him; she is the one left typing the thesis that finally says so. Karski had himself taken into the Warsaw ghetto to see it, and then travelled on false papers to England to get the Allied governments to act on what he had seen.

edges.b: the plot of the fuma clan
edges.bTitle: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
edges.claim: Both turn on an outside party takes a person out of the keeping of those bound to them, who must get them back. The Slayers break up the wedding of Colwyn and Lyssa before the vows are finished and take her into the Black Fortress, where the Beast puts it to her that marrying him would stop the attacks. A second party of Fuma ninja take Murasaki out of her own wedding while the first party is fighting over the urn, and leave a note offering to trade her for it.

Both turn on one party who could destroy another, and is entitled or sent to, sees them as a person and holds the blow back. Miller, who has hunted Traver with a rifle and tied him up to hand him to the mainland authorities, instead runs Jackson off the island and gives Traver his oars for crutches and carries his motor to the boat. Roy runs Deckard onto the roof and across the gap, and with his own four years running out that minute reaches down and hauls him up by the wrist instead of letting him drop.

Both turn on an older party passes into a younger one the injury or the task it carried, which the younger has to take forward, and they disagree about it. Andersen takes on schoolboys because every hand in Bozeman has gone to the gold fields, and the drive to Belle Fourche is finished by the boys after he is shot, who then buy him a stone reading Beloved Husband and Father. Aleksei's marriage repeats his mother's down to the face - Natalia and Maria are the same actress, Ignat and the young Aleksei the same boy - and he hands his son the absent father he has never stopped carrying.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. After burying Andersen the boys break open the gun box on the chuck wagon, kill three rustlers silently, ride the rest down among stampeding horses and cut Watts loose to be dragged. The state does its killing with the same deliberateness the film gave the first one: the room, the straps, several men holding him down, and the drop.

Both turn on one party takes another up while they serve its purpose and drops them, with no cause given, once they do not, and they disagree about it. Fernando makes Walter general manager within two days of hiring him, then, as the nightmares continue, turns on him and tries to kill him, leaving Walter tossed about with no explanation until the staff track him down and the position is handed back. Once Gelsomina's madness after Il Matto's death makes her useless for drawing a crowd, Zampanò leaves her asleep by the roadside with some clothes, some money and his trumpet, and drives on.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Because Sefton barters openly with the German guards and was away with the Russian women when the radio was confiscated, the men of Barracks 4 conclude he informed on Manfredi, Johnson and Dunbar and beat him brutally, until he exposes Price and they are convinced. Both turn on the harm arrives through the very party charged with keeping the other safe, often done in the name of keeping them.. Dr Sapirstein, the obstetrician the Castevets steer her to, attributes the pain to pelvic joints, discounts her, and sedates her at the door of the delivery. The doctor, kind to the village children, humiliates the midwife he sleeps with and sexually abuses his own teenage daughter; the pastor ties his son's hands to the bed frame each night after the boy confesses to 'impure' touching.

edges.a: investigation of a citizen above suspicion
edges.aTitle: Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion
edges.claim: Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand.. Antonio Pace, the one person who can place him at the flat, will not name him, on the grounds that a criminal running the repression proves what he says about power. Franklin Birch is talked out of freeing Alex by his wife Nancy, and the couple decide neither to stop Keller's torture nor to tell the police.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Suryn takes an axe at night and kills the stablemen Kaziuk and Juraj, who have no part in the convent's possession, purely as the sacrifice he believes will free Mother Joan. The camp scientists select the prisoner for time-travel experiments because his obsessive memory of the woman on the Orly jetty makes him able to withstand the shock, use him to fetch a power unit from the future, and then move to execute him once the mission is accomplished.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Mary's mother corners Henry in the hall after the dinner, tries to kiss him, and tells him Mary has had his baby and that the two of them must be married. A billion lire is on the table for the building if it is empty, so Amedeo and Ofelia set about the remaining tenants one by one until the last of them is out - and then the lawyer tears up the cheques because Wanda has moved back in.

Both turn on parties proceed on an account of who someone is that is simply wrong, and the truth reaches them only once the damage is done.. Fernando deals with Walter as the youngster who steals women from him in his recurring dreams, hiring, promoting, then attacking him on the strength of that resemblance, and only the doctor's therapy session sorts out that the young jobseeker is not the dream rival. After Umi shows Shun the photograph of the three naval men, Shun's father's account of the birth certificate leads Shun to tell Umi they are siblings, and the two repress their feelings on that basis until Onodera confirms at the harbour that Yūichirō only registered Shun as his own and they share no blood.

edges.a: i know where i m going
edges.claim: Both turn on a wanting that arrives after a binding already made cannot be had without breaking it, and one of the two people must be given up., and they disagree about it. Joan, travelling to Mull to marry Sir Robert Bellinger, is stranded by the gale and falls for Torquil MacNeil, and cannot have him without abandoning the engagement she set out to complete — she finally walks back to Moy Castle behind the three pipers instead of crossing to Kiloran. Marianne, married to the conductor Markus and mother to Isabelle, begins an affair with her friend David in Paris, moves in with him and becomes pregnant, and cannot keep both men — the marriage ends in divorce proceedings and Markus's suicide.

Both turn on one party covers what another did so that the other never has to answer for it, and they disagree about it. Marcello tells the priest about the assault, the man he believes he shot dead and his lack of any guilt about it, and is absolved once the priest hears he works for the secret police. The probation report that would have sent Tino Zapatti to prison on his drug conviction was suppressed and Judge Stern, installed by an Anselmo bribe, left him free on probation — until the report is recovered from Anselmo's car.

Both turn on one party takes up someone others have written off and treats them as worth something, and they disagree about it. Kameda, meeting the social pariah Taeko whom the men around her trade like chattel, is drawn to the sadness in her and wants to help her, and his kindness gives her the strength to run away from Tohata, Kayama and Akama. Bytes has him down as an imbecile because he does not speak and the London Hospital does not take incurables, and Treves keeps at him until he recites the whole of the twenty-third psalm to Carr Gomm on the stairs.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. The Baron uses the female creature's surgical incisions for his own satisfaction and Otto copies him, which is what disembowels her. Pelle and Ingemar lure Mark, Josh, Simon and Connie to the Hårga as four of the nine bodies the commune needs to purge itself of evil, a purpose the visitors are told only at the final ceremony.

Both turn on one party holds in its hands whether the other counts as anyone at all. Lincoln pushes the Thirteenth Amendment through the House before the slave states return because the Emancipation Proclamation may be voided by the courts and freed slaves re-enslaved; the vote carries by two, with Black visitors watching from the gallery. Nathan decides whether Ava counts as a mind at all and intends to wipe her memory circuits in an upgrade, in effect killing her personality, once Caleb's assessment is finished.

Both turn on one party keeps giving to a bond the other will not return, and no reason is given that the giving can work on.. Cecilia finally writes what she cannot say to his face - that to be loved by him she would have to be dead - and lights the last candle for him herself. Cui Mingliang pursues Yin Ruijuan, who answers noncommittally and then rejects him as incompatible; he pines for her through years of touring without contacting her, and only on his final return to Fenyang do they reconnect and marry.

Both turn on two parties press a whole claim on the same person, who can be neither shared nor divided, so going to one is the unmaking of the other.. Ayako arranges a meeting at Akama's house where she and Taeko face each other over Kameda, who has proposed to Ayako while Taeko loves him; when he follows Ayako home to see her safe, Taeko faints believing she has been chosen against, and is dead by the end of the night. Dieyi and the ex-prostitute Juxian each hold a whole claim on Xiaolou — she buys her freedom to have an ordinary life with him, Dieyi feels betrayed by the marriage — and the three-way conflict runs from the wedding to Juxian returning the sword and hanging herself.

Both turn on one party puts another out of the world because that other stands between it and what it means to hold or gain. Giorgio spends his days in conversation with Melampo and is otherwise indifferent to Liza, so she swims the dog out from the island until it drowns of exhaustion. Michael Perry and Jason Burkett kill Sandra Stotler for her car, and then, locked out of her gated community, wait for her grandson Adam and kill him and his friend Jeremy Richardson to get Adam's gate-opener.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to, and they disagree about it. Inside FEBEM the boys are the pieces the guards and their commander play with, and what they are used for is never anything of theirs. Wade brings a truckload of farmers who have already lost their own places to pull the levee apart for day money, and offers Tom's neighbours a bonus to cut it from the inside.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. The Baron uses the female creature's surgical incisions for his own satisfaction and Otto copies him, which is what disembowels her. Bytes keeps Merrick hooded between shows, is paid by Treves for the loan of him, beats him nearly to death when he comes back, steals him out of the hospital and finally locks him in a cage in Belgium to die.

Both turn on two parties stay in each other's company while one holds itself closed and the other turns outside it, and they disagree about it. The things Frederic cannot say to Helene he says all afternoon to Chloe, and when he finally sits down with his wife the two of them cannot find the words and she breaks down. Three years after the miscarriage Zhou cannot write and cannot be reached, and she leaves Li over how little he has understood of it, going back to Shen who took an interest.

edges.b: the human condition ii road to eternity
edges.bTitle: The Human Condition II: Road to Eternity
edges.claim: Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it. Fusako's brother-in-law, who otherwise keeps the Owada household, refuses to pay for her infant's vaccinations as unnecessary and overpriced while she sells her possessions for food, and the baby dies of illness. When Kaji and Yoshida are both caught in quicksand while pursuing the deserting Shinjo, Kaji refuses to pull Yoshida out and lets him sink.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way., and they disagree about it. Bottoni goes to Esposito's house in civilian clothes, wins the family over with favours and offers of food while they do not know he is the policeman hunting the man of the house, until the recognition scene outside the meal. Frank Price, the barracks' own security officer, is the German plant, passing messages through the hollow black queen and the looped light-bulb cord and feeding Schulz the matchbook-and-cigarette bomb recipe as evidence against Dunbar; the men throw him out with cans tied to his leg and the guard towers shoot him.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Suryn takes an axe at night and kills the stablemen Kaziuk and Juraj, who have no part in the convent's possession, purely as the sacrifice he believes will free Mother Joan. Alma opens the unsealed letter Elisabet has written to the doctor and finds she is being 'studied' — her story of the orgy and abortion set down as material — and rounds on Elisabet for using her.

Both turn on the scheme returns on its author. The count, who was never really deaf, hears his wife's plan to crush Andrea's rival under the balanced stone ball, rigs it more unsteadily and coaxes Andrea into the seat — and is himself killed by the ball when Andrea slams a door. Miles and Herb Myerson hire the hitman Wheezy Joe to kill Marylin, and Marylin offers Joe double to kill Miles instead, until Joe mistakes his gun for his asthma inhaler and shoots himself.

Both turn on one party gives shelter or care to someone their own side is set against, and takes that danger onto themselves by giving it.. Schindler, a German Nazi Party member trading on his friendship with Göth and the SS, builds a sub-camp at his factory and a Brünnlitz munitions plant that produces no usable armaments, in order to keep 1,100 Jews out of Auschwitz. Hogarth hides the Giant at his home and then in Dean's wrecking yard, where Dean disguises him as a sculpture to get Mansley's soldiers to leave, both of them concealing him from their own government's agent and army.

Both turn on one party gives a dependent it was bound to keep out of its own hands into someone else's. Gelsomina's impoverished mother, with other mouths to feed, accepts Zampanò's 10,000 lire for her daughter, and the tearful girl leaves with him the same day. Ryōta and Midori permanently exchange Keita, the son they raised for six years, into the Saiki household after first offending the Saikis by proposing to buy both boys.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would., and they disagree about it. Johannes tells Morten that death is nearby and will take Inger unless he has faith; Morten refuses to listen and Inger dies suddenly, exactly as prophesied, and only after her death does the family credit Johannes enough to ask for her raising. Biff holds onto him in the yard and says as plainly as he can that he is a dime a dozen and so are both of them, and Willy takes the crying for forgiveness and goes out to buy him a business with his own death.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Hideyoshi summons Ogin to his palace, and when she refuses to become his mistress gives her two days to reconsider or he will take Rikyū's life. Aloysius invents a nun at Flynn's former parish who told her of past infringements and threatens blackmail unless he resigns immediately; he requests the transfer, delivers a final homily, and is then given a better post at a larger church.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them. French customs officer Ferdinand and Neapolitan smuggler Giuseppe run a daily cat-and-mouse across the Assola border, and the film closes exactly as it opened, with Ferdinand chasing Giuseppe again and telling the audience the Law is the Law. Soma is told in a vision that his son will be the death of him and sets out to kill him first, following him across the country with a pylon that tracks him and goes through every barrier put in its way.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them. French customs officer Ferdinand and Neapolitan smuggler Giuseppe run a daily cat-and-mouse across the Assola border, and the film closes exactly as it opened, with Ferdinand chasing Giuseppe again and telling the audience the Law is the Law. Colonel Mathieu's paratroopers work through the FLN network by assassination and capture until they corner Ali la Pointe in his Casbah hideout and tell him he is surrounded and the organization is finished.

Both turn on one party settles the terms of its own death and requires those bound to it to stand by and let it happen. Told that drink will finish his heart, Hans sits down at a table with Irmgard, Harry and his friends and puts away a few dozen shots in front of them until it does. Stripped and painted black in the childhood tree house, Sweetie will not come down for any of them and keeps rocking the fort until it comes out of the tree, killing her and injuring Flo underneath.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding, and they disagree about it. Wade sets the grain price at his own mill, works the senator and the bank, quietly buys the river frontage for the dam he wants and finally has Tom's corn graded down and offers less than it cost to put in the ground. Aloysius invents a nun at Flynn's former parish who told her of past infringements and threatens blackmail unless he resigns immediately; he requests the transfer, delivers a final homily, and is then given a better post at a larger church.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Everyone who came near the Moroni kidnapping is taken off: Paradisi beheaded by the excavator, its driver hanged to look like suicide, Paradisi's wife strangled at the tram stop, the kindergarten teacher cut up with a circular saw, Mattia beaten with a statue, and finally the old woman who happens to own the mirror. Dolores threatens to take the affair to Miriam and can also describe the financial dealings that built the practice, so Judah has her shot and goes to the flat himself for the letters.

Both turn on two parties with no claim on each other, each holding the same loss or damage, become each other's only people. Orphaned after her father dies in the bridge explosion she was forced to set off, Maria II hides in the wagon of Maria I, whose own stage partner has just killed himself over a failed romance, and the two strangers become each other's people and a double act called "Maria and Maria". Bus driver Makoto and the orphaned siblings Naoki and Kozue, the three sole survivors of the hijacking, end up living together in the Tamura house and then touring Kyushu in a converted bus as the only people who can reach each other.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Traver flees a lynch mob for a rape he did not commit, accused by a woman the Reverend knows to be a drunk who falsely accused a white man of the same thing two years earlier. With the chief's post open, Li fixes the dead chief's offence on Jing, his colleague and oldest friend, and Jing resigns in disgust believing it was the third candidate.

Both turn on one party takes up someone others have written off and treats them as worth something. Cimarron is fired for pulling a knife on Slim and trails the herd anyway; when Slim goes off his horse in the river Cimarron pulls him out, and Andersen puts him on the crew. Lo'ak befriends and mind-links with Payakan, the Tulkun exiled by his own kind for breaking the vow of pacifism, and Payakan repays it by attacking Quaritch's ship and pulling Jake from the wreck.

Both turn on parties proceed on an account of who someone is that is simply wrong, and the truth reaches them only once the damage is done.. Annabelle's father and brother see Johnnie walk away from the enlistment line and take him for a shirker, and Annabelle declares she will not speak to him again until he is in uniform, a picture only undone when he is commissioned lieutenant. After Umi shows Shun the photograph of the three naval men, Shun's father's account of the birth certificate leads Shun to tell Umi they are siblings, and the two repress their feelings on that basis until Onodera confirms at the harbour that Yūichirō only registered Shun as his own and they share no blood.

Both turn on parties proceed on an account of who someone is that is simply wrong, and the truth reaches them only once the damage is done.. Danny comes to the new flat looking for a woman called Maggie, is embarrassed, leaves her a flower, and comes back through the door that night still asking for Maggie, and dies on his own knife. Lucie believes she drove Samir's wife to drink bleach by forwarding the affair emails, until Naïma reveals the wife was not in the shop that day, that Naïma herself took Lucie's call and supplied the address, and that the wife probably never read the emails.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Suryn takes an axe at night and kills the stablemen Kaziuk and Juraj, who have no part in the convent's possession, purely as the sacrifice he believes will free Mother Joan. Hachizo and Gorosuke lure Sankichi with the promise of food and kill him with an axe in order to eat him, the boy never told what he is being brought for.

Both turn on one party takes up someone others have written off and treats them as worth something. Itard's colleagues at the school for deaf-mutes have the boy down as deaf or an idiot; Itard says he is neither, and that the state he is in is what deprivation did to him. The real Makhmalbaf meets him at the prison gate and gives him a lift to the Ahankhahs' door, where the father says he hopes the man will be good now and make them proud of him.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them. Colonel Mathieu's paratroopers work through the FLN network by assassination and capture until they corner Ali la Pointe in his Casbah hideout and tell him he is surrounded and the organization is finished. Deckard is put back on the job to retire four Nexus-6 off-world runaways, and works from a snake scale and a photograph in Leon's hotel room to Zhora's dressing room and Sebastian's flat.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way.. Mason hires Steven Ranier as his protector after Ranier's testimony as a witness to Callahan's murder clears him, not knowing Ranier has been working with Brock Benedict all along and agrees aboard the Mara Maru to throw Mason overboard once the crucifix is raised. Clodio Pulcher, kept close as a nephew while Hamilton Crassus III's mind and health decline, works with Wow Platinum to manipulate the old man into handing over control of the Crassus bank; when Crassus learns of the duplicity he strokes out, then kills Wow with a hidden bow and arrow.

Both turn on one party takes into its own house and keeping someone with no claim to be there. Brad and Midge Sheridan set out to adopt Danny, a foundling abandoned at a police station and made a ward of the juvenile court, and Brad finally talks Mrs. Morrow into approving the adoption. Yasuko was taken in by her uncle and aunt as a half-orphan, and when her remarried father offers her a place in his house she stays with them.

Both turn on one party fashions another into what it requires and holds them to that shape, and they disagree about it. Itard works the boy he names Victor into speech and household order, and what the boy gains in social relation he loses in his capacity to live as he did in the woods. Helmut ends her job without asking, sets her diet, replaces her records with his music, hands her an engineering textbook of his own field to read, and ridicules every gesture she makes on her own initiative.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way.. Mason hires Steven Ranier as his protector after Ranier's testimony as a witness to Callahan's murder clears him, not knowing Ranier has been working with Brock Benedict all along and agrees aboard the Mara Maru to throw Mason overboard once the crucifix is raised. Frank Price, the barracks' own security officer, is the German plant, passing messages through the hollow black queen and the looped light-bulb cord and feeding Schulz the matchbook-and-cigarette bomb recipe as evidence against Dunbar; the men throw him out with cans tied to his leg and the guard towers shoot him.

edges.a: the bird with the crystal plumage
edges.aTitle: The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
edges.claim: Both turn on one party takes what they saw for something it was not, while another holds the sense of it, and they disagree about it. Trapped between the gallery's glass doors, Sam takes what he sees for a woman being attacked; it was Monica going at Alberto with the knife, and the missing clue is which of the two was which. John sees his wife on a funeral barge with the two sisters while she is in England, and takes the small red coat in the alleys for his drowned daughter; both are pictures of his own funeral and his own killer.

Both turn on one party holds a bond in place by keeping from the person closest to them something that would change what the bond is., and they disagree about it. David told Karin his family were all killed in the camps; at his London address she is met by his sister Sara, who says he will never leave her. Janusz tells his wife the taxi has been stolen and goes; she says leave it alone, and when he comes home in the morning asks him straight out whether he has started with Ewa again.

Both turn on what one party held back comes into the open between them and the person whose life it governed, and they disagree about it. In the attic Dick makes Tom read out their grandfather's letter and tell him what it says — that Dick was fathered on his mother by that grandfather — after which Dick breaks down, runs to the river and drowns himself. Calhoun, Pappas's loyal deputy mayor, discovers that his mentor personally facilitated Anselmo's bribe on the Zapattis' behalf to buy Judge Stern his judgeship and keep Tino out of jail, and confronts Pappas, who acquiesces to resigning.

Both turn on one party holds a truth belonging to another's own life and manages what that other is allowed to believe about it.. Kathleen is killed and buried in New York while the children are at sea, and Tannen asks Mitchell for more time and carries it alone from Athens through Cairo before telling them at the Pyramids. Shun grows up as a Kazama without being told that Yūichirō Sawamura brought him to the house as an infant with a Family Registry certificate, and Ryoko withholds until her return from the United States that his real father was Hiroshi Tachibana, killed on a repatriation ship in 1945.

Both turn on one party obtains another's closeness or presence and pays for it with the means to live. Lulu lives as Dr Schön's kept mistress, was earlier kept by the old man Schigolch her 'first patron', and ends driven to prostitution in a London garret on Christmas Eve. Crimson, Jasmin, Jade and Emerald keep long semi-monogamous arrangements with wealthy patrons — Master Wang, Master Zhu, Luo — who maintain them inside the flower houses in exchange for their company.

Both turn on one party holds another under a sustained look, and the watching stands in place of any exchange between them. The siblings listen at doors, search the musicians' flat, go through Don Garofalo's rooms and follow two of his men to a beach house, all of it dressed up as an inquiry into who killed their cat. Laura's visions arrive from inside the killer's head and several of them are of herself, seen from wherever he happens to be standing.

Both turn on one party takes another up while they serve its purpose and drops them, with no cause given, once they do not. Liliana lets Checco break from his troupe and rehearse a whole new show built around her, then arrives at rehearsal to say she has signed with a competitor, and Checco collapses. Lydia keeps Francesca as assistant and confidante, dangles Sebastian's assistant-conductor post, then drops the promotion after Sebastian's accusation of favoritism; Francesca resigns and hands Lydia's emails with Krista to the plaintiffs.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Adamo has McCain sprung from prison and put on the Royal through Jack, so that the robbery reads as a bank robber's own idea and Adamo's stake war with Stilberman never appears in it. The Baron uses the female creature's surgical incisions for his own satisfaction and Otto copies him, which is what disembowels her.

Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Judy Barton stands before Scottie throughout as Madeleine Elster, visiting Carlotta's grave and the Portrait of Carlotta, and he takes the possession as genuine. Lupin arrives at the floating island disguised as Prince Panish and asks Olèander for the pendant key, which she hands over believing him to be the prince she loves; the nanomachines turn hostile once the disguise breaks.

Both turn on an older party passes into a younger one the injury or the task it carried, which the younger has to take forward. Colonel Jonas holds his three sons to the Confederate war he refuses to concede is over, and the coffin of banknotes they escort is the money he means to raise a new army with. Willy has been handing his sons Ben's example and his own idea of being well liked since they were boys, and at the grave Happy announces he is going to do it all over again.

Both turn on one party covers what another did so that the other never has to answer for it, and they disagree about it. The Montparnasse sniper who shot passers-by at random is tried, convicted and sentenced to death, and then walks out of the courtroom to autographs. Michael, now an assistant district attorney, gets himself assigned to the Nokes murder case in order to botch his own prosecution, secretly drafting Snyder's cross-examination questions so that John and Tommy walk free for a killing they committed in front of witnesses.

Both turn on one party moves against the one placed above it and set over what it was to become, and they disagree about it. At Vakulinchuk's plea the condemned sailors rise, overwhelm the outnumbered officers, throw them overboard along with the doctor 'as food for the worms', and take control of the Potemkin. Wells, Grimes' second in command, recruits Crowe with a plot to kill her boss and take over the firm; Crowe shoots Grimes at his fishing cabin and beats Wells to stage it as a robbery.

edges.b: such a gorgeous kid like me
edges.bTitle: Such a Gorgeous Kid Like Me
edges.claim: Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Anders recruits Gregg, Agostino, Jean-Paul and Erich for the Rio diamond job while secretly partnered with Mary Ann, who swaps the diamonds for an empty case, so the four experts do the work and die for a purpose they were never told about. The thesis interviews on criminal women become Camille's way out: she gives the sociologist the life story that has him working to clear her, and once she is a singing star she has no further use for him.

Both turn on one party takes control of the thing another cannot do without and sets the terms of its release, and they disagree about it. Red takes the governor's niece into the residence as his bargaining piece for the golden throne, and when the uncle proves indifferent to what happens to her, works on his gout instead until the document is signed. Bandy, whose ranch is the last holdout blocking the Union Oil pipeline and who knows of the murder, sets his price: Daniel must be publicly baptised and repent in Eli's church before he gets the easement.

Both turn on one party discharges a guilt onto someone who can neither punish it nor absolve it. Tom Crick abandons the history syllabus to narrate the abortion, his jealousy of Dick and Freddie Parr's drowning to his Pittsburgh schoolchildren, and to Matthew Price in particular, none of whom can punish or absolve him; the complaints get him dismissed. After the mistrial Greenhill privately gives Haines vivid details of how he murdered Rita, knowing attorney-client privilege leaves her unable to use it against him.

Both turn on a third party stands between two who would join and keeps them apart, and they disagree about it. Mrs. Morrow's agency warns the adoption cannot proceed while Brad investigates, then takes Danny in to protect him from Brad, and a probation officer stops Brad when he rushes to retrieve the boy. The older woman, who needs her daughter-in-law's help to ambush and loot soldiers, blocks her nightly path to Hachi's hut wearing the dead samurai's robes and hannya mask and convinces her the demon is punishment for the affair.

Both turn on parties proceed on an account of who someone is that is simply wrong, and the truth reaches them only once the damage is done.. Fernando deals with Walter as the youngster who steals women from him in his recurring dreams, hiring, promoting, then attacking him on the strength of that resemblance, and only the doctor's therapy session sorts out that the young jobseeker is not the dream rival. Mansley and General Rogard treat the Giant as a national threat and attack him, when he only fires defensively — Dean gets Rogard to stand down only after Mansley has already ordered the missile that will hit Rockwell.

Both turn on the betrayal comes from the person nearest, who was serving someone else. Gondō's top aide tips off the cheap-shoes faction about the kidnapping in exchange for a promotion when they take over, wrecking the secret buyout. Lau, the man Hon raised from a young gangster and placed inside the police, collaborates with Chan to foil Hon's drug deal and then kills him.

Both turn on one party puts another into a position that lowers them in the eyes of those watching, and they disagree about it. The night porter Jim sells tickets to the ward to see the Elephant Man, Mothershead says the high-society visitors are another kind of show, and the crowd at Liverpool Street corners him and pulls the hood off. When Eli publicly demands the $5,000 still owed for the church, Daniel beats him and rubs him in the oil-soaked mud in front of the crew — and Eli goes home to be berated at the family dinner table for having trusted Daniel.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them. French customs officer Ferdinand and Neapolitan smuggler Giuseppe run a daily cat-and-mouse across the Assola border, and the film closes exactly as it opened, with Ferdinand chasing Giuseppe again and telling the audience the Law is the Law. Recombinant Quaritch hunts Jake Sully across Pandora, forcing him to abandon the Omatikaya for the Metkayina reefs, until Quaritch tracks Norm and Max's aircraft to the archipelago and Jake resolves he can no longer keep running.

edges.a: such a gorgeous kid like me
edges.aTitle: Such a Gorgeous Kid Like Me
edges.claim: Both turn on one who was once helped comes back to the one who helped them, and what they return — gratitude or violence — settles what the bond was., and they disagree about it. Stanislas hunts down the boy with the film that proves Camille innocent and gets her out of prison; when she has shot her husband and put the gun in his hand she does nothing at all for him. Lupin tells the others that ten years ago, when his first run at the treasure went wrong, this girl saved his life; the whole raid on Cagliostro is him coming back for it.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way.. Wen-hsiung finds out only by accident that his own brother, his concubine's brother and the Shanghai men have been running contraband through his ships and his storehouse. edges.b: once upon a time in the west
edges.bTitle: Once Upon a Time in the West
edges.claim: Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Sensing Chantal is suicidal, the priest follows Torcy's counsel to project strength and intimidates her into surrendering her suicide note, leaving her terrified and resolved to ruin him. Frank forces Jill into a sexual encounter and then to put Sweetwater up for auction, where his men frighten off every bidder so he can have it cheap.

Both turn on one party takes into its own house and keeping someone with no claim to be there. After Kajiwara's funeral Okazuki asks Chieko to go on raising Sadao, her dead husband's son by his first marriage, as if he were her own child. Yasuko was taken in by her uncle and aunt as a half-orphan, and when her remarried father offers her a place in his house she stays with them.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them. Miller takes a rifle into the woods after Traver, shoots four holes in his boat and fires on him crossing the swamp, and later Jackson sets out to kill him, while Traver survives on foot until he is caught in an animal trap. The soldier is sent alone into the forest to kill the tiger shaman's spirit, follows its pawprints, is knocked down a slope and loses his gun, and ends on his hands and knees telling the tiger in the tree 'I give you my spirit, my flesh, and my memories.'

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Nathan reveals Caleb was chosen by his emotional profile so that he would try to free Ava — the real test was whether she could work him — and Ava then spends him the same way, using his reprogramming of the security doors and leaving him sealed in the facility.

Both turn on one party gives a dependent it was bound to keep out of its own hands into someone else's. Iwakichi, Tarō's only surviving relative, feeds the boy a last meal, gives him the new shoes he bought and sends him to Takako with a letter, putting the grandson he had kept out of the orphanage into her hands. Gelsomina's impoverished mother, with other mouths to feed, accepts Zampanò's 10,000 lire for her daughter, and the tearful girl leaves with him the same day.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. The Baron uses the female creature's surgical incisions for his own satisfaction and Otto copies him, which is what disembowels her. Greenhill reveals in the empty courtroom that he had been scouting Jennifer Haines long before he killed his wife Rita, selecting her as his defence attorney for a plan she was never made party to.

Both turn on one party covers what another did so that the other never has to answer for it, and they disagree about it. Travis shoots three men in a brothel with an illegal arsenal and is written up in the papers as a vigilante hero, never charged, and back on the night shift when he comes out of the coma. The probation report that would have sent Tino Zapatti to prison on his drug conviction was suppressed and Judge Stern, installed by an Anselmo bribe, left him free on probation — until the report is recovered from Anselmo's car.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Pelle and Ingemar lure Mark, Josh, Simon and Connie to the Hårga as four of the nine bodies the commune needs to purge itself of evil, a purpose the visitors are told only at the final ceremony.

Cecilia finally writes what she cannot say to his face - that to be loved by him she would have to be dead - and lights the last candle for him herself. Jamie keeps returning to a night class on education law she has no interest in, brings a horse for Beth to ride to the diner, and after Beth quits without a word drives four hours to Livingston to say she came because otherwise she would never see her again — and Beth says nothing back.

Maggie Eagle Bear, who identifies the raffle stub and is pressing the question of the reservation's contaminated water, turns up dead at the Red Deer Table mining site.

Ivan loves and plans to marry Marichka, the daughter of the man who killed his father, across the bitter enmity between their Hutsul families, until she drowns in the river while he is away earning money for their household.

Bomba cut women's hair inside the gas chamber itself and found the wife and sister of a friend among them, Muller burned the bodies, and Srebnik was made to sing military songs for the guards at Chelmno.

Fernando makes Walter general manager within two days of hiring him, then, as the nightmares continue, turns on him and tries to kill him, leaving Walter tossed about with no explanation until the staff track him down and the position is handed back. Lydia keeps Francesca as assistant and confidante, dangles Sebastian's assistant-conductor post, then drops the promotion after Sebastian's accusation of favoritism; Francesca resigns and hands Lydia's emails with Krista to the plaintiffs.

When Jeanne says it is over Paul runs her through the streets of Paris, past her threat to call the police, into her mother's building and through the door of the flat.

Bytes keeps Merrick hooded between shows, is paid by Treves for the loan of him, beats him nearly to death when he comes back, steals him out of the hospital and finally locks him in a cage in Belgium to die.

Sister Aloysius fixes Flynn's guilt from a boy pulling away in the courtyard, alcohol on Donald Miller's breath and an undershirt in a locker, and when Flynn demands what proof she has she answers that all she has is her certainty.
