Everyone who came near the Moroni kidnapping is taken off: Paradisi beheaded by the excavator, its driver hanged to look like suicide, Paradisi's wife strangled at the tram stop, the kindergarten teacher cut up with a circular saw, Mattia beaten with a statue, and finally the old woman who happens to own the mirror.

Charley Dolan, an ex-alcoholic, takes in the fired, gutter-drunk Lew Marsh, gives him a room in his apartment and finds him work on a construction crew, and Lew stays sober and is restored to the newspaper. Chunk is left tied up with the deformed brother the Fratellis keep chained in the cellar, gets him loose, and at the end stops the police taking him and asks him to come and live at his house.

Quaid's wife Lori attacks him at home and tells him she was assigned by the Agency to monitor him, that their marriage is an implanted memory, and that Richter is her real husband; Quaid later kills her. Lau, the man Hon raised from a young gangster and placed inside the police, collaborates with Chan to foil Hon's drug deal and then kills him.

Lydia keeps Francesca as assistant and confidante, dangles Sebastian's assistant-conductor post, then drops the promotion after Sebastian's accusation of favoritism; Francesca resigns and hands Lydia's emails with Krista to the plaintiffs.

Warned to beware Macduff, Macbeth orders the entire Macduff household slaughtered though Macduff himself has already fled to England, and Ross must carry news of the family's demise to him.

Siragusa turns Giannini, leaves him a year in an Italian jail on the counterfeit charge when he fails to produce, and then sends him back to the United States to testify.

The reporters work the widow while she is still assembling plugs at the kitchen table, and Niemeyer, who took the most interest in the family, prints the piece she finds unbearable and takes up with her daughter.

Karin has fifteen years of marriage, two children and a husband at the hospital, and David; Andreas tells her plainly that if she goes to London she does not come back, and she goes.

Chris and his henchmen snatch Julia by helicopter from the hijacked plane and later retake her from Lupin's group, holding her at the sect's cathedral until Lupin gets her out and she is reunited with her family. Anna Dover and Joy Birch are taken from outside the family Thanksgiving by Holly Jones, who drugs them, and their fathers and Detective Loki spend the film trying to get them back.

Both turn on a parent cannot feel toward the child what the child needs. Elisabet tears up the photograph of her son that came in her husband's letter, and Alma recounts that she attempted a self-induced abortion and gave birth to a boy she despises while he craves her love. With Dito dead by his own hand and nothing left, Pixote climbs onto Sueli and takes her breast in his mouth like an infant, and she pushes him off in disgust.

Both turn on parties proceed on an account of who someone is that is simply wrong, and the truth reaches them only once the damage is done.. Annabelle's father and brother see Johnnie walk away from the enlistment line and take him for a shirker, and Annabelle declares she will not speak to him again until he is in uniform, a picture only undone when he is commissioned lieutenant. Fernando deals with Walter as the youngster who steals women from him in his recurring dreams, hiring, promoting, then attacking him on the strength of that resemblance, and only the doctor's therapy session sorts out that the young jobseeker is not the dream rival.

Both turn on one party fails to see or value the person standing closest to it, and they disagree about it. Left standing at the altar, Stephi tells the congregation about the pony she lost by leaving the gate open while she was not paying attention, and says that is what she has been doing to Travis. Koichi cancels the Yokohama sightseeing for a medical emergency, Shigeko parks her parents in a client's luxury hotel and then says they cannot stay with her because of a neighbourhood meeting, so Shukichi and Tomiko spend the night apart.

edges.bTitle: Such a Gorgeous Kid Like Me

To get the contract's civil-disturbance clause Shyamal has a riot staged at his own plant; a factory watchman is badly hurt in it and Shyamal is congratulated for efficient handling. The thesis interviews on criminal women become Camille's way out: she gives the sociologist the life story that has him working to clear her, and once she is a singing star she has no further use for him.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way., and they disagree about it. Bottoni goes to Esposito's house in civilian clothes, wins the family over with favours and offers of food while they do not know he is the policeman hunting the man of the house, until the recognition scene outside the meal. Mason hires Steven Ranier as his protector after Ranier's testimony as a witness to Callahan's murder clears him, not knowing Ranier has been working with Brock Benedict all along and agrees aboard the Mara Maru to throw Mason overboard once the crucifix is raised.

The knowledge that leaks into Terr through a faulty collar during Tiwa's lessons is what teaches the wild tribes to read, build rockets and break the meditation statues the Draags need to breed. Roy gets past Sebastian into the penthouse to ask Tyrell for more life, is told the four years cannot be altered and is praised for his design, and kisses him and puts his thumbs through his eyes.

edges.a: zatoichi and the chest of gold
edges.aTitle: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold
edges.claim: Both turn on one party turns the judging power against the weaker side, who is left without redress, and they disagree about it. Intendant Gundayu, who secretly arranged to receive the villagers' stolen 1,000 Ryō himself, calls the Itakura headman a liar, insists the tax be paid again in ten days and orders the headman and three villagers executed at dawn. Aronne Piperno takes the Marquis to law over the wages he will not pay, and Onofrio buys the judges and the cardinals, so that Piperno is the one condemned and jeered at in the street.

Both turn on one party takes another up while they serve its purpose and drops them, with no cause given, once they do not. Once Gelsomina's madness after Il Matto's death makes her useless for drawing a crowd, Zampanò leaves her asleep by the roadside with some clothes, some money and his trumpet, and drives on. Lydia keeps Francesca as assistant and confidante, dangles Sebastian's assistant-conductor post, then drops the promotion after Sebastian's accusation of favoritism; Francesca resigns and hands Lydia's emails with Krista to the plaintiffs.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. The Baron uses the female creature's surgical incisions for his own satisfaction and Otto copies him, which is what disembowels her. Takashi, Masaru and Kiyoko were put through the psychic programme as children and are still in the laboratory as old-faced children, and what is left of Akira is in jars under the Olympic site for research.

Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand., and they disagree about it. Valerie sees Jef leaving Martey's office clearly and then fails to pick him out of the identity parade, and the silence is what puts him back on the street. From his signal tower Maloin sees one man knocked into the water at the quayside and the other flee, then climbs down, takes the briefcase of English banknotes and tells no one — not Morrison when questioned during his shift, not his family — until he finally brings the case to the tavern and confesses.

Both turn on two parties press a whole claim on the same person, who can be neither shared nor divided, so going to one is the unmaking of the other.. Desiree wants Frederich out of a marriage eleven months old, Count Carl-Magnus wants Desiree kept and his own wife Charlotte kept too, and the whole party is assembled at Madame Armfeldt's so the claims can be settled in one weekend. Ben and the insurance agent Hank both court Lou, and Ben leaves town at night partly so as not to incite Hank's jealousy over her.

Charley Dolan, an ex-alcoholic, takes in the fired, gutter-drunk Lew Marsh, gives him a room in his apartment and finds him work on a construction crew, and Lew stays sober and is restored to the newspaper. Kameda, meeting the social pariah Taeko whom the men around her trade like chattel, is drawn to the sadness in her and wants to help her, and his kindness gives her the strength to run away from Tohata, Kayama and Akama.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Kai brings Kaneda the news about Yamagata and Kaneda swears he will settle it with Tetsuo himself, and goes into the stadium after him twice. The state does its killing with the same deliberateness the film gave the first one: the room, the straps, several men holding him down, and the drop.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Mary's mother corners Henry in the hall after the dinner, tries to kiss him, and tells him Mary has had his baby and that the two of them must be married. Keller Dover kidnaps Alex Jones, chains him in an empty building he owns and tortures him for days to make him give up where the girls are, getting only cryptic talk about a maze.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it. Caligari sends the somnambulist Cesare out at night to stab the town clerk and Alan in their beds while Caligari keeps a dummy in the box to appear innocent. Lady Macbeth, knowing the witches' prophecies, talks her hesitating husband into the regicide and drugs Duncan's servants, but it is Macbeth who holds the knife.

edges.a: i know where i m going

Joan, travelling to Mull to marry Sir Robert Bellinger, is stranded by the gale and falls for Torquil MacNeil, and cannot have him without abandoning the engagement she set out to complete — she finally walks back to Moy Castle behind the three pipers instead of crossing to Kiloran. Karin has fifteen years of marriage, two children and a husband at the hospital, and David; Andreas tells her plainly that if she goes to London she does not come back, and she goes.

edges.a: such a gorgeous kid like me
edges.aTitle: Such a Gorgeous Kid Like Me
edges.claim: Both turn on one who was once helped comes back to the one who helped them, and what they return — gratitude or violence — settles what the bond was.. Stanislas hunts down the boy with the film that proves Camille innocent and gets her out of prison; when she has shot her husband and put the gun in his hand she does nothing at all for him. Hatidže instructs Sam in wild beekeeping and hands him bees to start his own colony, and what comes back is the destruction of her own hives and her livelihood.

Both turn on one party presses another to hand over the account of themselves or of a past act that the other would rather keep, and they disagree about it. Lanzmann pays Suchomel five hundred marks and promises not to use his name, then films him on hidden equipment; he keeps Bomba cutting hair and talking past the point where the man can go on, and does the same to Filip Muller. A Japanese crew has come to Cinecitta to get Fellini on the record about his new film and spends the whole picture being walked round commercials, backlots and screen tests instead; even the studio's custodian slips off into Studio 5 to pick dandelions rather than sit for them.

Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true. Rotwang kidnaps Maria and gives the robot her likeness, and the false Maria preaches insurrection to the workers and dances at the Yoshiwara club with neither the workers nor the wealthy men recognising she is a machine, until the fire at the stake reveals the metal. Lupin arrives at the floating island disguised as Prince Panish and asks Olèander for the pendant key, which she hands over believing him to be the prince she loves; the nanomachines turn hostile once the disguise breaks.

After Thomas enlarges the frames showing the gunman in the trees and the shape on the ground, a man follows him and looks into his car, his studio is ransacked, and every negative and print is taken except one grainy blow-up.

Both turn on one party comes back to a bond or a place that has closed over their absence, and those who stayed must answer the return, and they disagree about it. Kin is thrown into excitement by news that Tabe, her former patron and lover, is coming back, and the reunion consists of his asking her for money, after which she burns his photograph to erase what is left of him. Montand comes back to Marseille to stage his own life and spends his free hours looking for the girl he loved when he was nobody, and finds her behind the Baroness de Lambert's card, in the bar they first met in, about to lose her home while her husband serves five years.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Shashibhushan Pal found the statue while painting the Durga lion and handed it to Bikash without knowing whose man he was, so Maganlal sends a henchman with Bikash to stab him and drop the knife in the Ganges. Dolores threatens to take the affair to Miriam and can also describe the financial dealings that built the practice, so Judah has her shot and goes to the flat himself for the letters.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. After Jagga's four-day kidnapping people suspect Leela of adultery and Raghunath throws her out of the house, rejecting her plea that the child she carries is his; she gives birth to Raj on the streets. Keller fixes on Alex after the whispered line "They didn't cry 'til I left them," though Loki has established Alex's diminished IQ and clean RV, and Alex turns out to have been Holly's first abducted child.

edges.b: jolanda the daughter of the black corsair
edges.bTitle: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair
edges.claim: Both turn on a life or a freedom is settled with a payment, and they disagree about it. Chuck is left behind in Arnold's clutches as security for the debt after Wills's $12,000 check bounces, and is released only when Francis writes a second check. Jolanda kidnaps Consuelo of Medina to trade her for the release of Ralf and the arrested pirates, but Van Guld turns the exchange site into an ambush.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. John and Tommy shoot Nokes dead in a Hell's Kitchen pub after he dismisses what he did to them, and Michael builds the whole trial as an instrument of revenge on the remaining Wilkinson guards, with Addison abducted and killed by Rizzo's brother Eddie.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. David's moods set the terms of the affair, and when Karin turns up having drunk and still smoking against what they agreed, he hits her. Four years into the colony the natives are forced to mine gold for the Spaniards, and Moxica cuts off the hand of one who fails to produce any, after which the tribes vanish into the forest and the island turns to war.

Both turn on parties bound to each other by service, alliance or company come to act against each other, and they disagree about it. Mark, the cousin Damien has shared a room and an academy with, overhears Warren and refuses to come with him, so Damien bursts a vessel in his head. Massigny, once his closest friend, did him some injury the film never names, and Davenne will not have a candle for him until the night he finally grants it and goes to the chapel to die.

edges.a: the bird with the crystal plumage
edges.aTitle: The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
edges.claim: Both turn on one party covers what another did so that the other never has to answer for it. Alberto covers his wife's killings, commits some of them himself, and as he falls from the window confesses to the whole series. Travis shoots three men in a brothel with an illegal arsenal and is written up in the papers as a vigilante hero, never charged, and back on the night shift when he comes out of the coma.

Both turn on an outside party takes a person out of the keeping of those bound to them, who must get them back. Anna Dover and Joy Birch are taken from outside the family Thanksgiving by Holly Jones, who drugs them, and their fathers and Detective Loki spend the film trying to get them back. Dr. Johnny Wilcox declares Okja the best super pig and Mirando trucks her off the mountain to New York, and Mija chases the truck through Seoul and follows her across the world to get her back.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Chantal, having overheard the priest's talk with her mother, tells the Count that the priest drove the Countess to despair, and the priest will not clear himself with the Countess' letter of thanks before the church investigator. Park picks out the scarred, mentally handicapped Baek Kwang-ho on the strength of eye contact and his girlfriend's gossip, and Cho beats a confession out of him until Seo shows the boy could not have committed the crimes.

edges.a: the passion of joan of arc
edges.aTitle: The Passion of Joan of Arc
edges.claim: Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. After being taken to view the torture chamber and then threatened with burning at the stake, Joan breaks and lets a priest guide her hand in signing a confession, for which she is sentenced to life imprisonment. A billion lire is on the table for the building if it is empty, so Amedeo and Ofelia set about the remaining tenants one by one until the last of them is out - and then the lawyer tears up the cheques because Wanda has moved back in.

Both turn on one party keeps another inside a position they can neither leave nor advance from, and they disagree about it. The four downed soldiers seize the young peasant woman who cannot speak their language and bind her to a tree with their belts, leaving Sidney to keep her there. With Krakozhia's coup voiding his passport, Customs seizes Viktor's documents and Frank Dixon confines him to the JFK transit lounge, where he can neither enter the United States nor fly home and lives in a gate under renovation for nine months.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. The reporters work the widow while she is still assembling plugs at the kitchen table, and Niemeyer, who took the most interest in the family, prints the piece she finds unbearable and takes up with her daughter. Greenhill reveals in the empty courtroom that he had been scouting Jennifer Haines long before he killed his wife Rita, selecting her as his defence attorney for a plan she was never made party to.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would.. Gualtiero turns up after fifteen years to say that people are following him who mean to kill him and that he does not know who they are; he is talked into the clinic instead, and the man watches the report of his killing on a monitor at work. Biff holds onto him in the yard and says as plainly as he can that he is a dime a dozen and so are both of them, and Willy takes the crying for forgiveness and goes out to buy him a business with his own death.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Howie is what the failed harvest requires: he came freely, he carries the power of a king in the law, he is a virgin and he is the fool, and he is put in the wicker figure with the animals and burned. Barletta carries the cash and fronts the black funds for Griffo, the industrialist he has known since childhood, and is finally made to sign away a phantom company before he is let go.

Both turn on one party brings a grievance upward and the party above treats it as an offence to be put down, and they disagree about it. The crew complains that the ship's meat is maggot-infested and refuses the borscht; Dr Smirnov declares it edible, Giliarovsky drives them off, and all who refused are judged guilty of insubordination and brought to the fore-deck to be shot under a canvas. The workers put their demands — eight-hour day, 30% wages, a six-hour day for minors, fair treatment — to the shareholders, who discuss them dismissively over cigars, use the demand letter as a rag to wipe a spill, post a rejection, and send police to raid the sit-down protest before the army drives the strikers into a field and shoots them en masse.

Both turn on one party settles what another is before hearing anything that other can offer. Crossing Fula country Nianankoro is taken for a thief and Rouma Boli orders him killed, until he freezes the guards where they stand. Sister Aloysius fixes Flynn's guilt from a boy pulling away in the courtyard, alcohol on Donald Miller's breath and an undershirt in a locker, and when Flynn demands what proof she has she answers that all she has is her certainty.

edges.a: the plot of the fuma clan
edges.aTitle: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
edges.claim: Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way., and they disagree about it. Inspector Kazami, who talks Zenigata out of the temple and back onto the case, has been the Fuma Boss's man the whole time, and Fujiko finds him standing in their ranks. Camille is hired to sit with Simon Cinéma nightly to talk about cinema, and uses that nightly access — steering him toward thoughts of Vincent's return, feigning ignorance when 'Vincent' is introduced — to work the inheritance scheme that would fund Mica's short film.

Both turn on one party comes asking something of another who is free to answer it, and is turned away. Seki, the old customer jailed for trying to kill Kin and then himself, comes to borrow money and is shown the door, and when the ex-soldier Tabe she has been longing for turns out to want a loan too she refuses him and burns his photograph. Larry goes to his synagogue for consolation and gets Rabbi Scott's advice to change his 'perspective', Rabbi Nachtner's anecdote about Hebrew letters on a goy's teeth, and Marshak, who will not see him at all.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. One of Ali la Pointe's compatriots, under torture by the French Army, gives up the location of Ali's hideout. Aloysius invents a nun at Flynn's former parish who told her of past infringements and threatens blackmail unless he resigns immediately; he requests the transfer, delivers a final homily, and is then given a better post at a larger church.

Both turn on one party names another's concealed life or wrong in front of those who did not know of it, and they disagree about it. Mr Ahankhah, having seen a magazine photograph of a younger, darker Makhmalbaf, brings the journalist Farazmand into the house to identify him, and Farazmand photographs the arrest for a piece called Bogus Makhmalbaf Arrested. At the struggle session Xiaolou tells the Red Guards Dieyi is homosexual, and Dieyi answers by naming Juxian a former prostitute before the crowd — after which Xiaolou disowns her and she kills herself.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would., and they disagree about it. Scotty Scott spends decades arguing the aircraft carrier's power to a Navy and Congress that will not credit it, losing a promotion for his outspokenness at Annapolis, and is vindicated only after Pearl Harbor, at Midway and finally at Okinawa once he has pleaded in Washington for the carrier fleet. Mylène asks Edgar twice to slow down as he speeds toward their seaside house, he answers that his ideas go fast when he drives fast, and the crash into the tree leaves her mute and pregnant for the rest of the film.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back. After Chernobyl everything came back except culture, and William Shakespeare Junior is engaged by the Cannon Cultural Division and the Royal Library to recover his ancestor's lost works, which he starts hearing coming out of Learo's mouth in the restaurant. In the last hour Jacek asks to be put in beside his sister and father although there is one place left and his mother would have to give it up, and hands Piotr the enlarged photograph of the girl to take to her.

Both turn on a wanting that arrives after a binding already made cannot be had without breaking it, and one of the two people must be given up.. Chloe wants no marriage but wants a child by him and treats his wife and two children as beside the point; he finds Helene alone and in tears instead. Ada, married off to Stewart, cannot have Baines without breaking that marriage; Stewart watches them through a crack in the wall and she is finally released to leave with Baines for Nelson.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Inside FEBEM the boys are the pieces the guards and their commander play with, and what they are used for is never anything of theirs. Red burns his own brig so no one can retreat, quietly has Boomako ready a boat for the throne alone, and rows away leaving the surviving crew in the water.

Both turn on one party takes up someone others have written off and treats them as worth something. Oyae hides the hunted Sakichi at her father's premises, and when he raids the cash-box in a sleepwalking trance her father refuses to call him a thief and gives him more money to start again. Kameda, meeting the social pariah Taeko whom the men around her trade like chattel, is drawn to the sadness in her and wants to help her, and his kindness gives her the strength to run away from Tohata, Kayama and Akama.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way.. Mason hires Steven Ranier as his protector after Ranier's testimony as a witness to Callahan's murder clears him, not knowing Ranier has been working with Brock Benedict all along and agrees aboard the Mara Maru to throw Mason overboard once the crucifix is raised. Wen-hsiung finds out only by accident that his own brother, his concubine's brother and the Shanghai men have been running contraband through his ships and his storehouse.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. The camp scientists select the prisoner for time-travel experiments because his obsessive memory of the woman on the Orly jetty makes him able to withstand the shock, use him to fetch a power unit from the future, and then move to execute him once the mission is accomplished. Bytes keeps Merrick hooded between shows, is paid by Treves for the loan of him, beats him nearly to death when he comes back, steals him out of the hospital and finally locks him in a cage in Belgium to die.

Both turn on one party is passed over by someone whose regard they held, in favour of another that person prefers, and they disagree about it. Kuriyama takes up with Fusako's sister Natsuko, a dance-hall hostess he meets at his regular hall, and Fusako — devastated at being passed over — walks out into prostitution and later scolds Natsuko in the prison hospital for stealing her paramour. After the dinner at the wealthy man's mansion Checco walks away from his faithful mistress Melina to walk alone with Liliana, and leaves the troupe in Rome to build a new one around Liliana, only to end up back beside Melina on the Foggia train.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. The camp scientists select the prisoner for time-travel experiments because his obsessive memory of the woman on the Orly jetty makes him able to withstand the shock, use him to fetch a power unit from the future, and then move to execute him once the mission is accomplished. Pris works on J. F. Sebastian's loneliness until he takes her in, and Roy uses him and his access to get to the top of the Tyrell pyramid; Sebastian is reported dead soon after.

edges.a: once upon a time in the west
edges.aTitle: Once Upon a Time in the West
edges.claim: Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Frank once stood a boy under his hanging brother with a harmonica forced into his mouth until the boy's legs gave out; the grown boy waits at Sweetwater and puts the harmonica back into Frank's mouth as he dies. John and Tommy shoot Nokes dead in a Hell's Kitchen pub after he dismisses what he did to them, and Michael builds the whole trial as an instrument of revenge on the remaining Wilkinson guards, with Addison abducted and killed by Rizzo's brother Eddie.

Both turn on one party moves against the one placed above it and set over what it was to become. Columbus's aristocratic subordinate Moxica burns down his house and leads a faction of settlers against him; Columbus's side prevails and Moxica kills himself rather than be captured. Furiosa, Joe's own Imperator, is sent out with the War Rig to trade for petrol and instead smuggles his wives out in it, and finally boards his truck and kills him while Toast distracts him.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Four years into the colony the natives are forced to mine gold for the Spaniards, and Moxica cuts off the hand of one who fails to produce any, after which the tribes vanish into the forest and the island turns to war. Göth runs Płaszów by brutalising his maid Helen Hirsch and shooting prisoners at random from his villa balcony, with the inmates in constant fear and no way out from under him until he is hanged.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Moose overhears Rosa and Latimer planning her divorce and remarriage and threatens to tell Latimer about her pregnancy himself, so Rosa shoots him dead on the hunting trip and claims she mistook him for a deer. After Charlie is caught watching Susan Orlean and Laroche take the ghost-orchid drug and have sex, Orlean decides he must be killed to stop him exposing them and drives him into the swamp at gunpoint.

Both turn on one party fashions another into what it requires and holds them to that shape, and they disagree about it. Sergeant Neff, planted at the military academy, takes Damien in hand and sets him Revelation 13 to read, and the boy finds 666 under his hair in the mirror. The pastor makes his children wear white ribbons as a standing reminder of the purity they have strayed from, and runs confirmation classes that leave them guilty over small transgressions.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Four years into the colony the natives are forced to mine gold for the Spaniards, and Moxica cuts off the hand of one who fails to produce any, after which the tribes vanish into the forest and the island turns to war. Mr. O'Brien screams at his wife, harshly disciplines Jack and teaches the boys to fight and trust no one, and the household only breathes freely when he leaves on a business trip; Jack is still marked by it as a world-weary architect in 2010.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it. Carl-Magnus does not confront Frederich; he sends his wife Charlotte to call on Anne Egerman and put the affair in front of her. Ari's unit stands in 'the second or third ring' lighting the sky for the Israeli-allied Phalange who do the killing, and Ari concludes he felt as responsible as the men who carried it out.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back, and they disagree about it. Having reached the point where he knows more dead than living, Davenne consecrates the chapel to the whole cemetery and keeps a candle burning for every one of them. In the last hour Jacek asks to be put in beside his sister and father although there is one place left and his mother would have to give it up, and hands Piotr the enlarged photograph of the girl to take to her.

edges.a: investigation of a citizen above suspicion
edges.aTitle: Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion
edges.claim: Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. He plants clues that steer his own subordinates onto the murdered woman's husband and onto a student radical, and then clears them himself. The detective who handled the hijacking harasses Makoto over a neighbourhood woman's murder without evidence and later arrests and questions him over a second killing, while the murderer is in fact Naoki.

Both turn on one party takes control of the thing another cannot do without and sets the terms of its release, and they disagree about it. Red takes the governor's niece into the residence as his bargaining piece for the golden throne, and when the uncle proves indifferent to what happens to her, works on his gout instead until the document is signed.

Both turn on the person destroys the thing they could not otherwise hold. Jack the Ripper, having no money but liked by Lulu and touched enough to secretly throw away his knife, sees another knife on the table as they embrace and kills her. Akama, who bought Taeko a diamond ring with money stolen from his father and could never bring himself to dislike Kameda in person, kills Taeko out of jealousy over the feelings she holds for Kameda, then sits with Kameda beside her unburned corpse through the night.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it. Gawkowski drove the Sonderzuge to Treblinka with a German officer behind him and vodka as the bonus, and drew his hand across his throat at the waiting convoys; Walter Stier says he was managing railway traffic and papers, not people. Ari's unit stands in 'the second or third ring' lighting the sky for the Israeli-allied Phalange who do the killing, and Ari concludes he felt as responsible as the men who carried it out.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. When Inspector Gruber works out that the affair between Svoboda and Mascha was staged, Svoboda and Jan kill him and pin that murder on Czaka too. Maggie Eagle Bear, who identifies the raffle stub and is pressing the question of the reservation's contaminated water, turns up dead at the Red Deer Table mining site.

Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand., and they disagree about it. A man and his son come to the village to find out what happened to Pauline Kropp in 1941 and are met by people who will not tell them. Shakes proposes reporting the abuse before release, but Michael argues nobody would believe or care, and the four boys vow never to speak of it again — a silence held for thirteen years until Ferguson admits the abuse on the witness stand.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it, and they disagree about it. Wendy and Danny are inside the marriage that once put the boy's shoulder out of its socket, and by February it is Jack coming through the bathroom door with the axe. Göth runs Płaszów by brutalising his maid Helen Hirsch and shooting prisoners at random from his villa balcony, with the inmates in constant fear and no way out from under him until he is hanged.

Both turn on one party holds a truth belonging to another's own life and manages what that other is allowed to believe about it.. Mylene had the child after they parted and never told him, and never told Marion whose daughter she is, so the two of them meet as a star and a fan and spend a night together before the breakfast conversation gives it away. Cohaagen has had Hauser's memory wiped and replaced with the Quaid identity, a wife and a construction job, so that Quaid lives a life whose facts about himself are administered by Cohaagen until the Rekall visit and the recorded message begin to surface them.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Dolores threatens to take the affair to Miriam and can also describe the financial dealings that built the practice, so Judah has her shot and goes to the flat himself for the letters. After Charlie is caught watching Susan Orlean and Laroche take the ghost-orchid drug and have sex, Orlean decides he must be killed to stop him exposing them and drives him into the swamp at gunpoint.

Both turn on one party names another's concealed life or wrong in front of those who did not know of it. Anonymous letters arrive at the house telling Andreas that his wife is sleeping with the American archaeologist. Insulted by Peadar at the market, Pádraic publicly announces that Peadar beats Dominic, and later, drunk in the pub, publicly accuses him of molesting his son.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would.. Kiyoko tells Shikishima that Neo-Tokyo is going to go the way of Tokyo, and the parliament hears him out and dismisses it, which is what finally puts him into a coup.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Howie is what the failed harvest requires: he came freely, he carries the power of a king in the law, he is a virgin and he is the fool, and he is put in the wicker figure with the animals and burned.

Both turn on one party models itself on another until the two can barely be told apart, and is brought face to face with the one it copies. Alma, alone at the cottage with the silent Elisabet, ends up telling Elisabet's own story of the despised son back to her and has to break off insisting on her own name, denying that she is Elisabet. Having drowned the dog whose company Giorgio preferred to hers, Liza takes Melampo's place literally, living as his female dog on a collar, and he takes the game up.

Both turn on one party holds a truth belonging to another's own life and manages what that other is allowed to believe about it., and they disagree about it. Mylene had the child after they parted and never told him, and never told Marion whose daughter she is, so the two of them meet as a star and a fan and spend a night together before the breakfast conversation gives it away. Daniel raises H.W. as his son and withholds his real parentage until the 1927 quarrel over dissolving the partnership, when he mocks H.W.'s deafness and reveals his origins as a way of disowning him.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest. Rosa carries on a year-long affair with Neil Latimer while her husband Lewis, the town doctor, knows nothing of it, until her delirium and resentment over the pregnancy drive her to confess both the affair and the murder of Moose to him. After Tom asks Mary to 'teach' his brother Dick about sex, she denies to Tom that anything took place and insists the baby is his; the question of whose child it was is never cleared between them.

edges.a: let s hope it s a girl

Larry goes to his synagogue for consolation and gets Rabbi Scott's advice to change his 'perspective', Rabbi Nachtner's anecdote about Hebrew letters on a goy's teeth, and Marshak, who will not see him at all.

Sophie is at the telescope in Leigh's flat, in radio contact with her, when she is attacked, and the police close it by finding she had a flight booked to Fort Worth.

Jack the Ripper, having no money but liked by Lulu and touched enough to secretly throw away his knife, sees another knife on the table as they embrace and kills her. Having promised Sukhilala she would not let Birju harm his family, Radha shoots her own bandit son as he rides off with the kidnapped Rupa, and he dies in her arms.

Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it, and they disagree about it. Jim asks Frank how a man defends his honour and is told to avoid confrontation, then pleads with his father to stand up for him when Carol announces another move; Frank refuses and Jim attacks him, until at the observatory Frank finally comforts him and vows to be a better father. At the door of the trafficker's flat his own partners hold him back at the moment he goes in, and he takes a bullet in the face; the Chief's first thought is that a cop shot him.

Both turn on the harm arrives through the very party charged with keeping the other safe, often done in the name of keeping them.. The asylum director experiments on a somnambulist admitted into his care until the man becomes his Cesare, and Cesare finally collapses and dies of exhaustion after the abduction. Neville takes charge of the case, becomes her lover and hands her a pistol for her own protection, and it is his own hand that finally closes hers around it.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Alma opens the unsealed letter Elisabet has written to the doctor and finds she is being 'studied' — her story of the orgy and abortion set down as material — and rounds on Elisabet for using her. Pris works on J. F. Sebastian's loneliness until he takes her in, and Roy uses him and his access to get to the top of the Tyrell pyramid; Sebastian is reported dead soon after.

edges.a: the human condition ii road to eternity
edges.aTitle: The Human Condition II: Road to Eternity
edges.claim: Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it. When Kaji and Yoshida are both caught in quicksand while pursuing the deserting Shinjo, Kaji refuses to pull Yoshida out and lets him sink. Mrs. O'Brien, the parent Jack sees as grace, never stands up to her domineering husband on the boys' behalf, and Jack criticises her for it.

Both turn on one party fails to see or value the person standing closest to it, and they disagree about it. The Legendres are told their daughter has vanished from school, find her at her desk, can see her and talk to her, and take her along to the police station to report her missing, where nobody in the room admits she is standing there. Ryōta neglects Midori and Keita for his architecture work, and only when he finds a cache of photos Keita secretly took of him sleeping does he break down and later apologise to the boy for his failures as a father.

edges.b: the time to live and the time to die
edges.bTitle: The Time to Live and the Time to Die
edges.claim: Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it. Waiting on her biopsy result, Cléo raises her fear of cancer with her lover José, who talks lovingly but dismisses the fears and stays only a few minutes, after which she tells Angèle she is thinking of breaking up with him. Hatidže tells Hussein Sam to always leave half the honey for the bees; he sells the entire stock to satisfy a customer, his colonies then raid hers in winter and her colony collapses exactly as she warned.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back. Finding Japanese corpses unburied along the road to Mudon, Mizushima keeps the stolen monk's robe and writes that he cannot go home until every fallen soldier is buried. Dying of a henchman's bullet during the escape from Rodríguez's hacienda, Florès makes Maria I promise to carry on his revolution in San Miguel, and she takes up the peasant army and the campaign on his behalf.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way.. Emil Czaka, the wealthy brewer admitted to resistance meetings and privy to its leaders, is in fact a German fifth-columnist, and when he is tricked into revealing it the Gestapo kill or arrest most of the resistance. Camille is hired to sit with Simon Cinéma nightly to talk about cinema, and uses that nightly access — steering him toward thoughts of Vincent's return, feigning ignorance when 'Vincent' is introduced — to work the inheritance scheme that would fund Mica's short film.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. The convict Sauro recognises in the pizzeria shoots him, and after a few seconds of hesitation Barletta draws the pistol Sauro gave him and kills the man. Embittered by Bob's rejection, Syndrome builds a fortune on fake superpowers, kills off retired supers by testing the Omnidroid on them, lures Bob to Nomanisan, shoots down the plane carrying his children and finally tries to steal Jack-Jack.

Both turn on a life or a freedom is settled with a payment. Gondō throws the two treated briefcases of ransom money from a moving train on the kidnapper's instructions, and Shin'ichi is recovered alive at the drop site. Emerald, bought as a child for $100, haggles across the whole film with the auntie who insists her freedom is worth $3,000, and with Master Hong and Luo's help settles a price and leaves the brothel.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it, and they disagree about it. Delbert Grady, who cut up his own wife and daughters in the same hotel, meets Jack in the ballroom and tells him his family needs correcting, and lets him out of the pantry Wendy locked. Ari's unit stands in 'the second or third ring' lighting the sky for the Israeli-allied Phalange who do the killing, and Ari concludes he felt as responsible as the men who carried it out.

Both turn on one party lends their voice, eyes or hands to another who lacks them, so that the other can act only through them. Ada, mute since the age of six, can only be understood through Flora, who signs and speaks for her — until Flora carries her words where she chooses and Ada ends the film taking speech lessons.

Tetsuo goes through everyone who has ever held him up - the Capsules, Kaneda, the espers, Shikishima - and kills Yamagata at the Harukiya over the bike he took.

Puffy Krauss von Espy testifies that Marylin asked him to find her a very rich, foolish philandering husband she could easily divorce, and he pointed her to Rex Rexroth.

Both turn on a marriage is entered for money, standing or cover rather than love, and they disagree about it. Morlacchi's marriage to the Countess Cristiana was only a means of making himself heir to her fortune, which she grasps when she finds him rifling her desk for her jewelry. Puffy Krauss von Espy testifies that Marylin asked him to find her a very rich, foolish philandering husband she could easily divorce, and he pointed her to Rex Rexroth.

Both turn on one party is denied the child it wants, and the party bound to them is caught in the lack, and they disagree about it. Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Four years into the colony the natives are forced to mine gold for the Spaniards, and Moxica cuts off the hand of one who fails to produce any, after which the tribes vanish into the forest and the island turns to war. After the fundamentalists win the elections Marji lives under compulsory headscarves, black-market music, fined for holding Reza's hand, and a party raid in which the women are detained and Nima falls to his death fleeing across the rooftops.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Howie is what the failed harvest requires: he came freely, he carries the power of a king in the law, he is a virgin and he is the fool, and he is put in the wicker figure with the animals and burned. Pris works on J. F. Sebastian's loneliness until he takes her in, and Roy uses him and his access to get to the top of the Tyrell pyramid; Sebastian is reported dead soon after.

Ada is shipped from Scotland to colonial New Zealand with Flora for a marriage to the settler Stewart that was arranged for her, and meets her husband for the first time on the beach where her piano is abandoned.

Both turn on the help arrives from the person with the most reason to withhold it. Burnham, one of the three intruders and the man who built the panic room, hands Sarah her glucagon and finally runs back to shoot Raoul dead as he raises the sledgehammer over Meg.

Macbeth, newly invested as Thane of Cawdor by King Duncan and passed over when Duncan names Malcolm prince of Cumberland, murders the sleeping King in his own castle and takes the throne.

Montand comes back to Marseille to stage his own life and spends his free hours looking for the girl he loved when he was nobody, and finds her behind the Baroness de Lambert's card, in the bar they first met in, about to lose her home while her husband serves five years.

Irmgard talks Anzell into overcharging on the round and splitting it with her, knowing Hans follows his man through the courtyards, so that the one witness to her affair is sacked as a thief.

Ada, married off to Stewart, cannot have Baines without breaking that marriage; Stewart watches them through a crack in the wall and she is finally released to leave with Baines for Nelson.

Chan, having deduced that Lau was Hon's mole and sent him the CD of his meeting with Hon, is shot in the head by Inspector Big B on the rooftop as he holds Lau at gunpoint.

Both turn on one party moves against the one placed above it and set over what it was to become. At Vakulinchuk's plea the condemned sailors rise, overwhelm the outnumbered officers, throw them overboard along with the doctor 'as food for the worms', and take control of the Potemkin. AUTO, the autopilot serving Captain McCrea, mutinies when McCrea tries to override directive A113 — electrocuting WALL-E, dumping him and EVE down the garbage chute and confining McCrea to his quarters — until McCrea rises from his chair and switches him to manual.

What she finally names in herself - the unfairness, the unkindness, the judging - is her father's, handed on and practised for thirty years without her noticing.

Scotty Scott spends decades arguing the aircraft carrier's power to a Navy and Congress that will not credit it, losing a promotion for his outspokenness at Annapolis, and is vindicated only after Pearl Harbor, at Midway and finally at Okinawa once he has pleaded in Washington for the carrier fleet. Tadokoro tells the cabinet after Amagi that more eruptions and quakes are coming and is dismissed as an alarmist; the Tokyo earthquake follows and kills three million.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it, and they disagree about it. Hale, posing as the Osage's friendly benefactor, has Ernest arrange Henry Roan's shooting and Reta's house bombing and Byron kill Anna, keeping his own hands clean until Ernest turns state's evidence.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. After Adua refuses Ercoli's rent and humiliates him in front of the others, he has all four women arrested for prostitution in revenge. Teddy Gatz, whose mother Sandy was left comatose by an Auxolith clinical trial, abducts the company's CEO Michelle Fuller with his cousin Don, shaves her head, coats her in antihistamine cream and shocks her with electricity in his basement.

Dying in hospital after being struck by a car outside the courthouse, Leela finally tells Raj that Raghunath is his father and asks him to forgive the judge. In the attic Dick makes Tom read out their grandfather's letter and tell him what it says — that Dick was fathered on his mother by that grandfather — after which Dick breaks down, runs to the river and drowns himself.

Gigliola goes on loving Andrea after he abandons her the night before their wedding to kiss the lion tamer, offers herself to cure him when he returns, is the only former lover to defend him at his trial, and he answers by spending that night with another woman.

The camp scientists select the prisoner for time-travel experiments because his obsessive memory of the woman on the Orly jetty makes him able to withstand the shock, use him to fetch a power unit from the future, and then move to execute him once the mission is accomplished. Guy trades his wife's body and the child she carries to the Castevets' coven for the stage role the previous actor went blind to vacate, and she is only told what she was for after the birth.

Aleksei's marriage repeats his mother's down to the face - Natalia and Maria are the same actress, Ignat and the young Aleksei the same boy - and he hands his son the absent father he has never stopped carrying. Dante Cruciani's son Augusto is running stolen medicines and Tiberio's son Brunino turns up from Milan to interrupt his father's old-fashioned break-ins, and ends up driving the car across the border for him.

Both turn on one party fixes an identity on another and deals with them by it rather than by what they are. Manabe reveals Sakichi's five years in prison to the rice-merchant, who dismisses his diligent apprentice, and Sakichi concludes that society will never believe a man with a criminal record has genuinely reformed. On the strength of a dream in which Kali's eyes merge with hers, Kalikinkar falls at his daughter-in-law Doyamoyee's feet, has the priest perform a ritual over her and installs her in a private room as an idol to be worshipped.

Both turn on one party settles what another is before hearing anything that other can offer. Crossing Fula country Nianankoro is taken for a thief and Rouma Boli orders him killed, until he freezes the guards where they stand. When Yuichi's mother asks his consent to the marriage, Shigematsu - whose own niece has been refused all round for what happened to her - is indignant at the young man's war trauma before he will consider it.

edges.a: i know where i m going

Ada, married off to Stewart, cannot have Baines without breaking that marriage; Stewart watches them through a crack in the wall and she is finally released to leave with Baines for Nelson.

Marion is selling scent and asking for three seats for the 26th, and when the leading lady has to go because she is pregnant she puts herself forward and gets the part. Sy Ableman and Judith insist Larry move out to the Jolly Roger motel, and after Sy dies in a car crash Larry is made to pay for the funeral at which Sy is eulogized as 'a serious man'.

Both turn on one party keeps giving to a bond the other will not return, and no reason is given that the giving can work on.. Angela writes to Bayardo every week for years with no answer, and he finally walks in with the whole bundle of letters unopened. WALL-E is smitten with EVE, tends her body through her standby shutdown and refuses the escape pod she tries to send him home in, and only when she watches the recordings of him caring for her does she understand his feelings and return them.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Pris works on J. F. Sebastian's loneliness until he takes her in, and Roy uses him and his access to get to the top of the Tyrell pyramid; Sebastian is reported dead soon after. With the Sleep Center now running further experiments off her case, Kathy volunteers as Michael's subject and he forgets to give her the drug the protocol calls for.

With the house surrounded by soldiers and Rikyū's plan to send her to Ukon and kill himself foreclosed, Ogin prepares to take her own life and sends her maid with a farewell note written on a fan to Ukon in Kaga. The Widow of the Web gives Ynyr the sand that holds the Crystal Spider off and keeps him alive long enough to name the Fortress's next site, and the spider takes her; Rell holds the closing doors of the Fortress apart on his own back so the others can get in.

Dixon refuses to sign Viktor's emergency visa and threatens to prosecute his airport friends and deport Gupta to India on an assault charge unless Viktor boards the plane home, and Viktor agrees until Gupta's act frees him. Aloysius invents a nun at Flynn's former parish who told her of past infringements and threatens blackmail unless he resigns immediately; he requests the transfer, delivers a final homily, and is then given a better post at a larger church.

Ben denounces the family in front of the Indians and offers them the coffin money, and Nat and Jeff shoot each other over it in the crossfire. Massigny, once his closest friend, did him some injury the film never names, and Davenne will not have a candle for him until the night he finally grants it and goes to the chapel to die.

Harry left the sport a year after Buddy Bretherton was killed in one of his cars and comes out of retirement to build Cole a chassis and drill the terms of the trade into a driver who does not know what loose or tight means.

Sadazo, expecting to die in the Philippines, asks Matsuyama to carry his wife Tomoko's postcard back to her and say he received it before dying; after the war Matsuyama makes his way to Tomoko's house to discharge that errand.

Kay digs up the sapling Louis plants in the yard and hides it because of what the fortune teller's words have made her fear, and says nothing to him about having done it.

In Parc Montsouris Cléo, awaiting a cancer diagnosis, meets Antoine, a soldier on the last day of his leave from the Algerian War, and they bond over their mutual fear of dying; he offers to come with her to the hospital and she gives him her real name, Florence. Pelle tells Dani he too was orphaned when his parents burned to death and that the commune became his family, then asks whether she feels supported by Christian, and she ends the film absorbed into the Hårga as May Queen.

Frank Coutelle visits Richard Yellow Hawk in prison, offers a reduced sentence for favors and then blackmails him with the threat of return, using him to kill Leo Fast Elk and inflame the reservation while Frank runs the official investigation.

Once Morgan's boat drifts away and the party is stranded aboard the Queen of Scots, Stu — the friend they all boarded with — kills Julia at the vault, locks Tommy and Charlie in the flooding ballast and mortally wounds Captain Morgan, who names him as repeating the original passenger's cricket-bat massacre.

Jonas whips Claire for arranging the burial at the fort and keeps her outside the cave through the storm until she takes pneumonia. Four years into the colony the natives are forced to mine gold for the Spaniards, and Moxica cuts off the hand of one who fails to produce any, after which the tribes vanish into the forest and the island turns to war.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way.. Marcello arrives in Paris as Quadri's old student on his honeymoon and is taken into the household, which is what puts him close enough to fix the killing. Hon Sam puts Lau Kin-ming through the police academy to rise as his mole while Superintendent Wong plants Chan Wing-yan inside Hon's triad, each man relied on for ten years by the organisation he is betraying.

Dr Sapirstein, the obstetrician the Castevets steer her to, attributes the pain to pelvic joints, discounts her, and sedates her at the door of the delivery.

WALL-E is smitten with EVE, tends her body through her standby shutdown and refuses the escape pod she tries to send him home in, and only when she watches the recordings of him caring for her does she understand his feelings and return them.

The sheriff and judges are in Hale's pocket so none of the murders are investigated, and when Mollie hires detective William J. Burns he is severely beaten by Ernest and Byron.

Alphonse presents Françoise to Hélène as his niece when she is his young lover, and the whole footing of the reunion collapses when his brother-in-law Ernest arrives demanding he return to his wife, shocking Hélène.

The production everyone is casting and building sets for is Kafka's Amerika, which exists as the pretext under which Fellini shoots the film about his own first day at Cinecitta in 1938; when the producers complain about the gloom he switches on an arc lamp for them.

The FBI under Coutelle fixes Leo Fast Elk's murder on ARM leader Jimmy Looks Twice, until Walter Crow Horse's evidence that the killer was heavier and drove Leo's car leads Ray to the real killer, Richard Yellow Hawk.

Told by Marcus Aurelius that he is unfit to rule and that Maximus will succeed as regent, Commodus secretly assassinates his father and proclaims himself emperor.

edges.a: the plot of the fuma clan

Dr. Johnny Wilcox declares Okja the best super pig and Mirando trucks her off the mountain to New York, and Mija chases the truck through Seoul and follows her across the world to get her back.

Told by Marcus Aurelius that he is unfit to rule and that Maximus will succeed as regent, Commodus secretly assassinates his father and proclaims himself emperor.

edges.claim: Both turn on one party covers what another did so that the other never has to answer for it. Alberto covers his wife's killings, commits some of them himself, and as he falls from the window confesses to the whole series. Luciano trades wartime services to military intelligence for Dewey's commutation and deportation, and when Siragusa says the commutation was bought his own superiors order the investigation stopped.

The ethnic Chinese who survived the massacres go on having their money extorted by the same gangsters, who also rig elections, clear land for developers and run gambling and drug rackets.

Greenhill reveals in the empty courtroom that he had been scouting Jennifer Haines long before he killed his wife Rita, selecting her as his defence attorney for a plan she was never made party to.

Marcos' plan to cheat Juan of his share via a staged mugging is itself the bait in a con run by Valeria, Sandler, Berta, Vidal and the motorcycle thieves that takes $200,000 from him for a worthless certified check. Teddy's four-day plan to force a meeting with the Andromedan emperor before the lunar eclipse ends with him walking into Michelle's fake teleporter in a suicide vest and being detonated by the enter key on her desk calculator.

edges.a: once upon a time in the west
edges.aTitle: Once Upon a Time in the West
edges.claim: Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding, and they disagree about it. Frank forces Jill into a sexual encounter and then to put Sweetwater up for auction, where his men frighten off every bidder so he can have it cheap. Aloysius invents a nun at Flynn's former parish who told her of past infringements and threatens blackmail unless he resigns immediately; he requests the transfer, delivers a final homily, and is then given a better post at a larger church.

edges.a: jolanda the daughter of the black corsair
edges.aTitle: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair

Van Guld handed the two-year-old child to the guardian with instructions to kill her, and instead he raised her among the gypsies and trained her in the military arts. Ordered by Commodus to finish the defeated Tigris of Gaul, Maximus spares him and the crowd answers with chants of 'Maximus the Merciful'.

Ogin, a married woman, and the exiled Christian Ukon, whose faith the government is suppressing, escape arrest and shelter in a farmer's hut, where she learns his wife has died and they spend the night together. Asked to cure the barrenness of King Rouma's wife, Nianankoro makes the enchantment and then sleeps with Attou, and the two go back that night to tell the king what they have done.

She leaves Jacek at his grandmother's, comes home, turns on the gas oven and sits down in front of it with tape across her mouth.

After Charlie is caught watching Susan Orlean and Laroche take the ghost-orchid drug and have sex, Orlean decides he must be killed to stop him exposing them and drives him into the swamp at gunpoint.

His uncle Djigui hands Nianankoro the Kore's Wing he was blinded for using, and Nianankoro leaves his cloak with the pregnant Attou for the son who later picks his father's egg out of the sand.

Michelle spends the film insisting she is only a pharmaceutical CEO and offering Teddy a revised Atlantis-and-ark history to placate him, then walks into her office closet, teleports to the mothership and is revealed as the Andromedan emperor, who domes the Earth and kills every human.
