edges.claim: Both turn on one party requires of another an act that other cannot square with themselves. The court presses Joan to say something that would disown her God-given mission to drive the English from France, and she holds to it through interrogation, and after signing recants the confession as unfaithfulness to God. Pablo and Pedro do not want to do it, announce it to everyone they meet in the hope of being stopped, and take the rum Clotilde presses on them, and still have to kill him because the town's custom leaves them nothing else.

Both turn on one party moves against the one placed above it and set over what it was to become. Wells, Grimes' second in command, recruits Crowe with a plot to kill her boss and take over the firm; Crowe shoots Grimes at his fishing cabin and beats Wells to stage it as a robbery. Told by Marcus Aurelius that he is unfit to rule and that Maximus will succeed as regent, Commodus secretly assassinates his father and proclaims himself emperor.

Both turn on one party holds out rescue, pity or an easier way and the one it is meant for will not take it, and they disagree about it. Mary's brothers reluctantly offer John a position and he refuses it as a 'charity job', ending up carrying a sandwich board instead. Takako offers to take the blinded, burned Iwakichi and his grandson Tarō back to the island with her, and Iwakichi refuses and runs away, relenting only when the neighbour talks him round — and then only for the boy.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back. Dying of a henchman's bullet during the escape from Rodríguez's hacienda, Florès makes Maria I promise to carry on his revolution in San Miguel, and she takes up the peasant army and the campaign on his behalf. Having reached the point where he knows more dead than living, Davenne consecrates the chapel to the whole cemetery and keeps a candle burning for every one of them.

Both turn on a need is laid before someone with no prior claim or duty, who must decide whether to take up a burden that is not theirs., and they disagree about it. Martha runs to Kaiser, a colleague she once trained and who owes her nothing, and he agrees to drive her; she grabs the wheel believing Helmut is behind them, and the crash kills him and paralyses her. Janusz sees through the game somewhere in the small hours and drives on with her anyway without saying so, and only goes home when it gets light.

edges.a: let s hope it s a girl
edges.claim: Both turn on one party keeps giving to a bond the other will not return, and no reason is given that the giving can work on., and they disagree about it. Nardoni, who has farmed for her and loved her for years, offers to buy the villa and marry her so she need not leave it; Elena sells him the land and refuses the marriage. WALL-E is smitten with EVE, tends her body through her standby shutdown and refuses the escape pod she tries to send him home in, and only when she watches the recordings of him caring for her does she understand his feelings and return them.

Both turn on one party takes control of the thing another cannot do without and sets the terms of its release, and they disagree about it. Casoni takes Lori and offers her life against the end of the investigation, the same trade Calabresi tried to make with him before the train. Red takes the governor's niece into the residence as his bargaining piece for the golden throne, and when the uncle proves indifferent to what happens to her, works on his gout instead until the document is signed.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it, and they disagree about it. Delbert Grady, who cut up his own wife and daughters in the same hotel, meets Jack in the ballroom and tells him his family needs correcting, and lets him out of the pantry Wendy locked. Gawkowski drove the Sonderzuge to Treblinka with a German officer behind him and vodka as the bonus, and drew his hand across his throat at the waiting convoys; Walter Stier says he was managing railway traffic and papers, not people.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out, and they disagree about it. Giannini is shot on Luciano's order before he can get in front of the grand jury in New York. DSC officers chase Peter for his footage of the crackdown and seize Jae-sik, who shouts for Peter to share the film with the world; soldiers at the mountain roadblock are ordered to stop any foreigners and fire on the taxi.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own, and they disagree about it. Major Kopp brings another soldier and forces Mariu's door, and the women carry out porcelain, rugs and clocks to the value of the money while Mariu stands there and hardly protests. Embittered by Bob's rejection, Syndrome builds a fortune on fake superpowers, kills off retired supers by testing the Omnidroid on them, lures Bob to Nomanisan, shoots down the plane carrying his children and finally tries to steal Jack-Jack.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to, and they disagree about it. Anna Maria is sent by her classmates to meet the Greek teacher at the Sea Horse Fountain and kiss him so they can photograph it and blackmail him into passing them, and the teacher is never party to the arrangement — until, hearing he is losing his sight and must give up teaching, she hugs him while covering his face so the photograph fails. Nathan reveals Caleb was chosen by his emotional profile so that he would try to free Ava — the real test was whether she could work him — and Ava then spends him the same way, using his reprogramming of the security doors and leaving him sealed in the facility.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. On the night Mussolini falls Marcello shouts that Lino murdered the Quadris, and then denounces his blind friend Italo as a Fascist to the crowd that carries him off. A boy dies under police beating and the institution puts the killing on Lilica's unnamed lover, and then kills him too.

Both turn on one party takes into its own house and keeping someone with no claim to be there. Itard takes formal custody and removes the boy to his own house on the edge of Paris, where he and his housekeeper raise him. The Kazamas, who had just lost their own newborn, take in the infant Shun when Yūichirō arrives one evening with him, after Ryoko—already pregnant with Umi—cannot raise him and his other relatives are killed in the bombing of Nagasaki.

Both turn on one party holds out rescue, pity or an easier way and the one it is meant for will not take it. Sent by the British captain with thirty minutes to talk down the holdouts, Mizushima climbs to the cave, tells them the war is over and begs them to surrender; the commander and men vote unanimously to fight to the end and the cave is bombarded. Jacques offers to marry Marie even after she tells him of the abuse, and tells her his father has dropped the court-ordered money, but she leaves and her mother tells him only "She's gone and will never come back."

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Every woman who could name the older client goes: McKenna a supposed suicide, Arlyn Page pulled out of the river after she tells Bree the photograph is the wrong man. Shashibhushan Pal found the statue while painting the Durga lion and handed it to Bikash without knowing whose man he was, so Maganlal sends a henchman with Bikash to stab him and drop the knife in the Ganges.

Both turn on one person occupies another's identity and lives it. Onofrio has a drunk coalman who is his double carried home and dressed in his clothes, and Gasperino wakes a marquis, is taken for possessed, is put up for exorcism, settles into it well enough that parts of the family prefer him, and is nearly guillotined in his place. Seduced by Eva's holograms deep in the station's cavern, the engineer Miguel is made to believe he is Carlo Rambaldi and is last seen talking romantically with her, fully embracing the dead singer's identity.

Both turn on a need is laid before someone with no prior claim or duty, who must decide whether to take up a burden that is not theirs., and they disagree about it. Martha runs to Kaiser, a colleague she once trained and who owes her nothing, and he agrees to drive her; she grabs the wheel believing Helmut is behind them, and the crash kills him and paralyses her. John, broke outside a diner, tells a stranger he needs $6,000 for his mother's funeral, and Sydney — owing him nothing — buys him coffee and takes him to Vegas to win it.

Both turn on those closest watch a person change and cannot reach them. Umaprasad gets Doyamoyee as far as the boat on the riverbank but she asks to be taken back, having begun to wonder whether she is a goddess; when he returns he finds her dressing in her wedding attire saying they must leave before she is killed, and she runs into the mist as he calls after her. Kaori holds onto Tetsuo at the stadium while Shikishima offers to mend his arm and teach him to hold the power, and Kaneda comes at him with a laser rifle; the mass takes the stadium, Kaori and Kaneda with it.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way.. Emil Czaka, the wealthy brewer admitted to resistance meetings and privy to its leaders, is in fact a German fifth-columnist, and when he is tricked into revealing it the Gestapo kill or arrest most of the resistance. Crowe is hired into Grimes' Toolshed and worked alongside by Wells while secretly reporting to CIA handler Smitty, whose agency intends to seize the firm; Smitty finally tells Wells about the infiltration and she comes to kill Crowe.

Both turn on one party keeps another inside a position they can neither leave nor advance from. When Howie goes back to his seaplane on May Day morning to call the mainland, the engine is dead and the radio is smashed. Immortan Joe keeps his five 'wives' — Toast, Capable, Cheedo, the Dag and the pregnant Angharad — inside the Citadel as breeders, and leads his entire army to drag them back when they flee in the War Rig; the confinement ends only when Furiosa kills him.

Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it, and they disagree about it. Jim asks Frank how a man defends his honour and is told to avoid confrontation, then pleads with his father to stand up for him when Carol announces another move; Frank refuses and Jim attacks him, until at the observatory Frank finally comforts him and vows to be a better father. Given command of the Swiss Guard at Castel Sant'Angelo, Onofrio leaves his post to check on a plebeian girl he is keeping, and the French walk in and take the Pope.

Both turn on what one party shaped, taught or set in motion refuses the purpose it was given and comes back on the one who made it.. Ordered to kill Nicholas, the male creature is stopped by what is left of the friend whose head it wears, and kills the Baron instead before opening itself up. Shortly after the pastor berates his daughter in front of the confirmation class, she takes scissors to his parakeet's cage and he finds the bird on his desk impaled in the shape of a cross.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to, and they disagree about it. Anna Maria is sent by her classmates to meet the Greek teacher at the Sea Horse Fountain and kiss him so they can photograph it and blackmail him into passing them, and the teacher is never party to the arrangement — until, hearing he is losing his sight and must give up teaching, she hugs him while covering his face so the photograph fails. Pelle and Ingemar lure Mark, Josh, Simon and Connie to the Hårga as four of the nine bodies the commune needs to purge itself of evil, a purpose the visitors are told only at the final ceremony.

edges.a: let s hope it s a girl
edges.claim: Both turn on one party keeps giving to a bond the other will not return, and no reason is given that the giving can work on.. Nardoni, who has farmed for her and loved her for years, offers to buy the villa and marry her so she need not leave it; Elena sells him the land and refuses the marriage. Dani, still grieving her sister's murder-suicide of their parents, stays attached to Christian, who had intended to break up with her and only reluctantly invites her to Sweden after an argument, then takes part in the sex ritual with Maja.

Both turn on parties proceed on an account of who someone is that is simply wrong, and the truth reaches them only once the damage is done.. Jim quietly removes the ammunition before handing the gun back to Plato, and the police, seeing only that Plato is still holding it, shoot him dead as he charges them. Blind Nydia, believing she is speaking to Antonius after Marcus's funeral, tells Gallinus — the man charged with persecuting Christians — how to find the secret Christian gathering, and that night he rounds them all up for torture and death.

Both turn on the penalty or cost owed for one party's act or settlement falls on someone else, while the one who owes it goes free., and they disagree about it. After the liberation of Sicily the same boss who forced him into the party is sitting with an American officer while former Fascists call themselves anti-Fascists, and he sacks Piscitello for that party membership. Eboshi's iron ball, fired into the boar god Nago, turns him into the demon whose curse lands on Ashitaka's arm and condemns him to death and exile, while Eboshi carries on prospering in Irontown until the curse is lifted at the film's end.

Both turn on the party who was failed or harmed confronts the one responsible and demands they answer for it. Woken by her mother's nightmare, Eva keeps her in the living room until morning and puts the whole ledger to her: the tours, the years away, the child she was pressed into aborting. After surviving the poisoning and Ernest's courtroom testimony, Mollie leaves him when he will not admit that he was the one poisoning her insulin.

Both turn on a need is laid before someone with no prior claim or duty, who must decide whether to take up a burden that is not theirs., and they disagree about it. The farmers, with no claim on him, ask Kambei to defend their village for nothing but food, and he agrees after recognising their suffering, then recruits Gorobei, Shichirōji, Heihachi and Kyūzō to a burden that is not theirs. Martha runs to Kaiser, a colleague she once trained and who owes her nothing, and he agrees to drive her; she grabs the wheel believing Helmut is behind them, and the crash kills him and paralyses her.

Both turn on a parent cannot feel toward the child what the child needs. Elisabet tears up the photograph of her son that came in her husband's letter, and Alma recounts that she attempted a self-induced abortion and gave birth to a boy she despises while he craves her love. Charlotte gives Helena a wristwatch, offers Eva her car, and on the train out asks her agent why the girl could not simply have died.

Both turn on one party fails to see or value the person standing closest to it. Ryōta neglects Midori and Keita for his architecture work, and only when he finds a cache of photos Keita secretly took of him sleeping does he break down and later apologise to the boy for his failures as a father. Gina is the one pressing for the sandstone, but Albert will only address Ryan, who gives her no backing in the negotiation and undermines her with their daughter; at the closing barbecue Ryan finally acknowledges the work she has done on the house.

Both turn on a third party stands between two who would join and keeps them apart. Mrs Robinson threatens to tell Elaine about the affair to stop the two of them, and Mr Robinson threatens Benjamin with jail and takes Elaine out of Berkeley to marry Carl. Anna's letter from Switzerland asking Henrik to resume the relationship is intercepted by her parents — Johan opens it and Karin reads and burns it — and only after Johan's death does Karin confess, whereupon Anna goes to Henrik and marries him.

edges.a: the plot of the fuma clan
edges.aTitle: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
edges.claim: Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way., and they disagree about it. Inspector Kazami, who talks Zenigata out of the temple and back onto the case, has been the Fuma Boss's man the whole time, and Fujiko finds him standing in their ranks. Larry acts as Akeem's friend and auditor and promises to unmask Molly's lover while having designs on Molly himself and denying to Feng that he is pursuing her; when he is caught chasing Birdy with a sword prop, Akeem shoves him into an elevator as Larry complains his friendship went unreciprocated.

Both turn on one party is passed over by someone whose regard they held, in favour of another that person prefers. Johannes courts the Count's daughter Gerda and then turns to her stepmother Helga once he learns Devil's Field will go to Helga, leaving Gerda to get engaged to Baron von Lellewel out of spite. Dito, whom Lilica took up after the reformatory, turns to the prostitute they are pimping, and Lilica walks out of the group.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Maximus, finding his wife and son murdered on Commodus' order, declares in the Colosseum that he will have his vengeance and finally kills Commodus in the arena duel. Michael Perry is interviewed on death row eight days before his execution on July 1, 2010, while Jason Burkett receives life instead, and Herzog also interviews a chaplain and a former death house worker who retired after taking part in Karla Faye Tucker's execution.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back. Having reached the point where he knows more dead than living, Davenne consecrates the chapel to the whole cemetery and keeps a candle burning for every one of them. Sadazo, expecting to die in the Philippines, asks Matsuyama to carry his wife Tomoko's postcard back to her and say he received it before dying; after the war Matsuyama makes his way to Tomoko's house to discharge that errand.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to, and they disagree about it. Anna Maria is sent by her classmates to meet the Greek teacher at the Sea Horse Fountain and kiss him so they can photograph it and blackmail him into passing them, and the teacher is never party to the arrangement — until, hearing he is losing his sight and must give up teaching, she hugs him while covering his face so the photograph fails. Bytes keeps Merrick hooded between shows, is paid by Treves for the loan of him, beats him nearly to death when he comes back, steals him out of the hospital and finally locks him in a cage in Belgium to die.

Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand., and they disagree about it. Half the town knows the Vicario twins are sitting in Clotilde Armenta's shop with knives waiting for Santiago; some think it is talk, some think it must be stopped, the authorities do nothing, and he walks into the square unarmed. From his signal tower Maloin sees one man knocked into the water at the quayside and the other flee, then climbs down, takes the briefcase of English banknotes and tells no one — not Morrison when questioned during his shift, not his family — until he finally brings the case to the tavern and confesses.

Both turn on two parties take each other up across a line their people hold as forbidden, and keep it out of sight of those who would move against them, and they disagree about it. Erich, in training for the church, is in love with his father's wife, who is a year younger than he is, and tells only Fredericka before running out to kill himself. Pauline, running her called-up husband's shop, takes the Polish prisoner assigned to help her as a lover, and they are seen at it in the open in a village where the race laws make it a capital matter for him.

Both turn on one party keeps attendance on another who can no longer answer or meet them, and goes on addressing them anyway. Eleven years after Julie's death Davenne keeps an upstairs room for her, and when it burns he rebuilds it in a ruined cemetery chapel as a forest of candles he goes on talking to. Matsumoto takes the semi-catatonic Sawako out of the hospital and walks her through the seasons tied to him by a red rope, keeping her company though she cannot answer him.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would.. Burning, Howie tells Summerisle that the orchards fail because the climate will not carry them and that the islanders will put him in the fire next year, and nobody on the hill takes it up. Biff holds onto him in the yard and says as plainly as he can that he is a dime a dozen and so are both of them, and Willy takes the crying for forgiveness and goes out to buy him a business with his own death.

Both turn on one party settles what another is before hearing anything that other can offer, and they disagree about it. The three senior Iyi samurai treat Motome as an extortionist running a suicide bluff and refuse the two-day delay he asks for without ever investigating that he wanted it to settle affairs with his dying wife and child. When Yuichi's mother asks his consent to the marriage, Shigematsu - whose own niece has been refused all round for what happened to her - is indignant at the young man's war trauma before he will consider it.

Both turn on two parties with no claim on each other, each holding the same loss or damage, become each other's only people. The unemployed Tramp and Ellen, an orphaned street urchin caught stealing bread, have no claim on each other but end up sharing a run-down shack, finding each other jobs, and walking down the road together at dawn. Pelle tells Dani he too was orphaned when his parents burned to death and that the commune became his family, then asks whether she feels supported by Christian, and she ends the film absorbed into the Hårga as May Queen.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Alma opens the unsealed letter Elisabet has written to the doctor and finds she is being 'studied' — her story of the orgy and abortion set down as material — and rounds on Elisabet for using her. Adamo has McCain sprung from prison and put on the Royal through Jack, so that the robbery reads as a bank robber's own idea and Adamo's stake war with Stilberman never appears in it.

Both turn on one party works on another to turn them back from a course that would undo them. In 'Other people's houses' the old village priest, learning that Zelinda means to end her strenuous, monotonous life, argues her out of it and physically hauls her back up when she slips off the cliff; in 'Mara' Vasco talks Mara out of going to work in a brothel the next morning by offering to keep her on his teacher's wage. Darek means to stay inside and go on with the hunger strike; Labrador builds a defence around union men swearing he is no danger to anyone, and sends his junior into the cell to talk him out of the strike, and the sentence is suspended.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to, and they disagree about it. Mirage hires Bob for a well-paid secret mission against the Omnidroid without telling him he is a live test subject in Syndrome's programme to perfect a robot that will kill supers. Daniel adopts the orphaned baby H.W. after a derrick accident kills the boy's father, specifically so he can present himself as a family man to investors, and only decades later tells H.W. he was a bastard from a basket used as a 'sweet face' to buy land.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Giannini is shot on Luciano's order before he can get in front of the grand jury in New York. Lt Yoon, the medical officer who oversaw the tortured detainees, agrees to describe the torture methods in court, and Cha's superiors frame him for desertion to nullify his testimony and send him to prison.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest. Beth never told Karen that she and David had an affair years earlier in her marriage; Karen only learns it second-hand from Gabe, who heard it from Tom, and is hurt that her closest friend kept it from her. Lydia hides her pursuit of Olga from Sharon — telling her the fall she took while following Olga home was a mugging — and Sharon, furious at the allegations and the lack of transparency, bars her from seeing Petra.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Dismounted Cossacks form lines at the top of the Odessa steps and advance on unarmed women and children, halting to fire volleys and ignoring their pleas, while cavalry cuts down the survivors at the bottom. The ethnic Chinese who survived the massacres go on having their money extorted by the same gangsters, who also rig elections, clear land for developers and run gambling and drug rackets.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Sweetie arrives back with Bob and takes the house over - Kay's clothes ruined, the furniture broken, everyone managed round her rages and then forgiven the next morning. After the fundamentalists win the elections Marji lives under compulsory headscarves, black-market music, fined for holding Reza's hand, and a party raid in which the women are detained and Nima falls to his death fleeing across the rooftops.

Both turn on a promise to marry, or to wait, is broken. Master Zhu promised Jade that if they could not marry they would die together; when the marriage plainly will not happen she feeds him opium and tries to drink it herself. Matsumoto breaks off his engagement to Sawako in order to marry the daughter of his company's president, and only afterwards binds himself back to her with the red rope.

Both turn on the help arrives from the person with the most reason to withhold it. Sefton, whom these men have just beaten as an informer and who despises Dunbar as a rich boy who only passed officer school on his family's money, is the one who goes into the water tower and gets Dunbar out of the camp. Facing the loss of his job, Ferdinand asks the very smuggler he has spent years arresting to help him, and Giuseppe takes him across to the Italian side for identity papers and later brings him food and the truth on the mountain.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it, and they disagree about it. Gérard, who takes charge of Balthazar at the bakery out of jealousy over Marie's affection, beats the donkey and prepares to bludgeon him to death, and holds Marie in a violent relationship that ends with him and his gang stripping, beating and locking her in the barn. Hans throws a chair at Irmgard in the bar for coming to fetch him and beats her in the flat in front of Renate, and she is gone with the child the next morning.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would.. Mylène asks Edgar twice to slow down as he speeds toward their seaside house, he answers that his ideas go fast when he drives fast, and the crash into the tree leaves her mute and pregnant for the rest of the film. Tadokoro tells the cabinet after Amagi that more eruptions and quakes are coming and is dismissed as an alarmist; the Tokyo earthquake follows and kills three million.

Both turn on a marriage is entered for money, standing or cover rather than love. Having overheard that the Count found oil under Devil's Field and having written the will that leaves Devil's Field to Helga, Johannes tells Helga he loves her and marries her after the Count's death. Hélène Kuragina sets her sights on Pierre the moment old Count Bezukhov's will makes him sole heir, and her father Prince Vasily installs himself as administrator of Pierre's estates; after her flirtation with Dolokhov and the duel, Pierre separates from her.

edges.claim: Both turn on one party keeps giving to a bond the other will not return, and no reason is given that the giving can work on., and they disagree about it. Nardoni, who has farmed for her and loved her for years, offers to buy the villa and marry her so she need not leave it; Elena sells him the land and refuses the marriage. Cui Mingliang pursues Yin Ruijuan, who answers noncommittally and then rejects him as incompatible; he pines for her through years of touring without contacting her, and only on his final return to Fenyang do they reconnect and marry.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to, and they disagree about it. Anna Maria is sent by her classmates to meet the Greek teacher at the Sea Horse Fountain and kiss him so they can photograph it and blackmail him into passing them, and the teacher is never party to the arrangement — until, hearing he is losing his sight and must give up teaching, she hugs him while covering his face so the photograph fails. Howie is what the failed harvest requires: he came freely, he carries the power of a king in the law, he is a virgin and he is the fool, and he is put in the wicker figure with the animals and burned.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Bought from her mother and travelling in Zampanò's motocarro, Gelsomina is presented as his wife, intimidated, forced upon and beaten, and when she rebels and runs to town he simply carries her back by force. After the fundamentalists win the elections Marji lives under compulsory headscarves, black-market music, fined for holding Reza's hand, and a party raid in which the women are detained and Nima falls to his death fleeing across the rooftops.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Michael Perry is interviewed on death row eight days before his execution on July 1, 2010, while Jason Burkett receives life instead, and Herzog also interviews a chaplain and a former death house worker who retired after taking part in Karla Faye Tucker's execution. After his donkey Jenny chokes to death on one of Colm's severed fingers, Pádraic announces at the pub that he will burn Colm's house down at 2 pm the next day, and does so with Colm sitting inside.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it, and they disagree about it. The Algerians of the Casbah live under French colonial administration and its paratroopers' routine torture, intimidation and murder, until the closing nationalist demonstrations show the war lost even though the battle was won. Four years into the colony the natives are forced to mine gold for the Spaniards, and Moxica cuts off the hand of one who fails to produce any, after which the tribes vanish into the forest and the island turns to war.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. The camp scientists select the prisoner for time-travel experiments because his obsessive memory of the woman on the Orly jetty makes him able to withstand the shock, use him to fetch a power unit from the future, and then move to execute him once the mission is accomplished. Bomba cut women's hair inside the gas chamber itself and found the wife and sister of a friend among them, Muller burned the bodies, and Srebnik was made to sing military songs for the guards at Chelmno.

Both turn on one party holds out rescue, pity or an easier way and the one it is meant for will not take it, and they disagree about it. Takako offers to take the blinded, burned Iwakichi and his grandson Tarō back to the island with her, and Iwakichi refuses and runs away, relenting only when the neighbour talks him round — and then only for the boy. Jacques offers to marry Marie even after she tells him of the abuse, and tells her his father has dropped the court-ordered money, but she leaves and her mother tells him only "She's gone and will never come back."

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it, and they disagree about it. Hans throws a chair at Irmgard in the bar for coming to fetch him and beats her in the flat in front of Renate, and she is gone with the child the next morning. He forbids her suntan oil on the honeymoon and then takes her in the hotel room while she is screaming from the burns, and afterwards he is aroused whenever she is hurt or frightened.

Both turn on one party settles what another is before hearing anything that other can offer. The detectives take the semen in her bed as evidence she and Danny were involved, and go on treating a woman who stabbed an unarmed man as something other than a survivor. Sister Aloysius fixes Flynn's guilt from a boy pulling away in the courtyard, alcohol on Donald Miller's breath and an undershirt in a locker, and when Flynn demands what proof she has she answers that all she has is her certainty.

edges.b: all the money in the world
edges.bTitle: All the Money in the World

Both turn on the emergency was arranged by the person it is about, and they disagree about it. Peter Cable hires his family friend Klute to find Gruneman and takes his reports throughout, having killed Gruneman himself and planted the obscene letter to explain him. Ewa gets Janusz out of the house on Christmas night to look for a husband who has not been hers for three years and is in Krakow with another family, and lays clues through the hospitals and the station to keep the search going till dawn.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Hachizo and Gorosuke lure Sankichi with the promise of food and kill him with an axe in order to eat him, the boy never told what he is being brought for. Alma opens the unsealed letter Elisabet has written to the doctor and finds she is being 'studied' — her story of the orgy and abortion set down as material — and rounds on Elisabet for using her.

When Cecilia breaks with him he shuts himself in the house and will not eat, will not see the doctor and will not speak.

Emil Czaka, the wealthy brewer admitted to resistance meetings and privy to its leaders, is in fact a German fifth-columnist, and when he is tricked into revealing it the Gestapo kill or arrest most of the resistance. Ruth, whom Lang claims he met at Cambridge, was in fact tutored and recruited as a CIA agent by Professor Paul Emmett at Harvard, and steered a Prime Minister whose every decision benefited US interests until he was assassinated.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest. Rosa carries on a year-long affair with Neil Latimer while her husband Lewis, the town doctor, knows nothing of it, until her delirium and resentment over the pregnancy drive her to confess both the affair and the murder of Moose to him. Beth never told Karen that she and David had an affair years earlier in her marriage; Karen only learns it second-hand from Gabe, who heard it from Tom, and is hurt that her closest friend kept it from her.

Mirage hires Bob for a well-paid secret mission against the Omnidroid without telling him he is a live test subject in Syndrome's programme to perfect a robot that will kill supers.

Teddy Gatz, whose mother Sandy was left comatose by an Auxolith clinical trial, abducts the company's CEO Michelle Fuller with his cousin Don, shaves her head, coats her in antihistamine cream and shocks her with electricity in his basement.

Both turn on one party fails to see or value the person standing closest to it, and they disagree about it. Yvonne, the only actual peasant in a cell that lectures itself about the peasantry, does the apartment's housework and is kept outside the discussions. Ryōta neglects Midori and Keita for his architecture work, and only when he finds a cache of photos Keita secretly took of him sleeping does he break down and later apologise to the boy for his failures as a father.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. The camp scientists select the prisoner for time-travel experiments because his obsessive memory of the woman on the Orly jetty makes him able to withstand the shock, use him to fetch a power unit from the future, and then move to execute him once the mission is accomplished. Inside FEBEM the boys are the pieces the guards and their commander play with, and what they are used for is never anything of theirs.

Both turn on a wanting that arrives after a binding already made cannot be had without breaking it, and one of the two people must be given up.. Kate promised to wait for Pete and loves Philip instead; when Pete turns out to be alive Philip urges her to keep the promise and marry him, and she can hardly bear the marriage. The actress, married with children and flying to Paris the next day, and the married Hiroshima architect cannot have each other without breaking those marriages; she agrees to stay, then tells him to go away.

edges.b: all the money in the world
edges.bTitle: All the Money in the World
edges.claim: Both turn on the help arrives from the person with the most reason to withhold it. Sefton, whom these men have just beaten as an informer and who despises Dunbar as a rich boy who only passed officer school on his family's money, is the one who goes into the water tower and gets Dunbar out of the camp. Cinquanta, one of Paul's own captors, tells him to run rather than wait at the handover and later attacks the criminal who corners him in Lauria so Paul can reach Gail.

Both turn on one party keeps giving to a bond the other will not return, and no reason is given that the giving can work on.. Cecilia finally writes what she cannot say to his face - that to be loved by him she would have to be dead - and lights the last candle for him herself. At the campsite Kurt breaks down, says something has 'come between' them and that he wants them to be real friends again, while Mark disagrees with the assessment and stays apprehensive; they part with a quick goodbye on the same street where they met.

Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand.. Valerie sees Jef leaving Martey's office clearly and then fails to pick him out of the identity parade, and the silence is what puts him back on the street. Mrs. Miller hears out Aloysius's account of what may be happening to Donald and asks her to leave it alone until June — the boy is beaten by his father for being gay, Flynn is the only man who has shown him kindness, and removal would cost him the school.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own, and they disagree about it. When Johannes tells Gerda he never loved either woman and acted only from ambition, she sets fire to the oil rig on Devil's Field and dies in the explosion. Major Kopp brings another soldier and forces Mariu's door, and the women carry out porcelain, rugs and clocks to the value of the money while Mariu stands there and hardly protests.

edges.a: sunrise a song of two humans
edges.aTitle: Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans
edges.claim: Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it, and they disagree about it. The Woman from the City proposes drowning the Wife and gathers the bundles of reeds that will keep the Man afloat when the boat is overturned, so that he does the killing and she stays clear of it. In Naples Luciano runs the drug traffic entirely through proxies out of a race track, so that dozens of his associates are arrested over the years and nothing is ever in his hand.

edges.b: the time to live and the time to die
edges.bTitle: The Time to Live and the Time to Die
edges.claim: Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it. Fusako's brother-in-law, who otherwise keeps the Owada household, refuses to pay for her infant's vaccinations as unnecessary and overpriced while she sells her possessions for food, and the baby dies of illness. The grandmother dies at home without Ah-ha or his two younger brothers noticing, and the mortician who comes for her finds half the body already gone and says nothing to them about it.

Both turn on an older party passes into a younger one the injury or the task it carried, which the younger has to take forward. Aleksei's marriage repeats his mother's down to the face - Natalia and Maria are the same actress, Ignat and the young Aleksei the same boy - and he hands his son the absent father he has never stopped carrying. William's older brother Curtis, a talented player who never reached the pros, transfers his unfulfilled aspirations onto William, who plays his sophomore and junior seasons under that weight.

edges.b: a quiet place in the country
edges.bTitle: A Quiet Place in the Country
edges.claim: Both turn on one party takes the gain of what another spent, made or suffered, and returns them nothing for it. Broke, Checco begs Melina for the money to launch the show featuring Liliana; she hands it over, orders him never to contact her again, and he takes it triumphantly. Flavia presses Leonardo to paint so her gallery has stock, and when he is committed she buys the small obscene canvases off the orderly who is now doing the pressing.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own, and they disagree about it. After Adua refuses Ercoli's rent and humiliates him in front of the others, he has all four women arrested for prostitution in revenge. After the knife-throwing Feluda swears he will either settle what was done to Jatayu or give up being a detective, and the sting that takes Maganlal is the settlement.

Both turn on one party fashions another into what it requires and holds them to that shape. The Baron is building a male and a female out of corpse parts to found an obedient Serbian race, and rejects heads for the wrong nose and the wrong libido. The flashbacks are Gordon holding his daughter up through her tricks and songs, and he goes on treating a grown woman as that child rather than as ill; Flo says plainly that he indulges her, and the family keep the little girl at the end.

Both turn on a wanting that arrives after a binding already made cannot be had without breaking it, and one of the two people must be given up.. Kate promised to wait for Pete and loves Philip instead; when Pete turns out to be alive Philip urges her to keep the promise and marry him, and she can hardly bear the marriage. Karin has fifteen years of marriage, two children and a husband at the hospital, and David; Andreas tells her plainly that if she goes to London she does not come back, and she goes.

Both turn on one party comes asking something of another who is free to answer it, and is turned away, and they disagree about it. With the wrong child taken, Gondō announces he will not pay the ransom for his chauffeur's son, and only relents after the chauffeur's continuous pleading and his wife's pressure. Larry goes to his synagogue for consolation and gets Rabbi Scott's advice to change his 'perspective', Rabbi Nachtner's anecdote about Hebrew letters on a goy's teeth, and Marshak, who will not see him at all.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Bomba cut women's hair inside the gas chamber itself and found the wife and sister of a friend among them, Muller burned the bodies, and Srebnik was made to sing military songs for the guards at Chelmno. Greenhill reveals in the empty courtroom that he had been scouting Jennifer Haines long before he killed his wife Rita, selecting her as his defence attorney for a plan she was never made party to.

edges.a: such a gorgeous kid like me
edges.aTitle: Such a Gorgeous Kid Like Me
edges.claim: Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Camille kills the husband who caught them and plants the pistol on Stanislas while he is unconscious, and he goes to prison for the murder. Beaten by her mother until she gives a name, Angela says Santiago Nasar, though the two were never seen together and she never alters a word of it in twenty-seven years.

Both turn on the betrayal comes from the person nearest, who was serving someone else. Giannini is Luciano's own associate, working for the Bureau of Narcotics the whole time, and Luciano finds it out by reading the letters Giannini sent through the mistress they were sharing. Quaid's wife Lori attacks him at home and tells him she was assigned by the Agency to monitor him, that their marriage is an implanted memory, and that Richter is her real husband; Quaid later kills her.

Both turn on the harm arrives through the very party charged with keeping the other safe, often done in the name of keeping them.. Dr Sapirstein, the obstetrician the Castevets steer her to, attributes the pain to pelvic joints, discounts her, and sedates her at the door of the delivery. The guards charged with the boys' custody at Wilkinson Home for Boys — Nokes, Addison, Ferguson and Styler — repeatedly rape and torture Shakes, Tommy, Michael and John, culminating in a 'farewell party' gang rape the night before Shakes' release.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Moose overhears Rosa and Latimer planning her divorce and remarriage and threatens to tell Latimer about her pregnancy himself, so Rosa shoots him dead on the hunting trip and claims she mistook him for a deer. Hutch researches the Bramford's history and Roman Castevet, arranges to bring Rosemary what he found, and falls into a coma that night; he surfaces once, to leave her the anagram.

edges.b: portrait of a lady on fire
edges.bTitle: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
edges.claim: Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true. A changeling kills the Emerald Seer and travels on with the party wearing his face until Rell and Colwyn find it out. Marianne is installed in the house as Héloïse's hired walking companion so she can memorise her face on the coastal walks and paint her in secret, until she confesses the commission and destroys the first portrait.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Every woman who could name the older client goes: McKenna a supposed suicide, Arlyn Page pulled out of the river after she tells Bree the photograph is the wrong man. Greenhill knocks out the investigator Moe and burns his office once Moe has dug up his history of dating older women who end up dead, then comes for Haines as she prepares to disclose everything.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. When Johannes tells Gerda he never loved either woman and acted only from ambition, she sets fire to the oil rig on Devil's Field and dies in the explosion. Kai brings Kaneda the news about Yamagata and Kaneda swears he will settle it with Tetsuo himself, and goes into the stadium after him twice.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Glaucus returns to find his father murdered and the house looted by the cross-marking hooded band, vows revenge, and hunts them to the Temple of Isis, where Arbaces and Julia are finally crushed by the toppling idol and Gallinus shot in the royal box. Michael Perry is interviewed on death row eight days before his execution on July 1, 2010, while Jason Burkett receives life instead, and Herzog also interviews a chaplain and a former death house worker who retired after taking part in Karla Faye Tucker's execution.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Maximus, finding his wife and son murdered on Commodus' order, declares in the Colosseum that he will have his vengeance and finally kills Commodus in the arena duel. Teddy Gatz, whose mother Sandy was left comatose by an Auxolith clinical trial, abducts the company's CEO Michelle Fuller with his cousin Don, shaves her head, coats her in antihistamine cream and shocks her with electricity in his basement.

edges.aTitle: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold

Martha runs to Kaiser, a colleague she once trained and who owes her nothing, and he agrees to drive her; she grabs the wheel believing Helmut is behind them, and the crash kills him and paralyses her.

Both turn on one party obtains another's closeness or presence and pays for it with the means to live. The two Maries systematically trade their company for meals — flirting with a man to secure a free lunch and crying when he leaves, and Marie II sitting with the butterfly collector who declares his love while she only asks him for food. Cook courts and marries Rhonda, a former teacher waiting tables while she and her mother Miranda grow desperate for money, and pays to have a house built for Miranda; Rhonda later takes her own life.

Both turn on parties bound to each other by service, alliance or company come to act against each other. Bernard murders Robert, the man he served alongside in Algeria, shortly after Hélène has urged Robert to go and talk to him. His own team-mate blocks his pit stall at North Wilkesboro and puts him in the outside wall on the last lap, Cole drives into him on the cool-down, and the whole shop ends in a fight that gets Cole and Harry fired.

Both turn on one party fashions another into what it requires and holds them to that shape. After meeting Judy on the street, Scottie makes her change her clothes and dye her hair until she is 'Madeleine' again, and holds her to that shape. The flashbacks are Gordon holding his daughter up through her tricks and songs, and he goes on treating a grown woman as that child rather than as ill; Flo says plainly that he indulges her, and the family keep the little girl at the end.

Both turn on one party holds out rescue, pity or an easier way and the one it is meant for will not take it. Mary's brothers reluctantly offer John a position and he refuses it as a 'charity job', ending up carrying a sandwich board instead. When Cecilia breaks with him he shuts himself in the house and will not eat, will not see the doctor and will not speak.

Crowe is hired into Grimes' Toolshed and worked alongside by Wells while secretly reporting to CIA handler Smitty, whose agency intends to seize the firm; Smitty finally tells Wells about the infiltration and she comes to kill Crowe. Hon Sam puts Lau Kin-ming through the police academy to rise as his mole while Superintendent Wong plants Chan Wing-yan inside Hon's triad, each man relied on for ten years by the organisation he is betraying.

Both turn on a wanting that arrives after a binding already made cannot be had without breaking it, and one of the two people must be given up.. Natasha, having promised to wait a year for Andrei while he is in Prussia, is seduced by Anatole Kuragin and agrees to elope with him; the plan is foiled by Sonya and Pierre but Andrei ends the engagement and refuses to forgive her even on the eve of Borodino. Karin has fifteen years of marriage, two children and a husband at the hospital, and David; Andreas tells her plainly that if she goes to London she does not come back, and she goes.

edges.aTitle: Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans

Both turn on one party brings a grievance upward and the party above treats it as an offence to be put down, and they disagree about it. The crew complains that the ship's meat is maggot-infested and refuses the borscht; Dr Smirnov declares it edible, Giliarovsky drives them off, and all who refused are judged guilty of insubordination and brought to the fore-deck to be shot under a canvas. Okajima goes to the boss to protest Yamada's dismissal for having two clients die after signing policies; the boss takes offence, the two scuffle, and Okajima is fired and bows on his way out.

edges.b: the plot of the fuma clan
edges.bTitle: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
edges.claim: Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it, and they disagree about it. Waiting on her biopsy result, Cléo raises her fear of cancer with her lover José, who talks lovingly but dismisses the fears and stays only a few minutes, after which she tells Angèle she is thinking of breaking up with him. Clan Elder Suminawa will not give up the urn for his granddaughter's life, because it holds the way to the family treasure, so Lupin steals it off him and makes the trade himself.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. After Genshichi attacks Ishimatsu and leaves him badly injured, Sakichi fights his way past the constables to the house where Genshichi is hiding and kills him. After Adua refuses Ercoli's rent and humiliates him in front of the others, he has all four women arrested for prostitution in revenge.

Both turn on one party ends or leaves the bond on their own account and gives the other no reason they can accept, and the other has no standing to refuse it.. Paul clears the flat and goes without a word, and Jeanne lets herself in to bare rooms; when he turns up again on the street it is to ask for it back. Colm abruptly stops speaking to his lifelong drinking companion Pádraic, tells him only that he is too dull and that he would rather compose music, and enforces the break by threatening to cut off one of his own fingers each time Pádraic speaks to him.

Both turn on one party takes the gain of what another spent, made or suffered, and returns them nothing for it, and they disagree about it. Broke, Checco begs Melina for the money to launch the show featuring Liliana; she hands it over, orders him never to contact her again, and he takes it triumphantly. The Goonies get through every trap in the tunnel to the Inferno and the Fratellis walk aboard, empty their pockets and start them along the plank.

Both turn on one party requires of another an act that other cannot square with themselves. Aldo Piscitello's boss tells him to join the Fascist Party or lose his municipal job, so he enrolls and backdates the enrollment to 1921 while continuing to meet his anti-Fascist friends at the pharmacist's shop. Shakes asks Father Bobby, the priest who once persuaded him to confess the hot-dog cart accident, to commit perjury; he reluctantly swears John and Tommy were with him at a Knicks game and produces three ticket stubs.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way.. Marcello arrives in Paris as Quadri's old student on his honeymoon and is taken into the household, which is what puts him close enough to fix the killing. Crowe is hired into Grimes' Toolshed and worked alongside by Wells while secretly reporting to CIA handler Smitty, whose agency intends to seize the firm; Smitty finally tells Wells about the infiltration and she comes to kill Crowe.

Both turn on a wanting that arrives after a binding already made cannot be had without breaking it, and one of the two people must be given up.. The actress, married with children and flying to Paris the next day, and the married Hiroshima architect cannot have each other without breaking those marriages; she agrees to stay, then tells him to go away.

edges.aTitle: Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans
edges.claim: Both turn on a wanting that arrives after a binding already made cannot be had without breaking it, and one of the two people must be given up., and they disagree about it. The Woman from the City whistles at the farmhouse fence and asks the Man to sell the farm and come to the city, which he cannot do while the Wife and child exist — and he finally sends her carriage away and returns to his wife's bedside. The actress, married with children and flying to Paris the next day, and the married Hiroshima architect cannot have each other without breaking those marriages; she agrees to stay, then tells him to go away.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Isabella discovered that Morlacchi and Cristiana had murdered the Countess's husband and tried to blackmail them, so they kill her and then hunt her diary through the fashion house, killing Nicole and burning Peggy to death in a furnace to find out where it went. Greenhill knocks out the investigator Moe and burns his office once Moe has dug up his history of dating older women who end up dead, then comes for Haines as she prepares to disclose everything.

Both turn on the betrayal comes from the person nearest, who was serving someone else. Pete leaves for Africa asking his childhood friend Philip to take care of Kate, and Philip calls on her daily and begins an affair with her at the old mill. Richard brings his wife to the museum to take up the daggers and Ann puts them into him, saying she has always belonged to Damien.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it, and they disagree about it. Dismounted Cossacks form lines at the top of the Odessa steps and advance on unarmed women and children, halting to fire volleys and ignoring their pleas, while cavalry cuts down the survivors at the bottom. Hans throws a chair at Irmgard in the bar for coming to fetch him and beats her in the flat in front of Renate, and she is gone with the child the next morning.

Both turn on one party comes back to a bond or a place that has closed over their absence, and those who stayed must answer the return, and they disagree about it. Tiberio comes out of prison to a Rome he does not know, finds a house painter installed with Teresa on rent paid in her company, learns his camera gear went to the lawyer's bill, and is thrown out of the door and sleeps in a wrecked car in the yard opposite. Montand comes back to Marseille to stage his own life and spends his free hours looking for the girl he loved when he was nobody, and finds her behind the Baroness de Lambert's card, in the bar they first met in, about to lose her home while her husband serves five years.

Both turn on one party fails to see or value the person standing closest to it, and they disagree about it. John comes home drunk on Christmas Eve after a woman at Bert's throws herself at him, yells at Mary over something trivial, and shows such apathy when she threatens to leave in April that she is shocked and hurt. Yvonne, the only actual peasant in a cell that lectures itself about the peasantry, does the apartment's housework and is kept outside the discussions.

Both turn on a body of people puts out one of its own members and withholds standing from them. Henri argues the pro-Soviet line inside the Aden Arabie cell, is denounced as a revisionist by the others and put out of the apartment. Ghanbar tells Panahi the photo turmoil has become unbearable and that the police and Revolutionary Guards are involved, and asks him to leave Jaban.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Hutch researches the Bramford's history and Roman Castevet, arranges to bring Rosemary what he found, and falls into a coma that night; he surfaces once, to leave her the anagram. Dolores threatens to take the affair to Miriam and can also describe the financial dealings that built the practice, so Judah has her shot and goes to the flat himself for the letters.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would., and they disagree about it. Scotty Scott spends decades arguing the aircraft carrier's power to a Navy and Congress that will not credit it, losing a promotion for his outspokenness at Annapolis, and is vindicated only after Pearl Harbor, at Midway and finally at Okinawa once he has pleaded in Washington for the carrier fleet. Rosemary reaches Dr Hill with the anagram, the tannis root and the necktie taken from the blinded actor, and he takes her for delusional and telephones Sapirstein.

edges.b: jolanda the daughter of the black corsair
edges.bTitle: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair
edges.claim: Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own, and they disagree about it. When Johannes tells Gerda he never loved either woman and acted only from ambition, she sets fire to the oil rig on Devil's Field and dies in the explosion. Learning that Van Guld, Count of Medina, treacherously murdered her father the Black Corsair, Jolanda allies with Morgan's pirates at Tortuga to make Van Guld pay, and he ends adrift in a boat full of lepers while she takes the family treasure.

Both turn on one party holds another under a sustained look, and the watching stands in place of any exchange between them, and they disagree about it. The administration reviews a list of code-named agents planted among the workers, and the spy 'Owl' photographs a strike leader taking the posted rejection letter with a camera hidden in a pocket watch, after which the leader is beaten and captured. Kopple keeps the camera running, and runs it empty when the film is out, because the crew being there is what holds the shooting down on the picket line.

edges.b: zatoichi and the chest of gold
edges.bTitle: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold
edges.claim: Both turn on a need is laid before someone with no prior claim or duty, who must decide whether to take up a burden that is not theirs., and they disagree about it. Svoboda, rejected by his own safe house, turns up at the home of Mascha, a stranger who had just misdirected the German search party, and her father Professor Novotny takes him in knowing he is the assassin. The Itakura villagers' ruin and Chiyo's plea to save them are laid before Ichi, a passing blind masseur with no duty to them, who promises to find the gold, kills Gundayu's eight musketeers and hands the recovered chest to Chiyo.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest. After Tom asks Mary to 'teach' his brother Dick about sex, she denies to Tom that anything took place and insists the baby is his; the question of whose child it was is never cleared between them. Lydia hides her pursuit of Olga from Sharon — telling her the fall she took while following Olga home was a mugging — and Sharon, furious at the allegations and the lack of transparency, bars her from seeing Petra.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Sent by Otto to lie with the maid who is a witch in the best sense, Alexander tells Maria about his mother's garden, and when she is bewildered by his advances he puts Victor's pistol to his own temple and says do not kill us. Smitty holds the disappearance of a $50,000 Iraqi bribe over Crowe and threatens prison time to force him to infiltrate the Toolshed as a mole against his will.

Both turn on one party is passed over by someone whose regard they held, in favour of another that person prefers, and they disagree about it. After the dinner at the wealthy man's mansion Checco walks away from his faithful mistress Melina to walk alone with Liliana, and leaves the troupe in Rome to build a new one around Liliana, only to end up back beside Melina on the Foggia train. Dito, whom Lilica took up after the reformatory, turns to the prostitute they are pimping, and Lilica walks out of the group.

Guy trades his wife's body and the child she carries to the Castevets' coven for the stage role the previous actor went blind to vacate, and she is only told what she was for after the birth. Pelle and Ingemar lure Mark, Josh, Simon and Connie to the Hårga as four of the nine bodies the commune needs to purge itself of evil, a purpose the visitors are told only at the final ceremony.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it, and they disagree about it. Taeko was kept as the rich Tohata's mistress from childhood, and his long-term abusive treatment has twisted her psyche and left her a pariah even after she runs from him. Hans throws a chair at Irmgard in the bar for coming to fetch him and beats her in the flat in front of Renate, and she is gone with the child the next morning.

Both turn on one party takes up someone others have written off and treats them as worth something, and they disagree about it. Kameda, meeting the social pariah Taeko whom the men around her trade like chattel, is drawn to the sadness in her and wants to help her, and his kindness gives her the strength to run away from Tohata, Kayama and Akama. Cimarron is fired for pulling a knife on Slim and trails the herd anyway; when Slim goes off his horse in the river Cimarron pulls him out, and Andersen puts him on the crew.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to, and they disagree about it. Irmgard talks Anzell into overcharging on the round and splitting it with her, knowing Hans follows his man through the courtyards, so that the one witness to her affair is sacked as a thief. Max is captured by the War Boys and, as a universal donor, strapped to Nux's car to be bled into him as a living blood bag; by the end he opens his own vein deliberately to transfuse Furiosa and save her.

Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand.. Valerie sees Jef leaving Martey's office clearly and then fails to pick him out of the identity parade, and the silence is what puts him back on the street. Franklin Birch is talked out of freeing Alex by his wife Nancy, and the couple decide neither to stop Keller's torture nor to tell the police.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it, and they disagree about it. Rowdy, going in for surgery on a burst vessel in his brain, asks Cole to drive his car at Daytona so that his sponsor will pay out his year. The Gwangju taxi drivers throw their cars into the DSC pursuit and die so that Man-seob's taxi and Peter's film can get clear.

Both turn on two parties stay in each other's company while one holds itself closed and the other turns outside it. The things Frederic cannot say to Helene he says all afternoon to Chloe, and when he finally sits down with his wife the two of them cannot find the words and she breaks down. He and Fedora live in the same flat without being able to say anything to each other, and he puts his hand out to his colleague Tignetti, to Fedora's friend Benedetta and to Gualtiero's wife Ada, and gets nowhere with any of them.

edges.b: all the money in the world
edges.bTitle: All the Money in the World
edges.claim: Both turn on the only help on offer comes from someone who holds what the other cannot do without, and the giving carries terms — named or hidden — that the receiver is in no position to refuse., and they disagree about it. Pier Luigi, the only person housing Angela, tells Jerry he can no longer support her and that she will end up a prostitute, which is what finally makes Jerry agree to run the stolen U.S. military goods for him. Getty finally agrees to pay only if Gail signs full custody of all her children over to their near-vegetative father — in effect to Getty — and then hands over just $1 million, the tax-deductible maximum.

Both turn on a parent leaves and the child is left waiting. Giorgio left a wife and son in Paris for the island, and only goes back when the boy comes to tell him his mother has tried to kill herself. Some time after the hijacking the Tamura children's mother abandons the family, and after their father dies in a car crash Naoki and Kozue go on living alone in the house.

edges.b: the bird with the crystal plumage
edges.bTitle: The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
edges.claim: Both turn on one party takes what they saw for something it was not, while another holds the sense of it, and they disagree about it. When Mizushima makes a white flag intending to ask the British for more time, the holdout soldiers take it for him surrendering on their behalf and beat him unconscious, leaving him on the cave floor. Trapped between the gallery's glass doors, Sam takes what he sees for a woman being attacked; it was Monica going at Alberto with the knife, and the missing clue is which of the two was which.

Both turn on an outside party takes a person out of the keeping of those bound to them, who must get them back. Chris and his henchmen snatch Julia by helicopter from the hijacked plane and later retake her from Lupin's group, holding her at the sect's cathedral until Lupin gets her out and she is reunited with her family. Dr. Johnny Wilcox declares Okja the best super pig and Mirando trucks her off the mountain to New York, and Mija chases the truck through Seoul and follows her across the world to get her back.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to, and they disagree about it. Bytes keeps Merrick hooded between shows, is paid by Treves for the loan of him, beats him nearly to death when he comes back, steals him out of the hospital and finally locks him in a cage in Belgium to die. Cohaagen explains that Quaid was manufactured out of Hauser purely as a ruse to slip past Kuato's psychic reading and destroy the mutant rebellion — a purpose Quaid himself is never made party to until the base is already massacred.

Both turn on one party is denied the child it wants, and the party bound to them is caught in the lack. Catherine and Jim's life at the chalet breaks down over their inability to conceive, and the reunion they agree to on news of her pregnancy is cancelled when Jules writes that she has miscarried. The gypsy woman's botched abortion of teenage Mary's pregnancy leaves her infertile, and in 1974 Tom lives inside her longing for the son they never had, which ends with her taking a stranger's baby from a supermarket as 'a gift from God'.

Both turn on one party takes up someone others have written off and treats them as worth something. Bytes has him down as an imbecile because he does not speak and the London Hospital does not take incurables, and Treves keeps at him until he recites the whole of the twenty-third psalm to Carr Gomm on the stairs. Lo'ak befriends and mind-links with Payakan, the Tulkun exiled by his own kind for breaking the vow of pacifism, and Payakan repays it by attacking Quaritch's ship and pulling Jake from the wreck.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to, and they disagree about it. Wade brings a truckload of farmers who have already lost their own places to pull the levee apart for day money, and offers Tom's neighbours a bonus to cut it from the inside. Eboshi and Jigo smear themselves with the blood of the slain boars so that the blind, mortally wounded Okkoto will unknowingly lead them to the Forest Spirit; his pain turns him into a demon and the Forest Spirit grants him death.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Everyone who came near the Moroni kidnapping is taken off: Paradisi beheaded by the excavator, its driver hanged to look like suicide, Paradisi's wife strangled at the tram stop, the kindergarten teacher cut up with a circular saw, Mattia beaten with a statue, and finally the old woman who happens to own the mirror. Maggie Eagle Bear, who identifies the raffle stub and is pressing the question of the reservation's contaminated water, turns up dead at the Red Deer Table mining site.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way.. Frank Price, the barracks' own security officer, is the German plant, passing messages through the hollow black queen and the looped light-bulb cord and feeding Schulz the matchbook-and-cigarette bomb recipe as evidence against Dunbar; the men throw him out with cans tied to his leg and the guard towers shoot him. Fujiko took the job of chaperoning Julia only so she could get inside the Earth Building and steal the lost prophecies from Douglas's top-floor safe.

Both turn on one person is bound to two parties at once and cannot answer one without wounding the other.. Mascha, having hidden Svoboda, is pulled between saving her hostage father and protecting the assassin: she goes to the Gestapo to denounce him, pleads for her father instead, and finally testifies falsely against Czaka while her father is executed anyway. In the middle of the boarding Frog finds Maria Dolores and crosses swords with Don Alfonso for her, and then breaks it off to go and help Red get the throne into the boat.

Both turn on one party comes asking something of another who is free to answer it, and is turned away. Johnnie hurries to be first in line at the Marietta recruiting office and is rejected because he is worth more as an engineer, a reason the recruiters never tell him. With the wrong child taken, Gondō announces he will not pay the ransom for his chauffeur's son, and only relents after the chauffeur's continuous pleading and his wife's pressure.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it. Carl-Magnus does not confront Frederich; he sends his wife Charlotte to call on Anne Egerman and put the affair in front of her. Michelle tells the frantic Teddy that the bottle of antifreeze in her car is an Andromedan antidote for his mother, and he drives to the hospital and injects it into Sandy's IV bag, killing her, while Michelle frees herself in the basement.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding, and they disagree about it. Hideyoshi summons Ogin to his palace, and when she refuses to become his mistress gives her two days to reconsider or he will take Rikyū's life. Wade sets the grain price at his own mill, works the senator and the bank, quietly buys the river frontage for the dam he wants and finally has Tom's corn graded down and offers less than it cost to put in the ground.

Both turn on one party obtains another's closeness or presence and pays for it with the means to live. An English visitor in a bar offers Ula fifty dollars; she laughs at it and then goes with him. Cook courts and marries Rhonda, a former teacher waiting tables while she and her mother Miranda grow desperate for money, and pays to have a house built for Miranda; Rhonda later takes her own life.

Sophie is at the telescope in Leigh's flat, in radio contact with her, when she is attacked, and the police close it by finding she had a flight booked to Fort Worth.

Hideyoshi summons Ogin to his palace, and when she refuses to become his mistress gives her two days to reconsider or he will take Rikyū's life.

Lucy Mirando flies Mija to New York and stages a heart-warming reunion with her pig purely to limit PR damage, while Okja is being force-bred and cut for a taste test in the lab.

Rosemary reaches Dr Hill with the anagram, the tannis root and the necktie taken from the blinded actor, and he takes her for delusional and telephones Sapirstein. Kiyoko tells Shikishima that Neo-Tokyo is going to go the way of Tokyo, and the parliament hears him out and dismisses it, which is what finally puts him into a coup.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it, and they disagree about it. A tsarist police agent strikes a deal with the barrel-dwelling 'King of Thieves' to supply provocateurs who burn and loot the state liquor depot in the factory district, so the workers who gather at the fire are set upon by firemen and then the military. Delbert Grady, who cut up his own wife and daughters in the same hotel, meets Jack in the ballroom and tells him his family needs correcting, and lets him out of the pantry Wendy locked.

Made stateless, Ferdinand takes his wartime marksman's rifle to the mountain above Assola and fires 'first notice' shots at the property of everyone in his notepad, planning to execute them one by one.

In the Inland Empire strand Nikki is stuck in a physically abusive marriage to Smithy in their working-class home, which Polish men periodically visit.

Howie is what the failed harvest requires: he came freely, he carries the power of a king in the law, he is a virgin and he is the fool, and he is put in the wicker figure with the animals and burned. Cohaagen explains that Quaid was manufactured out of Hauser purely as a ruse to slip past Kuato's psychic reading and destroy the mutant rebellion — a purpose Quaid himself is never made party to until the base is already massacred.

The Gwangju taxi drivers throw their cars into the DSC pursuit and die so that Man-seob's taxi and Peter's film can get clear.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Pris works on J. F. Sebastian's loneliness until he takes her in, and Roy uses him and his access to get to the top of the Tyrell pyramid; Sebastian is reported dead soon after. Lucy Mirando flies Mija to New York and stages a heart-warming reunion with her pig purely to limit PR damage, while Okja is being force-bred and cut for a taste test in the lab.

The Gwangju taxi drivers throw their cars into the DSC pursuit and die so that Man-seob's taxi and Peter's film can get clear.
