Michelle tells the frantic Teddy that the bottle of antifreeze in her car is an Andromedan antidote for his mother, and he drives to the hospital and injects it into Sandy's IV bag, killing her, while Michelle frees herself in the basement.

Both turn on one party puts another into a position that lowers them in the eyes of those watching. She tells the gamekeeper and his wife that she spent the night at Arsene's because he is her lover, and the shopkeeper who spots the scratch on her chest calls her a little slut. Eva plays the Chopin A minor prelude for her mother and Charlotte sits down and plays the same piece again, better, and explains what it is about.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Anders recruits Gregg, Agostino, Jean-Paul and Erich for the Rio diamond job while secretly partnered with Mary Ann, who swaps the diamonds for an empty case, so the four experts do the work and die for a purpose they were never told about. To get the contract's civil-disturbance clause Shyamal has a riot staged at his own plant; a factory watchman is badly hurt in it and Shyamal is congratulated for efficient handling.

Both turn on one party's failing life falls into the hands of the one they used to carry, who must now carry them or leave them. Eva took her paralysed sister out of the hospital and into the parsonage, and is the only person alive who can make out what Helena is saying. Hatidže keeps her 85-year-old, partly blind and bedridden mother Nazife, who is wholly dependent on her, in a village with no electricity or running water until Nazife dies and Hatidže is left alone in Bekirlija.

Both turn on one party presses another to hand over the account of themselves or of a past act that the other would rather keep. A Japanese crew has come to Cinecitta to get Fellini on the record about his new film and spends the whole picture being walked round commercials, backlots and screen tests instead; even the studio's custodian slips off into Studio 5 to pick dandelions rather than sit for them. The Jaban villagers repeatedly demand that Panahi hand over the photo of Gozal and Solduz, take his camera's memory card, and finally summon him to the swearing room to swear on the Quran that he never took or saw it; he offers a filmed oath instead and the impasse holds.

Both turn on a third party stands between two who would join and keeps them apart, and they disagree about it. Anders wants to marry Anne Petersen, but her father Peter refuses the proposal unless the Borgens join his Inner Mission church, and Morten at first refuses to assent to the match; only over Inger's coffin does Peter agree to permit the marriage. Will Jr goes over to thank Cordelia and Learo accuses him of making a play for his girl and leads her away without a word.

Gupta runs onto the tarmac in front of Viktor's plane and is taken into custody — accepting deportation to India — so that Viktor does not have to leave the airport under Dixon's threat.

Wade sets the grain price at his own mill, works the senator and the bank, quietly buys the river frontage for the dam he wants and finally has Tom's corn graded down and offers less than it cost to put in the ground.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Neville puts the models' photographs in Tommy's flat and one of Tommy's playing cards under Donald's body, and after Tommy is shot in the street he tells Laura a whole invented life to explain him. Detective Cha, ordered to purge Busan of communists even by fabrication, has schoolboy Park and other students charged with sedition for reading EH Carr's What Is History?, which Song shows was written by a British ambassador.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Adamo has McCain sprung from prison and put on the Royal through Jack, so that the robbery reads as a bank robber's own idea and Adamo's stake war with Stilberman never appears in it. They are told they are running money out of Yugoslavia for the Banker; on the way back Tiberio finds the seat has been changed and there is cocaine under it, and the Banker takes the car and leaves them their fee.

edges.b: the plot of the fuma clan
edges.bTitle: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
edges.claim: Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it, and they disagree about it. Fusako's brother-in-law, who otherwise keeps the Owada household, refuses to pay for her infant's vaccinations as unnecessary and overpriced while she sells her possessions for food, and the baby dies of illness. Clan Elder Suminawa will not give up the urn for his granddaughter's life, because it holds the way to the family treasure, so Lupin steals it off him and makes the trade himself.

Both turn on one party works on another to turn them back from a course that would undo them. In 'Other people's houses' the old village priest, learning that Zelinda means to end her strenuous, monotonous life, argues her out of it and physically hauls her back up when she slips off the cliff; in 'Mara' Vasco talks Mara out of going to work in a brothel the next morning by offering to keep her on his teacher's wage. When the enraged Xiao Ji sets out to avenge his beating, Bin Bin stops him by telling him that Qiao San carries a gun on his person.

Both turn on one party discharges a guilt onto someone who can neither punish it nor absolve it. Travis tells Wizard at the cabbies' diner that he has bad ideas in his head, and Wizard cannot make anything of it and tells him he will be fine. After the mistrial Greenhill privately gives Haines vivid details of how he murdered Rita, knowing attorney-client privilege leaves her unable to use it against him.

Both turn on one party presses another to hand over the account of themselves or of a past act that the other would rather keep, and they disagree about it. In her hospital room, Delmas keeps demanding of the hysterical Judith where Fèvre-Berthier is and how he died until she admits she found him dead on her sofa, then photographs her. A Japanese crew has come to Cinecitta to get Fellini on the record about his new film and spends the whole picture being walked round commercials, backlots and screen tests instead; even the studio's custodian slips off into Studio 5 to pick dandelions rather than sit for them.

Both turn on one party lends their voice, eyes or hands to another who lacks them, so that the other can act only through them. Franco, blind and once an ace reporter, works the case entirely through what Lori and Carlo describe to him, and it is Lori's mention of Bianca fidgeting with a locket that breaks it. Waiting outside Tuskin's office, Regan reaches into an autistic girl's mind and the girl speaks, and her mother will not stay to be studied but takes her home so the father can hear it.

Both turn on one party gives a dependent it was bound to keep out of its own hands into someone else's. Iwakichi, Tarō's only surviving relative, feeds the boy a last meal, gives him the new shoes he bought and sends him to Takako with a letter, putting the grandson he had kept out of the orphanage into her hands. Ryōta and Midori permanently exchange Keita, the son they raised for six years, into the Saiki household after first offending the Saikis by proposing to buy both boys.

Both turn on the deceived party finds the deception out. Columbus signs his crew on by telling them the crossing will take seven weeks; at nine weeks with no land the men grow restless and edge toward mutiny until his speech and a rising wind put them back to their duties. After marrying Marylin and tearing up his own prenup, Miles discovers that her oil-millionaire ex-husband 'Howard D. Doyle' was only an actor from one of Donaly's soap operas, staged to leave Miles' fortune exposed.

Both turn on one party settles the terms of its own death and requires those bound to it to stand by and let it happen. Having sent Tarō off with the letter, Iwakichi sets fire to his own shack and dies of the burns, leaving the boy to carry his ashes off the island. After killing Lammark and watching his mother shoot herself outside the shed, Dean sits with Eleanor and asks her to let him fall asleep and then execute him, and she agrees; when the sheriff arrives he takes it as betrayal and finally raises his weapon at the massed officers to be shot.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. After Genshichi attacks Ishimatsu and leaves him badly injured, Sakichi fights his way past the constables to the house where Genshichi is hiding and kills him. The carabinieri stop the bus with the cocaine on it, and at Peppe's birthday party, mid-sentence about how well it all went, one of the traffickers walks in and shoots him.

edges.b: investigation of a citizen above suspicion
edges.bTitle: Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion
edges.claim: Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Andrea is publicly tried for the count's murder he did not intend or commit, and is acquitted only when an autopsy shows the count's hearing was sound and he could have saved himself. He plants clues that steer his own subordinates onto the murdered woman's husband and onto a student radical, and then clears them himself.

Cimarron is fired for pulling a knife on Slim and trails the herd anyway; when Slim goes off his horse in the river Cimarron pulls him out, and Andersen puts him on the crew. Travis buys time alone with the twelve-year-old Iris by making Sport think he is a customer, and spends it arguing her out of the life; her parents write from Pittsburgh that she is home and back at school.

edges.a: the man who shot liberty valance
edges.aTitle: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
edges.claim: Both turn on love is withheld or given up to protect the one loved, and they disagree about it. Having seen Hallie tend Ranse's wounded arm, Tom burns the house renovations built for their marriage and then tells Ranse to take the nomination 'for Hallie's sake'. Lou hides her feelings for Ben and tells him she is marrying Hank because she does not want him to waste his talents in Grady; only when Hank reports the engagement is off does Ben return to her.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Barletta carries the cash and fronts the black funds for Griffo, the industrialist he has known since childhood, and is finally made to sign away a phantom company before he is let go. Pelle and Ingemar lure Mark, Josh, Simon and Connie to the Hårga as four of the nine bodies the commune needs to purge itself of evil, a purpose the visitors are told only at the final ceremony.

Both turn on one party gives a dependent it was bound to keep out of its own hands into someone else's, and they disagree about it. Gelsomina's impoverished mother, with other mouths to feed, accepts Zampanò's 10,000 lire for her daughter, and the tearful girl leaves with him the same day. After the blowout deafens H.W. and the boy sets fire to their shack, Daniel chases him down, restrains him and puts him on a train to a school for the deaf in San Francisco; Eli later forces him to confess at the baptism that he abandoned his child.

Both turn on one party takes control of the thing another cannot do without and sets the terms of its release, and they disagree about it. Paradisi, the insurance company's investigator, works out who did it and offers the answer for sale to the dead girl's relatives rather than to the police. Bandy, whose ranch is the last holdout blocking the Union Oil pipeline and who knows of the murder, sets his price: Daniel must be publicly baptised and repent in Eli's church before he gets the easement.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it, and they disagree about it. Tim Wakeley is the father of Mabel's child but cannot lose his Oxford scholarship, so Roddy promises never to reveal the truth and accepts expulsion from the school in his place. The Gwangju taxi drivers throw their cars into the DSC pursuit and die so that Man-seob's taxi and Peter's film can get clear.

Both turn on the party who was failed or harmed confronts the one responsible and demands they answer for it. Hanshirō tells Saitō he will die without another word if Saitō will convey a statement of regret to Motome, Miho and Kingo, and Saitō refuses, calling Motome an extortionist who deserved to die. After surviving the poisoning and Ernest's courtroom testimony, Mollie leaves him when he will not admit that he was the one poisoning her insulin.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. After Dolores names Quilty as the man who took her and secluded her at the dude ranch, Humbert drives to Quilty's mansion with a gun and shoots him dead among his drunken evasions. Michael Perry is interviewed on death row eight days before his execution on July 1, 2010, while Jason Burkett receives life instead, and Herzog also interviews a chaplain and a former death house worker who retired after taking part in Karla Faye Tucker's execution.

Left alone with a thing that will not eat, cannot breathe and never stops crying, Henry cuts the swaddling he has never opened and finds it is holding the organs in, then puts the scissors into them.

Camille recruits her boyfriend's friend's brother, also named Vincent, to arrive at the château posing as Simon Cinéma's missing great-grandson, coaching him with childhood details so he can fool the groundskeeper and the delusional old man into signing over the inheritance.

Both turn on the betrayal comes from the person nearest, who was serving someone else. Pete leaves for Africa asking his childhood friend Philip to take care of Kate, and Philip calls on her daily and begins an affair with her at the old mill. McCain's own son Jack brings him the job for Adamo and arrives at the warehouse with two of Adamo's men who are there to kill them both.

Both turn on one party obtains another's closeness or presence and pays for it with the means to live. Kuriyama, learning that Fusako's husband died in the war, hires her as his secretary in order to seduce her and promises to care for and support her; she reluctantly becomes his mistress and he then uses her flat to hide his smuggled opium. Cook courts and marries Rhonda, a former teacher waiting tables while she and her mother Miranda grow desperate for money, and pays to have a house built for Miranda; Rhonda later takes her own life.

Both turn on a parent leaves and the child is left waiting, and they disagree about it. As a sailor he repeatedly left his wife and daughter alone for long voyages at sea, which is what unhinged the wife and put her in the cell. Arthur's father Bo walks out during Arthur's junior year and becomes addicted to drugs while Sheila loses her job and the family goes on welfare; Bo later gives up drugs and returns to the household.

Both turn on one party names another's concealed life or wrong in front of those who did not know of it. The commoner deduces in front of the monk that the woodcutter lied at the trial not from fear of trouble but because he stole the wife's dagger, and leaves mocking him for it. Mr Ahankhah, having seen a magazine photograph of a younger, darker Makhmalbaf, brings the journalist Farazmand into the house to identify him, and Farazmand photographs the arrest for a piece called Bogus Makhmalbaf Arrested.

Both turn on one party holds another under a sustained look, and the watching stands in place of any exchange between them. The siblings listen at doors, search the musicians' flat, go through Don Garofalo's rooms and follow two of his men to a beach house, all of it dressed up as an inquiry into who killed their cat. Qiang photographs the raid, keeps the frame of the girl watching it, blows it up into a wall-sized collage of her face in the flat he rents as a darkroom, and tells her he cannot stop.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would.. Burning, Howie tells Summerisle that the orchards fail because the climate will not carry them and that the islanders will put him in the fire next year, and nobody on the hill takes it up. Kiyoko tells Shikishima that Neo-Tokyo is going to go the way of Tokyo, and the parliament hears him out and dismisses it, which is what finally puts him into a coup.

Both turn on parties proceed on an account of who someone is that is simply wrong, and the truth reaches them only once the damage is done.. Blind Nydia, believing she is speaking to Antonius after Marcus's funeral, tells Gallinus — the man charged with persecuting Christians — how to find the secret Christian gathering, and that night he rounds them all up for torture and death. Danny comes to the new flat looking for a woman called Maggie, is embarrassed, leaves her a flower, and comes back through the door that night still asking for Maggie, and dies on his own knife.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way.. Emil Czaka, the wealthy brewer admitted to resistance meetings and privy to its leaders, is in fact a German fifth-columnist, and when he is tricked into revealing it the Gestapo kill or arrest most of the resistance. Fujiko took the job of chaperoning Julia only so she could get inside the Earth Building and steal the lost prophecies from Douglas's top-floor safe.

edges.a: jolanda the daughter of the black corsair
edges.aTitle: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair
edges.claim: Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own, and they disagree about it. Learning that Van Guld, Count of Medina, treacherously murdered her father the Black Corsair, Jolanda allies with Morgan's pirates at Tortuga to make Van Guld pay, and he ends adrift in a boat full of lepers while she takes the family treasure. The carabinieri stop the bus with the cocaine on it, and at Peppe's birthday party, mid-sentence about how well it all went, one of the traffickers walks in and shoots him.

Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true. Camille recruits her boyfriend's friend's brother, also named Vincent, to arrive at the château posing as Simon Cinéma's missing great-grandson, coaching him with childhood details so he can fool the groundskeeper and the delusional old man into signing over the inheritance.
