Cui Mingliang pursues Yin Ruijuan, who answers noncommittally and then rejects him as incompatible; he pines for her through years of touring without contacting her, and only on his final return to Fenyang do they reconnect and marry. At the campsite Kurt breaks down, says something has 'come between' them and that he wants them to be real friends again, while Mark disagrees with the assessment and stays apprehensive; they part with a quick goodbye on the same street where they met.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way., and they disagree about it. Emil Czaka, the wealthy brewer admitted to resistance meetings and privy to its leaders, is in fact a German fifth-columnist, and when he is tricked into revealing it the Gestapo kill or arrest most of the resistance. Bikash Singha is one of the Ghosal household and takes Maganlal's money to lift the golden Ganesh out of it.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. After Dolores names Quilty as the man who took her and secluded her at the dude ranch, Humbert drives to Quilty's mansion with a gun and shoots him dead among his drunken evasions. The carabinieri stop the bus with the cocaine on it, and at Peppe's birthday party, mid-sentence about how well it all went, one of the traffickers walks in and shoots him.

Both turn on a marriage is entered for money, standing or cover rather than love, and they disagree about it. Humbert laughs at Charlotte's love letter but marries her anyway purely to stay in the house with Dolores, and his diary — recording his passion for the daughter and contempt for the wife — is what sends Charlotte running into the road. Puffy Krauss von Espy testifies that Marylin asked him to find her a very rich, foolish philandering husband she could easily divorce, and he pointed her to Rex Rexroth.

Both turn on one party comes back to a bond or a place that has closed over their absence, and those who stayed must answer the return. Montand comes back to Marseille to stage his own life and spends his free hours looking for the girl he loved when he was nobody, and finds her behind the Baroness de Lambert's card, in the bar they first met in, about to lose her home while her husband serves five years. The old man Corinne fled from at the bus stop turns out to be Honey and Heidi's estranged father, who approaches Honey wanting to reconnect and offers what he saw of Corinne as his opening.

Both turn on one party holds out rescue, pity or an easier way and the one it is meant for will not take it, and they disagree about it. Takako offers to take the blinded, burned Iwakichi and his grandson Tarō back to the island with her, and Iwakichi refuses and runs away, relenting only when the neighbour talks him round — and then only for the boy. Colm offers a truce at the pub and later suggests the burnt house has ended the feud, and Pádraic answers that it would have ended only if Colm had stayed inside, adding that some things there is no moving on from.

Both turn on a body of people puts out one of its own members and withholds standing from them, and they disagree about it. When the villagers of Nevers learn of her affair with the German they shave her head, and once her hair has grown back her parents send her away to Paris. After the lawsuits from the man Bob saved and the injured train passengers, the government bans supers from using their powers and relocates the Parrs into an anonymous suburban life until the Omnidroid fight restores public appreciation.

Both turn on one party ends or leaves the bond on their own account and gives the other no reason they can accept, and the other has no standing to refuse it., and they disagree about it. Paul clears the flat and goes without a word, and Jeanne lets herself in to bare rooms; when he turns up again on the street it is to ask for it back. After the intimate evening with Lou, Ben slips out of Grady at night without telling her he is going.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them, and they disagree about it. French customs officer Ferdinand and Neapolitan smuggler Giuseppe run a daily cat-and-mouse across the Assola border, and the film closes exactly as it opened, with Ferdinand chasing Giuseppe again and telling the audience the Law is the Law. The soldier is sent alone into the forest to kill the tiger shaman's spirit, follows its pawprints, is knocked down a slope and loses his gun, and ends on his hands and knees telling the tiger in the tree 'I give you my spirit, my flesh, and my memories.'

Both turn on a third party stands between two who would join and keeps them apart. Prince Nicholas Bolkonsky, holding that Natasha is too young and the Rostovs not the Bolkonskys' social equals, makes Andrei wait a year before marrying her, and it is inside that imposed year that the engagement is destroyed. Will Jr goes over to thank Cordelia and Learo accuses him of making a play for his girl and leads her away without a word.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Jagga, having learned Leela is pregnant with the judge's child, releases her and instead grooms the boy Raj into a thief to disprove Raghunath's doctrine, a design Raj knows nothing of until he kills Jagga in his mother's house. The camp scientists select the prisoner for time-travel experiments because his obsessive memory of the woman on the Orly jetty makes him able to withstand the shock, use him to fetch a power unit from the future, and then move to execute him once the mission is accomplished.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Andrea is publicly tried for the count's murder he did not intend or commit, and is acquitted only when an autopsy shows the count's hearing was sound and he could have saved himself. Keller fixes on Alex after the whispered line "They didn't cry 'til I left them," though Loki has established Alex's diminished IQ and clean RV, and Alex turns out to have been Holly's first abducted child.

Both turn on the betrayal comes from the person nearest, who was serving someone else. McCain's own son Jack brings him the job for Adamo and arrives at the warehouse with two of Adamo's men who are there to kill them both. Richard brings his wife to the museum to take up the daggers and Ann puts them into him, saying she has always belonged to Damien.

Both turn on a third party stands between two who would join and keeps them apart. Anders wants to marry Anne Petersen, but her father Peter refuses the proposal unless the Borgens join his Inner Mission church, and Morten at first refuses to assent to the match; only over Inger's coffin does Peter agree to permit the marriage. Anna's letter from Switzerland asking Henrik to resume the relationship is intercepted by her parents — Johan opens it and Karin reads and burns it — and only after Johan's death does Karin confess, whereupon Anna goes to Henrik and marries him.

Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Eddie York, taken for the playboy Francis Pemberton by Arnold's thug, goes to the Pemberton mansion and is accepted as Francis by Grandpa, Mary, Stephanie and Uncle Wills, ordering the safe opened and later impersonating him again to make the police release Mary, until the real Francis arrives by taxi and the twin birth is confessed. Marcos poses as a police officer to lift Juan from the convenience store, and the whole scheme runs on Vidal playing a deported Spanish collector, Berta a widow selling her husband's stamps, and Sandler an old associate.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. Gondō pays the ransom for his chauffeur's son Shin'ichi with the money mortgaged for the National Shoes buyout, and is forced out of the company while creditors auction the collateral. Gupta runs onto the tarmac in front of Viktor's plane and is taken into custody — accepting deportation to India — so that Viktor does not have to leave the airport under Dixon's threat.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Gérard, who takes charge of Balthazar at the bakery out of jealousy over Marie's affection, beats the donkey and prepares to bludgeon him to death, and holds Marie in a violent relationship that ends with him and his gang stripping, beating and locking her in the barn. Sweetie arrives back with Bob and takes the house over - Kay's clothes ruined, the furniture broken, everyone managed round her rages and then forgiven the next morning.

edges.a: the working class goes to heaven
edges.aTitle: The Working Class Goes to Heaven
edges.claim: Both turn on a body of people puts out one of its own members and withholds standing from them. When the union settles, the whole plant goes back through the gate except Lulu, sacked for the agitation the settlement was built on; the same unionists later get him taken back. After the lawsuits from the man Bob saved and the injured train passengers, the government bans supers from using their powers and relocates the Parrs into an anonymous suburban life until the Omnidroid fight restores public appreciation.

Both turn on one party keeps attendance on another who can no longer answer or meet them, and goes on addressing them anyway. Ula goes to a hypnotist to have Antek taken out of her head and sees him standing in the room instead, and keeps his files, his client and the candles at his grave going for the whole film. Adult Sophie in New York replays the MiniDV footage from Turkey and, in the rave sequences, pushes through the strobing crowd toward Calum, briefly holding him before he falls from her grasp.

Both turn on the threat is a person already admitted, and they disagree about it. The man is Herbert Stiles, the building's own inspector, who holds keys to her flat and to buildings all over the city as a condition of his job. MG, the policewoman Honey picks up at the station and takes to bed in her own apartment, turns out to be Mia's killer and is holding Corinne captive in her basement, where she stabs Honey before Honey scalds her with the kettle and shoots her.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Dedic's plan has Mascha claim at Gestapo headquarters that Czaka was the man she saw fleeing Heydrich's killing, backed by a mass of false testimony, and Czaka is gunned down for a murder he did not commit. Andrea is publicly tried for the count's murder he did not intend or commit, and is acquitted only when an autopsy shows the count's hearing was sound and he could have saved himself.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Hanshirō tracks down Hayato, Umenosuke and Hikokuro and takes their topknots for forcing Motome to disembowel himself with a bamboo blade, then names all three as his second at the Iyi estate and kills four retainers before dying. The carabinieri stop the bus with the cocaine on it, and at Peppe's birthday party, mid-sentence about how well it all went, one of the traffickers walks in and shoots him.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to, and they disagree about it. Inside FEBEM the boys are the pieces the guards and their commander play with, and what they are used for is never anything of theirs. Cohaagen explains that Quaid was manufactured out of Hauser purely as a ruse to slip past Kuato's psychic reading and destroy the mutant rebellion — a purpose Quaid himself is never made party to until the base is already massacred.

Both turn on one party arranges what others are living through from a position they cannot see, turning their need and their movements to an end that is not theirs.. Ishida, wanting to block Ukon's rehabilitation and place in the coming campaign, works on Shintaro at Hideyoshi's tea ceremony to engineer a meeting between Ogin and Ukon that can be used to prosecute them both. Mr. Ducasse's metal discs let him control the townspeople for one minute at a time, and he and Edgar play out the residents' relationships as miniatures on a chessboard while a monitor shows the lives being steered from the tower.

Both turn on one party works on another to turn them back from a course that would undo them, and they disagree about it. When Eugen storms out with a rifle threatening to shoot himself after Rakel's confession, she chases him and fetches an elderly neighbour to talk sense into him. On the train to the assassination Francis Jeanson works on Veronique for the length of the ride to turn her back from violence, and she goes on to the hotel anyway.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would., and they disagree about it. Johannes tells Morten that death is nearby and will take Inger unless he has faith; Morten refuses to listen and Inger dies suddenly, exactly as prophesied, and only after her death does the family credit Johannes enough to ask for her raising. Hatidže tells Hussein Sam to always leave half the honey for the bees; he sells the entire stock to satisfy a customer, his colonies then raid hers in winter and her colony collapses exactly as she warned.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it. In Naples Luciano runs the drug traffic entirely through proxies out of a race track, so that dozens of his associates are arrested over the years and nothing is ever in his hand. Judah takes it to his brother Jack, who finds the man and arranges it, so that Judah is only ever the one who made the phone call.

Both turn on two parties take each other up across a line their people hold as forbidden, and keep it out of sight of those who would move against them. Ivan loves and plans to marry Marichka, the daughter of the man who killed his father, across the bitter enmity between their Hutsul families, until she drowns in the river while he is away earning money for their household. Benjamin meets his father's law partner's wife at the Taft Hotel through the summer, signing the register as Mr Gladstone.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it. Gawkowski drove the Sonderzuge to Treblinka with a German officer behind him and vodka as the bonus, and drew his hand across his throat at the waiting convoys; Walter Stier says he was managing railway traffic and papers, not people. Michelle tells the frantic Teddy that the bottle of antifreeze in her car is an Andromedan antidote for his mother, and he drives to the hospital and injects it into Sandy's IV bag, killing her, while Michelle frees herself in the basement.

Both turn on whom a person is bound to is settled by parties outside the bond for ends of their own, and the one bound must go on living inside it., and they disagree about it. Angela tells her parents she does not love Bayardo San Roman and her mother answers that love can be learned; the family marries her off with a lavish party and he brings her back to the door the same night. Ada is shipped from Scotland to colonial New Zealand with Flora for a marriage to the settler Stewart that was arranged for her, and meets her husband for the first time on the beach where her piano is abandoned.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. A boy dies under police beating and the institution puts the killing on Lilica's unnamed lover, and then kills him too. Detective Cha, ordered to purge Busan of communists even by fabrication, has schoolboy Park and other students charged with sedition for reading EH Carr's What Is History?, which Song shows was written by a British ambassador.

Both turn on the death lands on the person who was standing nearby. Waiting for the randy farmhand outside the brothel, the Baron and Otto take the head of the friend who was there to be talked out of the monastery; Nicholas walks away alive. Don Alfonso levels his pistol at Frog across the water, Maria Dolores throws herself at his arm, and the ball takes Boomako.

Both turn on the person destroys the thing they could not otherwise hold. After Jim rebuffs her and says he will marry Gilberte, Catherine asks him into her car, tells Jules to watch, and drives off a ruined bridge into the river, killing herself and Jim. Left alone with a thing that will not eat, cannot breathe and never stops crying, Henry cuts the swaddling he has never opened and finds it is holding the organs in, then puts the scissors into them.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would.. Rosemary reaches Dr Hill with the anagram, the tannis root and the necktie taken from the blinded actor, and he takes her for delusional and telephones Sapirstein. Burning, Howie tells Summerisle that the orchards fail because the climate will not carry them and that the islanders will put him in the fire next year, and nobody on the hill takes it up.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. A billion lire is on the table for the building if it is empty, so Amedeo and Ofelia set about the remaining tenants one by one until the last of them is out - and then the lawyer tears up the cheques because Wanda has moved back in. Cha's agents torture Park and the other students until they sign confessions, and Cha then testifies that the bruises were self-inflicted.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Jagga, having learned Leela is pregnant with the judge's child, releases her and instead grooms the boy Raj into a thief to disprove Raghunath's doctrine, a design Raj knows nothing of until he kills Jagga in his mother's house. Alma opens the unsealed letter Elisabet has written to the doctor and finds she is being 'studied' — her story of the orgy and abortion set down as material — and rounds on Elisabet for using her.

Both turn on a parent leaves and the child is left waiting, and they disagree about it. As a sailor he repeatedly left his wife and daughter alone for long voyages at sea, which is what unhinged the wife and put her in the cell. Shoichi has not seen his father since the divorce and his mother is dead, so he spends his last spring break as a sixth-grader flying to Sydney on an old address and then following him to Tasmania.

Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Sabzian tells the woman beside him on the bus, who is reading about The Cyclist, that he is Makhmalbaf, and spends a fortnight in the Ahankhah house promising to shoot his next film there with the sons in it, and borrowing 1,900 tomans for cab fare. Marcos poses as a police officer to lift Juan from the convenience store, and the whole scheme runs on Vidal playing a deported Spanish collector, Berta a widow selling her husband's stamps, and Sandler an old associate.

edges.b: the bird with the crystal plumage
edges.bTitle: The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
edges.claim: Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Sensing Chantal is suicidal, the priest follows Torcy's counsel to project strength and intimidates her into surrendering her suicide note, leaving her terrified and resolved to ruin him. The killer telephones Sam and promises to kill Julia unless he drops the investigation, and then goes for her in the flat while he is out.

edges.a: jolanda the daughter of the black corsair
edges.aTitle: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair
edges.claim: Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true. Jolanda, raised to look and bear herself like a young man, enters the Medina palace and reaches Consuelo, who has been madly in love with her since their first meeting six months earlier, deceived by that masculine appearance. A stranger arrives claiming to be Daniel's half-brother Henry, is taken in and worked alongside until he fails to recognise a childhood joke and admits at gunpoint that he was only a friend of the real Henry, who died of tuberculosis — whereupon Daniel shoots and buries him.

Both turn on the help arrives from the person with the most reason to withhold it. Blasi deliberately lets his prisoners Richardson and Burke escape, and later Richardson refuses to hand the captured Italians or their weapons over to the hostile headman and decides instead to arm his own prisoners when the village surrounds them. Burnham, one of the three intruders and the man who built the panic room, hands Sarah her glucagon and finally runs back to shoot Raoul dead as he raises the sledgehammer over Meg.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest. Anatole Kuragin courts Natasha and persuades her to elope while concealing that he is already secretly married — the fact Pierre uses to threaten him with exposure. Samir carried on the affair with Marie while married, insisting to Ahmad that his wife knew nothing of it and that her depression and a customer incident caused the suicide attempt.

Both turn on one party settles the terms of its own death and requires those bound to it to stand by and let it happen. Li takes Gu's service pistol, shoots the director and then Shen, leaves Zhou alive, and lets Shu walk him to a hotel room with the police already coming up the stairs. After killing Lammark and watching his mother shoot herself outside the shed, Dean sits with Eleanor and asks her to let him fall asleep and then execute him, and she agrees; when the sheriff arrives he takes it as betrayal and finally raises his weapon at the massed officers to be shot.

Both turn on two parties stay in each other's company while one holds itself closed and the other turns outside it. Ivan marries Palahna in the blindfolded, yoked Hutsul ceremony but stays shut inside his obsession with the dead Marichka, and the emotionally abandoned Palahna takes up with the molfar Yurko, whose blow eventually kills Ivan. Three years after the miscarriage Zhou cannot write and cannot be reached, and she leaves Li over how little he has understood of it, going back to Shen who took an interest.

edges.a: zatoichi and the chest of gold
edges.b: investigation of a citizen above suspicion
edges.aTitle: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold
edges.bTitle: Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion
edges.claim: Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. The village men accost Ichi and blame him for the theft of the tax gold, and later mob him again on his return to Itakura, though he had fought off the robbers atop the chest. He plants clues that steer his own subordinates onto the murdered woman's husband and onto a student radical, and then clears them himself.

Both turn on one party turns the judging power against the weaker side, who is left without redress, and they disagree about it. The mayor's assistant promises a real investigation and is stopped by political pressure, and the district attorney keeps the grand jury questions narrow so that how far the corruption goes never gets said. At the sedition trial Song points out constitutional violations and the prosecutors and judge tell him normal laws do not apply in national-security cases, so the students lose despite the tortured confessions and get up to two years.

edges.a: once upon a time in the west
edges.aTitle: Once Upon a Time in the West
edges.claim: Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Frank once stood a boy under his hanging brother with a harmonica forced into his mouth until the boy's legs gave out; the grown boy waits at Sweetwater and puts the harmonica back into Frank's mouth as he dies. The carabinieri stop the bus with the cocaine on it, and at Peppe's birthday party, mid-sentence about how well it all went, one of the traffickers walks in and shoots him.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. The carabinieri stop the bus with the cocaine on it, and at Peppe's birthday party, mid-sentence about how well it all went, one of the traffickers walks in and shoots him. Teddy Gatz, whose mother Sandy was left comatose by an Auxolith clinical trial, abducts the company's CEO Michelle Fuller with his cousin Don, shaves her head, coats her in antihistamine cream and shocks her with electricity in his basement.

Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Rotwang kidnaps Maria and gives the robot her likeness, and the false Maria preaches insurrection to the workers and dances at the Yoshiwara club with neither the workers nor the wealthy men recognising she is a machine, until the fire at the stake reveals the metal. Judy Barton stands before Scottie throughout as Madeleine Elster, visiting Carlotta's grave and the Portrait of Carlotta, and he takes the possession as genuine.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Bought from her mother and travelling in Zampanò's motocarro, Gelsomina is presented as his wife, intimidated, forced upon and beaten, and when she rebels and runs to town he simply carries her back by force. Gérard, who takes charge of Balthazar at the bakery out of jealousy over Marie's affection, beats the donkey and prepares to bludgeon him to death, and holds Marie in a violent relationship that ends with him and his gang stripping, beating and locking her in the barn.

Both turn on a third party stands between two who would join and keeps them apart. Lermontov, whose company policy forced Irina Boronskaya out for marrying, tells Julian and Vicky their work is deteriorating and gives Julian the ultimatum to end the relationship or leave Ballet Lermontov, then later works on Vicky in Cannes to bring her back without Julian. Tsukasa proposes to Kuniko in the Shimas' rose garden, but his mother's letter forbidding the marriage and the Shimas' announcement that they are kin to his family and see no possibility for it break her down and she disappears.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Giannini is shot on Luciano's order before he can get in front of the grand jury in New York. Sophie is at the telescope in Leigh's flat, in radio contact with her, when she is attacked, and the police close it by finding she had a flight booked to Fort Worth.

Both turn on the scheme returns on its author. Garr holds Boyd and Lew at gunpoint and orders them to drink so their deaths will look accidental, but the two get the upper hand and Garr is the one killed. Miles and Herb Myerson hire the hitman Wheezy Joe to kill Marylin, and Marylin offers Joe double to kill Miles instead, until Joe mistakes his gun for his asthma inhaler and shoots himself.

Both turn on one party holds another under a sustained look, and the watching stands in place of any exchange between them. With a killer at large in the city, the inspector taking John's report about his missing wife puts men on him instead. The sublet's heating duct carries a stranger's analysis into Marion's writing room, and she sits and listens to Hope's sessions day after day before ever speaking to her.

Both turn on a parent cannot feel toward the child what the child needs. Charlotte gives Helena a wristwatch, offers Eva her car, and on the train out asks her agent why the girl could not simply have died. With Dito dead by his own hand and nothing left, Pixote climbs onto Sueli and takes her breast in his mouth like an infant, and she pushes him off in disgust.

edges.a: once upon a time in the west
edges.aTitle: Once Upon a Time in the West
edges.claim: Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Frank forces Jill into a sexual encounter and then to put Sweetwater up for auction, where his men frighten off every bidder so he can have it cheap. Maganlal offers Feluda two thousand rupees to drop the Ganesh case, and when it is refused he stands Jatayu against a board and has knives thrown around him.

Both turn on one party takes another up while they serve its purpose and drops them, with no cause given, once they do not. Once Gelsomina's madness after Il Matto's death makes her useless for drawing a crowd, Zampanò leaves her asleep by the roadside with some clothes, some money and his trumpet, and drives on. The Thalmanns take her up at the funeral and want her husband as a victim of capitalism for the election, and when she wants something done the anarchists take her on to the hostage-taking she stands horrified in the middle of.

Both turn on one party takes control of the thing another cannot do without and sets the terms of its release, and they disagree about it. Baines buys Ada's piano from Stewart with the land Stewart covets and then sets terms — one black key returned per lesson, against escalating sexual demands — before finally giving the instrument back and confessing he wants her to care for him genuinely. Jimmy pulls a gun on Sydney and demands $10,000 to keep quiet about the Atlantic City killing, settles for $6,000 from the casino cashier, and Sydney later waits in Jimmy's house and shoots him, taking the cash back.

Both turn on an outside party takes a person out of the keeping of those bound to them, who must get them back. To forestall the prophecy that a twelve-year-old named Bikram will destroy him, Acharya has his soldiers kidnap every twelve-year-old boy in Anandapur named Bikram and hypnotizes them into his servants. Chris and his henchmen snatch Julia by helicopter from the hijacked plane and later retake her from Lupin's group, holding her at the sect's cathedral until Lupin gets her out and she is reunited with her family.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest. She has never told her husband about the German soldier at Nevers, and the architect is elated when he learns that the story she has just told him has been kept from her husband. After Tom asks Mary to 'teach' his brother Dick about sex, she denies to Tom that anything took place and insists the baby is his; the question of whose child it was is never cleared between them.

Both turn on one party puts another into a position that lowers them in the eyes of those watching, and they disagree about it. Eva plays the Chopin A minor prelude for her mother and Charlotte sits down and plays the same piece again, better, and explains what it is about. The night porter Jim sells tickets to the ward to see the Elephant Man, Mothershead says the high-society visitors are another kind of show, and the crowd at Liverpool Street corners him and pulls the hood off.

Both turn on the person destroys the thing they could not otherwise hold. Having promised Sukhilala she would not let Birju harm his family, Radha shoots her own bandit son as he rides off with the kidnapped Rupa, and he dies in her arms. After Jim rebuffs her and says he will marry Gilberte, Catherine asks him into her car, tells Jules to watch, and drives off a ruined bridge into the river, killing herself and Jim.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Glaucus returns to find his father murdered and the house looted by the cross-marking hooded band, vows revenge, and hunts them to the Temple of Isis, where Arbaces and Julia are finally crushed by the toppling idol and Gallinus shot in the royal box. The carabinieri stop the bus with the cocaine on it, and at Peppe's birthday party, mid-sentence about how well it all went, one of the traffickers walks in and shoots him.

Both turn on one party finally sees, repays or repents their part only after the moment when it could have changed anything has closed.. Years on, Zampanò hears a woman singing Gelsomina's trumpet tune, learns that she was taken in on a beach, wasted away and died in her sleep, and that night he gets drunk, brawls, and collapses weeping on the sand. At fifty-plus Marion works out what she has been to the people around her - the brother who feels she is ashamed of him, the school friend she eclipsed, the stepdaughter who resents her, and the first husband who killed himself.

Both turn on one party holds another under a sustained look, and the watching stands in place of any exchange between them, and they disagree about it. Kopple keeps the camera running, and runs it empty when the film is out, because the crew being there is what holds the shooting down on the picket line. The siblings listen at doors, search the musicians' flat, go through Don Garofalo's rooms and follow two of his men to a beach house, all of it dressed up as an inquiry into who killed their cat.

Both turn on two parties take each other up across a line their people hold as forbidden, and keep it out of sight of those who would move against them. Ivan loves and plans to marry Marichka, the daughter of the man who killed his father, across the bitter enmity between their Hutsul families, until she drowns in the river while he is away earning money for their household. Gozal and Solduz love each other against the village's rule that her umbilical cord was cut in Jacob's name, keep it hidden, plan to elope in a week, and are both shot dead trying to cross the border.

edges.a: the bird with the crystal plumage
edges.aTitle: The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
edges.claim: Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. The killer telephones Sam and promises to kill Julia unless he drops the investigation, and then goes for her in the flat while he is out. Sent by Otto to lie with the maid who is a witch in the best sense, Alexander tells Maria about his mother's garden, and when she is bewildered by his advances he puts Victor's pistol to his own temple and says do not kill us.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Andrea is publicly tried for the count's murder he did not intend or commit, and is acquitted only when an autopsy shows the count's hearing was sound and he could have saved himself. Wendy takes the marks on Danny for Jack's doing, and Jack, having seen the woman in 237 and told Wendy he saw nothing, says the boy did it to himself.

Both turn on one party fixes the account of what happened or of who someone is, and the party it concerns has no purchase on it, whatever they say.. The official account of the night in Stammheim is that Baader, Ensslin and Raspe killed themselves, and the film keeps returning to people who cannot make it hold: Fassbinder with his mother, Biermann singing Girl in Stuttgart, Mahler in his cell. Piotr goes into the judge's chambers to ask whether a better lawyer could have saved his client, and is told his was the finest argument against the death penalty the judge had heard and that it could never have made any difference.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Park picks out the scarred, mentally handicapped Baek Kwang-ho on the strength of eye contact and his girlfriend's gossip, and Cho beats a confession out of him until Seo shows the boy could not have committed the crimes. EVE blames WALL-E for the missing seedling and he is designated a rogue robot, until the two of them see GO-4 stowing the plant in a self-destructing escape pod.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. In retaliation for the steps massacre the sailors turn the battleship's guns on the Odessa opera house where Tsarist military leaders are meeting. After Adua refuses Ercoli's rent and humiliates him in front of the others, he has all four women arrested for prostitution in revenge.

Both turn on one party comes asking something of another who is free to answer it, and is turned away, and they disagree about it. Angela begs Pier Luigi at the nightclub to go back for Dina, who was left behind on the way and is then run over by a transport truck, and later asks him for help escaping and is refused outright. A rebel soldier asks the farmer Mariano to join the war, appealing to his children's future; Mariano says he only wants to live in peace and orders him off, and only joins the Sierra Maestra rebels after government planes bomb his home and kill his son.

Both turn on the penalty or cost owed for one party's act or settlement falls on someone else, while the one who owes it goes free.. After the liberation of Sicily the same boss who forced him into the party is sitting with an American officer while former Fascists call themselves anti-Fascists, and he sacks Piscitello for that party membership. Ming talks Liren into forging the contractor's weather-delay documents at the bar, and it is Liren who is fired for forgery while Ming returns to his office untouched.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. After Dolores names Quilty as the man who took her and secluded her at the dude ranch, Humbert drives to Quilty's mansion with a gun and shoots him dead among his drunken evasions. Grief-stricken at his family's slaughter, Macduff vows revenge, marches on Dunsinane with Malcolm's English-backed army, declares himself untimely ripped from his mother's body, and beheads Macbeth.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Wade sets the grain price at his own mill, works the senator and the bank, quietly buys the river frontage for the dam he wants and finally has Tom's corn graded down and offers less than it cost to put in the ground. Stewart tries to force himself on Ada, coerces a promise that she will not see Baines again, and when she breaks it chops off her index finger and sends it to Baines with a threat to take more.

Both turn on one party works on another to turn them back from a course that would undo them. When Eugen storms out with a rifle threatening to shoot himself after Rakel's confession, she chases him and fetches an elderly neighbour to talk sense into him. When the enraged Xiao Ji sets out to avenge his beating, Bin Bin stops him by telling him that Qiao San carries a gun on his person.

Both turn on one party who has been denied or bereaved unloads it as harm on people who had no part in it. In the junkyard the Panthers read Cleaver and Baraka and pass rifles hand to hand while a group of captive white women in white are shot off camera and their bodies laid out in tableaux. Holly explains she and her husband lost their son to cancer and their faith with him, and began abducting other people's children to wage a war on God and make demons of the parents; Loki shoots her dead.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to, and they disagree about it. To get the contract's civil-disturbance clause Shyamal has a riot staged at his own plant; a factory watchman is badly hurt in it and Shyamal is congratulated for efficient handling. Wade brings a truckload of farmers who have already lost their own places to pull the levee apart for day money, and offers Tom's neighbours a bonus to cut it from the inside.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Anders recruits Gregg, Agostino, Jean-Paul and Erich for the Rio diamond job while secretly partnered with Mary Ann, who swaps the diamonds for an empty case, so the four experts do the work and die for a purpose they were never told about. Daniel adopts the orphaned baby H.W. after a derrick accident kills the boy's father, specifically so he can present himself as a family man to investors, and only decades later tells H.W. he was a bastard from a basket used as a 'sweet face' to buy land.

Both turn on one party works on another to turn them back from a course that would undo them. Darek means to stay inside and go on with the hunger strike; Labrador builds a defence around union men swearing he is no danger to anyone, and sends his junior into the cell to talk him out of the strike, and the sentence is suspended. Travis telephones his father to say he is in love with Jonni, and his father talks him down by telling him about his own dalliance before the wedding - with Jonni listening.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Rotwang, whose beloved Hel left him to marry Fredersen and died bearing Freder, works his revenge through the false Maria and dies falling from the cathedral roof while fighting Freder. Debora took them for the cocaine money in Rio, and when Pixote finds her at the club the argument ends with a knife in her.

Both turn on one party keeps attendance on another who can no longer answer or meet them, and goes on addressing them anyway. Eleven years after Julie's death Davenne keeps an upstairs room for her, and when it burns he rebuilds it in a ruined cemetery chapel as a forest of candles he goes on talking to. Adult Sophie in New York replays the MiniDV footage from Turkey and, in the rave sequences, pushes through the strobing crowd toward Calum, briefly holding him before he falls from her grasp.

Both turn on two parties take each other up across a line their people hold as forbidden, and keep it out of sight of those who would move against them. In occupied Nevers the French woman loved a German soldier and planned to elope to Bavaria with him; he was shot while waiting for her on the day the town was liberated. Benjamin meets his father's law partner's wife at the Taft Hotel through the summer, signing the register as Mr Gladstone.

Both turn on the deceived party finds the deception out, and they disagree about it. Scottie sees Judy wearing the necklace from Carlotta's portrait, drives her back to San Juan Bautista and forces her up the tower until she admits Gavin paid her to impersonate his wife. After marrying Marylin and tearing up his own prenup, Miles discovers that her oil-millionaire ex-husband 'Howard D. Doyle' was only an actor from one of Donaly's soap operas, staged to leave Miles' fortune exposed.

Both turn on parties bound to each other by service, alliance or company come to act against each other. Tetsuo goes through everyone who has ever held him up - the Capsules, Kaneda, the espers, Shikishima - and kills Yamagata at the Harukiya over the bike he took. His own team-mate blocks his pit stall at North Wilkesboro and puts him in the outside wall on the last lap, Cole drives into him on the cool-down, and the whole shop ends in a fight that gets Cole and Harry fired.

Both turn on the death lands on the person who was standing nearby. Lennie Garr and his henchman rig a car to kill Boyd and kill Charley Dolan by mistake, and Boyd, who was the intended target, attempts suicide out of guilt. Waiting for the randy farmhand outside the brothel, the Baron and Otto take the head of the friend who was there to be talked out of the monastery; Nicholas walks away alive.

Both turn on what one party held back comes into the open between them and the person whose life it governed, and they disagree about it. Sadao consults his birth certificate while preparing his university application and learns that Chieko is not his mother but his father's second wife, forcing the years-long concealment into the open between them until he tearfully apologises and, after a second rupture, comes home. Pressed by Ahmad, Lucie tells Marie that she forwarded her and Samir's email correspondence to Samir's wife the day before the suicide attempt, and Marie orders her out of the house.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Jagga, having learned Leela is pregnant with the judge's child, releases her and instead grooms the boy Raj into a thief to disprove Raghunath's doctrine, a design Raj knows nothing of until he kills Jagga in his mother's house. Hachizo and Gorosuke lure Sankichi with the promise of food and kill him with an axe in order to eat him, the boy never told what he is being brought for.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. After Dolores names Quilty as the man who took her and secluded her at the dude ranch, Humbert drives to Quilty's mansion with a gun and shoots him dead among his drunken evasions. Embittered by Bob's rejection, Syndrome builds a fortune on fake superpowers, kills off retired supers by testing the Omnidroid on them, lures Bob to Nomanisan, shoots down the plane carrying his children and finally tries to steal Jack-Jack.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. The roll call of Irish and foreign writers banned by the censorship board is read over church bells rung as at a funeral, and emigration is named as what the bans produced. Sergeant Tolt mentions he holds photographs of Captain Allen and his wife, and Jonas decides he must be killed quietly and the photographs taken.

Both turn on a need is laid before someone with no prior claim or duty, who must decide whether to take up a burden that is not theirs., and they disagree about it. Martha runs to Kaiser, a colleague she once trained and who owes her nothing, and he agrees to drive her; she grabs the wheel believing Helmut is behind them, and the crash kills him and paralyses her. Franziska Busch stops her car in the underground garage, gets the man off the woman he is hitting, and takes her home to look after her.

Both turn on one party settles the terms of its own death and requires those bound to it to stand by and let it happen. When the other personality has finished talking, Neville folds Laura's hand around the gun he gave her and asks her to shoot him, and she does. After killing Lammark and watching his mother shoot herself outside the shed, Dean sits with Eleanor and asks her to let him fall asleep and then execute him, and she agrees; when the sheriff arrives he takes it as betrayal and finally raises his weapon at the massed officers to be shot.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way., and they disagree about it. Bikash Singha is one of the Ghosal household and takes Maganlal's money to lift the golden Ganesh out of it. Clodio Pulcher, kept close as a nephew while Hamilton Crassus III's mind and health decline, works with Wow Platinum to manipulate the old man into handing over control of the Crassus bank; when Crassus learns of the duplicity he strokes out, then kills Wow with a hidden bow and arrow.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back. Dying of a henchman's bullet during the escape from Rodríguez's hacienda, Florès makes Maria I promise to carry on his revolution in San Miguel, and she takes up the peasant army and the campaign on his behalf. Marcus Aurelius' charge to restore the Roman Republic passes to Maximus, who carries it through the arena and, dying, asks for political reforms and Gracchus' reinstatement as senator.

edges.a: the man who shot liberty valance
edges.aTitle: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
edges.claim: Both turn on one party fixes the account of what happened or of who someone is, and the party it concerns has no purchase on it, whatever they say.. Ranse finally tells the newspaper editor the truth about who shot Valance and the editor burns the reporter's notes — 'when the legend becomes fact, print the legend' — so the false account stands and the train conductor still calls Ranse the man who shot Liberty Valance. A manipulatively edited video of Lydia's Juilliard masterclass goes viral, a New York Post piece accuses her of sexual predation and an unseen hand rewrites her Wikipedia page, and nothing she does — deposition, book tour, storming the stage — touches the account.

Both turn on one party takes another up while they serve its purpose and drops them, with no cause given, once they do not. Liliana lets Checco break from his troupe and rehearse a whole new show built around her, then arrives at rehearsal to say she has signed with a competitor, and Checco collapses. Willy goes in to ask Howard, whose father he worked for, to be taken off the road and put on the city, and comes out with no job at all.

Both turn on a third party stands between two who would join and keeps them apart, and they disagree about it. Lermontov, whose company policy forced Irina Boronskaya out for marrying, tells Julian and Vicky their work is deteriorating and gives Julian the ultimatum to end the relationship or leave Ballet Lermontov, then later works on Vicky in Cannes to bring her back without Julian. Anna's letter from Switzerland asking Henrik to resume the relationship is intercepted by her parents — Johan opens it and Karin reads and burns it — and only after Johan's death does Karin confess, whereupon Anna goes to Henrik and marries him.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest. Rosa carries on a year-long affair with Neil Latimer while her husband Lewis, the town doctor, knows nothing of it, until her delirium and resentment over the pregnancy drive her to confess both the affair and the murder of Moose to him. Anatole Kuragin courts Natasha and persuades her to elope while concealing that he is already secretly married — the fact Pierre uses to threaten him with exposure.

Both turn on one party stands close enough to watch another's life and is eaten by the sight of it. Lermontov, who has no emotional life of his own, treats his dancers' happiness as a personal slight and moves against Vicky and Julian's love out of jealousy of it, even while his own choreographer praises Julian's work. The nurse admits in court that, newly married and struggling with her stepchildren, she grew envious of the Nonomiyas' happiness and spitefully swapped the two newborns.

Both turn on one party takes up someone others have written off and treats them as worth something. Itard's colleagues at the school for deaf-mutes have the boy down as deaf or an idiot; Itard says he is neither, and that the state he is in is what deprivation did to him. Chunk is left tied up with the deformed brother the Fratellis keep chained in the cellar, gets him loose, and at the end stops the police taking him and asks him to come and live at his house.

edges.a: the bird with the crystal plumage
edges.aTitle: The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
edges.claim: Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding, and they disagree about it. The killer telephones Sam and promises to kill Julia unless he drops the investigation, and then goes for her in the flat while he is out. A billion lire is on the table for the building if it is empty, so Amedeo and Ofelia set about the remaining tenants one by one until the last of them is out - and then the lawyer tears up the cheques because Wanda has moved back in.

Both turn on one party is passed over by someone whose regard they held, in favour of another that person prefers. After the dinner at the wealthy man's mansion Checco walks away from his faithful mistress Melina to walk alone with Liliana, and leaves the troupe in Rome to build a new one around Liliana, only to end up back beside Melina on the Foggia train. Kathy comes back to the flat and finds Kevin there with another woman, and after they patch it up she dreams of killing him for it.

edges.a: zatoichi and the chest of gold
edges.aTitle: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold
edges.claim: Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. The village men accost Ichi and blame him for the theft of the tax gold, and later mob him again on his return to Itakura, though he had fought off the robbers atop the chest. With the chief's post open, Li fixes the dead chief's offence on Jing, his colleague and oldest friend, and Jing resigns in disgust believing it was the third candidate.

Both turn on the deceived party finds the deception out, and they disagree about it. Scottie sees Judy wearing the necklace from Carlotta's portrait, drives her back to San Juan Bautista and forces her up the tower until she admits Gavin paid her to impersonate his wife. Columbus signs his crew on by telling them the crossing will take seven weeks; at nine weeks with no land the men grow restless and edge toward mutiny until his speech and a rising wind put them back to their duties.

Both turn on the work takes the life it was supposed to support. The pace of the assembly line drives the Tramp to a nervous breakdown; he runs amok, is caught inside the machine, and is hospitalised, and every later job — shipbuilder, night watchman, mechanic's assistant, singing waiter — throws him back out again. Vicky's dancing career, and the Red Shoes ballet in which the shoes will not let the dancer stop until she dies, takes her over exactly as the fairytale predicts — she dies in costume and asks Julian to take the red shoes off.

edges.a: investigation of a citizen above suspicion
edges.aTitle: Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion
edges.claim: Both turn on one party covers what another did so that the other never has to answer for it. The Doctor lays every proof of his own guilt in front of his superiors and confesses, and they refuse to hear it and make him withdraw the confession, the commissioner concurring. Marcello tells the priest about the assault, the man he believes he shot dead and his lack of any guilt about it, and is absolved once the priest hears he works for the secret police.

Both turn on one party takes another up while they serve its purpose and drops them, with no cause given, once they do not, and they disagree about it. Fernando makes Walter general manager within two days of hiring him, then, as the nightmares continue, turns on him and tries to kill him, leaving Walter tossed about with no explanation until the staff track him down and the position is handed back. Sister Małgorzata leaves the convent and becomes Margareth after falling in love with the squire Chrząszczewski, who abandons her the morning after the killings.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest. Anne, who has been trailing Moreau to find her father, sends her mother out of the room and tells Moreau that she knows of the affair with Judith but her mother does not. Beth never told Karen that she and David had an affair years earlier in her marriage; Karen only learns it second-hand from Gabe, who heard it from Tom, and is hurt that her closest friend kept it from her.

Both turn on one party takes another up while they serve its purpose and drops them, with no cause given, once they do not. Sister Małgorzata leaves the convent and becomes Margareth after falling in love with the squire Chrząszczewski, who abandons her the morning after the killings. Lydia keeps Francesca as assistant and confidante, dangles Sebastian's assistant-conductor post, then drops the promotion after Sebastian's accusation of favoritism; Francesca resigns and hands Lydia's emails with Krista to the plaintiffs.

Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Rotwang kidnaps Maria and gives the robot her likeness, and the false Maria preaches insurrection to the workers and dances at the Yoshiwara club with neither the workers nor the wealthy men recognising she is a machine, until the fire at the stake reveals the metal. Clare Quilty crosses Humbert's path first as a policeman at the convention hotel and then as the school psychologist 'Dr. Zempf' in his darkened living room, and Humbert only learns years later from Dolores who the man was.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. Mac persuades Corby and Fletcher to let him take the raft alone and draw the general's guards' fire, and is shot while they infiltrate the house, kill the general and fly out on an enemy plane. Rosemary Scott arranges the passage out for McCain and Irene, is taken by Francesco's men for it, and kills herself before they can get his position out of her.

Both turn on those already in place weigh the one who arrives among them and withhold a standing of their own from them, and they disagree about it. Liliana asks Checco on the night train to be taken into the troupe and is refused; the company only accepts her the next morning after she spends her last money hiring the carriage that spares them miles of walking. On Noirmoutier the shopkeeper's daughter says the newcomer scared her, the linen vendors Max and Pierre single him out in the market as someone amiss, and the hotel accuses him of killing the cat left on his doorstep.

Both turn on one party fails to see or value the person standing closest to it, and they disagree about it. John comes home drunk on Christmas Eve after a woman at Bert's throws herself at him, yells at Mary over something trivial, and shows such apathy when she threatens to leave in April that she is shocked and hurt. The Legendres are told their daughter has vanished from school, find her at her desk, can see her and talk to her, and take her along to the police station to report her missing, where nobody in the room admits she is standing there.

edges.a: the passion of joan of arc
edges.aTitle: The Passion of Joan of Arc
edges.claim: Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding, and they disagree about it. After being taken to view the torture chamber and then threatened with burning at the stake, Joan breaks and lets a priest guide her hand in signing a confession, for which she is sentenced to life imprisonment. Herzog retells the story of threatening to shoot Kinski if he walked off the production of Aguirre, the Wrath of God, and Kinski stayed.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back. Marcus Aurelius' charge to restore the Roman Republic passes to Maximus, who carries it through the arena and, dying, asks for political reforms and Gracchus' reinstatement as senator. Sadazo, expecting to die in the Philippines, asks Matsuyama to carry his wife Tomoko's postcard back to her and say he received it before dying; after the war Matsuyama makes his way to Tomoko's house to discharge that errand.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Gérard, who takes charge of Balthazar at the bakery out of jealousy over Marie's affection, beats the donkey and prepares to bludgeon him to death, and holds Marie in a violent relationship that ends with him and his gang stripping, beating and locking her in the barn. Göth runs Płaszów by brutalising his maid Helen Hirsch and shooting prisoners at random from his villa balcony, with the inmates in constant fear and no way out from under him until he is hanged.

Both turn on an outside party takes a person out of the keeping of those bound to them, who must get them back. Annabelle goes back aboard for her belongings just as Captain Anderson's Union spies steal The General, and she is carried north as their captive until Johnnie finds her at the officers' house and smuggles her into a boxcar. Corinne vanishes after her shift at Wiener Heaven and Heidi phones Honey for help; Honey hunts the town for her until she spots Corinne's green lipstick on a teacup at MG's house and finds her alive in the basement.

Both turn on one party takes another up while they serve its purpose and drops them, with no cause given, once they do not. Liliana lets Checco break from his troupe and rehearse a whole new show built around her, then arrives at rehearsal to say she has signed with a competitor, and Checco collapses. Once Gelsomina's madness after Il Matto's death makes her useless for drawing a crowd, Zampanò leaves her asleep by the roadside with some clothes, some money and his trumpet, and drives on.

edges.b: the working class goes to heaven
edges.bTitle: The Working Class Goes to Heaven
edges.claim: Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Jagga, having learned Leela is pregnant with the judge's child, releases her and instead grooms the boy Raj into a thief to disprove Raghunath's doctrine, a design Raj knows nothing of until he kills Jagga in his mother's house. Management holds up Lulu's piece rate as proof of what the line can do and raises everyone's quota from it, which is why the men beside him will not have him.

Both turn on the deceived party finds the deception out, and they disagree about it. After marrying Marylin and tearing up his own prenup, Miles discovers that her oil-millionaire ex-husband 'Howard D. Doyle' was only an actor from one of Donaly's soap operas, staged to leave Miles' fortune exposed.
