Xiao Ji is led off the discotheque dance floor by Qiao San's men, who humiliate and beat him for flirting with Qiao Qiao.

Both turn on two parties take each other up across a line their people hold as forbidden, and keep it out of sight of those who would move against them. Pauline, running her called-up husband's shop, takes the Polish prisoner assigned to help her as a lover, and they are seen at it in the open in a village where the race laws make it a capital matter for him. Asked to cure the barrenness of King Rouma's wife, Nianankoro makes the enchantment and then sleeps with Attou, and the two go back that night to tell the king what they have done.

Both turn on what one party held back comes into the open between them and the person whose life it governed. Sadao consults his birth certificate while preparing his university application and learns that Chieko is not his mother but his father's second wife, forcing the years-long concealment into the open between them until he tearfully apologises and, after a second rupture, comes home. After the Ushigunis leave, Toyoko tells Yoko that she slept with Yoko's husband Saburo 22 years ago while Yoko was on tour and that Saburo fathered her daughter Akemi; Yoko is indignant and Toyoko walks out, but the two settle it and later attend Akemi's tentative-marriage ceremony together.

Both turn on one party fixes the account of what happened or of who someone is, and the party it concerns has no purchase on it, whatever they say.. The Church is modernising and will not have Satan on the books, so Merrin is tried for heresy after his death on the strength of his own writings. The official account of the night in Stammheim is that Baader, Ensslin and Raspe killed themselves, and the film keeps returning to people who cannot make it hold: Fassbinder with his mother, Biermann singing Girl in Stuttgart, Mahler in his cell.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Bought from her mother and travelling in Zampanò's motocarro, Gelsomina is presented as his wife, intimidated, forced upon and beaten, and when she rebels and runs to town he simply carries her back by force. Göth runs Płaszów by brutalising his maid Helen Hirsch and shooting prisoners at random from his villa balcony, with the inmates in constant fear and no way out from under him until he is hanged.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Sergeant Tolt mentions he holds photographs of Captain Allen and his wife, and Jonas decides he must be killed quietly and the photographs taken. McAra drowns after discovering Lang's torture-flight involvement and Ruth's recruitment, and the Ghost, having decoded the same message from the first words of McAra's chapters and passed a note to Ruth, is hit by an accelerating car outside the book launch.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Jagga, having learned Leela is pregnant with the judge's child, releases her and instead grooms the boy Raj into a thief to disprove Raghunath's doctrine, a design Raj knows nothing of until he kills Jagga in his mother's house. Bomba cut women's hair inside the gas chamber itself and found the wife and sister of a friend among them, Muller burned the bodies, and Srebnik was made to sing military songs for the guards at Chelmno.

Both turn on the deceived party finds the deception out. Charlotte finds Humbert's hidden diary and reads his desire for Dolores and his loathing of her, then runs out of the house distraught and is struck by a car. Alphonse presents Françoise to Hélène as his niece when she is his young lover, and the whole footing of the reunion collapses when his brother-in-law Ernest arrives demanding he return to his wife, shocking Hélène.

edges.a: the man who shot liberty valance
edges.aTitle: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
edges.claim: Both turn on one party fixes the account of what happened or of who someone is, and the party it concerns has no purchase on it, whatever they say.. Ranse finally tells the newspaper editor the truth about who shot Valance and the editor burns the reporter's notes — 'when the legend becomes fact, print the legend' — so the false account stands and the train conductor still calls Ranse the man who shot Liberty Valance. Piotr goes into the judge's chambers to ask whether a better lawyer could have saved his client, and is told his was the finest argument against the death penalty the judge had heard and that it could never have made any difference.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Alma opens the unsealed letter Elisabet has written to the doctor and finds she is being 'studied' — her story of the orgy and abortion set down as material — and rounds on Elisabet for using her. Gina secretly tapes her conversation with the unfocused elderly Albert to pin down his tentative agreement over the sandstone, and when she and Ryan come back to load the truck he watches from the window and will not return her wave.

Both turn on one party obtains another's closeness or presence and pays for it with the means to live. Tamae is unhappy that her son Kiyoshi is kept by an older mistress who pays him for being at her service. Cook courts and marries Rhonda, a former teacher waiting tables while she and her mother Miranda grow desperate for money, and pays to have a house built for Miranda; Rhonda later takes her own life.

Both turn on one party holds out rescue, pity or an easier way and the one it is meant for will not take it. Jacques offers to marry Marie even after she tells him of the abuse, and tells her his father has dropped the court-ordered money, but she leaves and her mother tells him only "She's gone and will never come back." Colm offers a truce at the pub and later suggests the burnt house has ended the feud, and Pádraic answers that it would have ended only if Colm had stayed inside, adding that some things there is no moving on from.

edges.b: where are you going on holiday
edges.bTitle: Where Are You Going on Holiday?
edges.claim: Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true. The woman Fred takes for a German princess is an adventuress; she sails for Rangoon with £1000 of his money before he learns what she was. Arturo guides safaris as Wilson to keep his Italian roots out of it, and pours the whole story out drunk to a well-mannered listener who is the insurance investigator on the case.

Both turn on a parent leaves and the child is left waiting. As a sailor he repeatedly left his wife and daughter alone for long voyages at sea, which is what unhinged the wife and put her in the cell. Jason Burkett's father was incarcerated for most of Jason's life and his emotional appeal on that account helps spare Jason the death sentence; the two are now imprisoned in the same facility.

Both turn on one party takes the gain of what another spent, made or suffered, and returns them nothing for it. Julian walks out of Heart of Fire on recognising that his professor has passed off Julian's own compositions as his score, and writes to Lermontov exposing it. Broke, Checco begs Melina for the money to launch the show featuring Liliana; she hands it over, orders him never to contact her again, and he takes it triumphantly.

Both turn on one party comes asking something of another who is free to answer it, and is turned away. Johnnie hurries to be first in line at the Marietta recruiting office and is rejected because he is worth more as an engineer, a reason the recruiters never tell him. Fuller asks Laura to walk out the front and stall the police as though he had a gun on her so he can slip out the back, and she instead tells them exactly where he is — though she later visits him in prison and agrees to answer his letters.

Both turn on one party takes the gain of what another spent, made or suffered, and returns them nothing for it. Broke, Checco begs Melina for the money to launch the show featuring Liliana; she hands it over, orders him never to contact her again, and he takes it triumphantly. Pedro's landlord rides up mid-harvest to say he has sold the land to United Fruit, telling him he may keep 'the sweat you put into growing them' and nothing else of his best sugar crop; Pedro burns the crop and house and dies in the smoke.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding, and they disagree about it. Mary's mother corners Henry in the hall after the dinner, tries to kiss him, and tells him Mary has had his baby and that the two of them must be married. Herzog retells the story of threatening to shoot Kinski if he walked off the production of Aguirre, the Wrath of God, and Kinski stayed.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. After Adua refuses Ercoli's rent and humiliates him in front of the others, he has all four women arrested for prostitution in revenge. The convict Sauro recognises in the pizzeria shoots him, and after a few seconds of hesitation Barletta draws the pistol Sauro gave him and kills the man.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would., and they disagree about it. Johannes tells Morten that death is nearby and will take Inger unless he has faith; Morten refuses to listen and Inger dies suddenly, exactly as prophesied, and only after her death does the family credit Johannes enough to ask for her raising. Umaprasad, back from his English studies in Calcutta, argues privately with his father that the goddess business is delusion, but the sick boy's eyes opening settles it for Kalikinkar, and the cost falls on Khoka.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them. When Jeanne says it is over Paul runs her through the streets of Paris, past her threat to call the police, into her mother's building and through the door of the flat. Soma is told in a vision that his son will be the death of him and sets out to kill him first, following him across the country with a pylon that tracks him and goes through every barrier put in its way.

Both turn on one party takes into its own house and keeping someone with no claim to be there. Brad and Midge Sheridan set out to adopt Danny, a foundling abandoned at a police station and made a ward of the juvenile court, and Brad finally talks Mrs. Morrow into approving the adoption. Itard takes formal custody and removes the boy to his own house on the edge of Paris, where he and his housekeeper raise him.

Both turn on one party who has been denied or bereaved unloads it as harm on people who had no part in it. Jacek carries a rope round the city, plays pointless cruelties on strangers, and strangles and then stones a taxi driver he has no quarrel with; five years earlier his twelve-year-old sister was run down by a driver who had been drinking with Jacek that afternoon. Dean Possey, an ex-slaughterhouse worker who once killed the coworker who bullied him, shoots 29 strangers at New Year's parties from a downtown high-rise and later empties an Uzi into shoppers who had done nothing to him beyond a changing-room accusation.

edges.a: jolanda the daughter of the black corsair
edges.aTitle: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair
edges.claim: Both turn on a life or a freedom is settled with a payment, and they disagree about it. Jolanda kidnaps Consuelo of Medina to trade her for the release of Ralf and the arrested pirates, but Van Guld turns the exchange site into an ambush. Emerald, bought as a child for $100, haggles across the whole film with the auntie who insists her freedom is worth $3,000, and with Master Hong and Luo's help settles a price and leaves the brothel.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it. Caligari sends the somnambulist Cesare out at night to stab the town clerk and Alan in their beds while Caligari keeps a dummy in the box to appear innocent. The plan is put into the labour officer's hands to provoke the strike and the lock-out, so that the defective paint never has to be Shyamal's to answer for.

Both turn on one party obtains another's closeness or presence and pays for it with the means to live. The two Maries systematically trade their company for meals — flirting with a man to secure a free lunch and crying when he leaves, and Marie II sitting with the butterfly collector who declares his love while she only asks him for food. Crimson, Jasmin, Jade and Emerald keep long semi-monogamous arrangements with wealthy patrons — Master Wang, Master Zhu, Luo — who maintain them inside the flower houses in exchange for their company.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back, and they disagree about it. Bernard cannot get free of Muriel, the girl he helped torture and murder during his service in Algeria, and writes in the journal Alphonse finds that since her death he is 'no longer alive'. Dying of a henchman's bullet during the escape from Rodríguez's hacienda, Florès makes Maria I promise to carry on his revolution in San Miguel, and she takes up the peasant army and the campaign on his behalf.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it, and they disagree about it. Rosemary Scott arranges the passage out for McCain and Irene, is taken by Francesco's men for it, and kills herself before they can get his position out of her. With the jets over the house and the broadcast running, Alexander promises God he will give up everything he has and loves, his son included, if the day can be taken back, and in the morning he burns the house to the ground to keep the bargain.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Buzz's gang become convinced Jim informed on them about the chickie-run death, steal Plato's address book and hunt Jim down, though Jim's attempt to confess had been turned away at the police station. With the chief's post open, Li fixes the dead chief's offence on Jing, his colleague and oldest friend, and Jing resigns in disgust believing it was the third candidate.

Both turn on one party holds another under a sustained look, and the watching stands in place of any exchange between them. The sublet's heating duct carries a stranger's analysis into Marion's writing room, and she sits and listens to Hope's sessions day after day before ever speaking to her. Suspecting Hogarth is hiding something, Mansley rents a room in Annie's house specifically to keep the boy under observation, until he finds the photograph linking Hogarth to the Giant.

Both turn on a parent leaves and the child is left waiting. As a sailor he repeatedly left his wife and daughter alone for long voyages at sea, which is what unhinged the wife and put her in the cell. The passing doctor at the dacha gate is the one who says out loud that Maria's husband has left her; the father is a voice reciting poems for most of the film and comes back only when the war is over, to a wife still bitter and children in tears.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Red burns his own brig so no one can retreat, quietly has Boomako ready a boat for the throne alone, and rows away leaving the surviving crew in the water. Olèander, the Zufu police agent posing as Headhunter's daughter Emerah, learns during the escape from Zenigata that Headhunter has been using her to get at the key, and is then captured by Crisis.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. Rosemary Scott arranges the passage out for McCain and Irene, is taken by Francesco's men for it, and kills herself before they can get his position out of her. Djigui lost his sight long ago because he chose to turn the Kore's Wing to his people's use rather than his own.

Both turn on whom a person is bound to is settled by parties outside the bond for ends of their own, and the one bound must go on living inside it., and they disagree about it. Otome asks Kihachi to talk Jiro into marrying Harue, and Kihachi — stung that nobody considers him a match himself — puts it to Jiro, who gruffly rejects it. Mr Robinson pulls Elaine out of college and settles her marriage to Carl, and she is at the altar in Santa Barbara before she breaks it.

edges.a: the passion of joan of arc
edges.aTitle: The Passion of Joan of Arc
edges.claim: Both turn on one party lends their voice, eyes or hands to another who lacks them, so that the other can act only through them, and they disagree about it. A priest reads aloud in the prison to the illiterate Joan a forged letter said to be from Charles VII telling her to trust the bearer, her only access to the king's word being the mouth of her captors. Waiting outside Tuskin's office, Regan reaches into an autistic girl's mind and the girl speaks, and her mother will not stay to be studied but takes her home so the father can hear it.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Anders recruits Gregg, Agostino, Jean-Paul and Erich for the Rio diamond job while secretly partnered with Mary Ann, who swaps the diamonds for an empty case, so the four experts do the work and die for a purpose they were never told about. Semyon rapes the trafficked fourteen-year-old Tatiana to demonstrate to Kirill how to 'break' her, then gives her pills to induce an abortion; she dies giving birth to his child.

Both turn on a marriage is entered for money, standing or cover rather than love. Julia Fotheringale marries Roddy after his £30,000 inheritance, keeps up her affair with her leading man Archie, and discards him once the money is spent and his mansion swindled away. Matsumoto sets aside his fiancée to marry his company president's daughter, a match made for his standing in the firm, then abandons it and runs away with Sawako.

edges.b: all the money in the world
edges.bTitle: All the Money in the World
edges.claim: Both turn on the penalty or cost owed for one party's act or settlement falls on someone else, while the one who owes it goes free.. Ming talks Liren into forging the contractor's weather-delay documents at the bar, and it is Liren who is fired for forgery while Ming returns to his office untouched. With the ransom unpaid month after month, Paul's second set of captors cut off his ear and mail it to a newspaper, while Getty, who is withholding the money, sits untouched in England.

Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Camille recruits her boyfriend's friend's brother, also named Vincent, to arrive at the château posing as Simon Cinéma's missing great-grandson, coaching him with childhood details so he can fool the groundskeeper and the delusional old man into signing over the inheritance. Mulgarath appears in the house as the children's father Richard, and as an old man at the goblin campsite before that, until Jared's suspicion at his words makes him stab the false Richard and Hogsqueal eats the raven he turns into.

Both turn on an outside party takes a person out of the keeping of those bound to them, who must get them back. Mary abducts an infant from a woman in a supermarket and Tom has to help her hand the baby back before urging her to see a counsellor. Raoul tricks Meg out of the panic room to fetch Sarah's syringes and the men take the room with Sarah locked inside, then prepare to leave with her as a hostage until Meg ambushes them on the stairs.

Both turn on what one party held back comes into the open between them and the person whose life it governed. Calhoun, Pappas's loyal deputy mayor, discovers that his mentor personally facilitated Anselmo's bribe on the Zapattis' behalf to buy Judge Stern his judgeship and keep Tino out of jail, and confronts Pappas, who acquiesces to resigning. AUTO reveals the secret no-return directive A113 recorded by Buy n Large's CEO Shelby Forthright in 2110, which he had been acting on when he ordered GO-4 to destroy the plant.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Jagga, having learned Leela is pregnant with the judge's child, releases her and instead grooms the boy Raj into a thief to disprove Raghunath's doctrine, a design Raj knows nothing of until he kills Jagga in his mother's house. They are told they are running money out of Yugoslavia for the Banker; on the way back Tiberio finds the seat has been changed and there is cocaine under it, and the Banker takes the car and leaves them their fee.

Both turn on one party keeps giving to a bond the other will not return, and no reason is given that the giving can work on.. Jules stays with Catherine through the affairs she uses to torment and punish him and through the six months she left him and Sabine, and holds the marriage in place by offering her to Jim. At the campsite Kurt breaks down, says something has 'come between' them and that he wants them to be real friends again, while Mark disagrees with the assessment and stays apprehensive; they part with a quick goodbye on the same street where they met.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Maganlal offers Feluda two thousand rupees to drop the Ganesh case, and when it is refused he stands Jatayu against a board and has knives thrown around him. Stewart tries to force himself on Ada, coerces a promise that she will not see Baines again, and when she breaks it chops off her index finger and sends it to Baines with a threat to take more.

Both turn on one party takes up someone others have written off and treats them as worth something, and they disagree about it. Kameda, meeting the social pariah Taeko whom the men around her trade like chattel, is drawn to the sadness in her and wants to help her, and his kindness gives her the strength to run away from Tohata, Kayama and Akama. Chunk is left tied up with the deformed brother the Fratellis keep chained in the cellar, gets him loose, and at the end stops the police taking him and asks him to come and live at his house.

Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand.. Mrs. Miller hears out Aloysius's account of what may be happening to Donald and asks her to leave it alone until June — the boy is beaten by his father for being gay, Flynn is the only man who has shown him kindness, and removal would cost him the school. Franklin Birch is talked out of freeing Alex by his wife Nancy, and the couple decide neither to stop Keller's torture nor to tell the police.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Jagga, having learned Leela is pregnant with the judge's child, releases her and instead grooms the boy Raj into a thief to disprove Raghunath's doctrine, a design Raj knows nothing of until he kills Jagga in his mother's house. The reporters work the widow while she is still assembling plugs at the kitchen table, and Niemeyer, who took the most interest in the family, prints the piece she finds unbearable and takes up with her daughter.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Moose overhears Rosa and Latimer planning her divorce and remarriage and threatens to tell Latimer about her pregnancy himself, so Rosa shoots him dead on the hunting trip and claims she mistook him for a deer. Everyone who holds a piece of what happened at the Terzi Institute is removed in turn: Calabresi under a train, the photographer with the uncropped negatives strangled, Bianca strangled over the locket, Braun stabbed.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. When Johannes tells Gerda he never loved either woman and acted only from ambition, she sets fire to the oil rig on Devil's Field and dies in the explosion. In retaliation for the steps massacre the sailors turn the battleship's guns on the Odessa opera house where Tsarist military leaders are meeting.

edges.a: jolanda the daughter of the black corsair
edges.b: star wars episode i the phantom menace
edges.aTitle: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair
edges.bTitle: Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace
edges.claim: Both turn on a life or a freedom is settled with a payment, and they disagree about it. Jolanda kidnaps Consuelo of Medina to trade her for the release of Ralf and the arrested pirates, but Van Guld turns the exchange site into an ambush. Watto refuses Republic currency for the hyperdrive part, so Qui-Gon stakes both the part and the nine-year-old slave Anakin's freedom on a podrace, which Anakin wins.

edges.a: the human condition ii road to eternity
edges.aTitle: The Human Condition II: Road to Eternity
edges.claim: Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it, and they disagree about it. Kaji, marked as a leftist sympathiser, is given the harshest duties in his recruiting class and is beaten again and again by the veteran artillerymen, with no way out from under the army he is bound to. Wendy and Danny are inside the marriage that once put the boy's shoulder out of its socket, and by February it is Jack coming through the bathroom door with the axe.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Stewart tries to force himself on Ada, coerces a promise that she will not see Baines again, and when she breaks it chops off her index finger and sends it to Baines with a threat to take more. Herzog retells the story of threatening to shoot Kinski if he walked off the production of Aguirre, the Wrath of God, and Kinski stayed.

Both turn on one party puts another into a position that lowers them in the eyes of those watching. Henrik publicly humiliates the mill owner Nordenson in church after Nordenson refuses to kneel with his wife and daughters, which disturbs the Forsboda villagers. The boy's father, a cannon-loader, is blamed for a safety mishap on the giant red railway gun and made to stand beside it without safety gear while the lavishly dressed officer fires it again.

edges.b: a quiet place in the country
edges.bTitle: A Quiet Place in the Country
edges.claim: Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true. The woman Fred takes for a German princess is an adventuress; she sails for Rangoon with £1000 of his money before he learns what she was. Leonardo convinces Wanda's destitute mother in her Venice flat that he is a journalist writing about the aristocracy, and steals photographs of Wanda while she shows him the red satin dress.

Both turn on one party obtains another's closeness or presence and pays for it with the means to live. Kuriyama, learning that Fusako's husband died in the war, hires her as his secretary in order to seduce her and promises to care for and support her; she reluctantly becomes his mistress and he then uses her flat to hide his smuggled opium. Every episode is the same transaction in a different century: Brit made up to draw a passing trader, Mimi at her window, Nini going through the sleeping banker's wallet, Catherine working out of a friend's car and then an ambulance.

edges.a: zatoichi and the chest of gold
edges.aTitle: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold
edges.claim: Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. The village men accost Ichi and blame him for the theft of the tax gold, and later mob him again on his return to Itakura, though he had fought off the robbers atop the chest. The Foucaulds sack the nanny over the postcards the man in the park handed the girls while she sat reading.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out, and they disagree about it. Hutch researches the Bramford's history and Roman Castevet, arranges to bring Rosemary what he found, and falls into a coma that night; he surfaces once, to leave her the anagram. Once Anna's uncle Stepan has translated Tatiana's diary naming Semyon as her rapist, Semyon burns the diary and orders Nikolai to kill Stepan, who instead hides him in a hotel in Edinburgh.

edges.a: investigation of a citizen above suspicion
edges.aTitle: Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion
edges.claim: Both turn on one party covers what another did so that the other never has to answer for it. The Doctor lays every proof of his own guilt in front of his superiors and confesses, and they refuse to hear it and make him withdraw the confession, the commissioner concurring. The Montparnasse sniper who shot passers-by at random is tried, convicted and sentenced to death, and then walks out of the courtroom to autographs.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it, and they disagree about it. In Naples Luciano runs the drug traffic entirely through proxies out of a race track, so that dozens of his associates are arrested over the years and nothing is ever in his hand. Frank Coutelle visits Richard Yellow Hawk in prison, offers a reduced sentence for favors and then blackmails him with the threat of return, using him to kill Leo Fast Elk and inflame the reservation while Frank runs the official investigation.

edges.a: zatoichi and the chest of gold
edges.aTitle: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold
edges.claim: Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. The village men accost Ichi and blame him for the theft of the tax gold, and later mob him again on his return to Itakura, though he had fought off the robbers atop the chest. To get the illegal pig slaughter off Marga, the two women hide meat in Fred's office and garden and stage a rape with Marga arriving as the witness.

Both turn on one party takes control of the thing another cannot do without and sets the terms of its release. Clarisse hands the Count her ring to buy Lupin's life and he takes the ring and goes back on it; on the clock face Lupin offers both rings for her and the Count does it again. Bandy, whose ranch is the last holdout blocking the Union Oil pipeline and who knows of the murder, sets his price: Daniel must be publicly baptised and repent in Eli's church before he gets the easement.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Hachizo and Gorosuke lure Sankichi with the promise of food and kill him with an axe in order to eat him, the boy never told what he is being brought for. Gina secretly tapes her conversation with the unfocused elderly Albert to pin down his tentative agreement over the sandstone, and when she and Ryan come back to load the truck he watches from the window and will not return her wave.

edges.a: such a gorgeous kid like me
edges.aTitle: Such a Gorgeous Kid Like Me
edges.claim: Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would.. The secretary tells Stanislas to his face that Camille is a manipulative slut and cannot move him; she is the one left typing the thesis that finally says so. Chunk gets to a telephone and gives the sheriff the whole thing - the Fratellis, the bodies in the freezer, the tunnel - and the sheriff files it with his other stories.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Because Sefton barters openly with the German guards and was away with the Russian women when the radio was confiscated, the men of Barracks 4 conclude he informed on Manfredi, Johnson and Dunbar and beat him brutally, until he exposes Price and they are convinced. The Foucaulds sack the nanny over the postcards the man in the park handed the girls while she sat reading.

Both turn on one party puts another into a position that lowers them in the eyes of those watching, and they disagree about it. Omura sets his former pupil to holding a banner and handing out flyers for the Calorie Café — the same job the sacked Douryou took — which Okajima feels is beneath him and which distresses Sugako, until the teaching post from the Ministry arrives. Henrik publicly humiliates the mill owner Nordenson in church after Nordenson refuses to kneel with his wife and daughters, which disturbs the Forsboda villagers.

Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true. The woman Fred takes for a German princess is an adventuress; she sails for Rangoon with £1000 of his money before he learns what she was. Donald walks into Susan Orlean's office presenting himself as Charlie Kaufman and interviews her, and she answers him as the writer adapting her book.

Both turn on the deceived party finds the deception out. Master Wang discovers Crimson has been having an affair with an actor and goes into a drunken rage in her rooms. Marianne and David arrange to meet in Paris precisely so Markus need not be lied to, but Markus works out that they are having an affair and eventually discovers the two of them together.

Herzog revisits the apartment, locations and set footage of five films made with Kinski, recounting heated and sometimes violent altercations that kept recurring between them from Aguirre through Cobra Verde without ever being settled.

Both turn on one party holds another under a sustained look, and the watching stands in place of any exchange between them. With a killer at large in the city, the inspector taking John's report about his missing wife puts men on him instead. Qiang photographs the raid, keeps the frame of the girl watching it, blows it up into a wall-sized collage of her face in the flat he rents as a darkroom, and tells her he cannot stop.

Both turn on one party is denied the child it wants, and the party bound to them is caught in the lack. Natsue, the midwife Takako once taught alongside, has been left sterile by the bomb's aftereffects and is arranging with her husband to adopt. The gypsy woman's botched abortion of teenage Mary's pregnancy leaves her infertile, and in 1974 Tom lives inside her longing for the son they never had, which ends with her taking a stranger's baby from a supermarket as 'a gift from God'.

edges.b: portrait of a lady on fire
edges.bTitle: Portrait of a Lady on Fire

edges.a: once upon a time in the west
edges.aTitle: Once Upon a Time in the West

Sadazo, expecting to die in the Philippines, asks Matsuyama to carry his wife Tomoko's postcard back to her and say he received it before dying; after the war Matsuyama makes his way to Tomoko's house to discharge that errand.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back. Having reached the point where he knows more dead than living, Davenne consecrates the chapel to the whole cemetery and keeps a candle burning for every one of them. Marcus Aurelius' charge to restore the Roman Republic passes to Maximus, who carries it through the arena and, dying, asks for political reforms and Gracchus' reinstatement as senator.

Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Mulgarath appears in the house as the children's father Richard, and as an old man at the goblin campsite before that, until Jared's suspicion at his words makes him stab the false Richard and Hogsqueal eats the raven he turns into.

The farmers, with no claim on him, ask Kambei to defend their village for nothing but food, and he agrees after recognising their suffering, then recruits Gorobei, Shichirōji, Heihachi and Kyūzō to a burden that is not theirs. Man-seob takes the Gwangju fare only for the 100,000 won, then — after hearing the radio blame North Korean infiltrators — turns his taxi around at Suncheon and goes back to a city and a journalist he owes nothing to.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest. Anatole Kuragin courts Natasha and persuades her to elope while concealing that he is already secretly married — the fact Pierre uses to threaten him with exposure. Rosemary Scott arranges the passage out for McCain and Irene, is taken by Francesco's men for it, and kills herself before they can get his position out of her.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Wade brings a truckload of farmers who have already lost their own places to pull the levee apart for day money, and offers Tom's neighbours a bonus to cut it from the inside. Olèander, the Zufu police agent posing as Headhunter's daughter Emerah, learns during the escape from Zenigata that Headhunter has been using her to get at the key, and is then captured by Crisis.

edges.b: the bird with the crystal plumage

Ruth, whom Lang claims he met at Cambridge, was in fact tutored and recruited as a CIA agent by Professor Paul Emmett at Harvard, and steered a Prime Minister whose every decision benefited US interests until he was assassinated.

edges.a: where are you going on holiday
edges.aTitle: Where Are You Going on Holiday?

Mulgarath appears in the house as the children's father Richard, and as an old man at the goblin campsite before that, until Jared's suspicion at his words makes him stab the false Richard and Hogsqueal eats the raven he turns into.

Cui Mingliang pursues Yin Ruijuan, who answers noncommittally and then rejects him as incompatible; he pines for her through years of touring without contacting her, and only on his final return to Fenyang do they reconnect and marry.

Both turn on the deceived party finds the deception out. Charlotte finds Humbert's hidden diary and reads his desire for Dolores and his loathing of her, then runs out of the house distraught and is struck by a car. Caleb, who had begun to reciprocate Ava's professed romantic interest, is told by Nathan that she only pretended feelings for him, and it is confirmed when Ava walks past him, locks the glass door and ignores his pleas.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Irmgard talks Anzell into overcharging on the round and splitting it with her, knowing Hans follows his man through the courtyards, so that the one witness to her affair is sacked as a thief. Olèander, the Zufu police agent posing as Headhunter's daughter Emerah, learns during the escape from Zenigata that Headhunter has been using her to get at the key, and is then captured by Crisis.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Howie is what the failed harvest requires: he came freely, he carries the power of a king in the law, he is a virgin and he is the fool, and he is put in the wicker figure with the animals and burned. Gina secretly tapes her conversation with the unfocused elderly Albert to pin down his tentative agreement over the sandstone, and when she and Ryan come back to load the truck he watches from the window and will not return her wave.

edges.a: once upon a time in the west
edges.b: investigation of a citizen above suspicion
edges.aTitle: Once Upon a Time in the West
edges.bTitle: Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion

Frank leaves evidence at the McBain ranch pointing at Cheyenne, and Cheyenne spends the film as the wanted man whose bounty is finally bid as the price of the land. He plants clues that steer his own subordinates onto the murdered woman's husband and onto a student radical, and then clears them himself.

Keller fixes on Alex after the whispered line "They didn't cry 'til I left them," though Loki has established Alex's diminished IQ and clean RV, and Alex turns out to have been Holly's first abducted child.

After Chernobyl everything came back except culture, and William Shakespeare Junior is engaged by the Cannon Cultural Division and the Royal Library to recover his ancestor's lost works, which he starts hearing coming out of Learo's mouth in the restaurant.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Chan, having deduced that Lau was Hon's mole and sent him the CD of his meeting with Hon, is shot in the head by Inspector Big B on the rooftop as he holds Lau at gunpoint.

Marietta disdainfully refuses the Neapolitan soldier's invitation to a night meeting in the park and then sees him courting a Swedish nanny, after which she vanishes and her friends search the Muro Torto cliff for her body.

Both turn on one party presses another to hand over the account of themselves or of a past act that the other would rather keep, and they disagree about it. In her hospital room, Delmas keeps demanding of the hysterical Judith where Fèvre-Berthier is and how he died until she admits she found him dead on her sofa, then photographs her. The Fratellis pick Chunk up off the road, work on him in the restaurant until he tells them where the others went into the tunnel, and then go after them.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it. Judah takes it to his brother Jack, who finds the man and arranges it, so that Judah is only ever the one who made the phone call.

Both turn on a life or a freedom is settled with a payment, and they disagree about it. Chuck is left behind in Arnold's clutches as security for the debt after Wills's $12,000 check bounces, and is released only when Francis writes a second check. Moroni goes to pay the ransom for Stefania and is taken along with her, and the two of them are left in the shack to die.

Both turn on a person is judged by their parentage or rank rather than what they did, and they disagree about it. Pierre is snubbed by the Bezukhov relatives at his dying father's mansion as the count's illegitimate son, and their derision turns to hypocritical concern only when the will acknowledges him as legitimate and sole heir. Arrested at a table of common criminals, Onofrio tells the crowd that being noble entitles him to do as he pleases and that being poor they are worth nothing, and he refuses Piperno's wages on the grounds that a Jew killed Christ.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Dedic's plan has Mascha claim at Gestapo headquarters that Czaka was the man she saw fleeing Heydrich's killing, backed by a mass of false testimony, and Czaka is gunned down for a murder he did not commit. EVE blames WALL-E for the missing seedling and he is designated a rogue robot, until the two of them see GO-4 stowing the plant in a self-destructing escape pod.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Suryn takes an axe at night and kills the stablemen Kaziuk and Juraj, who have no part in the convent's possession, purely as the sacrifice he believes will free Mother Joan. Anders recruits Gregg, Agostino, Jean-Paul and Erich for the Rio diamond job while secretly partnered with Mary Ann, who swaps the diamonds for an empty case, so the four experts do the work and die for a purpose they were never told about.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. Rosemary Scott arranges the passage out for McCain and Irene, is taken by Francesco's men for it, and kills herself before they can get his position out of her. Charlie Schwartz climbs down into the ravine where the herd is bedded to bring back the glasses Dan dropped, and is trampled doing it.

edges.b: the plot of the fuma clan
edges.bTitle: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
edges.claim: Both turn on an outside party takes a person out of the keeping of those bound to them, who must get them back. Annabelle goes back aboard for her belongings just as Captain Anderson's Union spies steal The General, and she is carried north as their captive until Johnnie finds her at the officers' house and smuggles her into a boxcar. A second party of Fuma ninja take Murasaki out of her own wedding while the first party is fighting over the urn, and leave a note offering to trade her for it.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would., and they disagree about it. Johannes tells Morten that death is nearby and will take Inger unless he has faith; Morten refuses to listen and Inger dies suddenly, exactly as prophesied, and only after her death does the family credit Johannes enough to ask for her raising. Tadokoro tells the cabinet after Amagi that more eruptions and quakes are coming and is dismissed as an alarmist; the Tokyo earthquake follows and kills three million.

edges.a: the human condition ii road to eternity
edges.aTitle: The Human Condition II: Road to Eternity
edges.claim: Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. Leading his group of recruits, Kaji repeatedly takes onto himself the beatings the veteran artillerymen mete out for the slightest offence, so that his men are not the ones struck. Rosemary Scott arranges the passage out for McCain and Irene, is taken by Francesco's men for it, and kills herself before they can get his position out of her.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Dismounted Cossacks form lines at the top of the Odessa steps and advance on unarmed women and children, halting to fire volleys and ignoring their pleas, while cavalry cuts down the survivors at the bottom. Sweetie arrives back with Bob and takes the house over - Kay's clothes ruined, the furniture broken, everyone managed round her rages and then forgiven the next morning.

edges.a: the plot of the fuma clan
edges.aTitle: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
edges.claim: Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way., and they disagree about it. Inspector Kazami, who talks Zenigata out of the temple and back onto the case, has been the Fuma Boss's man the whole time, and Fujiko finds him standing in their ranks. Ruth, whom Lang claims he met at Cambridge, was in fact tutored and recruited as a CIA agent by Professor Paul Emmett at Harvard, and steered a Prime Minister whose every decision benefited US interests until he was assassinated.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. Cui's peasant cousin Sanming takes a poorly paid job in an unregulated coal mine so his sister Wenying can afford university, and sends her five yuan by Cui with word never to come back. The Gwangju taxi drivers throw their cars into the DSC pursuit and die so that Man-seob's taxi and Peter's film can get clear.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Because Sefton barters openly with the German guards and was away with the Russian women when the radio was confiscated, the men of Barracks 4 conclude he informed on Manfredi, Johnson and Dunbar and beat him brutally, until he exposes Price and they are convinced. Traver flees a lynch mob for a rape he did not commit, accused by a woman the Reverend knows to be a drunk who falsely accused a white man of the same thing two years earlier.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back, and they disagree about it. Finding Japanese corpses unburied along the road to Mudon, Mizushima keeps the stolen monk's robe and writes that he cannot go home until every fallen soldier is buried. Bernard cannot get free of Muriel, the girl he helped torture and murder during his service in Algeria, and writes in the journal Alphonse finds that since her death he is 'no longer alive'.

Both turn on two parties take each other up across a line their people hold as forbidden, and keep it out of sight of those who would move against them. In occupied Nevers the French woman loved a German soldier and planned to elope to Bavaria with him; he was shot while waiting for her on the day the town was liberated. Asked to cure the barrenness of King Rouma's wife, Nianankoro makes the enchantment and then sleeps with Attou, and the two go back that night to tell the king what they have done.

edges.a: zatoichi and the chest of gold
edges.aTitle: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold
edges.claim: Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. The village men accost Ichi and blame him for the theft of the tax gold, and later mob him again on his return to Itakura, though he had fought off the robbers atop the chest. Wendy takes the marks on Danny for Jack's doing, and Jack, having seen the woman in 237 and told Wendy he saw nothing, says the boy did it to himself.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. The convict Sauro recognises in the pizzeria shoots him, and after a few seconds of hesitation Barletta draws the pistol Sauro gave him and kills the man. The state does its killing with the same deliberateness the film gave the first one: the room, the straps, several men holding him down, and the drop.

Both turn on one who was once helped comes back to the one who helped them, and what they return — gratitude or violence — settles what the bond was.. Angela stops the train so the wounded Sergeant Jerry Jackson can be treated; he returns to thank her, keeps coming back for her, breaks out of the prison camp to reach her, and dies driving off a cliff with her body beside him. Hatidže instructs Sam in wild beekeeping and hands him bees to start his own colony, and what comes back is the destruction of her own hives and her livelihood.

Both turn on one party comes through and is left answerable to those it did not bring through with it, and they disagree about it. Shigematsu buries one hibakusha friend after another while watching his own wife and niece begin to go the same way, and stands in the road at the end waiting for a rainbow over the ambulance. Matsuyama comes home from the navy alive while Sadazo and Sanpei did not, is told by his own wife that she wishes he had died in the war, and stands before Tomoko as the man who survived to deliver her husband's postcard.

Both turn on what one party held back comes into the open between them and the person whose life it governed, and they disagree about it. Sadao consults his birth certificate while preparing his university application and learns that Chieko is not his mother but his father's second wife, forcing the years-long concealment into the open between them until he tearfully apologises and, after a second rupture, comes home. Julio tells Tenoch he slept with his girlfriend, Tenoch jealously answers that he slept with Julio's, and drunk at the village they admit it happened repeatedly rather than once; after the trip the two stop seeing each other.

Both turn on the penalty or cost owed for one party's act or settlement falls on someone else, while the one who owes it goes free.. Ming talks Liren into forging the contractor's weather-delay documents at the bar, and it is Liren who is fired for forgery while Ming returns to his office untouched. Lammark's superiors order the arrest of the cable-news caller over his objections, and when the shootout kills the caller's friends and maims Marquand the Bureau blames Lammark for the investigation's failures and fires him.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Red burns his own brig so no one can retreat, quietly has Boomako ready a boat for the throne alone, and rows away leaving the surviving crew in the water. Semyon rapes the trafficked fourteen-year-old Tatiana to demonstrate to Kirill how to 'break' her, then gives her pills to induce an abortion; she dies giving birth to his child.

Both turn on two parties press a whole claim on the same person, who can be neither shared nor divided, so going to one is the unmaking of the other., and they disagree about it. Jules marries Catherine but, fearing she will leave him forever, gives Jim his blessing to marry her so he can keep visiting the chalet and seeing her; the arrangement holds until Jim leaves for Paris and Catherine drives them both off the bridge. Ben and the insurance agent Hank both court Lou, and Ben leaves town at night partly so as not to incite Hank's jealousy over her.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest. Anne, who has been trailing Moreau to find her father, sends her mother out of the room and tells Moreau that she knows of the affair with Judith but her mother does not. After Tom asks Mary to 'teach' his brother Dick about sex, she denies to Tom that anything took place and insists the baby is his; the question of whose child it was is never cleared between them.

edges.a: a quiet place in the country
edges.aTitle: A Quiet Place in the Country
edges.claim: Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true. Mulgarath appears in the house as the children's father Richard, and as an old man at the goblin campsite before that, until Jared's suspicion at his words makes him stab the false Richard and Hogsqueal eats the raven he turns into.

Master Guan's troupe beats Douzi each time he says 'I am by nature a boy, not a girl' until he delivers the dan monologue correctly, and Dieyi lives the rest of his life inside Consort Yu, dying by her sword when the old slip returns in 1977.

Scottie sees Judy wearing the necklace from Carlotta's portrait, drives her back to San Juan Bautista and forces her up the tower until she admits Gavin paid her to impersonate his wife. Caleb, who had begun to reciprocate Ava's professed romantic interest, is told by Nathan that she only pretended feelings for him, and it is confirmed when Ava walks past him, locks the glass door and ignores his pleas.

Wen-ching, who has been deaf since he was a boy, is taken from the miners' hospital into a system running summary trials; he comes out once, delivers an executed cellmate's things to the widow, is taken again, and Hinomi can find no record of him anywhere in Taipei. A manipulatively edited video of Lydia's Juilliard masterclass goes viral, a New York Post piece accuses her of sexual predation and an unseen hand rewrites her Wikipedia page, and nothing she does — deposition, book tour, storming the stage — touches the account.

Sebastian's loneliness until he takes her in, and Roy uses him and his access to get to the top of the Tyrell pyramid; Sebastian is reported dead soon after. Clodio Pulcher, kept close as a nephew while Hamilton Crassus III's mind and health decline, works with Wow Platinum to manipulate the old man into handing over control of the Crassus bank; when Crassus learns of the duplicity he strokes out, then kills Wow with a hidden bow and arrow.

edges.a: jolanda the daughter of the black corsair
edges.aTitle: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair

Miller, who has hunted Traver with a rifle and tied him up to hand him to the mainland authorities, instead runs Jackson off the island and gives Traver his oars for crutches and carries his motor to the boat.

The official account of the night in Stammheim is that Baader, Ensslin and Raspe killed themselves, and the film keeps returning to people who cannot make it hold: Fassbinder with his mother, Biermann singing Girl in Stuttgart, Mahler in his cell.

edges.b: all the money in the world
edges.bTitle: All the Money in the World
edges.claim: Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it, and they disagree about it. Toni asks her lover Fred, a Party official and the one man in town who could act, to help the jailed aunt; he refuses, and then tells her the aunt died in the bombing of the prison. Gail travels to Getty's English estate to beg for the ransom for his own grandson and he refuses, saying paying would only invite more kidnappings of his family, sending Chace to investigate instead of money.

Beaten by her mother until she gives a name, Angela says Santiago Nasar, though the two were never seen together and she never alters a word of it in twenty-seven years.

Annabelle goes back aboard for her belongings just as Captain Anderson's Union spies steal The General, and she is carried north as their captive until Johnnie finds her at the officers' house and smuggles her into a boxcar. Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Camille recruits her boyfriend's friend's brother, also named Vincent, to arrive at the château posing as Simon Cinéma's missing great-grandson, coaching him with childhood details so he can fool the groundskeeper and the delusional old man into signing over the inheritance.

Headhunter holds Dr. Voltsky prisoner while telling his daughter Emerah that her father is dead, until Fujiko, planted as her secretary, helps her escape.

Eboshi beheads the Forest Spirit to secure Irontown's future, and its headless body floods and destroys the town while Moro's severed head bites off Eboshi's arm; she survives repentant and resolves to rebuild.

Anatole Kuragin courts Natasha and persuades her to elope while concealing that he is already secretly married — the fact Pierre uses to threaten him with exposure.

After Hye-young dies, Park Yi kills his entire gang and faces President Cho in a Mexican standoff in which both men shoot each other.

Zhang Jun pressures Zhong Ping into perming her hair and then, having got her pregnant, forces her into an abortion, after which she eventually cuts off contact with him and the troupe.

Robertson keeps coming back to it between songs: sixteen years on the road, the numbers start to scare you, and he could not live with twenty - which is what the concert is for. Beth drives an eight-hour round trip twice a week from Livingston to teach the Belfry night class on top of her real job, and eventually quits and is replaced by a permanent teacher.

Attilio shows Leonardo the small room with the one-way mirror where he and Wanda had sex while Wanda's mother watched from the other side.

Both turn on one party holds another under a sustained look, and the watching stands in place of any exchange between them. After Sankichi's killing, Gorosuke repents and begs Kamegoro — the boy's grandfather — for forgiveness before they bury the body at sea.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back. After Chernobyl everything came back except culture, and William Shakespeare Junior is engaged by the Cannon Cultural Division and the Royal Library to recover his ancestor's lost works, which he starts hearing coming out of Learo's mouth in the restaurant. Sadazo, expecting to die in the Philippines, asks Matsuyama to carry his wife Tomoko's postcard back to her and say he received it before dying; after the war Matsuyama makes his way to Tomoko's house to discharge that errand.

Toni asks her lover Fred, a Party official and the one man in town who could act, to help the jailed aunt; he refuses, and then tells her the aunt died in the bombing of the prison.

Finding Japanese corpses unburied along the road to Mudon, Mizushima keeps the stolen monk's robe and writes that he cannot go home until every fallen soldier is buried. Viktor's father died with 56 of the 57 autographs from the 'A Great Day in Harlem' photograph collected in the Planters peanut can, and Viktor came to New York solely to get Benny Golson's, which he finally obtains at the hotel.

edges.aTitle: Once Upon a Time in the West

Giorgio spends his days in conversation with Melampo and is otherwise indifferent to Liza, so she swims the dog out from the island until it drowns of exhaustion.

Grace sees Eddie kissing a blonde woman outside the bank, then follows his lie about a client dinner to the restaurant and catches him with her, and he denies the kiss to her face.

edges.bTitle: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
edges.claim: Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way., and they disagree about it. Inspector Kazami, who talks Zenigata out of the temple and back onto the case, has been the Fuma Boss's man the whole time, and Fujiko finds him standing in their ranks.

A manipulatively edited video of Lydia's Juilliard masterclass goes viral, a New York Post piece accuses her of sexual predation and an unseen hand rewrites her Wikipedia page, and nothing she does — deposition, book tour, storming the stage — touches the account.

edges.a: the human condition ii road to eternity
edges.aTitle: The Human Condition II: Road to Eternity
edges.claim: Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it, and they disagree about it. The Giant bids Hogarth farewell and flies up to collide with the nuclear missile Mansley launched at Rockwell, detonating it in the exosphere so the town's people are not destroyed, at apparent cost of himself.

edges.bTitle: Rolling Thunder Revue: A Bob Dylan Story by Martin Scorsese
edges.claim: Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Boxer Rubin 'Hurricane' Carter is wrongfully convicted of murder, and the tour's campaign — Dylan's unscheduled visit to record executives to rush out 'Hurricane', Congressman Tanner persuading President Carter to intervene — leads to the retrial and his release.

Dani, still grieving her sister's murder-suicide of their parents, stays attached to Christian, who had intended to break up with her and only reluctantly invites her to Sweden after an argument, then takes part in the sex ritual with Maja.

Both turn on one party obtains another's closeness or presence and pays for it with the means to live. Lulu lives as Dr Schön's kept mistress, was earlier kept by the old man Schigolch her 'first patron', and ends driven to prostitution in a London garret on Christmas Eve. The two Maries systematically trade their company for meals — flirting with a man to secure a free lunch and crying when he leaves, and Marie II sitting with the butterfly collector who declares his love while she only asks him for food.

Both turn on one party takes into its own house and keeping someone with no claim to be there. Larry keeps his brother Arthur, who sleeps on the couch draining his sebaceous cyst and filling the 'Mentaculus', consoles him over the gambling and sodomy charges, and is left with the $3,000 bill from Arthur's lawyer. The Kazamas, who had just lost their own newborn, take in the infant Shun when Yūichirō arrives one evening with him, after Ryoko—already pregnant with Umi—cannot raise him and his other relatives are killed in the bombing of Nagasaki.

Both turn on one party names another's concealed life or wrong in front of those who did not know of it. Sue confronts Billy in front of his family and professes her love, and his wife Doris repeatedly slaps her.

Both turn on one person is bound to two parties at once and cannot answer one without wounding the other.. Ming presses Qiqi to take the PR job his aunt arranged and leave Molly, then outside his office demands she choose between him and Molly, while Qiqi is unwilling to give up the friendship — she ends by returning to Molly at the empty company and reconciling.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Sensing Chantal is suicidal, the priest follows Torcy's counsel to project strength and intimidates her into surrendering her suicide note, leaving her terrified and resolved to ruin him. Keller Dover kidnaps Alex Jones, chains him in an empty building he owns and tortures him for days to make him give up where the girls are, getting only cryptic talk about a maze.

Clan Elder Suminawa will not give up the urn for his granddaughter's life, because it holds the way to the family treasure, so Lupin steals it off him and makes the trade himself.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. The convict Sauro recognises in the pizzeria shoots him, and after a few seconds of hesitation Barletta draws the pistol Sauro gave him and kills the man.

The FBI under Coutelle fixes Leo Fast Elk's murder on ARM leader Jimmy Looks Twice, until Walter Crow Horse's evidence that the killer was heavier and drove Leo's car leads Ray to the real killer, Richard Yellow Hawk.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. Gupta runs onto the tarmac in front of Viktor's plane and is taken into custody — accepting deportation to India — so that Viktor does not have to leave the airport under Dixon's threat. Neteyam goes back to pull Lo'ak, Tsireya and Spider out of the sinking RDA ship and is fatally shot during their escape.

Shipped home by pitying sailors from Marseille and delirious through London, Roddy finds his way back to the father who had thrown him over, and is joyfully taken back. The old man Corinne fled from at the bus stop turns out to be Honey and Heidi's estranged father, who approaches Honey wanting to reconnect and offers what he saw of Corinne as his opening.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it. Schigolch persuades the reluctant Countess Geschwitz, infatuated with Lulu, to lure Quast into a stateroom and kill him, while Lulu and Schigolch keep clear. Carl-Magnus does not confront Frederich; he sends his wife Charlotte to call on Anne Egerman and put the affair in front of her.

Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true. Claire is put into the dead prostitute's part as the widow of Captain Ambrose Allen and has to keep the grief up in front of a sheriff's posse, a minister who knew him, and finally his old fort. Marcos poses as a police officer to lift Juan from the convenience store, and the whole scheme runs on Vidal playing a deported Spanish collector, Berta a widow selling her husband's stamps, and Sandler an old associate.

Both turn on whom a person is bound to is settled by parties outside the bond for ends of their own, and the one bound must go on living inside it.. Otome asks Kihachi to talk Jiro into marrying Harue, and Kihachi — stung that nobody considers him a match himself — puts it to Jiro, who gruffly rejects it. Molly tells Ming over lunch that her sister was the one betrothed to Akeem but fell in love with the author, so Akeem's father picked Molly as the replacement bride, and she is still living inside that engagement while Akeem keeps funding her company hoping love will follow.

Both turn on one party takes what they saw for something it was not, while another holds the sense of it, and they disagree about it. When Mizushima makes a white flag intending to ask the British for more time, the holdout soldiers take it for him surrendering on their behalf and beat him unconscious, leaving him on the cave floor. Seeing Giuseppe climbing the mountain flanked by the Italian police and the French Gendarmerie, Ferdinand takes it for betrayal and shoots, the bullet stopped by a bottle of smuggled liquor under Giuseppe's clothes.

edges.a: the battle of the river plate
edges.aTitle: The Battle of the River Plate
edges.claim: Both turn on one party arranges what others are living through from a position they cannot see, turning their need and their movements to an end that is not theirs.. The British, knowing their heavy ships are far off, lobby Uruguay to extend Graf Spee's stay in Montevideo while local media report battleships and carriers massing outside; Langsdorff, seeing only the trap he is meant to see, sails out with a skeleton crew and scuttles his ship. Larry pushes Akeem to hand Molly the entertainment company precisely so that its failure will let Akeem reclaim it and her, then audits it, feeds Akeem's jealousy and offers to identify her lover, while Molly runs the company never knowing her situation is being arranged.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. The Foucaulds sack the nanny over the postcards the man in the park handed the girls while she sat reading. District Attorney Cicero prosecuted Cesar for his wife's murder and later admits, as blackmail material offered at the Megalopolis site, that he knew all along she had taken her own life and prosecuted maliciously anyway.

Both turn on one party fixes an identity on another and deals with them by it rather than by what they are. A Turkish man is taken outside the Schleyer memorial for carrying a rifle, and at the French crossing a couple's papers are gone through because the guard thinks the woman looks like one of the wanted. Every family that comes to look at Yasuko withdraws the moment they hear she was in Hiroshima that morning, on the grounds that she may sicken or bear sick children, and no certificate of her health makes any difference.

Both turn on one party names another's concealed life or wrong in front of those who did not know of it. Maria's fruit-seller fiancé René walks into her hovel as her American client is leaving with her crucifix, and the American calls out 'Goodbye, Betty!' — naming her casino bar-prostitute life in front of him. Sue confronts Billy in front of his family and professes her love, and his wife Doris repeatedly slaps her.

Both turn on parties bound to each other by service, alliance or company come to act against each other. Ben denounces the family in front of the Indians and offers them the coffin money, and Nat and Jeff shoot each other over it in the crossfire. Coleman and Simon greet each other as old friends at the closed nightclub, with Coleman at the piano, and the film ends with Coleman shooting him on the pavement outside the hotel.

Officer Gary Hunt hears the whole thing out and tells Leigh that watching a woman through a telescope and telephoning her is not a crime he can act on.

Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it. Toni asks her lover Fred, a Party official and the one man in town who could act, to help the jailed aunt; he refuses, and then tells her the aunt died in the bombing of the prison. The town official warns her again and again what the law will do, and when it comes to it he stands away from her - and is still living in the village when her son and grandson come looking.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Because Sefton barters openly with the German guards and was away with the Russian women when the radio was confiscated, the men of Barracks 4 conclude he informed on Manfredi, Johnson and Dunbar and beat him brutally, until he exposes Price and they are convinced. Gruneman walked in on Cable beating Jane McKenna, so Cable wrote to Bree in Gruneman's name and left the letter in his office to make him the man in the black book.

Both turn on one party takes another up while they serve its purpose and drops them, with no cause given, once they do not. Liliana lets Checco break from his troupe and rehearse a whole new show built around her, then arrives at rehearsal to say she has signed with a competitor, and Checco collapses. The Thalmanns take her up at the funeral and want her husband as a victim of capitalism for the election, and when she wants something done the anarchists take her on to the hostage-taking she stands horrified in the middle of.

Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it. Her son and daughter-in-law go on holiday days after the killing and come back to announce they are moving out; Corinna tells her to keep away from the communists and then leaves too. The town official warns her again and again what the law will do, and when it comes to it he stands away from her - and is still living in the village when her son and grandson come looking.

Both turn on one party takes up someone others have written off and treats them as worth something. Charley Dolan, an ex-alcoholic, takes in the fired, gutter-drunk Lew Marsh, gives him a room in his apartment and finds him work on a construction crew, and Lew stays sober and is restored to the newspaper. The real Makhmalbaf meets him at the prison gate and gives him a lift to the Ahankhahs' door, where the father says he hopes the man will be good now and make them proud of him.
