The court presses Joan to say something that would disown her God-given mission to drive the English from France, and she holds to it through interrogation, and after signing recants the confession as unfaithfulness to God. Kawano has broken with the leading Japanese trading house he was an executive of because he cannot square its logging and land practices in Tasmania with himself, and now campaigns against them.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Because Sefton barters openly with the German guards and was away with the Russian women when the radio was confiscated, the men of Barracks 4 conclude he informed on Manfredi, Johnson and Dunbar and beat him brutally, until he exposes Price and they are convinced. After Macduff discovers Duncan's body, Macbeth summarily executes the drugged servants, presenting it as just punishment for a betrayal they did not commit.

Both turn on one party covers what another did so that the other never has to answer for it. Sakichi hides the burglar Genshichi from the officers pursuing him, and later denies to Manabe that he knows where his thieving brother Ishimatsu is. Luciano trades wartime services to military intelligence for Dewey's commutation and deportation, and when Siragusa says the commutation was bought his own superiors order the investigation stopped.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Beaten by her mother until she gives a name, Angela says Santiago Nasar, though the two were never seen together and she never alters a word of it in twenty-seven years. Stopped by the fundamentalist police for wearing makeup, Marji points to a man who had been ogling her and claims he made indecent comments, and her grandmother rebukes her for it.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Lt. Zuenon arrests Mason for Callahan's murder on the strength of the bar quarrel and Callahan's jealousy over Mason's pre-marriage relationship with Stella, until Ranier's account frees him. Stopped by the fundamentalist police for wearing makeup, Marji points to a man who had been ogling her and claims he made indecent comments, and her grandmother rebukes her for it.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Buzz's gang become convinced Jim informed on them about the chickie-run death, steal Plato's address book and hunt Jim down, though Jim's attempt to confess had been turned away at the police station. Stopped by the fundamentalist police for wearing makeup, Marji points to a man who had been ogling her and claims he made indecent comments, and her grandmother rebukes her for it.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Hachizo and Gorosuke lure Sankichi with the promise of food and kill him with an axe in order to eat him, the boy never told what he is being brought for. With the Sleep Center now running further experiments off her case, Kathy volunteers as Michael's subject and he forgets to give her the drug the protocol calls for.

Both turn on one party is passed over by someone whose regard they held, in favour of another that person prefers. Halley turns Cliff down gently and goes to London, and comes back engaged to Lester, who had sent her white roses round the clock for days. Judith tells Larry she has fallen in love with the widower Sy Ableman and needs a get, then empties their bank accounts and leaves him penniless.

edges.a: the bird with the crystal plumage
edges.aTitle: The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
edges.claim: Both turn on one party covers what another did so that the other never has to answer for it, and they disagree about it. Alberto covers his wife's killings, commits some of them himself, and as he falls from the window confesses to the whole series. Sydney arrives at the motel where John and Clementine are holding a beaten tourist hostage over an unpaid trick, talks them into fleeing on a honeymoon, and stays behind to clear the evidence from the room.

Both turn on whom a person is bound to is settled by parties outside the bond for ends of their own, and the one bound must go on living inside it., and they disagree about it. Ogin accepts Shintaro of the Mozuya family because her mother warns that refusing would bring consequences on her father Rikyū and Ukon shows no opposition, and two years on Shintaro reproaches her for still loving Ukon while refusing him. Clarisse is to be married to the Count who rules in her name, because the wedding fixes his regency and puts her ancestral ring beside his over the treasure; she is drugged for the ceremony.

edges.a: let s hope it s a girl
edges.claim: Both turn on one party gives a dependent it was bound to keep out of its own hands into someone else's. Elena and Nardoni get Uncle Gugo into the retirement home where Nardoni's mother lives by trickery, and he walks out of it one night and comes home. Ryōta and Midori permanently exchange Keita, the son they raised for six years, into the Saiki household after first offending the Saikis by proposing to buy both boys.

Both turn on one party comes asking something of another who is free to answer it, and is turned away. With the wrong child taken, Gondō announces he will not pay the ransom for his chauffeur's son, and only relents after the chauffeur's continuous pleading and his wife's pressure. Grace goes to her father Wyly for support after leaving Eddie, and he gives her none, his attention fixed entirely on the upcoming show jumping competition.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it. Caligari sends the somnambulist Cesare out at night to stab the town clerk and Alan in their beds while Caligari keeps a dummy in the box to appear innocent. Ari's unit stands in 'the second or third ring' lighting the sky for the Israeli-allied Phalange who do the killing, and Ari concludes he felt as responsible as the men who carried it out.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Silvestri's sex-maniac theory sends every man at the salon into custody and prompts Marco to accuse the designer Cesare, while Cristiana kills a fifth model and strews the mask, hat and coat around her bathroom to pass her off as the killer. District Attorney Cicero prosecuted Cesar for his wife's murder and later admits, as blackmail material offered at the Megalopolis site, that he knew all along she had taken her own life and prosecuted maliciously anyway.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Dismounted Cossacks form lines at the top of the Odessa steps and advance on unarmed women and children, halting to fire volleys and ignoring their pleas, while cavalry cuts down the survivors at the bottom. David's moods set the terms of the affair, and when Karin turns up having drunk and still smoking against what they agreed, he hits her.

Both turn on one party brings a grievance upward and the party above treats it as an offence to be put down. Okajima goes to the boss to protest Yamada's dismissal for having two clients die after signing policies; the boss takes offence, the two scuffle, and Okajima is fired and bows on his way out. When Aloysius takes her suspicions about Donald to Flynn and to the boy's mother, Flynn charges her with insubordination and acting outside her duties and threatens to have her removed from her position as principal if she does not back down.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. Jiro borrows from the barber to pay Tomio's doctor's bill and plans to work as a labourer in Hokkaido to repay it, so Kihachi knocks him unconscious to make him miss the ship and sails for Hokkaido in his place — then jumps overboard and swims home. Father Suryn takes Mother Joan's eight demons into himself through his love for her and then damns himself by doing Satan's bidding so that she may be saved.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would.. Tadokoro tells the cabinet after Amagi that more eruptions and quakes are coming and is dismissed as an alarmist; the Tokyo earthquake follows and kills three million. Karski had himself taken into the Warsaw ghetto to see it, and then travelled on false papers to England to get the Allied governments to act on what he had seen.

edges.a: jolanda the daughter of the black corsair
edges.aTitle: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair
edges.claim: Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Captured at the ambush, Jolanda is tortured for the location of the Ventimiglia treasure and does not reveal it. Sent by Otto to lie with the maid who is a witch in the best sense, Alexander tells Maria about his mother's garden, and when she is bewildered by his advances he puts Victor's pistol to his own temple and says do not kill us.

Both turn on one party fashions another into what it requires and holds them to that shape. After meeting Judy on the street, Scottie makes her change her clothes and dye her hair until she is 'Madeleine' again, and holds her to that shape. Lord Summerisle's grandfather bred fruit trees for the Scottish climate and gave the Christian islanders the old gods to go with them, so that the ministers left and the island now owes its gods a body when the crop fails.

Both turn on two parties with no claim on each other, each holding the same loss or damage, become each other's only people, and they disagree about it. The unemployed Tramp and Ellen, an orphaned street urchin caught stealing bread, have no claim on each other but end up sharing a run-down shack, finding each other jobs, and walking down the road together at dawn. Jim, Judy and Plato — each with a home that has failed them — take refuge in the deserted mansion and act out a fantasy of being a family, until the police shoot Plato dead outside the observatory.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. The detective who handled the hijacking harasses Makoto over a neighbourhood woman's murder without evidence and later arrests and questions him over a second killing, while the murderer is in fact Naoki. After Macduff discovers Duncan's body, Macbeth summarily executes the drugged servants, presenting it as just punishment for a betrayal they did not commit.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. After Hye-young dies, Park Yi kills his entire gang and faces President Cho in a Mexican standoff in which both men shoot each other. Grief-stricken at his family's slaughter, Macduff vows revenge, marches on Dunsinane with Malcolm's English-backed army, declares himself untimely ripped from his mother's body, and beheads Macbeth.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Everyone who works out what Damien is dies within the scene: Bugenhagen and Morgan under the ruins, Joan Hart blinded by the raven and run down, the doctor who finds jackal marrow under a falling elevator cable, Warren under a locomotive. Deputy sheriff Casey, Teddy's childhood babysitter, comes to the house searching for Michelle, is knocked out and chained in the basement, and when he hears Don's gunshot Teddy beats him to death with a shovel.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. The kidnapper supplies his two accomplices, who could identify him, with uncut heroin and they are found dead of overdose in the hideout where Shin'ichi was held. The midwife commandeers the schoolteacher's bicycle to ride to the police, saying her son has told her who attacked him, and neither she nor the boy is ever seen again.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. A billion lire is on the table for the building if it is empty, so Amedeo and Ofelia set about the remaining tenants one by one until the last of them is out - and then the lawyer tears up the cheques because Wanda has moved back in. Sent by Otto to lie with the maid who is a witch in the best sense, Alexander tells Maria about his mother's garden, and when she is bewildered by his advances he puts Victor's pistol to his own temple and says do not kill us.

Both turn on one party holds a bond in place by keeping from the person closest to them something that would change what the bond is.. David told Karin his family were all killed in the camps; at his London address she is met by his sister Sara, who says he will never leave her. In the Rigoletto episode a producer installs himself at the Madonna Inn with a starlet without knowing that his wife is in another room of the same motel with a man of her own.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Anselmo, at Paul Zapatti's behest, plants money to incriminate the dead Detective Eddie Santos and pressures Internal Affairs to portray the decorated cop as dirty, while Cogan and Calhoun work to clear him. Stopped by the fundamentalist police for wearing makeup, Marji points to a man who had been ogling her and claims he made indecent comments, and her grandmother rebukes her for it.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it. Schigolch persuades the reluctant Countess Geschwitz, infatuated with Lulu, to lure Quast into a stateroom and kill him, while Lulu and Schigolch keep clear. Lady Macbeth, knowing the witches' prophecies, talks her hesitating husband into the regicide and drugs Duncan's servants, but it is Macbeth who holds the knife.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Silvestri's sex-maniac theory sends every man at the salon into custody and prompts Marco to accuse the designer Cesare, while Cristiana kills a fifth model and strews the mask, hat and coat around her bathroom to pass her off as the killer. The Shanghai gang settle the quarrel over Red Monkey's money by using their mainland connections to have the Lin brothers denounced as Japanese collaborators; Wen-liang comes out of the cells with his brain damaged.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it, and they disagree about it. When Hanshirō's clan was abolished in 1619 and he planned to die alongside his lord, his closest friend died in his place, leaving Hanshirō alive and responsible for the friend's teenage son Motome. With the jets over the house and the broadcast running, Alexander promises God he will give up everything he has and loves, his son included, if the day can be taken back, and in the morning he burns the house to the ground to keep the bargain.

Both turn on a third party stands between two who would join and keeps them apart. Mrs. Morrow's agency warns the adoption cannot proceed while Brad investigates, then takes Danny in to protect him from Brad, and a probation officer stops Brad when he rushes to retrieve the boy. Anna's letter from Switzerland asking Henrik to resume the relationship is intercepted by her parents — Johan opens it and Karin reads and burns it — and only after Johan's death does Karin confess, whereupon Anna goes to Henrik and marries him.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Embittered by Bob's rejection, Syndrome builds a fortune on fake superpowers, kills off retired supers by testing the Omnidroid on them, lures Bob to Nomanisan, shoots down the plane carrying his children and finally tries to steal Jack-Jack. After Hye-young dies, Park Yi kills his entire gang and faces President Cho in a Mexican standoff in which both men shoot each other.

Both turn on one party is passed over by someone whose regard they held, in favour of another that person prefers. Johannes courts the Count's daughter Gerda and then turns to her stepmother Helga once he learns Devil's Field will go to Helga, leaving Gerda to get engaged to Baron von Lellewel out of spite. Amelia gets Viktor his one-day emergency visa through her married government boyfriend and tells him in the same breath that she has rekindled that relationship.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Stopped by the fundamentalist police for wearing makeup, Marji points to a man who had been ogling her and claims he made indecent comments, and her grandmother rebukes her for it. District Attorney Cicero prosecuted Cesar for his wife's murder and later admits, as blackmail material offered at the Megalopolis site, that he knew all along she had taken her own life and prosecuted maliciously anyway.

Both turn on one party holds another under a sustained look, and the watching stands in place of any exchange between them. The administration reviews a list of code-named agents planted among the workers, and the spy 'Owl' photographs a strike leader taking the posted rejection letter with a camera hidden in a pocket watch, after which the leader is beaten and captured. The commissaire has Jef followed, bugs his room while he is out and puts dozens of plainclothes men on him through the Metro; the police never speak to him again, they only look.

Both turn on the deceived party finds the deception out. Alphonse presents Françoise to Hélène as his niece when she is his young lover, and the whole footing of the reunion collapses when his brother-in-law Ernest arrives demanding he return to his wife, shocking Hélène. Marion catches Ken in his affair and leaves the marriage she had already recognised as unfulfilling.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them, and they disagree about it. Miller takes a rifle into the woods after Traver, shoots four holes in his boat and fires on him crossing the swamp, and later Jackson sets out to kill him, while Traver survives on foot until he is caught in an animal trap. Soma is told in a vision that his son will be the death of him and sets out to kill him first, following him across the country with a pylon that tracks him and goes through every barrier put in its way.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them. Miller takes a rifle into the woods after Traver, shoots four holes in his boat and fires on him crossing the swamp, and later Jackson sets out to kill him, while Traver survives on foot until he is caught in an animal trap. Colonel Mathieu's paratroopers work through the FLN network by assassination and capture until they corner Ali la Pointe in his Casbah hideout and tell him he is surrounded and the organization is finished.

Both turn on one party moves against the one placed above it and set over what it was to become, and they disagree about it. Don Alfonso takes the Neptune the moment Captain Linares dies, and Red and Frog work the crew up against him until the open rebellion carries the ship. Told by Marcus Aurelius that he is unfit to rule and that Maximus will succeed as regent, Commodus secretly assassinates his father and proclaims himself emperor.

Both turn on the penalty or cost owed for one party's act or settlement falls on someone else, while the one who owes it goes free.. After the liberation of Sicily the same boss who forced him into the party is sitting with an American officer while former Fascists call themselves anti-Fascists, and he sacks Piscitello for that party membership. Xiao Ji straps a fake bomb to Bin Bin's chest and drives him to the China Construction Bank, then flees on his motorbike to locations unknown while Bin Bin is arrested and told robbery is a capital crime.

edges.aTitle: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair

Captured at the ambush, Jolanda is tortured for the location of the Ventimiglia treasure and does not reveal it. A billion lire is on the table for the building if it is empty, so Amedeo and Ofelia set about the remaining tenants one by one until the last of them is out - and then the lawyer tears up the cheques because Wanda has moved back in.

Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand., and they disagree about it. Watts lets Dan go with a promise to cut his throat if he speaks, and Dan says nothing about the men trailing the herd until they are already in the camp. From his signal tower Maloin sees one man knocked into the water at the quayside and the other flee, then climbs down, takes the briefcase of English banknotes and tells no one — not Morrison when questioned during his shift, not his family — until he finally brings the case to the tavern and confesses.

edges.b: the human condition ii road to eternity
edges.bTitle: The Human Condition II: Road to Eternity
edges.claim: Both turn on one party comes asking something of another who is free to answer it, and is turned away, and they disagree about it. Senor Ortega, whose brother had hidden the crucifix from the Japanese, begs Mason at the church steps to give the cross back and Mason wrests it from him instead — only handing it to Manuelo after Ortega is killed. Kaji demands that his superiors discipline Yoshida for driving Obara to suicide, and Yoshida goes unpunished.

Both turn on one party keeps attendance on another who can no longer answer or meet them, and goes on addressing them anyway. Ivan goes on addressing the drowned Marichka for years, hallucinating her spirit in the water and among the trees, until her colourless shade touches his outstretched hand and he screams and dies. Matsumoto takes the semi-catatonic Sawako out of the hospital and walks her through the seasons tied to him by a red rope, keeping her company though she cannot answer him.

Both turn on one party puts another into a position that lowers them in the eyes of those watching, and they disagree about it. In La parolaccia the successful author tells the struggling first-novelist to write out his most depraved fantasies, then humiliates him in front of the assembled literary society when he presents the result. The night porter Jim sells tickets to the ward to see the Elephant Man, Mothershead says the high-society visitors are another kind of show, and the crowd at Liverpool Street corners him and pulls the hood off.

Both turn on parties bound to each other by service, alliance or company come to act against each other. After evading the police roadblock Erich murders his own crewmate Jean-Paul for the diamond case, and is then intercepted and murdered in turn by Milford at the meeting point. Ben denounces the family in front of the Indians and offers them the coffin money, and Nat and Jeff shoot each other over it in the crossfire.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. The Shanghai gang settle the quarrel over Red Monkey's money by using their mainland connections to have the Lin brothers denounced as Japanese collaborators; Wen-liang comes out of the cells with his brain damaged. Stopped by the fundamentalist police for wearing makeup, Marji points to a man who had been ogling her and claims he made indecent comments, and her grandmother rebukes her for it.

Both turn on one party keeps giving to a bond the other will not return, and no reason is given that the giving can work on.. Kihachi begins grooming himself so Harue will notice him, and she tells him plainly she thinks of him as nothing more than a kind uncle. Jules stays with Catherine through the affairs she uses to torment and punish him and through the six months she left him and Sabine, and holds the marriage in place by offering her to Jim.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Chantal, having overheard the priest's talk with her mother, tells the Count that the priest drove the Countess to despair, and the priest will not clear himself with the Countess' letter of thanks before the church investigator. After Macduff discovers Duncan's body, Macbeth summarily executes the drugged servants, presenting it as just punishment for a betrayal they did not commit.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. David's moods set the terms of the affair, and when Karin turns up having drunk and still smoking against what they agreed, he hits her. After the fundamentalists win the elections Marji lives under compulsory headscarves, black-market music, fined for holding Reza's hand, and a party raid in which the women are detained and Nima falls to his death fleeing across the rooftops.

Both turn on whom a person is bound to is settled by parties outside the bond for ends of their own, and the one bound must go on living inside it.. Tohata offers Kayama a Y600,000 dowry to take Taeko off his hands and spare him disgrace, Ono brokers the deal, and Akama counters with Y1,000,000 for Kayama not to marry her — none of it settled with Taeko, who bolts. Angela tells her parents she does not love Bayardo San Roman and her mother answers that love can be learned; the family marries her off with a lavish party and he brings her back to the door the same night.

Both turn on every account of the same event flatters its teller. Tajōmaru, the wife, the dead samurai through a medium, and finally the woodcutter each give an account of the same killing in which their own conduct is least shameful — an honourable duel, a faint with a dagger, a suicide, a clumsy fight — and the woodcutter's own version is compromised by his theft of the dagger. Paid to make a life of Lester, Cliff cuts him against Mussolini on the balcony, against himself shouting at his staff and making a pass at a young actress, and screens it to the man's face.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it, and they disagree about it. Father Suryn takes Mother Joan's eight demons into himself through his love for her and then damns himself by doing Satan's bidding so that she may be saved. Schindler spends his entire fortune over seven months on bribes and on shell casings bought from other companies, and is broke by the German surrender in 1945, so that his workers survive.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own, and they disagree about it. Major Kopp brings another soldier and forces Mariu's door, and the women carry out porcelain, rugs and clocks to the value of the money while Mariu stands there and hardly protests. Debora took them for the cocaine money in Rio, and when Pixote finds her at the club the argument ends with a knife in her.

edges.a: the human condition ii road to eternity
edges.aTitle: The Human Condition II: Road to Eternity
edges.claim: Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it, and they disagree about it. Leading his group of recruits, Kaji repeatedly takes onto himself the beatings the veteran artillerymen mete out for the slightest offence, so that his men are not the ones struck. Rowdy, going in for surgery on a burst vessel in his brain, asks Cole to drive his car at Daytona so that his sponsor will pay out his year.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Siragusa turns Giannini, leaves him a year in an Italian jail on the counterfeit charge when he fails to produce, and then sends him back to the United States to testify. Inside FEBEM the boys are the pieces the guards and their commander play with, and what they are used for is never anything of theirs.

Both turn on a child is claimed at once by those who bore them and those who keep them, and where the child belongs is settled between the adults., and they disagree about it. Aleksei tells Natalia that Ignat has said he wants to live with him; put the question in front of the boy, Ignat says he never said it. After the hospital reveals Keita and Ryūsei were switched at birth, the Nonomiyas and the Saikis meet, share photos and negotiate between themselves whether to keep the boys they raised or take back their biological sons.

Both turn on one party holds a bond in place by keeping from the person closest to them something that would change what the bond is.. In the Rigoletto episode a producer installs himself at the Madonna Inn with a starlet without knowing that his wife is in another room of the same motel with a man of her own. Kay digs up the sapling Louis plants in the yard and hides it because of what the fortune teller's words have made her fear, and says nothing to him about having done it.

Both turn on one party brings a grievance upward and the party above treats it as an offence to be put down, and they disagree about it. The crew complains that the ship's meat is maggot-infested and refuses the borscht; Dr Smirnov declares it edible, Giliarovsky drives them off, and all who refused are judged guilty of insubordination and brought to the fore-deck to be shot under a canvas. Marji is expelled after rebutting her teacher's lies about government abuses, and her speech to the university forum challenging its sexist double standard changes nothing.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. After Jagga's four-day kidnapping people suspect Leela of adultery and Raghunath throws her out of the house, rejecting her plea that the child she carries is his; she gives birth to Raj on the streets. Silvestri's sex-maniac theory sends every man at the salon into custody and prompts Marco to accuse the designer Cesare, while Cristiana kills a fifth model and strews the mask, hat and coat around her bathroom to pass her off as the killer.

Gugo walks back to the villa that evening and sits through the whole search for the two runaway girls without mentioning that he watched the Mustang go over the edge.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. In Lo sport the bullying office manager, having lost a bet, puts his wife out on the street to settle it, and an employee who finds out uses the fact as a hold over him. Greenhill reveals in the empty courtroom that he had been scouting Jennifer Haines long before he killed his wife Rita, selecting her as his defence attorney for a plan she was never made party to.

Both turn on one party takes another up while they serve its purpose and drops them, with no cause given, once they do not. Once Gelsomina's madness after Il Matto's death makes her useless for drawing a crowd, Zampanò leaves her asleep by the roadside with some clothes, some money and his trumpet, and drives on. St. Joseph's scout recruits Arthur Agee out of West Garfield Park, then at the end of freshman year he is put out of the school because his family cannot pay tuition, while Gates's fees are covered by his Encyclopedia Britannica sponsor; Agee's confidence collapses and he finishes at John Marshall.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest. Maloin hides the £55,000 from Camélia and Henriette, turns brusque at dinner, drags Henriette out of the butcher's job and buys her an expensive mink stole, while Camélia can only ask uncomprehendingly why he has ruined the girl's prospects and spent their savings. Calum keeps his depression and turmoil from 11-year-old Sophie behind a facade of contentment — hiding his smoking, practising tai chi and reading self-help books alone, sobbing in the hotel room after the birthday song while she sleeps unaware.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest, and they disagree about it. Maloin hides the £55,000 from Camélia and Henriette, turns brusque at dinner, drags Henriette out of the butcher's job and buys her an expensive mink stole, while Camélia can only ask uncomprehendingly why he has ruined the girl's prospects and spent their savings. Faye hides her ongoing affair with the producer Cook from BV even while the three travel together in Mexico, and only admits it when BV, seeing her crying and acting strangely, asks point blank whether she slept with him.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. When Hanshirō's clan was abolished in 1619 and he planned to die alongside his lord, his closest friend died in his place, leaving Hanshirō alive and responsible for the friend's teenage son Motome. Douzi takes the troupe's beating in Shitou's place as a boy, and as Dieyi sings for the Japanese to get Xiaolou released from arrest, which afterwards leaves him charged with treason by the Kuomintang.

Both turn on two parties are closed in with each other and neither can leave. Kamegoro, his grandson and the two crewmen are closed in aboard a ship that has lost all navigation and drifts for weeks, until a ship blown off course by a typhoon finds them. Deputy sheriff Casey, Teddy's childhood babysitter, comes to the house searching for Michelle, is knocked out and chained in the basement, and when he hears Don's gunshot Teddy beats him to death with a shovel.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. With the Sleep Center now running further experiments off her case, Kathy volunteers as Michael's subject and he forgets to give her the drug the protocol calls for. Greenhill reveals in the empty courtroom that he had been scouting Jennifer Haines long before he killed his wife Rita, selecting her as his defence attorney for a plan she was never made party to.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them. Ellen first appears fleeing police over the stolen bread, escapes the crashed paddy wagon with the Tramp, and at the café the police arrive to arrest her for that escape, sending the two of them running again. Recombinant Quaritch hunts Jake Sully across Pandora, forcing him to abandon the Omatikaya for the Metkayina reefs, until Quaritch tracks Norm and Max's aircraft to the archipelago and Jake resolves he can no longer keep running.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Sophie is at the telescope in Leigh's flat, in radio contact with her, when she is attacked, and the police close it by finding she had a flight booked to Fort Worth. Deputy sheriff Casey, Teddy's childhood babysitter, comes to the house searching for Michelle, is knocked out and chained in the basement, and when he hears Don's gunshot Teddy beats him to death with a shovel.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Sent by Otto to lie with the maid who is a witch in the best sense, Alexander tells Maria about his mother's garden, and when she is bewildered by his advances he puts Victor's pistol to his own temple and says do not kill us. Keller Dover kidnaps Alex Jones, chains him in an empty building he owns and tortures him for days to make him give up where the girls are, getting only cryptic talk about a maze.

Both turn on one person is bound to two parties at once and cannot answer one without wounding the other., and they disagree about it. On the night of her Monte Carlo comeback Vicky must choose between Julian, who has abandoned his own opera premiere and demands she leave with him at once, and Lermontov's claim on her as a dancer; she chooses the company, then runs from the theatre in the red shoes and throws herself under a train. San, raised by Moro among the wolves and unable to forgive humanity, admits she loves Ashitaka but stays in the forest while he remains to rebuild Irontown, the two promising to meet as often as they can.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it, and they disagree about it. David's moods set the terms of the affair, and when Karin turns up having drunk and still smoking against what they agreed, he hits her. Wendy and Danny are inside the marriage that once put the boy's shoulder out of its socket, and by February it is Jack coming through the bathroom door with the axe.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Bomba cut women's hair inside the gas chamber itself and found the wife and sister of a friend among them, Muller burned the bodies, and Srebnik was made to sing military songs for the guards at Chelmno. With the Sleep Center now running further experiments off her case, Kathy volunteers as Michael's subject and he forgets to give her the drug the protocol calls for.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back, and they disagree about it. John's father dies when he is twelve, and at 21 he leaves for New York certain he will become somebody important 'just as his father had always believed', a conviction that survives every job he loses. Marcus Aurelius' charge to restore the Roman Republic passes to Maximus, who carries it through the arena and, dying, asks for political reforms and Gracchus' reinstatement as senator.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. After Adua refuses Ercoli's rent and humiliates him in front of the others, he has all four women arrested for prostitution in revenge. The state does its killing with the same deliberateness the film gave the first one: the room, the straps, several men holding him down, and the drop.

Both turn on the person destroys the thing they could not otherwise hold. Sidney, left alone to guard the peasant girl tied to the tree, talks at her in a language she cannot understand, unbelts her expecting an embrace, and shoots her dead when she runs. Left alone with a thing that will not eat, cannot breathe and never stops crying, Henry cuts the swaddling he has never opened and finds it is holding the organs in, then puts the scissors into them.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it, and they disagree about it. Gérard, who takes charge of Balthazar at the bakery out of jealousy over Marie's affection, beats the donkey and prepares to bludgeon him to death, and holds Marie in a violent relationship that ends with him and his gang stripping, beating and locking her in the barn. Sport is at once Iris's pimp and the man she is in love with, which is what makes Travis's argument with her go nowhere until he comes back with the guns.

Both turn on one party requires of another an act that other cannot square with themselves, and they disagree about it. The First Officer orders the firing squad to shoot their own shipmates and the squad lowers its rifles; later the Tsarist squadron sent to quell the mutiny refuses to open fire and cheers the Potemkin through its ships. Aldo Piscitello's boss tells him to join the Fascist Party or lose his municipal job, so he enrolls and backdates the enrollment to 1921 while continuing to meet his anti-Fascist friends at the pharmacist's shop.

edges.b: the time to live and the time to die
edges.bTitle: The Time to Live and the Time to Die
edges.claim: Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it. Given command of the Swiss Guard at Castel Sant'Angelo, Onofrio leaves his post to check on a plebeian girl he is keeping, and the French walk in and take the Pope. The grandmother dies at home without Ah-ha or his two younger brothers noticing, and the mortician who comes for her finds half the body already gone and says nothing to them about it.

Both turn on the deceived party finds the deception out. Scottie sees Judy wearing the necklace from Carlotta's portrait, drives her back to San Juan Bautista and forces her up the tower until she admits Gavin paid her to impersonate his wife. Marion catches Ken in his affair and leaves the marriage she had already recognised as unfulfilling.

Both turn on one party puts another out of the world because that other stands between it and what it means to hold or gain, and they disagree about it. Giorgio spends his days in conversation with Melampo and is otherwise indifferent to Liza, so she swims the dog out from the island until it drowns of exhaustion. King Zog is in Vienna in 1931 to see a lover and his opponents are waiting on the opera-house steps; he draws and fires back and lives.

Both turn on one party puts another out of the world because that other stands between it and what it means to hold or gain. Yablonski ran against Boyle for the UMWA presidency in 1969, lost an election everyone took to be rigged, and was found murdered with his family; Boyle was convicted of paying 20,000 dollars for it. Uneasy at the prophecy that Banquo shall father a line of kings, Macbeth sends assassins — with Ross as the third murderer — to kill Banquo and his son Fleance.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Silvestri's sex-maniac theory sends every man at the salon into custody and prompts Marco to accuse the designer Cesare, while Cristiana kills a fifth model and strews the mask, hat and coat around her bathroom to pass her off as the killer. A boy dies under police beating and the institution puts the killing on Lilica's unnamed lover, and then kills him too.

Both turn on the person destroys the thing they could not otherwise hold. Akama, who bought Taeko a diamond ring with money stolen from his father and could never bring himself to dislike Kameda in person, kills Taeko out of jealousy over the feelings she holds for Kameda, then sits with Kameda beside her unburned corpse through the night. Sidney, left alone to guard the peasant girl tied to the tree, talks at her in a language she cannot understand, unbelts her expecting an embrace, and shoots her dead when she runs.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. When Inspector Gruber works out that the affair between Svoboda and Mascha was staged, Svoboda and Jan kill him and pin that murder on Czaka too. Every woman who could name the older client goes: McKenna a supposed suicide, Arlyn Page pulled out of the river after she tells Bree the photograph is the wrong man.

Both turn on the scheme returns on its author, and they disagree about it. Eboshi beheads the Forest Spirit to secure Irontown's future, and its headless body floods and destroys the town while Moro's severed head bites off Eboshi's arm; she survives repentant and resolves to rebuild. Teddy's four-day plan to force a meeting with the Andromedan emperor before the lunar eclipse ends with him walking into Michelle's fake teleporter in a suicide vest and being detonated by the enter key on her desk calculator.

edges.a: investigation of a citizen above suspicion
edges.aTitle: Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion
edges.claim: Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand.. Antonio Pace, the one person who can place him at the flat, will not name him, on the grounds that a criminal running the repression proves what he says about power. A man and his son come to the village to find out what happened to Pauline Kropp in 1941 and are met by people who will not tell them.

edges.a: sunrise a song of two humans
edges.aTitle: Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans
edges.claim: Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it. The Woman from the City proposes drowning the Wife and gathers the bundles of reeds that will keep the Man afloat when the boat is overturned, so that he does the killing and she stays clear of it. Delbert Grady, who cut up his own wife and daughters in the same hotel, meets Jack in the ballroom and tells him his family needs correcting, and lets him out of the pantry Wendy locked.

Both turn on one party holds a truth belonging to another's own life and manages what that other is allowed to believe about it., and they disagree about it. Rachael has Tyrell's niece's memories and a family photograph to go with them, and Deckard, having taken a hundred questions to be sure, recites her own childhood back to her until she leaves in tears. Shun grows up as a Kazama without being told that Yūichirō Sawamura brought him to the house as an infant with a Family Registry certificate, and Ryoko withholds until her return from the United States that his real father was Hiroshi Tachibana, killed on a repatriation ship in 1945.

Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand.. Watts lets Dan go with a promise to cut his throat if he speaks, and Dan says nothing about the men trailing the herd until they are already in the camp. Half the town knows the Vicario twins are sitting in Clotilde Armenta's shop with knives waiting for Santiago; some think it is talk, some think it must be stopped, the authorities do nothing, and he walks into the square unarmed.

Both turn on a parent leaves and the child is left waiting. The crying drives Mary out of the one-room flat and back to her family, leaving Henry with the child she is not sure is a child. Richard has left the family for another woman in New York, Jared keeps failing to reach him by phone until Mallory tells him the truth, and Jared ends by refusing to live with his father at all.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Because Sefton barters openly with the German guards and was away with the Russian women when the radio was confiscated, the men of Barracks 4 conclude he informed on Manfredi, Johnson and Dunbar and beat him brutally, until he exposes Price and they are convinced. Julia stabs Consul Ascanius and pins the killing on Glaucus, who is imprisoned for murder alongside the Christians already condemned for the crime wave her own hooded men committed.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Hutch researches the Bramford's history and Roman Castevet, arranges to bring Rosemary what he found, and falls into a coma that night; he surfaces once, to leave her the anagram. Deputy sheriff Casey, Teddy's childhood babysitter, comes to the house searching for Michelle, is knocked out and chained in the basement, and when he hears Don's gunshot Teddy beats him to death with a shovel.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out, and they disagree about it. Once Anna's uncle Stepan has translated Tatiana's diary naming Semyon as her rapist, Semyon burns the diary and orders Nikolai to kill Stepan, who instead hides him in a hotel in Edinburgh. Deputy sheriff Casey, Teddy's childhood babysitter, comes to the house searching for Michelle, is knocked out and chained in the basement, and when he hears Don's gunshot Teddy beats him to death with a shovel.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. After Jagga's four-day kidnapping people suspect Leela of adultery and Raghunath throws her out of the house, rejecting her plea that the child she carries is his; she gives birth to Raj on the streets. Gruneman walked in on Cable beating Jane McKenna, so Cable wrote to Bree in Gruneman's name and left the letter in his office to make him the man in the black book.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Jagga, having learned Leela is pregnant with the judge's child, releases her and instead grooms the boy Raj into a thief to disprove Raghunath's doctrine, a design Raj knows nothing of until he kills Jagga in his mother's house. With the Sleep Center now running further experiments off her case, Kathy volunteers as Michael's subject and he forgets to give her the drug the protocol calls for.

Both turn on one party keeps giving to a bond the other will not return, and no reason is given that the giving can work on., and they disagree about it. Jules stays with Catherine through the affairs she uses to torment and punish him and through the six months she left him and Sabine, and holds the marriage in place by offering her to Jim. Cui Mingliang pursues Yin Ruijuan, who answers noncommittally and then rejects him as incompatible; he pines for her through years of touring without contacting her, and only on his final return to Fenyang do they reconnect and marry.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Moose overhears Rosa and Latimer planning her divorce and remarriage and threatens to tell Latimer about her pregnancy himself, so Rosa shoots him dead on the hunting trip and claims she mistook him for a deer. Giannini is shot on Luciano's order before he can get in front of the grand jury in New York.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. A boy dies under police beating and the institution puts the killing on Lilica's unnamed lover, and then kills him too. Stopped by the fundamentalist police for wearing makeup, Marji points to a man who had been ogling her and claims he made indecent comments, and her grandmother rebukes her for it.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. After Thomas enlarges the frames showing the gunman in the trees and the shape on the ground, a man follows him and looks into his car, his studio is ransacked, and every negative and print is taken except one grainy blow-up. The roll call of Irish and foreign writers banned by the censorship board is read over church bells rung as at a funeral, and emigration is named as what the bans produced.

edges.a: the passion of joan of arc
edges.aTitle: The Passion of Joan of Arc
edges.claim: Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. After being taken to view the torture chamber and then threatened with burning at the stake, Joan breaks and lets a priest guide her hand in signing a confession, for which she is sentenced to life imprisonment. Mary's mother corners Henry in the hall after the dinner, tries to kiss him, and tells him Mary has had his baby and that the two of them must be married.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Detective Cha, ordered to purge Busan of communists even by fabrication, has schoolboy Park and other students charged with sedition for reading EH Carr's What Is History?, which Song shows was written by a British ambassador. After Macduff discovers Duncan's body, Macbeth summarily executes the drugged servants, presenting it as just punishment for a betrayal they did not commit.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. The reporters work the widow while she is still assembling plugs at the kitchen table, and Niemeyer, who took the most interest in the family, prints the piece she finds unbearable and takes up with her daughter. With the Sleep Center now running further experiments off her case, Kathy volunteers as Michael's subject and he forgets to give her the drug the protocol calls for.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. They are told they are running money out of Yugoslavia for the Banker; on the way back Tiberio finds the seat has been changed and there is cocaine under it, and the Banker takes the car and leaves them their fee. With the Sleep Center now running further experiments off her case, Kathy volunteers as Michael's subject and he forgets to give her the drug the protocol calls for.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. After Jagga's four-day kidnapping people suspect Leela of adultery and Raghunath throws her out of the house, rejecting her plea that the child she carries is his; she gives birth to Raj on the streets. Beaten by her mother until she gives a name, Angela says Santiago Nasar, though the two were never seen together and she never alters a word of it in twenty-seven years.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. When Inspector Gruber works out that the affair between Svoboda and Mascha was staged, Svoboda and Jan kill him and pin that murder on Czaka too. Isabella discovered that Morlacchi and Cristiana had murdered the Countess's husband and tried to blackmail them, so they kill her and then hunt her diary through the fashion house, killing Nicole and burning Peggy to death in a furnace to find out where it went.

edges.b: i know where i m going
edges.claim: Both turn on a marriage is entered for money, standing or cover rather than love, and they disagree about it. Having overheard that the Count found oil under Devil's Field and having written the will that leaves Devil's Field to Helga, Johannes tells Helga he loves her and marries her after the Count's death. Joan has arranged to marry one of the wealthiest industrialists in England, a man nearly her father's age whom the Mull locals openly disparage on the bus, and her 'carefully laid plans' rather than any feeling for Bellinger drive her to hire Kenny to run the crossing.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it, and they disagree about it. He forbids her suntan oil on the honeymoon and then takes her in the hotel room while she is screaming from the burns, and afterwards he is aroused whenever she is hurt or frightened. Sport is at once Iris's pimp and the man she is in love with, which is what makes Travis's argument with her go nowhere until he comes back with the guns.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest, and they disagree about it. Henrik goes on secretly living with Frida the waitress while courting and becoming engaged to Anna, until Karin tells Anna and the family verifies it. Maloin hides the £55,000 from Camélia and Henriette, turns brusque at dinner, drags Henriette out of the butcher's job and buys her an expensive mink stole, while Camélia can only ask uncomprehendingly why he has ruined the girl's prospects and spent their savings.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Lt Yoon, the medical officer who oversaw the tortured detainees, agrees to describe the torture methods in court, and Cha's superiors frame him for desertion to nullify his testimony and send him to prison. Deputy sheriff Casey, Teddy's childhood babysitter, comes to the house searching for Michelle, is knocked out and chained in the basement, and when he hears Don's gunshot Teddy beats him to death with a shovel.

Both turn on one party takes up someone others have written off and treats them as worth something. Oyae hides the hunted Sakichi at her father's premises, and when he raids the cash-box in a sleepwalking trance her father refuses to call him a thief and gives him more money to start again. The real Makhmalbaf meets him at the prison gate and gives him a lift to the Ahankhahs' door, where the father says he hopes the man will be good now and make them proud of him.

Both turn on the person destroys the thing they could not otherwise hold. Sidney, left alone to guard the peasant girl tied to the tree, talks at her in a language she cannot understand, unbelts her expecting an embrace, and shoots her dead when she runs. Having promised Sukhilala she would not let Birju harm his family, Radha shoots her own bandit son as he rides off with the kidnapped Rupa, and he dies in her arms.

Both turn on parties bound to each other by service, alliance or company come to act against each other, and they disagree about it. After evading the police roadblock Erich murders his own crewmate Jean-Paul for the diamond case, and is then intercepted and murdered in turn by Milford at the meeting point. Massigny, once his closest friend, did him some injury the film never names, and Davenne will not have a candle for him until the night he finally grants it and goes to the chapel to die.

Both turn on one party covers what another did so that the other never has to answer for it, and they disagree about it. Sakichi hides the burglar Genshichi from the officers pursuing him, and later denies to Manabe that he knows where his thieving brother Ishimatsu is. Michael, now an assistant district attorney, gets himself assigned to the Nokes murder case in order to botch his own prosecution, secretly drafting Snyder's cross-examination questions so that John and Tommy walk free for a killing they committed in front of witnesses.

edges.b: portrait of a lady on fire
edges.bTitle: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
edges.claim: Both turn on whom a person is bound to is settled by parties outside the bond for ends of their own, and the one bound must go on living inside it., and they disagree about it. Mr Robinson pulls Elaine out of college and settles her marriage to Carl, and she is at the altar in Santa Barbara before she breaks it. Héloïse, brought back from the convent after her sister's suicide, is betrothed by the Countess to a Milanese nobleman she has never met, and the portrait Marianne is hired to paint is the instrument of that transaction; the film ends with Héloïse married in Milan.

Both turn on others with the standing to do it settle the shape of a party's life in advance, and the one whose life it is was never put the question.. The Count and Louise arrange to pack Chantal off to boarding school to get her out of the way, and Chantal comes to the priest for advice about it carrying a suicide note. Miller decides Evvie will be given to the church and schooled on the mainland, revokes his permission for her to go to town with Jackson, and then asks the Reverend whether marrying her would settle the matter of the rape.

edges.a: such a gorgeous kid like me
edges.aTitle: Such a Gorgeous Kid Like Me
edges.claim: Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. The thesis interviews on criminal women become Camille's way out: she gives the sociologist the life story that has him working to clear her, and once she is a singing star she has no further use for him. With the Sleep Center now running further experiments off her case, Kathy volunteers as Michael's subject and he forgets to give her the drug the protocol calls for.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. When Hanshirō's clan was abolished in 1619 and he planned to die alongside his lord, his closest friend died in his place, leaving Hanshirō alive and responsible for the friend's teenage son Motome. Hallorann picks up Danny's call in Florida, flies to Colorado and drives a snowcat up the mountain to a lobby where Jack is waiting with the axe.

Both turn on one party keeps giving to a bond the other will not return, and no reason is given that the giving can work on., and they disagree about it. Angela writes to Bayardo every week for years with no answer, and he finally walks in with the whole bundle of letters unopened. Jamie keeps returning to a night class on education law she has no interest in, brings a horse for Beth to ride to the diner, and after Beth quits without a word drives four hours to Livingston to say she came because otherwise she would never see her again — and Beth says nothing back.

Both turn on one party takes what they saw for something it was not, while another holds the sense of it. Thomas photographs the older man and Jane in the park as a pair of lovers and only later, in the blow-ups, sees Jane looking worriedly toward a figure with a pistol, while Jane — who chases him to his studio demanding the roll and leaves a false phone number — knew what she was in. John sees his wife on a funeral barge with the two sisters while she is in England, and takes the small red coat in the alleys for his drowned daughter; both are pictures of his own funeral and his own killer.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. With the Sleep Center now running further experiments off her case, Kathy volunteers as Michael's subject and he forgets to give her the drug the protocol calls for. Takashi, Masaru and Kiyoko were put through the psychic programme as children and are still in the laboratory as old-faced children, and what is left of Akira is in jars under the Olympic site for research.

Both turn on a parent leaves and the child is left waiting. His arms crushed by a boulder and humiliated by Sukhilala for living on his wife's earnings, Shamu decides he is of no use and walks away from Radha and their three sons to his probable death by starvation. Richard has left the family for another woman in New York, Jared keeps failing to reach him by phone until Mallory tells him the truth, and Jared ends by refusing to live with his father at all.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest. Kate and Philip let Pete believe the child Kate bears is his, and Pete raises the baby as a devoted father until Kate returns and tells him he is not the father. Maloin hides the £55,000 from Camélia and Henriette, turns brusque at dinner, drags Henriette out of the butcher's job and buys her an expensive mink stole, while Camélia can only ask uncomprehendingly why he has ruined the girl's prospects and spent their savings.

edges.a: the plot of the fuma clan
edges.aTitle: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
edges.claim: Both turn on an outside party takes a person out of the keeping of those bound to them, who must get them back. A second party of Fuma ninja take Murasaki out of her own wedding while the first party is fighting over the urn, and leave a note offering to trade her for it. Raoul tricks Meg out of the panic room to fetch Sarah's syringes and the men take the room with Sarah locked inside, then prepare to leave with her as a hostage until Meg ambushes them on the stairs.

edges.b: investigation of a citizen above suspicion
edges.bTitle: Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion
edges.claim: Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand.. Valerie sees Jef leaving Martey's office clearly and then fails to pick him out of the identity parade, and the silence is what puts him back on the street. Antonio Pace, the one person who can place him at the flat, will not name him, on the grounds that a criminal running the repression proves what he says about power.

Both turn on the deceived party finds the deception out. Marion catches Ken in his affair and leaves the marriage she had already recognised as unfulfilling. Caleb, who had begun to reciprocate Ava's professed romantic interest, is told by Nathan that she only pretended feelings for him, and it is confirmed when Ava walks past him, locks the glass door and ignores his pleas.

Both turn on one party obtains another's closeness or presence and pays for it with the means to live. Lulu lives as Dr Schön's kept mistress, was earlier kept by the old man Schigolch her 'first patron', and ends driven to prostitution in a London garret on Christmas Eve. The five women at Dreamland sell their presence to clients to live — Yasumi keeps Mr. Aoki as a long-term paying client and Hanae works to feed a suicidal husband and infant — and when the anti-prostitution bill fails the maid Shizuko is sent out front to beckon in the next customers.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it, and they disagree about it. The Giant bids Hogarth farewell and flies up to collide with the nuclear missile Mansley launched at Rockwell, detonating it in the exosphere so the town's people are not destroyed, at apparent cost of himself. Hye-young is shot in the neck and left mute trying to shield Jeong Woo from a gangster's bullet, and later steps into the bullet fired at Park Yi and dies.

edges.b: the working class goes to heaven
edges.bTitle: The Working Class Goes to Heaven
edges.claim: Both turn on one party takes another up while they serve its purpose and drops them, with no cause given, once they do not. Liliana lets Checco break from his troupe and rehearse a whole new show built around her, then arrives at rehearsal to say she has signed with a competitor, and Checco collapses. Lulu moves the students at the gates into his flat and calls the strike with them, and when he is out of work they tell him he is no use to them because he is an individual case.

Both turn on what one party held back comes into the open between them and the person whose life it governed, and they disagree about it. Dying in hospital after being struck by a car outside the courthouse, Leela finally tells Raj that Raghunath is his father and asks him to forgive the judge. Julio tells Tenoch he slept with his girlfriend, Tenoch jealously answers that he slept with Julio's, and drunk at the village they admit it happened repeatedly rather than once; after the trip the two stop seeing each other.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. After Charlie is caught watching Susan Orlean and Laroche take the ghost-orchid drug and have sex, Orlean decides he must be killed to stop him exposing them and drives him into the swamp at gunpoint. McAra drowns after discovering Lang's torture-flight involvement and Ruth's recruitment, and the Ghost, having decoded the same message from the first words of McAra's chapters and passed a note to Ruth, is hit by an accelerating car outside the book launch.

Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand.. Watts lets Dan go with a promise to cut his throat if he speaks, and Dan says nothing about the men trailing the herd until they are already in the camp. The villagers around Treblinka and Chelmno tell Lanzmann they watched full trains go in and empty ones come out and guessed within days what it meant, and that they said nothing because of what would have happened to them.

Both turn on one party puts another into a position that lowers them in the eyes of those watching.
