edges.bTitle: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
edges.claim: Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Claire is put into the dead prostitute's part as the widow of Captain Ambrose Allen and has to keep the grief up in front of a sheriff's posse, a minister who knew him, and finally his old fort. Marianne is installed in the house as Héloïse's hired walking companion so she can memorise her face on the coastal walks and paint her in secret, until she confesses the commission and destroys the first portrait.

Both turn on one party keeps attendance on another who can no longer answer or meet them, and goes on addressing them anyway. Ivan goes on addressing the drowned Marichka for years, hallucinating her spirit in the water and among the trees, until her colourless shade touches his outstretched hand and he screams and dies. Ula goes to a hypnotist to have Antek taken out of her head and sees him standing in the room instead, and keeps his files, his client and the candles at his grave going for the whole film.

Both turn on a child is claimed at once by those who bore them and those who keep them, and where the child belongs is settled between the adults., and they disagree about it. Kate returns to take the baby and tells Pete he is not its father, Pete refuses to believe her or give the child up, and only after the courtroom scene do Kate and Philip come to the cottage and carry the child away. With Kathleen dead, the stepfather flies out to take the three children home and Tannen decides to go for full custody, and Mitchell promises to use his practice to ruin him for it.

Both turn on one party moves against the one placed above it and set over what it was to become, and they disagree about it. Columbus's aristocratic subordinate Moxica burns down his house and leads a faction of settlers against him; Columbus's side prevails and Moxica kills himself rather than be captured. AUTO, the autopilot serving Captain McCrea, mutinies when McCrea tries to override directive A113 — electrocuting WALL-E, dumping him and EVE down the garbage chute and confining McCrea to his quarters — until McCrea rises from his chair and switches him to manual.

Both turn on one party comes asking something of another who is free to answer it, and is turned away, and they disagree about it. Buddy Pine asks Mr. Incredible to let him be his sidekick during the Bomb Voyage robbery and Bob brushes him off, a refusal Buddy carries for fifteen years until he returns as Syndrome and dies in the plane engine. Fuller asks Laura to walk out the front and stall the police as though he had a gun on her so he can slip out the back, and she instead tells them exactly where he is — though she later visits him in prison and agrees to answer his letters.

Both turn on one party takes another up while they serve its purpose and drops them, with no cause given, once they do not. The Thalmanns take her up at the funeral and want her husband as a victim of capitalism for the election, and when she wants something done the anarchists take her on to the hostage-taking she stands horrified in the middle of. St. Joseph's scout recruits Arthur Agee out of West Garfield Park, then at the end of freshman year he is put out of the school because his family cannot pay tuition, while Gates's fees are covered by his Encyclopedia Britannica sponsor; Agee's confidence collapses and he finishes at John Marshall.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it, and they disagree about it. Frank Coutelle visits Richard Yellow Hawk in prison, offers a reduced sentence for favors and then blackmails him with the threat of return, using him to kill Leo Fast Elk and inflame the reservation while Frank runs the official investigation. Ari's unit stands in 'the second or third ring' lighting the sky for the Israeli-allied Phalange who do the killing, and Ari concludes he felt as responsible as the men who carried it out.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it, and they disagree about it. With the jets over the house and the broadcast running, Alexander promises God he will give up everything he has and loves, his son included, if the day can be taken back, and in the morning he burns the house to the ground to keep the bargain. Hye-young is shot in the neck and left mute trying to shield Jeong Woo from a gangster's bullet, and later steps into the bullet fired at Park Yi and dies.

Both turn on one party asks the person they harmed for a release that is that person's alone to give. The daughter, who cannot forgive her father for driving her mother crazy, is met by him again outside the ward, where he asks her forgiveness and asks after her engagement. In court Sabzian says he did it because the films let him feel seen in his own suffering, and the judge puts it to the Ahankhahs, who pardon him on condition that he makes something of himself.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding, and they disagree about it. One of Ali la Pointe's compatriots, under torture by the French Army, gives up the location of Ali's hideout. Stewart tries to force himself on Ada, coerces a promise that she will not see Baines again, and when she breaks it chops off her index finger and sends it to Baines with a threat to take more.

Both turn on one party works on another to turn them back from a course that would undo them, and they disagree about it. Mae, worn out, puts it to Tom that he is losing to Wade and to the river both and should stop, and he goes back out to the sandbags on his own. Travis telephones his father to say he is in love with Jonni, and his father talks him down by telling him about his own dalliance before the wedding - with Jonni listening.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them, and they disagree about it. Richardson, furious at Blasi sneaking his infantrymen out the back of the fort, chases them into hilly terrain against Rootes' advice, and the Italians answer by having dismissed tribal warriors fire the forest and destroy his armored cars. Eleanor Falco and Lammark track the New Year's Eve sniper from the burned sniper's nest through the mall footage, the slaughterhouse and Lang's hiring records to Dean Possey's parents' farm, and Eleanor ends up alone in the house with the man she has spent the film reading, talking him toward sleep before the deputies arrive.

Both turn on the person telling the truth is the one nobody credits. Thomas, having found the body in Maryon Park, asks Ron at the drug-drenched Thames party to come to the park as a witness and cannot get the cannabis-addled Ron to credit any of it, and is drawn into the party instead. Laura has told Fuller for eight months that accepting the company's small settlement killed his claim, and he only accepts it when she takes him to a second, male lawyer who says exactly the same thing.

Both turn on one party works on another to turn them back from a course that would undo them, and they disagree about it. Travis telephones his father to say he is in love with Jonni, and his father talks him down by telling him about his own dalliance before the wedding - with Jonni listening. Wen-ching finds Hinoe in the mountains with the guerillas and asks to join them; Hinoe sends him back down and tells him Hinomi loves him.

Both turn on one party puts another into a position that lowers them in the eyes of those watching. She tells the gamekeeper and his wife that she spent the night at Arsene's because he is her lover, and the shopkeeper who spots the scratch on her chest calls her a little slut. The papers drop the pizzeria shooting almost at once, and Nicola, his wife Laura and their daughter Patrizia make a joke of the accountant with the pistol in front of each other.

Both turn on one party puts another into a position that lowers them in the eyes of those watching. Eva plays the Chopin A minor prelude for her mother and Charlotte sits down and plays the same piece again, better, and explains what it is about. The papers drop the pizzeria shooting almost at once, and Nicola, his wife Laura and their daughter Patrizia make a joke of the accountant with the pistol in front of each other.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. The convict Sauro recognises in the pizzeria shoots him, and after a few seconds of hesitation Barletta draws the pistol Sauro gave him and kills the man. Kai brings Kaneda the news about Yamagata and Kaneda swears he will settle it with Tetsuo himself, and goes into the stadium after him twice.

edges.a: the bird with the crystal plumage
edges.aTitle: The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
edges.claim: Both turn on one party covers what another did so that the other never has to answer for it, and they disagree about it. Alberto covers his wife's killings, commits some of them himself, and as he falls from the window confesses to the whole series. Michael, now an assistant district attorney, gets himself assigned to the Nokes murder case in order to botch his own prosecution, secretly drafting Snyder's cross-examination questions so that John and Tommy walk free for a killing they committed in front of witnesses.

edges.a: the plot of the fuma clan
edges.aTitle: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
edges.claim: Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. Held at knifepoint on the castle roof as the thing that would stop Goemon fighting, Murasaki throws herself off it and takes Kazami down with her. Rowdy, going in for surgery on a burst vessel in his brain, asks Cole to drive his car at Daytona so that his sponsor will pay out his year.

Both turn on one party takes control of the thing another cannot do without and sets the terms of its release. Clarisse hands the Count her ring to buy Lupin's life and he takes the ring and goes back on it; on the clock face Lupin offers both rings for her and the Count does it again. Quaritch seizes Kiri, Tuk, Lo'ak and Spider aboard the whaling ship and demands Jake surrender himself in exchange for his children, later holding a blade to Kiri until Neytiri threatens Spider in return.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Every woman who could name the older client goes: McKenna a supposed suicide, Arlyn Page pulled out of the river after she tells Bree the photograph is the wrong man. Everyone who holds a piece of what happened at the Terzi Institute is removed in turn: Calabresi under a train, the photographer with the uncropped negatives strangled, Bianca strangled over the locket, Braun stabbed.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back, and they disagree about it. Hanshirō says Motome, Miho and Kingo have every right to ask him whether justice has been exacted for their deaths, and comes to the Iyi courtyard to answer that question before joining them. Sadazo, expecting to die in the Philippines, asks Matsuyama to carry his wife Tomoko's postcard back to her and say he received it before dying; after the war Matsuyama makes his way to Tomoko's house to discharge that errand.

Both turn on one party is passed over by someone whose regard they held, in favour of another that person prefers. Dito, whom Lilica took up after the reformatory, turns to the prostitute they are pimping, and Lilica walks out of the group. Kathy comes back to the flat and finds Kevin there with another woman, and after they patch it up she dreams of killing him for it.

Both turn on an outside party takes a person out of the keeping of those bound to them, who must get them back, and they disagree about it. Quilty removes Dolores from the hospital by claiming to be her uncle, and Humbert — devastated — spends three years unable to find her, learning her whereabouts only when she writes asking for money. Raoul tricks Meg out of the panic room to fetch Sarah's syringes and the men take the room with Sarah locked inside, then prepare to leave with her as a hostage until Meg ambushes them on the stairs.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. On the night Mussolini falls Marcello shouts that Lino murdered the Quadris, and then denounces his blind friend Italo as a Fascist to the crowd that carries him off. Park picks out the scarred, mentally handicapped Baek Kwang-ho on the strength of eye contact and his girlfriend's gossip, and Cho beats a confession out of him until Seo shows the boy could not have committed the crimes.

Both turn on those already in place weigh the one who arrives among them and withhold a standing of their own from them, and they disagree about it. On Noirmoutier the shopkeeper's daughter says the newcomer scared her, the linen vendors Max and Pierre single him out in the market as someone amiss, and the hotel accuses him of killing the cat left on his doorstep. Noriko, Shoji's fiancée, fears she is not accepted by the Hirayamas at Tomiko's funeral, and Shukichi thanks her, gives her Tomiko's watch as a keepsake and asks her to look after his son.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them. Soma is told in a vision that his son will be the death of him and sets out to kill him first, following him across the country with a pylon that tracks him and goes through every barrier put in its way. Nikki/Sue, feeling stalked by the Phantom, arms herself with a screwdriver, and finally shoots him in the Axxon N. apartment, where he transforms into a grotesque figure with her own face before dying.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding, and they disagree about it. One of Ali la Pointe's compatriots, under torture by the French Army, gives up the location of Ali's hideout. The company's gun thugs keep their weapons out of shot at first and openly brandish them as the year goes on, shooting at the picket, and it is only when Lawrence Jones is shot dead that both sides sit down.

Both turn on one party who has been denied or bereaved unloads it as harm on people who had no part in it. In the escalating exchange between pieds-noirs and locals, Djamila, Zohra and Hassiba carry bombs into European civilian spaces such as the Milk Bar Café, while the security forces answer with indiscriminate killings in the Casbah. Jacek carries a rope round the city, plays pointless cruelties on strangers, and strangles and then stones a taxi driver he has no quarrel with; five years earlier his twelve-year-old sister was run down by a driver who had been drinking with Jacek that afternoon.

Both turn on one party takes up someone others have written off and treats them as worth something. Oyae hides the hunted Sakichi at her father's premises, and when he raids the cash-box in a sleepwalking trance her father refuses to call him a thief and gives him more money to start again. Bytes has him down as an imbecile because he does not speak and the London Hospital does not take incurables, and Treves keeps at him until he recites the whole of the twenty-third psalm to Carr Gomm on the stairs.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would., and they disagree about it. Johannes tells Morten that death is nearby and will take Inger unless he has faith; Morten refuses to listen and Inger dies suddenly, exactly as prophesied, and only after her death does the family credit Johannes enough to ask for her raising. Kiyoko tells Shikishima that Neo-Tokyo is going to go the way of Tokyo, and the parliament hears him out and dismisses it, which is what finally puts him into a coup.

Both turn on an outside party takes a person out of the keeping of those bound to them, who must get them back. Raoul tricks Meg out of the panic room to fetch Sarah's syringes and the men take the room with Sarah locked inside, then prepare to leave with her as a hostage until Meg ambushes them on the stairs. Anna Dover and Joy Birch are taken from outside the family Thanksgiving by Holly Jones, who drugs them, and their fathers and Detective Loki spend the film trying to get them back.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Gérard, who takes charge of Balthazar at the bakery out of jealousy over Marie's affection, beats the donkey and prepares to bludgeon him to death, and holds Marie in a violent relationship that ends with him and his gang stripping, beating and locking her in the barn. Jonas whips Claire for arranging the burial at the fort and keeps her outside the cave through the storm until she takes pneumonia.

Both turn on a wanting that arrives after a binding already made cannot be had without breaking it, and one of the two people must be given up., and they disagree about it. The actress, married with children and flying to Paris the next day, and the married Hiroshima architect cannot have each other without breaking those marriages; she agrees to stay, then tells him to go away. Chloe wants no marriage but wants a child by him and treats his wife and two children as beside the point; he finds Helene alone and in tears instead.

Both turn on the deceived party finds the deception out. Yasumi lets Mr. Aoki believe she will elope with him so he pays off her debts and embezzles to do it; when he confronts her and finds she never meant to marry him he attacks her and nearly kills her. Bakhtiar lets Zara believe he has obtained a real passport when it is a film prop, she interrupts the shoot to say so to Panahi's camera and walks off, and her body is later found drowned on the shore.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. After Charlie is caught watching Susan Orlean and Laroche take the ghost-orchid drug and have sex, Orlean decides he must be killed to stop him exposing them and drives him into the swamp at gunpoint. Chan, having deduced that Lau was Hon's mole and sent him the CD of his meeting with Hon, is shot in the head by Inspector Big B on the rooftop as he holds Lau at gunpoint.

Both turn on one party brings a grievance upward and the party above treats it as an offence to be put down, and they disagree about it. The crew complains that the ship's meat is maggot-infested and refuses the borscht; Dr Smirnov declares it edible, Giliarovsky drives them off, and all who refused are judged guilty of insubordination and brought to the fore-deck to be shot under a canvas. When Aloysius takes her suspicions about Donald to Flynn and to the boy's mother, Flynn charges her with insubordination and acting outside her duties and threatens to have her removed from her position as principal if she does not back down.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out, and they disagree about it. After Thomas enlarges the frames showing the gunman in the trees and the shape on the ground, a man follows him and looks into his car, his studio is ransacked, and every negative and print is taken except one grainy blow-up. DSC officers chase Peter for his footage of the crackdown and seize Jae-sik, who shouts for Peter to share the film with the world; soldiers at the mountain roadblock are ordered to stop any foreigners and fire on the taxi.

edges.a: zatoichi and the chest of gold
edges.aTitle: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold
edges.claim: Both turn on the leader turns on the person he depends on. Gundayu burns the written evidence in a way that saves himself and implicates his constabulary chief Monji, then kills Monji when he demands half the gold. Once Richard Yellow Hawk confesses to Ray that Frank put him up to Leo's murder, Richard is found dead with his wrists slit to pass as suicide.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Birju, embittered since childhood by Sukhilala's demands and driven out as a bandit after seizing back his mother's pawned kangan, returns on Rupa's wedding day to kill Sukhilala and carry off his daughter. Maximus, finding his wife and son murdered on Commodus' order, declares in the Colosseum that he will have his vengeance and finally kills Commodus in the arena duel.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Neville puts the models' photographs in Tommy's flat and one of Tommy's playing cards under Donald's body, and after Tommy is shot in the street he tells Laura a whole invented life to explain him. The detective who handled the hijacking harasses Makoto over a neighbourhood woman's murder without evidence and later arrests and questions him over a second killing, while the murderer is in fact Naoki.

Both turn on the threat is a person already admitted. Haines takes Greenhill on as a client and he then appears uninvited in her social life, stalks her, beats Phil into hospital and tries to stage her suicide at her apartment building. MG, the policewoman Honey picks up at the station and takes to bed in her own apartment, turns out to be Mia's killer and is holding Corinne captive in her basement, where she stabs Honey before Honey scalds her with the kettle and shoots her.

Both turn on one party names another's concealed life or wrong in front of those who did not know of it. Sue confronts Billy in front of his family and professes her love, and his wife Doris repeatedly slaps her. Insulted by Peadar at the market, Pádraic publicly announces that Peadar beats Dominic, and later, drunk in the pub, publicly accuses him of molesting his son.

edges.b: the plot of the fuma clan
edges.bTitle: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
edges.claim: Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it, and they disagree about it. Jiro borrows from the barber to pay Tomio's doctor's bill and plans to work as a labourer in Hokkaido to repay it, so Kihachi knocks him unconscious to make him miss the ship and sails for Hokkaido in his place — then jumps overboard and swims home. Held at knifepoint on the castle roof as the thing that would stop Goemon fighting, Murasaki throws herself off it and takes Kazami down with her.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them. Johnnie chases the stolen General alone by foot, handcar, bicycle and then the Texas while the hijackers uncouple a trailing car and drop railroad ties on the track, and the chase reverses with two Union trains behind him once he steals his engine back. Richardson, furious at Blasi sneaking his infantrymen out the back of the fort, chases them into hilly terrain against Rootes' advice, and the Italians answer by having dismissed tribal warriors fire the forest and destroy his armored cars.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back, and they disagree about it. John's father dies when he is twelve, and at 21 he leaves for New York certain he will become somebody important 'just as his father had always believed', a conviction that survives every job he loses. Viktor's father died with 56 of the 57 autographs from the 'A Great Day in Harlem' photograph collected in the Planters peanut can, and Viktor came to New York solely to get Benny Golson's, which he finally obtains at the hotel.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back. Dying of a henchman's bullet during the escape from Rodríguez's hacienda, Florès makes Maria I promise to carry on his revolution in San Miguel, and she takes up the peasant army and the campaign on his behalf. Mikey tells them they may fill their pockets but must leave what sits on the scales in front of One-Eyed Willy, and it is the Fratellis grabbing that which brings the grotto down.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it, and they disagree about it. With the house surrounded by soldiers and Rikyū's plan to send her to Ukon and kill himself foreclosed, Ogin prepares to take her own life and sends her maid with a farewell note written on a fan to Ukon in Kaga. The Giant bids Hogarth farewell and flies up to collide with the nuclear missile Mansley launched at Rockwell, detonating it in the exosphere so the town's people are not destroyed, at apparent cost of himself.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Every woman who could name the older client goes: McKenna a supposed suicide, Arlyn Page pulled out of the river after she tells Bree the photograph is the wrong man. Everyone who came near the Moroni kidnapping is taken off: Paradisi beheaded by the excavator, its driver hanged to look like suicide, Paradisi's wife strangled at the tram stop, the kindergarten teacher cut up with a circular saw, Mattia beaten with a statue, and finally the old woman who happens to own the mirror.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Traver flees a lynch mob for a rape he did not commit, accused by a woman the Reverend knows to be a drunk who falsely accused a white man of the same thing two years earlier. The detective who handled the hijacking harasses Makoto over a neighbourhood woman's murder without evidence and later arrests and questions him over a second killing, while the murderer is in fact Naoki.

Both turn on the work takes the life it was supposed to support, and they disagree about it. Vicky's dancing career, and the Red Shoes ballet in which the shoes will not let the dancer stop until she dies, takes her over exactly as the fairytale predicts — she dies in costume and asks Julian to take the red shoes off. Robertson keeps coming back to it between songs: sixteen years on the road, the numbers start to scare you, and he could not live with twenty - which is what the concert is for.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. To get the contract's civil-disturbance clause Shyamal has a riot staged at his own plant; a factory watchman is badly hurt in it and Shyamal is congratulated for efficient handling. Pris works on J. F. Sebastian's loneliness until he takes her in, and Roy uses him and his access to get to the top of the Tyrell pyramid; Sebastian is reported dead soon after.

Both turn on one party holds a truth belonging to another's own life and manages what that other is allowed to believe about it.. Cohaagen has had Hauser's memory wiped and replaced with the Quaid identity, a wife and a construction job, so that Quaid lives a life whose facts about himself are administered by Cohaagen until the Rekall visit and the recorded message begin to surface them. Shun grows up as a Kazama without being told that Yūichirō Sawamura brought him to the house as an infant with a Family Registry certificate, and Ryoko withholds until her return from the United States that his real father was Hiroshi Tachibana, killed on a repatriation ship in 1945.

Both turn on one who was once helped comes back to the one who helped them, and what they return — gratitude or violence — settles what the bond was., and they disagree about it. Angela stops the train so the wounded Sergeant Jerry Jackson can be treated; he returns to thank her, keeps coming back for her, breaks out of the prison camp to reach her, and dies driving off a cliff with her body beside him. After Ben saves Dr. Hogue's life during his heart attack, the grateful Hogue privately telephones Dr. Halberstrom to excuse Ben's delay, and Halberstrom hires Ben on Hogue's recommendation.

Both turn on the betrayal comes from the person nearest, who was serving someone else. Julia, the Consul's Egyptian mistress, has been directing the hooded murders to fund an uprising against Rome, and confesses it to Ascanius before stabbing him. Gondō's top aide tips off the cheap-shoes faction about the kidnapping in exchange for a promotion when they take over, wrecking the secret buyout.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Dismounted Cossacks form lines at the top of the Odessa steps and advance on unarmed women and children, halting to fire volleys and ignoring their pleas, while cavalry cuts down the survivors at the bottom. Garda Peadar Kearney beats his son Dominic severely for drinking his poitín, Pádraic and Siobhán can only shelter him for one night, and Dominic is later found dead in the lake.

Both turn on a parent cannot feel toward the child what the child needs. Judy believes her father ignores her now that she is no longer a little girl, and when she dresses in racy clothes to draw his attention he calls her a 'dirty tramp'. With Dito dead by his own hand and nothing left, Pixote climbs onto Sueli and takes her breast in his mouth like an infant, and she pushes him off in disgust.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Jonas whips Claire for arranging the burial at the fort and keeps her outside the cave through the storm until she takes pneumonia. He forbids her suntan oil on the honeymoon and then takes her in the hotel room while she is screaming from the burns, and afterwards he is aroused whenever she is hurt or frightened.

edges.b: jolanda the daughter of the black corsair
edges.bTitle: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair
edges.claim: Both turn on what one party held back comes into the open between them and the person whose life it governed. Sadao consults his birth certificate while preparing his university application and learns that Chieko is not his mother but his father's second wife, forcing the years-long concealment into the open between them until he tearfully apologises and, after a second rupture, comes home. Only as he lies dying of his wounds after the fight near Maracaibo does the guardian who raised her tell Jolly that she is Jolanda, daughter of the Count of Ventimiglia, and that a family treasure exists.

Both turn on one party comes asking something of another who is free to answer it, and is turned away. Betsy walks out of the porno theatre he takes her to on the second date, will not take his calls or his flowers, and has him thrown out of the Palantine office when he comes to argue. Larry goes to his synagogue for consolation and gets Rabbi Scott's advice to change his 'perspective', Rabbi Nachtner's anecdote about Hebrew letters on a goy's teeth, and Marshak, who will not see him at all.

Both turn on one party settles the terms of its own death and requires those bound to it to stand by and let it happen. Told that drink will finish his heart, Hans sits down at a table with Irmgard, Harry and his friends and puts away a few dozen shots in front of them until it does. Simon walks out of the hotel with the case of heroin, reaches inside his overcoat for a gun he is not carrying, and Coleman finds the empty pocket afterwards.

edges.a: the passion of joan of arc
edges.aTitle: The Passion of Joan of Arc
edges.claim: Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding, and they disagree about it. After being taken to view the torture chamber and then threatened with burning at the stake, Joan breaks and lets a priest guide her hand in signing a confession, for which she is sentenced to life imprisonment. Wade sets the grain price at his own mill, works the senator and the bank, quietly buys the river frontage for the dam he wants and finally has Tom's corn graded down and offers less than it cost to put in the ground.

Both turn on the terms of the offer are not what they appeared. Pazuzu comes to Lamont in the taxi wearing Regan's face and offers him power without limit, and he takes it far enough that Regan has to call him back out of it. Jonni takes him on a test drive and loads the order with every option except the extended warranty, and the car is a lemon because Dave has been building them out of inferior parts.

Both turn on a life or a freedom is settled with a payment, and they disagree about it. Moroni goes to pay the ransom for Stefania and is taken along with her, and the two of them are left in the shack to die. On the slaughterhouse ramp Mija holds out her grandfather's solid gold pig to Nancy, who takes it as a sound business deal and lets Okja walk out.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them, and they disagree about it. Miller takes a rifle into the woods after Traver, shoots four holes in his boat and fires on him crossing the swamp, and later Jackson sets out to kill him, while Traver survives on foot until he is caught in an animal trap. Nikki/Sue, feeling stalked by the Phantom, arms herself with a screwdriver, and finally shoots him in the Axxon N. apartment, where he transforms into a grotesque figure with her own face before dying.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Everyone who holds a piece of what happened at the Terzi Institute is removed in turn: Calabresi under a train, the photographer with the uncropped negatives strangled, Bianca strangled over the locket, Braun stabbed. Tino's cousin Vinnie is found dead after telling Calhoun why Santos approached Tino, Schwartz is murdered mid-phone-call with Calhoun while holding the incriminating probation report, and Zapatti orders Anselmo to shoot himself so he cannot become an informant.

Both turn on parties bound to each other by service, alliance or company come to act against each other. Moreau brings in his friend Delmas to help find the diplomat, then threatens to take the film by force and finally punches him at the Pike Slip Inn over the corpse photographs. Ben denounces the family in front of the Indians and offers them the coffin money, and Nat and Jeff shoot each other over it in the crossfire.

Both turn on one party holds another under a sustained look, and the watching stands in place of any exchange between them, and they disagree about it. The administration reviews a list of code-named agents planted among the workers, and the spy 'Owl' photographs a strike leader taking the posted rejection letter with a camera hidden in a pocket watch, after which the leader is beaten and captured. Before Leigh has spent a night in the high-rise the caller has been through her flat and left microphones in it, and the free-holiday letters, the telescope and the swimsuit keep arriving from a man she cannot see.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back. John's father dies when he is twelve, and at 21 he leaves for New York certain he will become somebody important 'just as his father had always believed', a conviction that survives every job he loses. Hanshirō says Motome, Miho and Kingo have every right to ask him whether justice has been exacted for their deaths, and comes to the Iyi courtyard to answer that question before joining them.

Both turn on one party keeps attendance on another who can no longer answer or meet them, and goes on addressing them anyway. Ivan goes on addressing the drowned Marichka for years, hallucinating her spirit in the water and among the trees, until her colourless shade touches his outstretched hand and he screams and dies. Eleven years after Julie's death Davenne keeps an upstairs room for her, and when it burns he rebuilds it in a ruined cemetery chapel as a forest of candles he goes on talking to.

edges.b: the plot of the fuma clan
edges.bTitle: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
edges.claim: Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. Tim Wakeley is the father of Mabel's child but cannot lose his Oxford scholarship, so Roddy promises never to reveal the truth and accepts expulsion from the school in his place. Held at knifepoint on the castle roof as the thing that would stop Goemon fighting, Murasaki throws herself off it and takes Kazami down with her.

Both turn on one party fixes the account of what happened or of who someone is, and the party it concerns has no purchase on it, whatever they say.. After Franzis attacks the asylum director and is strapped into a straitjacket, the director announces to the staff that he now understands Franzis's delusion and can cure him, and Franzis has no answer to it. The official account of the night in Stammheim is that Baader, Ensslin and Raspe killed themselves, and the film keeps returning to people who cannot make it hold: Fassbinder with his mother, Biermann singing Girl in Stuttgart, Mahler in his cell.

Both turn on one party takes control of the thing another cannot do without and sets the terms of its release, and they disagree about it. Casoni takes Lori and offers her life against the end of the investigation, the same trade Calabresi tried to make with him before the train. Jimmy pulls a gun on Sydney and demands $10,000 to keep quiet about the Atlantic City killing, settles for $6,000 from the casino cashier, and Sydney later waits in Jimmy's house and shoots him, taking the cash back.

Both turn on whom a person is bound to is settled by parties outside the bond for ends of their own, and the one bound must go on living inside it.. Mr Robinson pulls Elaine out of college and settles her marriage to Carl, and she is at the altar in Santa Barbara before she breaks it. Clarisse is to be married to the Count who rules in her name, because the wedding fixes his regency and puts her ancestral ring beside his over the treasure; she is drugged for the ceremony.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it, and they disagree about it. Once Bottoni confides that he will lose his job if the thief is not taken, Esposito decides to deliver himself to prison so the sergeant is not ruined. Hye-young is shot in the neck and left mute trying to shield Jeong Woo from a gangster's bullet, and later steps into the bullet fired at Park Yi and dies.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Birju, embittered since childhood by Sukhilala's demands and driven out as a bandit after seizing back his mother's pawned kangan, returns on Rupa's wedding day to kill Sukhilala and carry off his daughter. After his donkey Jenny chokes to death on one of Colm's severed fingers, Pádraic announces at the pub that he will burn Colm's house down at 2 pm the next day, and does so with Colm sitting inside.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Chantal, having overheard the priest's talk with her mother, tells the Count that the priest drove the Countess to despair, and the priest will not clear himself with the Countess' letter of thanks before the church investigator. Neville puts the models' photographs in Tommy's flat and one of Tommy's playing cards under Donald's body, and after Tommy is shot in the street he tells Laura a whole invented life to explain him.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. The roll call of Irish and foreign writers banned by the censorship board is read over church bells rung as at a funeral, and emigration is named as what the bans produced. McAra drowns after discovering Lang's torture-flight involvement and Ruth's recruitment, and the Ghost, having decoded the same message from the first words of McAra's chapters and passed a note to Ruth, is hit by an accelerating car outside the book launch.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out, and they disagree about it. After Thomas enlarges the frames showing the gunman in the trees and the shape on the ground, a man follows him and looks into his car, his studio is ransacked, and every negative and print is taken except one grainy blow-up. Once Anna's uncle Stepan has translated Tatiana's diary naming Semyon as her rapist, Semyon burns the diary and orders Nikolai to kill Stepan, who instead hides him in a hotel in Edinburgh.

Both turn on one party takes into its own house and keeping someone with no claim to be there. The three men find an abandoned baby at the Rashōmon gate and the woodcutter carries it away saying he will raise it alongside his own children, which restores the monk's faith. Brad and Midge Sheridan set out to adopt Danny, a foundling abandoned at a police station and made a ward of the juvenile court, and Brad finally talks Mrs. Morrow into approving the adoption.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. The roll call of Irish and foreign writers banned by the censorship board is read over church bells rung as at a funeral, and emigration is named as what the bans produced. After Charlie is caught watching Susan Orlean and Laroche take the ghost-orchid drug and have sex, Orlean decides he must be killed to stop him exposing them and drives him into the swamp at gunpoint.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Anders recruits Gregg, Agostino, Jean-Paul and Erich for the Rio diamond job while secretly partnered with Mary Ann, who swaps the diamonds for an empty case, so the four experts do the work and die for a purpose they were never told about. Irmgard talks Anzell into overcharging on the round and splitting it with her, knowing Hans follows his man through the courtyards, so that the one witness to her affair is sacked as a thief.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out, and they disagree about it. Moose overhears Rosa and Latimer planning her divorce and remarriage and threatens to tell Latimer about her pregnancy himself, so Rosa shoots him dead on the hunting trip and claims she mistook him for a deer. Wanda is holding recordings of Don Garofalo and Legrand, which is why her dinner was poisoned and why Garofalo puts a man on her when she runs for the border.

edges.a: the bird with the crystal plumage
edges.aTitle: The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
edges.claim: Both turn on one party covers what another did so that the other never has to answer for it, and they disagree about it. Alberto covers his wife's killings, commits some of them himself, and as he falls from the window confesses to the whole series. The probation report that would have sent Tino Zapatti to prison on his drug conviction was suppressed and Judge Stern, installed by an Anselmo bribe, left him free on probation — until the report is recovered from Anselmo's car.

Both turn on one party takes another up while they serve its purpose and drops them, with no cause given, once they do not. St. Joseph's scout recruits Arthur Agee out of West Garfield Park, then at the end of freshman year he is put out of the school because his family cannot pay tuition, while Gates's fees are covered by his Encyclopedia Britannica sponsor; Agee's confidence collapses and he finishes at John Marshall. Wells seduces Crowe to get him to murder Grimes, then rebuffs his affections once she controls the Toolshed, having used him for what she wanted.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back. Mikey tells them they may fill their pockets but must leave what sits on the scales in front of One-Eyed Willy, and it is the Fratellis grabbing that which brings the grotto down. Sadazo, expecting to die in the Philippines, asks Matsuyama to carry his wife Tomoko's postcard back to her and say he received it before dying; after the war Matsuyama makes his way to Tomoko's house to discharge that errand.

Both turn on one party keeps giving to a bond the other will not return, and no reason is given that the giving can work on.. Cecilia finally writes what she cannot say to his face - that to be loved by him she would have to be dead - and lights the last candle for him herself. Jacob is with Eleni from the Temirtau newsreel in 1953, is ditched when she jumps on the tram with Spyros, crosses the Hungarian border with her in 1973 only for her to end it and send him on to Israel, and after visiting her and Spyros in Berlin in 1999 he drowns himself in the Spree.

Both turn on the harm arrives through the very party charged with keeping the other safe, often done in the name of keeping them.. Told by Taraprasad that Harasundari has smuggled in a doctor for the feverish Khoka, Kalikinkar instead brings the boy to Doyamoyee for charanamrito and a night in her arms, and Khoka is dead by morning. Humbert marries Charlotte to be near Dolores, becomes her sole guardian after Charlotte's death, and travels the country with her publicly as father and daughter while sleeping with her and policing her contact with boys and the school play.

edges.a: the plot of the fuma clan
edges.aTitle: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
edges.claim: Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. Held at knifepoint on the castle roof as the thing that would stop Goemon fighting, Murasaki throws herself off it and takes Kazami down with her. Schindler spends his entire fortune over seven months on bribes and on shell casings bought from other companies, and is broke by the German surrender in 1945, so that his workers survive.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back, and they disagree about it. Finding Japanese corpses unburied along the road to Mudon, Mizushima keeps the stolen monk's robe and writes that he cannot go home until every fallen soldier is buried. Hanshirō says Motome, Miho and Kingo have every right to ask him whether justice has been exacted for their deaths, and comes to the Iyi courtyard to answer that question before joining them.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them, and they disagree about it. Sergeant Bottoni is given three months to catch the small-time swindler Esposito or lose his job, and the pursuit ends not in capture but in Esposito walking himself to prison while Bottoni is reluctant to take him. Nikki/Sue, feeling stalked by the Phantom, arms herself with a screwdriver, and finally shoots him in the Axxon N. apartment, where he transforms into a grotesque figure with her own face before dying.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Everyone who came near the Moroni kidnapping is taken off: Paradisi beheaded by the excavator, its driver hanged to look like suicide, Paradisi's wife strangled at the tram stop, the kindergarten teacher cut up with a circular saw, Mattia beaten with a statue, and finally the old woman who happens to own the mirror. Tino's cousin Vinnie is found dead after telling Calhoun why Santos approached Tino, Schwartz is murdered mid-phone-call with Calhoun while holding the incriminating probation report, and Zapatti orders Anselmo to shoot himself so he cannot become an informant.

edges.a: the plot of the fuma clan
edges.aTitle: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
edges.claim: Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it, and they disagree about it. Held at knifepoint on the castle roof as the thing that would stop Goemon fighting, Murasaki throws herself off it and takes Kazami down with her. Hye-young is shot in the neck and left mute trying to shield Jeong Woo from a gangster's bullet, and later steps into the bullet fired at Park Yi and dies.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Tino's cousin Vinnie is found dead after telling Calhoun why Santos approached Tino, Schwartz is murdered mid-phone-call with Calhoun while holding the incriminating probation report, and Zapatti orders Anselmo to shoot himself so he cannot become an informant. McAra drowns after discovering Lang's torture-flight involvement and Ruth's recruitment, and the Ghost, having decoded the same message from the first words of McAra's chapters and passed a note to Ruth, is hit by an accelerating car outside the book launch.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it, and they disagree about it. With the house surrounded by soldiers and Rikyū's plan to send her to Ukon and kill himself foreclosed, Ogin prepares to take her own life and sends her maid with a farewell note written on a fan to Ukon in Kaga. Rowdy, going in for surgery on a burst vessel in his brain, asks Cole to drive his car at Daytona so that his sponsor will pay out his year.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them. After the botched cocaine transaction Wong and Hon each set their man to find the other's mole, so Lau, assigned by both the HKPF and Hon, hunts the very Chan who is hunting him. Nikki/Sue, feeling stalked by the Phantom, arms herself with a screwdriver, and finally shoots him in the Axxon N. apartment, where he transforms into a grotesque figure with her own face before dying.

Both turn on one party puts another into a position that lowers them in the eyes of those watching. In La parolaccia the successful author tells the struggling first-novelist to write out his most depraved fantasies, then humiliates him in front of the assembled literary society when he presents the result. The papers drop the pizzeria shooting almost at once, and Nicola, his wife Laura and their daughter Patrizia make a joke of the accountant with the pistol in front of each other.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Birju, embittered since childhood by Sukhilala's demands and driven out as a bandit after seizing back his mother's pawned kangan, returns on Rupa's wedding day to kill Sukhilala and carry off his daughter. John and Tommy shoot Nokes dead in a Hell's Kitchen pub after he dismisses what he did to them, and Michael builds the whole trial as an instrument of revenge on the remaining Wilkinson guards, with Addison abducted and killed by Rizzo's brother Eddie.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out, and they disagree about it. Wanda is holding recordings of Don Garofalo and Legrand, which is why her dinner was poisoned and why Garofalo puts a man on her when she runs for the border. Dolores threatens to take the affair to Miriam and can also describe the financial dealings that built the practice, so Judah has her shot and goes to the flat himself for the letters.

Both turn on the person telling the truth is the one nobody credits, and they disagree about it. Jared tells his mother and siblings he has found Arthur's Field Guide and that fairies are real; Helen disbelieves him through the car argument until the goblins break the mushroom circle and the family has to fight them off in the kitchen. Laura has told Fuller for eight months that accepting the company's small settlement killed his claim, and he only accepts it when she takes him to a second, male lawyer who says exactly the same thing.

Both turn on parties bound to each other by service, alliance or company come to act against each other. Moreau brings in his friend Delmas to help find the diplomat, then threatens to take the film by force and finally punches him at the Pike Slip Inn over the corpse photographs. Tetsuo goes through everyone who has ever held him up - the Capsules, Kaneda, the espers, Shikishima - and kills Yamagata at the Harukiya over the bike he took.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Jonas whips Claire for arranging the burial at the fort and keeps her outside the cave through the storm until she takes pneumonia. He holds her down and sodomises her with a stick of butter, and she tells him afterwards that she tries to leave and cannot make herself do it.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Tino's cousin Vinnie is found dead after telling Calhoun why Santos approached Tino, Schwartz is murdered mid-phone-call with Calhoun while holding the incriminating probation report, and Zapatti orders Anselmo to shoot himself so he cannot become an informant. After Charlie is caught watching Susan Orlean and Laroche take the ghost-orchid drug and have sex, Orlean decides he must be killed to stop him exposing them and drives him into the swamp at gunpoint.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. After Thomas enlarges the frames showing the gunman in the trees and the shape on the ground, a man follows him and looks into his car, his studio is ransacked, and every negative and print is taken except one grainy blow-up. Lt Yoon, the medical officer who oversaw the tortured detainees, agrees to describe the torture methods in court, and Cha's superiors frame him for desertion to nullify his testimony and send him to prison.

Both turn on one party moves another to carry out the deed in its place while itself staying clear of it, and they disagree about it. Carl-Magnus does not confront Frederich; he sends his wife Charlotte to call on Anne Egerman and put the affair in front of her. Brahmananda Acharya invites Goopy and Bagha to Anandagarh fort and sets them to steal three valuable stones with their ghost-given powers while he stays clear of the theft, paying them with a promise of twenty years' youth he knows he cannot deliver.

Both turn on one party keeps another inside a position they can neither leave nor advance from. Jack smashes the two-way radio and disables the snowcat, so that when Wendy has him unconscious on the pantry floor there is still no way down the mountain. Holly shoots and wounds Keller at her house and drops him into the hidden pit in her yard, where he finds Anna's whistle and Loki only faintly hears it blowing at the end.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Gruneman walked in on Cable beating Jane McKenna, so Cable wrote to Bree in Gruneman's name and left the letter in his office to make him the man in the black book. The detective who handled the hijacking harasses Makoto over a neighbourhood woman's murder without evidence and later arrests and questions him over a second killing, while the murderer is in fact Naoki.

Both turn on one party works on another to turn them back from a course that would undo them. Mae, worn out, puts it to Tom that he is losing to Wade and to the river both and should stop, and he goes back out to the sandbags on his own. Darek means to stay inside and go on with the hunger strike; Labrador builds a defence around union men swearing he is no danger to anyone, and sends his junior into the cell to talk him out of the strike, and the sentence is suspended.

Both turn on what one party shaped, taught or set in motion refuses the purpose it was given and comes back on the one who made it.. Shortly after the pastor berates his daughter in front of the confirmation class, she takes scissors to his parakeet's cage and he finds the bird on his desk impaled in the shape of a cross. Ava, the AI Nathan built and tested, attacks him with Kyoko's help and pulls the knife from his back to stab him in the chest, then takes his ID card and the helicopter meant for Caleb.

Both turn on two parties are closed in with each other and neither can leave. Kamegoro, his grandson and the two crewmen are closed in aboard a ship that has lost all navigation and drifts for weeks, until a ship blown off course by a typhoon finds them. The sea takes the inflatable, their one way off the rock, and the two of them are left on it with no provisions and fish they cannot live on.

Both turn on a marriage is entered for money, standing or cover rather than love. Julia Fotheringale marries Roddy after his £30,000 inheritance, keeps up her affair with her leading man Archie, and discards him once the money is spent and his mansion swindled away. Morlacchi's marriage to the Countess Cristiana was only a means of making himself heir to her fortune, which she grasps when she finds him rifling her desk for her jewelry.

Both turn on one party settles the terms of its own death and requires those bound to it to stand by and let it happen. Having sent Tarō off with the letter, Iwakichi sets fire to his own shack and dies of the burns, leaving the boy to carry his ashes off the island. Simon walks out of the hotel with the case of heroin, reaches inside his overcoat for a gun he is not carrying, and Coleman finds the empty pocket afterwards.

Both turn on a life or a freedom is settled with a payment. Schindler pays Göth a huge bribe for the workers named on the list Stern types, and bribes Auschwitz commandant Höss again when the women and girls are misrouted to Birkenau. On the slaughterhouse ramp Mija holds out her grandfather's solid gold pig to Nancy, who takes it as a sound business deal and lets Okja walk out.

Both turn on one party hunts another who survives only by staying ahead of it, and the chase works on both of them. Nikki/Sue, feeling stalked by the Phantom, arms herself with a screwdriver, and finally shoots him in the Axxon N. apartment, where he transforms into a grotesque figure with her own face before dying. Recombinant Quaritch hunts Jake Sully across Pandora, forcing him to abandon the Omatikaya for the Metkayina reefs, until Quaritch tracks Norm and Max's aircraft to the archipelago and Jake resolves he can no longer keep running.

Both turn on one party gives a dependent it was bound to keep out of its own hands into someone else's. Pregnant and upset, Anna insists the orphan Petrus the Bergmans took in be sent away, saying she never agreed to a permanent adoption and dislikes him; Petrus overhears, carries baby Dag to an icy river, and leaves after Henrik slaps him down. Ryōta and Midori permanently exchange Keita, the son they raised for six years, into the Saiki household after first offending the Saikis by proposing to buy both boys.

Both turn on one party holds a truth belonging to another's own life and manages what that other is allowed to believe about it.. Kameda's father left him a large ranch which Ono sold through Kayama, and Kameda knows nothing of the inheritance until Ono's daughter Ayako teases him about it. Cohaagen has had Hauser's memory wiped and replaced with the Quaid identity, a wife and a construction job, so that Quaid lives a life whose facts about himself are administered by Cohaagen until the Rekall visit and the recorded message begin to surface them.

Both turn on the help arrives from the person with the most reason to withhold it. Sefton, whom these men have just beaten as an informer and who despises Dunbar as a rich boy who only passed officer school on his family's money, is the one who goes into the water tower and gets Dunbar out of the camp. Blasi deliberately lets his prisoners Richardson and Burke escape, and later Richardson refuses to hand the captured Italians or their weapons over to the hostile headman and decides instead to arm his own prisoners when the village surrounds them.

Both turn on one party presses another to hand over the account of themselves or of a past act that the other would rather keep. Coleman takes Louis at a restaurant table and works him at the precinct until the one man who looked unbreakable gives up Simon's and Paul's names. Lamont comes to the institute to make Regan account for how Merrin died, Tuskin blocks him and then hypnotises Regan herself, and the girl keeps saying she remembers nothing of Georgetown.

Both turn on one party will not concede what everyone around them treats as already settled, and the group's agreement is exactly what cannot move them.. Gabi Teichert will not teach the German history in the syllabus as settled and goes digging into Mayerling, the Spartacists and Rommel's poisoning, to her superiors' alarm, and sits taking notes through the SPD conference. Cordelia will not produce the profession the room requires, and Will Jr says in voice-over that everything organising itself around her silence, wanting to silence her silence, is what produces the violence.

Both turn on word entrusted to a carrier does not arrive as sent, and they disagree about it. Ada sends Flora to Baines with a piano key engraved with a love declaration, and Flora, now bonded to Stewart as a father, hands the package to him instead. Mija tells the ALF through K that she only wants Okja returned to the mountains, and K deliberately translates it as agreement to the plan to let Okja be recaptured with a recorder in her ear.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Pris works on J. F. Sebastian's loneliness until he takes her in, and Roy uses him and his access to get to the top of the Tyrell pyramid; Sebastian is reported dead soon after. Red burns his own brig so no one can retreat, quietly has Boomako ready a boat for the throne alone, and rows away leaving the surviving crew in the water.

Both turn on one party takes another up while they serve its purpose and drops them, with no cause given, once they do not. Shot in the supermarket robbery, he is replaced on the security run by a harder ex-carabinieri marshal, and after the ambush and the days in jail Griffo drops him altogether. St. Joseph's scout recruits Arthur Agee out of West Garfield Park, then at the end of freshman year he is put out of the school because his family cannot pay tuition, while Gates's fees are covered by his Encyclopedia Britannica sponsor; Agee's confidence collapses and he finishes at John Marshall.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. Father Suryn takes Mother Joan's eight demons into himself through his love for her and then damns himself by doing Satan's bidding so that she may be saved. Hye-young is shot in the neck and left mute trying to shield Jeong Woo from a gangster's bullet, and later steps into the bullet fired at Park Yi and dies.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Beaten by her mother until she gives a name, Angela says Santiago Nasar, though the two were never seen together and she never alters a word of it in twenty-seven years. The detective who handled the hijacking harasses Makoto over a neighbourhood woman's murder without evidence and later arrests and questions him over a second killing, while the murderer is in fact Naoki.

edges.a: portrait of a lady on fire
edges.aTitle: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
edges.claim: Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Marianne is installed in the house as Héloïse's hired walking companion so she can memorise her face on the coastal walks and paint her in secret, until she confesses the commission and destroys the first portrait. Michelle spends the film insisting she is only a pharmaceutical CEO and offering Teddy a revised Atlantis-and-ark history to placate him, then walks into her office closet, teleports to the mothership and is revealed as the Andromedan emperor, who domes the Earth and kills every human.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way.. Camille is hired to sit with Simon Cinéma nightly to talk about cinema, and uses that nightly access — steering him toward thoughts of Vincent's return, feigning ignorance when 'Vincent' is introduced — to work the inheritance scheme that would fund Mica's short film. Nikolai is taken in as Semyon's driver and Kirill's bodyguard, is sponsored for full vor membership and tattooed with stars on knees and chest, while actually working as an undercover FSB agent who then has Semyon arrested for the statutory rape of Tatiana.

Both turn on one party puts another out of the world because that other stands between it and what it means to hold or gain, and they disagree about it. King Zog is in Vienna in 1931 to see a lover and his opponents are waiting on the opera-house steps; he draws and fires back and lives. Told by Henriette that a man is locked in their seaside hut, Maloin goes there, calls Brown's name, steps inside and comes out breathing heavily — having killed the one man hunting the briefcase he had taken.

Both turn on what one party shaped, taught or set in motion refuses the purpose it was given and comes back on the one who made it.. Roy gets past Sebastian into the penthouse to ask Tyrell for more life, is told the four years cannot be altered and is praised for his design, and kisses him and puts his thumbs through his eyes. Shortly after the pastor berates his daughter in front of the confirmation class, she takes scissors to his parakeet's cage and he finds the bird on his desk impaled in the shape of a cross.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Jonas whips Claire for arranging the burial at the fort and keeps her outside the cave through the storm until she takes pneumonia. Sweetie arrives back with Bob and takes the house over - Kay's clothes ruined, the furniture broken, everyone managed round her rages and then forgiven the next morning.

Both turn on a child is claimed at once by those who bore them and those who keep them, and where the child belongs is settled between the adults., and they disagree about it. Kate returns to take the baby and tells Pete he is not its father, Pete refuses to believe her or give the child up, and only after the courtroom scene do Kate and Philip come to the cottage and carry the child away. After the hospital reveals Keita and Ryūsei were switched at birth, the Nonomiyas and the Saikis meet, share photos and negotiate between themselves whether to keep the boys they raised or take back their biological sons.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. On the night Mussolini falls Marcello shouts that Lino murdered the Quadris, and then denounces his blind friend Italo as a Fascist to the crowd that carries him off. With the chief's post open, Li fixes the dead chief's offence on Jing, his colleague and oldest friend, and Jing resigns in disgust believing it was the third candidate.

Both turn on the deceived party finds the deception out. Yasumi lets Mr. Aoki believe she will elope with him so he pays off her debts and embezzles to do it; when he confronts her and finds she never meant to marry him he attacks her and nearly kills her. Jef walks back into the club making no attempt to be unseen, puts on his working gloves in front of the room and levels an unloaded gun at Valerie so the waiting police will shoot.

Halley turns Cliff down gently and goes to London, and comes back engaged to Lester, who had sent her white roses round the clock for days.

Caleb, who had begun to reciprocate Ava's professed romantic interest, is told by Nathan that she only pretended feelings for him, and it is confirmed when Ava walks past him, locks the glass door and ignores his pleas.

Mr Ahankhah, having seen a magazine photograph of a younger, darker Makhmalbaf, brings the journalist Farazmand into the house to identify him, and Farazmand photographs the arrest for a piece called Bogus Makhmalbaf Arrested.

The hannya mask she took from the samurai she tricked into the pit will not come off after the rain, and when the daughter-in-law breaks it away with a mallet the older woman's own face is disfigured like the samurai's, so that she is fled from as the demon she pretended to be. Katrin hands Nicholas to her brother and is paid in the use of the male creature, which kills her in the act.

Legrand offers the siblings money to let the cat business drop and Ofelia takes the stand against him instead, and explains in open court how the poison was meant for Wanda.

Hale has Minnie, Anna, Henry Roan, and Reta and Bill killed — the last by a house bombing — so that Mollie's headrights concentrate and pass through Ernest to him.

Quilty removes Dolores from the hospital by claiming to be her uncle, and Humbert — devastated — spends three years unable to find her, learning her whereabouts only when she writes asking for money. With the house surrounded by soldiers and Rikyū's plan to send her to Ukon and kill himself foreclosed, Ogin prepares to take her own life and sends her maid with a farewell note written on a fan to Ukon in Kaga.

edges.a: the passion of joan of arc
edges.aTitle: The Passion of Joan of Arc
edges.claim: Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding, and they disagree about it. After being taken to view the torture chamber and then threatened with burning at the stake, Joan breaks and lets a priest guide her hand in signing a confession, for which she is sentenced to life imprisonment. Dixon refuses to sign Viktor's emergency visa and threatens to prosecute his airport friends and deport Gupta to India on an assault charge unless Viktor boards the plane home, and Viktor agrees until Gupta's act frees him.

edges.a: the man who shot liberty valance
edges.aTitle: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance

Liberty Valance terrorises Shinbone unchecked — robbing Ranse, bullying him in Ericson's steakhouse, wrecking the Star office and beating Peabody — because Marshal Appleyard is too cowardly to act. Gérard, who takes charge of Balthazar at the bakery out of jealousy over Marie's affection, beats the donkey and prepares to bludgeon him to death, and holds Marie in a violent relationship that ends with him and his gang stripping, beating and locking her in the barn.

Beaten by her mother until she gives a name, Angela says Santiago Nasar, though the two were never seen together and she never alters a word of it in twenty-seven years.

Burning, Howie tells Summerisle that the orchards fail because the climate will not carry them and that the islanders will put him in the fire next year, and nobody on the hill takes it up.

Nikki/Sue, feeling stalked by the Phantom, arms herself with a screwdriver, and finally shoots him in the Axxon N. apartment, where he transforms into a grotesque figure with her own face before dying.

Michelle spends the film insisting she is only a pharmaceutical CEO and offering Teddy a revised Atlantis-and-ark history to placate him, then walks into her office closet, teleports to the mothership and is revealed as the Andromedan emperor, who domes the Earth and kills every human.

Francis Preston Blair controls the conservative faction's votes Lincoln cannot pass the amendment without, and releases them only on condition that Lincoln authorise his peace mission to the Confederates.

Michael Perry and Jason Burkett kill Sandra Stotler for her car, and then, locked out of her gated community, wait for her grandson Adam and kill him and his friend Jeremy Richardson to get Adam's gate-opener.

Stripped and painted black in the childhood tree house, Sweetie will not come down for any of them and keeps rocking the fort until it comes out of the tree, killing her and injuring Flo underneath.

With Ben talking him through it, Willy drives the car off the road on purpose so that the twenty thousand of insurance will set Biff up in business.

Caligari sends the somnambulist Cesare out at night to stab the town clerk and Alan in their beds while Caligari keeps a dummy in the box to appear innocent. Frank Coutelle visits Richard Yellow Hawk in prison, offers a reduced sentence for favors and then blackmails him with the threat of return, using him to kill Leo Fast Elk and inflame the reservation while Frank runs the official investigation.

Park picks out the scarred, mentally handicapped Baek Kwang-ho on the strength of eye contact and his girlfriend's gossip, and Cho beats a confession out of him until Seo shows the boy could not have committed the crimes.

Bernard cannot get free of Muriel, the girl he helped torture and murder during his service in Algeria, and writes in the journal Alphonse finds that since her death he is 'no longer alive'.

Travis telephones his father to say he is in love with Jonni, and his father talks him down by telling him about his own dalliance before the wedding - with Jonni listening.

Insulted by Peadar at the market, Pádraic publicly announces that Peadar beats Dominic, and later, drunk in the pub, publicly accuses him of molesting his son.

Mr Robinson pulls Elaine out of college and settles her marriage to Carl, and she is at the altar in Santa Barbara before she breaks it.
