Married to Piotrek — who watches her celebrate from a distance and warns Devon of 'dark consequences' — Nikki begins an affair with her co-star Devon that mirrors the script of On High in Blue Tomorrows.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Wendy and Danny are inside the marriage that once put the boy's shoulder out of its socket, and by February it is Jack coming through the bathroom door with the axe. In the Inland Empire strand Nikki is stuck in a physically abusive marriage to Smithy in their working-class home, which Polish men periodically visit.

Both turn on one party keeps attendance on another who can no longer answer or meet them, and goes on addressing them anyway, and they disagree about it. The janitor stares into his wife's cell and attends her through examinations and her morning walk though she never recognises him, and at the end he can no longer reach her ward because the doctor has picked up the keys he lost. Merrick shows Treves and Ann the photograph of his mother, says he must have been a disappointment to her and hopes she would be proud to see him among friends, and dies to her voice.

Both turn on one party turns the judging power against the weaker side, who is left without redress, and they disagree about it. When the conditions of the mother-in-law's loan are disputed, the village elders rule in favour of the moneylender Sukhilala, fixing the three-quarters-of-the-crop interest on Radha and Shamu with no appeal. The mayor's assistant promises a real investigation and is stopped by political pressure, and the district attorney keeps the grand jury questions narrow so that how far the corruption goes never gets said.

Both turn on one party sees plainly what is true and cannot get it credited by the people who would have to act on it, and the cost falls where they said it would.. Tadokoro tells the cabinet after Amagi that more eruptions and quakes are coming and is dismissed as an alarmist; the Tokyo earthquake follows and kills three million. Chunk gets to a telephone and gives the sheriff the whole thing - the Fratellis, the bodies in the freezer, the tunnel - and the sheriff files it with his other stories.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest, and they disagree about it. Marta, pregnant by Martin, finds him refusing to hear her news the day his brothers bring word of their father's death, and when he raises parting ways she tells him she was only joking about having something to say, then bears the child without him. She has never told her husband about the German soldier at Nevers, and the architect is elated when he learns that the story she has just told him has been kept from her husband.

Both turn on one party names another's concealed life or wrong in front of those who did not know of it, and they disagree about it. Anonymous letters arrive at the house telling Andreas that his wife is sleeping with the American archaeologist. Mr Ahankhah, having seen a magazine photograph of a younger, darker Makhmalbaf, brings the journalist Farazmand into the house to identify him, and Farazmand photographs the arrest for a piece called Bogus Makhmalbaf Arrested.

Both turn on one party keeps another inside a position they can neither leave nor advance from, and they disagree about it. After the German's death her parents lock her alternately in her bedroom and the cellar in Nevers while her shaved hair grows out and she comes out of her madness. Jack smashes the two-way radio and disables the snowcat, so that when Wendy has him unconscious on the pantry floor there is still no way down the mountain.

Both turn on a wanting that arrives after a binding already made cannot be had without breaking it, and one of the two people must be given up.. Travis is marrying the girl he has known his whole life and spends the eve of it in Dallas with the saleswoman who sold him the car. Married to Piotrek — who watches her celebrate from a distance and warns Devon of 'dark consequences' — Nikki begins an affair with her co-star Devon that mirrors the script of On High in Blue Tomorrows.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. Dismounted Cossacks form lines at the top of the Odessa steps and advance on unarmed women and children, halting to fire volleys and ignoring their pleas, while cavalry cuts down the survivors at the bottom. Soldiers fire on Gwangju civilians in the street, including those dragging the wounded away, while the state broadcasts that North Korean infiltrators caused the chaos.

edges.a: such a gorgeous kid like me
edges.aTitle: Such a Gorgeous Kid Like Me
edges.claim: Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. The thesis interviews on criminal women become Camille's way out: she gives the sociologist the life story that has him working to clear her, and once she is a singing star she has no further use for him. Lucy Mirando flies Mija to New York and stages a heart-warming reunion with her pig purely to limit PR damage, while Okja is being force-bred and cut for a taste test in the lab.

Both turn on one party is taken in and relied on while acting for an interest that is not the other's, and the trust itself is what opens the way.. Fujiko took the job of chaperoning Julia only so she could get inside the Earth Building and steal the lost prophecies from Douglas's top-floor safe. Clodio Pulcher, kept close as a nephew while Hamilton Crassus III's mind and health decline, works with Wow Platinum to manipulate the old man into handing over control of the Crassus bank; when Crassus learns of the duplicity he strokes out, then kills Wow with a hidden bow and arrow.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own. Rotwang, whose beloved Hel left him to marry Fredersen and died bearing Freder, works his revenge through the false Maria and dies falling from the cathedral roof while fighting Freder. The carabinieri stop the bus with the cocaine on it, and at Peppe's birthday party, mid-sentence about how well it all went, one of the traffickers walks in and shoots him.

edges.b: once upon a time in the west
edges.bTitle: Once Upon a Time in the West
edges.claim: Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own, and they disagree about it. Made stateless, Ferdinand takes his wartime marksman's rifle to the mountain above Assola and fires 'first notice' shots at the property of everyone in his notepad, planning to execute them one by one. Frank once stood a boy under his hanging brother with a harmonica forced into his mouth until the boy's legs gave out; the grown boy waits at Sweetwater and puts the harmonica back into Frank's mouth as he dies.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own, and they disagree about it. Made stateless, Ferdinand takes his wartime marksman's rifle to the mountain above Assola and fires 'first notice' shots at the property of everyone in his notepad, planning to execute them one by one. Teddy Gatz, whose mother Sandy was left comatose by an Auxolith clinical trial, abducts the company's CEO Michelle Fuller with his cousin Don, shaves her head, coats her in antihistamine cream and shocks her with electricity in his basement.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Smitty holds the disappearance of a $50,000 Iraqi bribe over Crowe and threatens prison time to force him to infiltrate the Toolshed as a mole against his will. Zhang Jun pressures Zhong Ping into perming her hair and then, having got her pregnant, forces her into an abortion, after which she eventually cuts off contact with him and the troupe.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back. The charge of raising Sadao is laid on Chieko by Okazuki immediately after Kajiwara's funeral, and she carries it for years without telling the boy. Marcus Aurelius' charge to restore the Roman Republic passes to Maximus, who carries it through the arena and, dying, asks for political reforms and Gracchus' reinstatement as senator.

Both turn on a parent cannot feel toward the child what the child needs. Judy believes her father ignores her now that she is no longer a little girl, and when she dresses in racy clothes to draw his attention he calls her a 'dirty tramp'. Charlotte gives Helena a wristwatch, offers Eva her car, and on the train out asks her agent why the girl could not simply have died.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Takashi, Masaru and Kiyoko were put through the psychic programme as children and are still in the laboratory as old-faced children, and what is left of Akira is in jars under the Olympic site for research. Lucy Mirando flies Mija to New York and stages a heart-warming reunion with her pig purely to limit PR damage, while Okja is being force-bred and cut for a taste test in the lab.

Both turn on one party keeps attendance on another who can no longer answer or meet them, and goes on addressing them anyway. Merrick shows Treves and Ann the photograph of his mother, says he must have been a disappointment to her and hopes she would be proud to see him among friends, and dies to her voice. Every morning Umi raises the signal flags reading "I pray for safe voyages" over Yokohama harbour for her father Yūichirō, killed on a supply ship in the Korean War; by the end she goes on raising them but no longer only for him.

edges.a: once upon a time in the west
edges.aTitle: Once Upon a Time in the West
edges.claim: Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding, and they disagree about it. Frank forces Jill into a sexual encounter and then to put Sweetwater up for auction, where his men frighten off every bidder so he can have it cheap. Clive Park's father threatens to sue Larry for defamation if he calls the envelope of cash a bribe and for theft if he keeps it without passing Clive, and Larry finally changes the grade from F to C−.

Both turn on one party names another's concealed life or wrong in front of those who did not know of it. The commoner deduces in front of the monk that the woodcutter lied at the trial not from fear of trouble but because he stole the wife's dagger, and leaves mocking him for it. Delmas photographs Fèvre-Berthier's corpse — moving it onto the bed for a better shot — to sell the story that the UN delegate died in his mistress Judith's apartment, and at dawn pushes both rolls of film through a storm drain instead.

Both turn on a need is laid before someone with no prior claim or duty, who must decide whether to take up a burden that is not theirs.. Franziska Busch stops her car in the underground garage, gets the man off the woman he is hitting, and takes her home to look after her. Janusz sees through the game somewhere in the small hours and drives on with her anyway without saying so, and only goes home when it gets light.

Both turn on one party knows of a wrong and holds it unspoken — because speaking would ruin them, or because they simply will not — and the silence lets the wrong stand., and they disagree about it. Shakes proposes reporting the abuse before release, but Michael argues nobody would believe or care, and the four boys vow never to speak of it again — a silence held for thirteen years until Ferguson admits the abuse on the witness stand. Franklin Birch is talked out of freeing Alex by his wife Nancy, and the couple decide neither to stop Keller's torture nor to tell the police.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Andrea is publicly tried for the count's murder he did not intend or commit, and is acquitted only when an autopsy shows the count's hearing was sound and he could have saved himself. Anselmo, at Paul Zapatti's behest, plants money to incriminate the dead Detective Eddie Santos and pressures Internal Affairs to portray the decorated cop as dirty, while Cogan and Calhoun work to clear him.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Zhang Jun pressures Zhong Ping into perming her hair and then, having got her pregnant, forces her into an abortion, after which she eventually cuts off contact with him and the troupe. Cha's agents torture Park and the other students until they sign confessions, and Cha then testifies that the bruises were self-inflicted.

Both turn on one party keeps another inside a position they can neither leave nor advance from, and they disagree about it. The sylphs have kept Arthur Spiderwick in their realm for eighty years and refuse to let Jared, Simon and Mallory leave because they know too much about the fairies, until Arthur distracts them with the fake book. Immortan Joe keeps his five 'wives' — Toast, Capable, Cheedo, the Dag and the pregnant Angharad — inside the Citadel as breeders, and leads his entire army to drag them back when they flee in the War Rig; the confinement ends only when Furiosa kills him.

edges.a: jolanda the daughter of the black corsair
edges.aTitle: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair
edges.claim: Both turn on one party stands before another under an identity that is not their own, and the other takes it as true, and they disagree about it. Jolanda, raised to look and bear herself like a young man, enters the Medina palace and reaches Consuelo, who has been madly in love with her since their first meeting six months earlier, deceived by that masculine appearance. Lupin arrives at the floating island disguised as Prince Panish and asks Olèander for the pendant key, which she hands over believing him to be the prince she loves; the nanomachines turn hostile once the disguise breaks.

Both turn on one party's rule or violence sets the condition of another who is bound to them and has no way out from under it. After the fundamentalists win the elections Marji lives under compulsory headscarves, black-market music, fined for holding Reza's hand, and a party raid in which the women are detained and Nima falls to his death fleeing across the rooftops. Soldiers fire on Gwangju civilians in the street, including those dragging the wounded away, while the state broadcasts that North Korean infiltrators caused the chaos.

Both turn on two parties take each other up across a line their people hold as forbidden, and keep it out of sight of those who would move against them. Benjamin meets his father's law partner's wife at the Taft Hotel through the summer, signing the register as Mr Gladstone. Zhang and Zhong keep their out-of-wedlock relationship going on the road until the authorities discover it under interrogation and they are sent back to Fenyang.

Both turn on one person is bound to two parties at once and cannot answer one without wounding the other.. Mascha, having hidden Svoboda, is pulled between saving her hostage father and protecting the assassin: she goes to the Gestapo to denounce him, pleads for her father instead, and finally testifies falsely against Czaka while her father is executed anyway. Spider, raised among the Sullys but recognized as Quaritch's son, teaches his father Na'vi language and culture, then sabotages the RDA vessel, saves Quaritch from drowning, and refuses to stay with him.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it. Andrea is publicly tried for the count's murder he did not intend or commit, and is acquitted only when an autopsy shows the count's hearing was sound and he could have saved himself. District Attorney Cicero prosecuted Cesar for his wife's murder and later admits, as blackmail material offered at the Megalopolis site, that he knew all along she had taken her own life and prosecuted maliciously anyway.

Both turn on one party takes control of the thing another cannot do without and sets the terms of its release. Bandy, whose ranch is the last holdout blocking the Union Oil pipeline and who knows of the murder, sets his price: Daniel must be publicly baptised and repent in Eli's church before he gets the easement. Quaritch seizes Kiri, Tuk, Lo'ak and Spider aboard the whaling ship and demands Jake surrender himself in exchange for his children, later holding a blade to Kiri until Neytiri threatens Spider in return.

Both turn on one party takes onto itself the danger, ruin or loss that belongs to another, so the other does not carry it. Hallorann picks up Danny's call in Florida, flies to Colorado and drives a snowcat up the mountain to a lobby where Jack is waiting with the axe. Djigui lost his sight long ago because he chose to turn the Kore's Wing to his people's use rather than his own.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to, and they disagree about it. Cohaagen explains that Quaid was manufactured out of Hauser purely as a ruse to slip past Kuato's psychic reading and destroy the mutant rebellion — a purpose Quaid himself is never made party to until the base is already massacred. Lucy Mirando flies Mija to New York and stages a heart-warming reunion with her pig purely to limit PR damage, while Okja is being force-bred and cut for a taste test in the lab.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own, and they disagree about it. Made stateless, Ferdinand takes his wartime marksman's rifle to the mountain above Assola and fires 'first notice' shots at the property of everyone in his notepad, planning to execute them one by one. Glaucus returns to find his father murdered and the house looted by the cross-marking hooded band, vows revenge, and hunts them to the Temple of Isis, where Arbaces and Julia are finally crushed by the toppling idol and Gallinus shot in the royal box.

edges.a: the human condition ii road to eternity
edges.aTitle: The Human Condition II: Road to Eternity
edges.claim: Both turn on one party that owes another protection, backing or help stays away at the moment the other most needs it. When Kaji and Yoshida are both caught in quicksand while pursuing the deserting Shinjo, Kaji refuses to pull Yoshida out and lets him sink. Chris demands on TV that Douglas quit the presidential race to get his daughter back, and Douglas refuses, saying the kidnapping will win his campaign sympathy.

Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding. Maganlal offers Feluda two thousand rupees to drop the Ganesh case, and when it is refused he stands Jatayu against a board and has knives thrown around him. The film opens on Menahem Golan on a three-way call telling Godard how long he has taken and that it will be at Cannes in 1987.

Both turn on a friendship is broken by a power neither friend controls, and they disagree about it. The war puts Jules in the Austrian army and Jim in the French one, each spending the conflict fearing he will face the other or learn he has killed his friend. Tom and Beth's divorce splits the four-way friendship into separate confidences — Karen with Beth, Gabe with Tom — until Gabe and Karen admit at Martha's Vineyard that they no longer feel close to either of them.

Both turn on one party spends another on a purpose that other is never made party to. Guy trades his wife's body and the child she carries to the Castevets' coven for the stage role the previous actor went blind to vacate, and she is only told what she was for after the birth. Lucy Mirando flies Mija to New York and stages a heart-warming reunion with her pig purely to limit PR damage, while Okja is being force-bred and cut for a taste test in the lab.

Both turn on a parent leaves and the child is left waiting. Some time after the hijacking the Tamura children's mother abandons the family, and after their father dies in a car crash Naoki and Kozue go on living alone in the house. Richard has left the family for another woman in New York, Jared keeps failing to reach him by phone until Mallory tells him the truth, and Jared ends by refusing to live with his father at all.

Both turn on one party gives a dependent it was bound to keep out of its own hands into someone else's, and they disagree about it. Iwakichi, Tarō's only surviving relative, feeds the boy a last meal, gives him the new shoes he bought and sends him to Takako with a letter, putting the grandson he had kept out of the orphanage into her hands. In 'The baby' the broke young Roman couple carry their newborn to a church to abandon it, but the mother cannot settle on the right spot and the father finally changes his mind and they keep the child.

Both turn on a marriage is entered for money, standing or cover rather than love. Humbert laughs at Charlotte's love letter but marries her anyway purely to stay in the house with Dolores, and his diary — recording his passion for the daughter and contempt for the wife — is what sends Charlotte running into the road. Morlacchi's marriage to the Countess Cristiana was only a means of making himself heir to her fortune, which she grasps when she finds him rifling her desk for her jewelry.

edges.a: i know where i m going
edges.claim: Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back. Torquil, laird of Kiloran, refuses to enter Moy Castle because of the curse the drowned woman laid on every future MacNeil — that he shall never leave it a free man and shall be chained to a woman until he dies — and only enters after Joan has gone, to meet her there. Marcus Aurelius' charge to restore the Roman Republic passes to Maximus, who carries it through the arena and, dying, asks for political reforms and Gracchus' reinstatement as senator.

Both turn on the blame is fixed on someone who did not do it, and they disagree about it. Andrea is publicly tried for the count's murder he did not intend or commit, and is acquitted only when an autopsy shows the count's hearing was sound and he could have saved himself. The Shanghai gang settle the quarrel over Red Monkey's money by using their mainland connections to have the Lin brothers denounced as Japanese collaborators; Wen-liang comes out of the cells with his brain damaged.

Both turn on a need is laid before someone with no prior claim or duty, who must decide whether to take up a burden that is not theirs.. Franziska Busch stops her car in the underground garage, gets the man off the woman he is hitting, and takes her home to look after her. John, broke outside a diner, tells a stranger he needs $6,000 for his mother's funeral, and Sydney — owing him nothing — buys him coffee and takes him to Vegas to win it.

Both turn on the household conceals its ruin to keep its standing. When the daughter tells him her marriage is in trouble, the janitor imagines taking his wife out of the asylum to hide her existence, and dreams of a lottery-won chest of drawers to give her as a dowry. Bottoni hides his suspension from his family, and at the end both men send Esposito off to the station as though he were leaving on a business trip so neither household learns the truth.

Both turn on an arrival occupies the place someone already held. Hans brings his old Legion friend Harry into the business and then into the house; Harry works the cart better than he ever did, and after the funeral stays on with Irmgard. The Prefect of Police is arrested for desecration by officers who will not believe who he is, and is brought to his own office, where another Prefect is already sitting and greets him as an acquaintance.

edges.a: once upon a time in the west
edges.aTitle: Once Upon a Time in the West
edges.claim: Both turn on one party applies pressure, harm or the threat of it until another gives up what they were withholding, and they disagree about it. Frank forces Jill into a sexual encounter and then to put Sweetwater up for auction, where his men frighten off every bidder so he can have it cheap. Zhang Jun pressures Zhong Ping into perming her hair and then, having got her pregnant, forces her into an abortion, after which she eventually cuts off contact with him and the troupe.

Both turn on the deceived party finds the deception out, and they disagree about it. Yasumi lets Mr. Aoki believe she will elope with him so he pays off her debts and embezzles to do it; when he confronts her and finds she never meant to marry him he attacks her and nearly kills her. Columbus signs his crew on by telling them the crossing will take seven weeks; at nine weeks with no land the men grow restless and edge toward mutiny until his speech and a rising wind put them back to their duties.

Both turn on one party moves against another for what that other has learned, to keep it from getting out. Maggie Eagle Bear, who identifies the raffle stub and is pressing the question of the reservation's contaminated water, turns up dead at the Red Deer Table mining site. Greenhill knocks out the investigator Moe and burns his office once Moe has dug up his history of dating older women who end up dead, then comes for Haines as she prepares to disclose everything.

Both turn on a single lie has to be maintained by more of them, and they disagree about it. Rhisley preaches from a fake book of Nostradamus's prophecies, reciting a verse that 'predicted' the hijacking Chris arranged, and later announces the Earth Building will explode while Chris's hypnotised bombers make it happen. The boys invent a secluded beach called Boca del Cielo to impress Luisa at the wedding, and when she takes them up on it they must hurriedly get directions from Saba to a real beach that could pass for it.

Both turn on two parties take each other up across a line their people hold as forbidden, and keep it out of sight of those who would move against them. Katsushirō secretly shares his rice with Shino, whose father Manzō had disguised her as a boy, and the two form a relationship they know their class difference forbids; Manzō beats her when he sees them leave a hut together. Zhang and Zhong keep their out-of-wedlock relationship going on the road until the authorities discover it under interrogation and they are sent back to Fenyang.

Both turn on one party comes to occupy, or is installed in, the place that belongs to someone gone, and is held to it. Zampanò comes back a year after Rosa died on the road with him to ask her mother whether Gelsomina will take Rosa's place, and Gelsomina is handed over to fill it. The nameless writer is hired by Rhinehart to finish Lang's autobiography after the previous ghost McAra drowns, works from McAra's manuscript, drives McAra's car to Emmett's Belmont house, and ends up dead in the street as McAra did on the beach.

Both turn on one party holds out rescue, pity or an easier way and the one it is meant for will not take it. Mary's brothers reluctantly offer John a position and he refuses it as a 'charity job', ending up carrying a sandwich board instead. Colm offers a truce at the pub and later suggests the burnt house has ended the feud, and Pádraic answers that it would have ended only if Colm had stayed inside, adding that some things there is no moving on from.

Both turn on the thing concealed is concealed from the person nearest. She has never told her husband about the German soldier at Nevers, and the architect is elated when he learns that the story she has just told him has been kept from her husband. Lydia hides her pursuit of Olga from Sharon — telling her the fall she took while following Olga home was a mugging — and Sharon, furious at the allegations and the lack of transparency, bars her from seeing Petra.

Both turn on one party covers what another did so that the other never has to answer for it. Marcello tells the priest about the assault, the man he believes he shot dead and his lack of any guilt about it, and is absolved once the priest hears he works for the secret police. Luciano trades wartime services to military intelligence for Dewey's commutation and deportation, and when Siragusa says the commutation was bought his own superiors order the investigation stopped.

Both turn on one party is passed over by someone whose regard they held, in favour of another that person prefers. Henry goes across the hall to the woman he slept with and finds her in her doorway with another man, looking at him. After four or five years with Crimson, Master Wang is refused her hand in marriage, takes up with the younger Jasmin instead, agrees to marry Jasmin and departs for Guangdong, leaving Crimson angered.

Both turn on two parties take each other up across a line their people hold as forbidden, and keep it out of sight of those who would move against them. Zhang and Zhong keep their out-of-wedlock relationship going on the road until the authorities discover it under interrogation and they are sent back to Fenyang. Gozal and Solduz love each other against the village's rule that her umbilical cord was cut in Jacob's name, keep it hidden, plan to elope in a week, and are both shot dead trying to cross the border.

Both turn on one party keeps attendance on another who can no longer answer or meet them, and goes on addressing them anyway, and they disagree about it. Merrick shows Treves and Ann the photograph of his mother, says he must have been a disappointment to her and hopes she would be proud to see him among friends, and dies to her voice. Adult Sophie in New York replays the MiniDV footage from Turkey and, in the rave sequences, pushes through the strobing crowd toward Calum, briefly holding him before he falls from her grasp.

Both turn on an outside party takes a person out of the keeping of those bound to them, who must get them back, and they disagree about it. Rikichi's wife was taken by the bandits in an earlier raid, and when the samurai burn the camp he breaks down at the sight of her; she runs back into the burning barracks rather than return to him. Raoul tricks Meg out of the panic room to fetch Sarah's syringes and the men take the room with Sarah locked inside, then prepare to leave with her as a hostage until Meg ambushes them on the stairs.

Both turn on one party works on another to turn them back from a course that would undo them. When Eugen storms out with a rifle threatening to shoot himself after Rakel's confession, she chases him and fetches an elderly neighbour to talk sense into him. In 'Other people's houses' the old village priest, learning that Zelinda means to end her strenuous, monotonous life, argues her out of it and physically hauls her back up when she slips off the cliff; in 'Mara' Vasco talks Mara out of going to work in a brothel the next morning by offering to keep her on his teacher's wage.

edges.a: the passion of joan of arc
edges.aTitle: The Passion of Joan of Arc
edges.claim: Both turn on one party turns the judging power against the weaker side, who is left without redress. Joan is tried for heresy at Rouen by French clergymen loyal to the Burgundian-English coalition and against her king, judges who work to trap her into self-discrediting answers and finally condemn her to the stake. When the conditions of the mother-in-law's loan are disputed, the village elders rule in favour of the moneylender Sukhilala, fixing the three-quarters-of-the-crop interest on Radha and Shamu with no appeal.

Both turn on one party puts another into a position that lowers them in the eyes of those watching. The boy's father, a cannon-loader, is blamed for a safety mishap on the giant red railway gun and made to stand beside it without safety gear while the lavishly dressed officer fires it again. Xiao Ji is led off the discotheque dance floor by Qiao San's men, who humiliate and beat him for flirting with Qiao Qiao.

Both turn on one party sets out to make another pay in kind for a harm already done to them or to their own, and they disagree about it. After Genshichi attacks Ishimatsu and leaves him badly injured, Sakichi fights his way past the constables to the house where Genshichi is hiding and kills him. After the knife-throwing Feluda swears he will either settle what was done to Jatayu or give up being a detective, and the sting that takes Maganlal is the settlement.

Both turn on the dead leave a charge, a debt or an unfinished work on the living, who carry it and cannot hand it back, and they disagree about it. Bernard cannot get free of Muriel, the girl he helped torture and murder during his service in Algeria, and writes in the journal Alphonse finds that since her death he is 'no longer alive'. Treadwell bequeathed his belongings to ex-girlfriend Jewel Palovak, including the camera holding the audio of his and Huguenard's deaths; she could neither listen to it nor destroy it, put it in a bank vault, and only around 2023 destroyed the tape.

Both turn on one party is passed over by someone whose regard they held, in favour of another that person prefers. After four or five years with Crimson, Master Wang is refused her hand in marriage, takes up with the younger Jasmin instead, agrees to marry Jasmin and departs for Guangdong, leaving Crimson angered. Mr. O'Brien disciplines Jack harshly while cutting R.L. slack because of their shared love of music, and Jack resents being the son passed over.

Both turn on one party keeps another inside a position they can neither leave nor advance from, and they disagree about it.
